(90)be/:rerjes :rdo stuno sheste /)krung da ga pa ba 'jug gnas bka' bstan dpe sdur khang gis dpe bsdur zhus/krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang /

rgyud 'bum/ (mi (9༷ )0585 'phags pa gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 3dang po/ gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 3gnyis pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku tshe'i tshad bstan pa'i le'u/ 6gsum pa/ rmi lam mthong ba'i le'u/ 14bzhi pa/ bshags pa'i le'u/ 15lnga pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la bstod pa me tog padma'i 'byung gnas kyi le'u/ 26drug pa/ stong pa nyid kyi le'u/ 30bdun pa/ rgyal po chen po bzhi'i le'u/ 34brgyad pa/ dbyangs can gyi le'u/ 67dgu pa/ lha mo chen mo dpal gyi le'u/ 73bcu pa/ sa'i lha mo brtan ma'i le'u/ 77bcu gcig pa/ yang dag shes kyi le'u/ 84bcu gnyis pa/ rgyal po'i bstan bcos lha'i dbang po'i dam tshig ces bya

ba'i le'u/ 88bcu gsum pa/ legs par byung ba'i le'u/ 95bcu bzhi pa/ gnod sbyin gyi gnas zhes bya ba kun tu bsrungs pa'i le'u/ 99bcwa lnga pa/ lha'i bu stong phrag bcu lung bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 106bcu drug pa/ nad rab tu zhi bar bya ba'i le'u/ 111bcu bdun pa/ chu 'bebs kyis nya btul ba sngon byung ba'i le'u/ 117bcwa brgyad pa/ stag mo la lus yongs su btang ba'i le'u/ 127bcu dgu pa/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bstod pa'i le'u/ 144nyi shu pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bstod pa'i le'u/ 146nyi shu gcig pa/ mjug bsdus pa'i le'u/ 147bsdur mchan/(150) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(175)0586 stong chen mo rab tu 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i mdo/ 176rgya gar gyi mkhan po shī lend+rabo dhi dang / dzñā na sirnyi dang / shākya pra bha dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba brje ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/slar yang lo tsā ba gzhon nu dpal gyis chos rje chag lo'i rgya dpe dang bstun nas zhu dag par bgyis/bsdur mchan/(236) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(253)0587 rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo/ 254rgya gar gyi mkhan po shī lend+ra bo dhi dang / dzñā 2

na sid dhi dang / shākya pra bha dang / zhu chen gyi lotstsha ba ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(330) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(351)0588 'phags pa rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya'i yang snying zhes bya ba/ 352bsdur mchan/(354) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(354)0589 'phags pa rig pa'i rgyal mo so so 'brang ba chen mo/ 355rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba brje ye shes sdes zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/slar yang lo tsā ba gzhon nu dpal gyis chos rje chag lo'i rgya dpe dang bstun nas zhus dag par bgyis/bsdur mchan/(406) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(420)0590 bsil ba'i tshal chen po'i mdo/ 421paṇḍi ta shī lend+ra bo dhi dang / dzñā na sirnyi dang /shākya pra bha dang / lo tsā ba bande ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos te gtan la phab/phyis 'gos gzhon nu dpal gyis chag lo tsā ba'i phyag dpe las zhus/bsdur mchan/(449) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(456)

0591 gsang sngags chen po rjes su 'dzin pa'i mdo/ 457paṇḍi ta shī lend+ra bo zhi dang / tsā na sirnyi dang /shākya pra bha dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba bande ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(472) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(476)0592 'phags ma 'od zer can zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 477paṇḍi ta a mo gha badzra dang / lo tsā ba dge slong ba ri rin chen grags pas bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(480) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(481)0593 sgyu ma'i 'od zer can 'byung ba'i rgyud las phyung ba'i rtog pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba/ 482bsdur mchan/(500) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(507)0594 'phags ma 'od zer can gyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'od zer can 'byung ba'i rgyud stong phrag bcu gnyis pa las phyung pa'i rtog pa'i snying po bdun brgya pa zhes bya ba/ 508bsdur mchan/(557) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(572)0595 'phags pa rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo rgyal ba can cenas drarmi ba 5734

rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba bande ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(587) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(591)0596 'phags pa rgyal ba can zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 592bsdur mchan/(602) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(606)0597 'phags pa dbang bskur ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 607 rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / tā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lotstsha ba bande ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(611) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(612)0598 'phags pa dbyig dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 613rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shrī la dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba bande ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(618) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(619)0599 'phags pa dug sel ces bya ba'i rig sngags/ 620bsdur mchan/(623) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(625)0600 bklags pas grub pa bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma sor mo can zhes bya ba rig pa'i rgyal mo/ 626

bsdur mchan/(629) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(630)0601 'phags ma chos thams cad kyi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 631bsdur mchan/(632) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(633)0602 'phags pa gtsug gi nor bu zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 634rgya gar gyi mkhan po shī lend+ra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lotstsha ba bande ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(639) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(641)0603 'phags pa yi ge drug pa'i rig sngags/ 642bsdur mchan/(644) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(645)0604 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa'i gzungs/ 646bsdur mchan/(647) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(647)0605 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa'i gzungs/ 648bsdur mchan/(649) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(649)6

0606 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong pa'i gzungs/ 650bsdur mchan/(651) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(651)0607 pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi snying po'i gzungs/ 652bsdur mchan/(653) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(653)0608 pha rol tu phyin pa drug gzung bar 'gyur ba'i gzungs/ 654bsdur mchan/(655) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(656)0609 pha rol tu phyin pa bcu thob par 'gyur ba'i gzungs/ 657bsdur mchan/(658) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(658)0610 tshad med pa bzhi thob par 'gyur ba'i gzungs/ 659bsdur mchan/(660) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(660)0611 shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa gzung bar 'gyur ba'i gzungs/ 661bsdur mchan/(662) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(662)7

0612 'phags pa phal po che gzung bar 'gyur ba'i gzungs/ 663bsdur mchan/(664) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(664)0613 'phags pa sdong po bkod pa'i snying po/ 665bsdur mchan/(666) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(666)0614 'phags pa ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po'i mdo gzung bar 'gyur ba'i gzungs/ 667bsdur mchan/(668) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(668)0615 'phags pa rma bya chen mo'i snying po/ 669bsdur mchan/(670) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(670)0616 'phags ma so sor 'brang ma chen mo gzung bar 'gyur ba'i gzungs/ 671bsdur mchan/(672) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(672)0617 'phags pa lang kur gshegs pa'i mdo thams cad bklags par 'gyur ba'i gzungs/ 673

bsdur mchan/(674) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(675)0618 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can gzhan gyis mi thub ma phyir zlog pa'i rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo'ol 676bsdur mchan/(695) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(701)0619 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can gzhan gyis mi thub pa phyir zlog pa chen mo mchog tu grub pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 702paṇḍi ta pa ra hi ta bha dra dang / lotstsha ba gzu dga' rdor gyis kha che'i bdud rtsi 'byung gnas kyi gtsug lag khang gi dpe rnying la gtugs nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(718) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(723)0620 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can gzhan gyis mi thub pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 724bsdur mchan/(736) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(739)9

0621 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can gzhan gyis mi thub pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 740gtsug tor lha yul ma chung ba kha che'i paṇḍi ta ma hā tshwa nas rang 'gyur du mdzad/bsdur mchan/(753) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(758)0622 de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs rtog pa dang rbecas pa 759paṇḍi ta chos kyi sde dang / khams pa lotstsha ba dge slong ba ris bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(778) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(782)0623 de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs rtog pa dang bcas pa/ 783bsdur mchan/(795) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(798)0624 de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs rtog pa dang bcas pa 799bsdur mchan/(802) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(803)0625 'phags pa ngan 'gro thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gtsug 10

tor rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 804rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su rend+ra bo dhe dang / zhu chen gyi lotstsha ba bande ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(815) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(818)0626 de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i gzungs zhes bya ba'i rtog pa/ 819mang du thos pa'i lotstsha ba gnas brtan dpal nyi ma rgyal mtshan bzang pos dpal thar pa gling gi gtsug lag khang du rang gis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(825) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(826)0627 kun nas sgor 'jug pa'i 'od zer gtsug tor dri ma med par snang ba de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po dang dam tshig la rnam par lta ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs / 827rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / shī lend+ra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lotstsha ba bande ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(8ri9) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(854)0628 gtsug tor 'bar ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 855bsdur mchan/(856) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(856)11

0629 shes pas thams cad mthar phyin par grub pa'i mchod rten zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 857bsdur mchan/(873) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(877)0630 mchod rten gcig btab na bye ba btab par 'gyur ba'i gzungs / 878bsdur mchan/(880) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(880)0639 snying rje'i mchog ces bya ba'i gzungs/ 881bsdur mchan/(886) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(887)0632 khro bo rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa gsang ba'i rgyud/ 888dang po/ rgyud 'byung ba zhes bya ba/ 888gnyis pa/ yi dgas phal po che'i dkyil 'khor rim par phye ba/ 890gsum pa/ yi dgas phal po che'i dkyil 'khor gyi sngags rim par phye ba/ 896bzhi pa/ be con gyi phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i mchod pa rim par phye ba/ 898lnga pa/ be con gyi phyag rgya'i cho ga zhib mo rim par phye ba/ 901drug pa/ ro langs ma'i cho ga zhib mo rnam par phye ba/ 905bdun pa/ khro bo'i brtul zhugs rim par phye ba/ 923bsdur mchan/(931) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(943)12
pas thod yig tu bsdus te bkod yod/

rog /'phags pa gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/6)༄༅gi /rgya gar skad du/ ārya su barṇa pra bhā sotta ma sru (khutrend+ra rā dza ( nā ma ma hā yā (snyan sru tra/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ bam po dang po/ 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / 'phags pa nyan thos thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 'di skad (gebadag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bya (6)rgod phung po chos kyi dbyings/ /zab mo sangs rgyas spyod yul na/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bzhugs nas ni/ /dag cing rdul rnams med pa yi7)/ /byang chub sems dpa' mchog rnams la/ /mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po ste/ /mnyan nanon shin tu zab pa dang / /yongs su brtags na zab pa nyid/ /gser 'od dam pa 'di 'chad do/ /phyogs bzhir sangs rgyas rnams kyis ni/ /byin gyi rlabs 59ra90—3

kyis byin brlabs (1 pa/ /mi 'khrugs pas ni shar phyogs su/ /rin chen tog gis lho phyogs su/ /'od dpag med kyis 25nub phyogs su/ /rnga ( nisgra yis ni byang phyogs su/ /sdig pa thams cad gzhig 4pa'i phyir/ /bshad pa dam pa bkra shis pa / /sdig pa'i las rnams zad byed pa/ /bde ba thams cad sbyin byed pa/ /sdug bsngal thams cad 'jig 55byed pa/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi gzhi/ /dpal kun gyis ni legs brgyan payi/ /byin gyis brlabs te (yabarjod par bya/ /sems can gang dag dbang po nyams/ /tshe zad pa dang tshe nyams dang / /phun sum tshogs min gang chags dang / /lha rnams rgyab (8༄kyis phyogs pa dang / /mdza' sdug skye bo sdang ba dang / /bran bza' la sogs 99rigatses pa dang / /phan tshun mthun 1 pa ma yin dang / /nor 'gribs pas ni gnod pa dang / /mya ngan ngal dang gnod pa dang / /'jigs pa dang ni phongs 1nyapa dang / /gza' dang rgyu skar byad stems 32dang / /mi bzad nya gdon gyis nyen pa dang / /mya ngan ngal las byung ba yi/ /rmi lam sdig pa mthong na yang / /des ni rab bkrus gtsang ma yin/ /mdo sde dam pa mnyan par bya/ /gang dag yid dge sems dang 1 zhing / /gos gtsang rnams kyis rab brgyan te/ /zab mo sangs rgyas spyod yul ba/ /mdo sde mnyan 15par byed na ni/ /mdo sde 'di yi gzi brjid kyis/ /srog chags kun gyi gnod pa dgas /shin tu mi bzad 'di 'dra ba/ /de dag rtag tu zhi bar 'gyur1 / /'jig rten skyong ba bdag nyid dang / /blon po tshogs kyi dbang phyug bcas/ /gnod sbyin bye ba du ma yis/ /de dag la ni srung yoshebar byed/ /lha mo chen mo dbyangs can dang / /nai rañdza nar 19gnas pa dang / /'byung po'i ma mo 'phrog ma dang / / sa yi na tsholha mo brtan ma dang / /tshangs pa'i 90—4

dbang dang lha dbang dang / /klu dbang mthu chen rnams dang ni/ /mi 'am ci dbang lha min dbang / /de bzhin nam mkha' lding dbang rnams/ /sde dang stobs dang bzhin pa dang / /bcas te de dag der lhags nas/ /nyin dang mtshan mo mi g.yel bar/ /de dag la ni srung 51)bar byed/ /zab mo sangs rgyas spyod yul ba/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba ste/ /bskal pa bye bar rnyed dka' ba/ /mdo 'di (mirab tu bshad par bya/ /gang dag mdo 'di nyan pa dang / /gang dag gzhan la thos byed dang / /gang su rjes su yi rin)rang dang / /gang dag mchod pa byed pa rnams/ /de dag lha dang klu dag dang / /mi dang mi 'am ci dag dang / /lha min gnod sbyin du ma yis/ /bskal pa bye bar mchod par 'gyur/ /srog chags bsod nams med 54 pa rnams/ /de dag bsod nams phung po ni/ /mtha' yas grangs kyang med pa dang / /bsam gyis mi khyab skye bar 'gyur/ /phyogs bcu'i rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / /de bzhin zab mor spyod pa yis(snye/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis kyang / /phyinorab tu gzung (7)bar 'gyur ba yin/ /gtsang ma'i gos rnams rab bgos la/ /dri zhim pa yi gos 'chang zhing / /byams pa'i sems ni nyer bzhag nas/ /g.yel ba med par mchod par bya/ /rang gi sems ni dri med cing / /rgya che bar yang rab byed la/ /sems kyang shin tu dang rinabyed kyis/ /mdo sde dam pa mnyan par gyis/ /gang dag mdo 'di nyan pa ni/ /de dag mi nang legs par 'ongs / /mi yi srid pa legs par thob/ /'tsho ba bde bas 'tsho bar 'gyur/ /gang gi rna ba'i bu gar yang / /bshad pa 'di ni grag (9)'gyur banyu / /de dag dge rtsa sbyangs pa ste/ /sangs rgyas mang pos rab tu bsngags/ /gser 'od 90—5

dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po las/ gleng gzhi'i 6)le'u zhes bya ba ②ste dang po'o// // yang de'i tshe de'i dus na/ rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer chen po na②/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mdzes pa'i tog ces bya ba/ sngon gyi rgyal ba la bsnyen bkur byas pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa/ sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag mang po la rim gro byas pa zhig gnas pa de 'di snyam du sems te / rgyu gang dang rkyen gang gis/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa 'di lta ste/lo brgyad cu 9gezhig thub ste/ 'di ltar sku tshe thung snyam nas/ de yang 'di snyam du sems te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang 'di skad du/ rgyu gnyis dang rkyen gnyis kyis tshe ring bar 'gyur te/ gnyis gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ srog gcod pa spangs pa dang / kha zas rab tu sbyin pa'o zhes gsungs te/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas ni/ bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong grangs med pa mang po nas/ srog gcod pa spangs par gyur pa nas/ dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam gyi bar du yang dag par blangs par gyur(5ci/ zas dang (6)phyi nang gi dngos po rnams sems can dag la yongs su btang ste/ tha na rang gi lus kyi sha dang khrag dang rus pa dang rkang gis kyang sems can ltogs pa rnams tshim par mdzad na/zas gzhan gyis lta ci smos snyam mo/ /de nas skyes (7)bu dam pa de sangs rgyas la song ba'i yid la byed pa dag las/ 'di lta bu'i tshul gyis bsam pa 'di dag sems pa na/ de'i khyim yangs shing rgya che la bee ḍūrya (3)sngon po las grub pa/lha'i rin po che du mas spras pa/ de bzhin gshegs pas kha dog bsgyur ba/90—6

lha'i 6)las 'das pa'i spos kyis khyab par gyur to/ /khyim de'i phyogs bzhi nas lha'i rin po che'i khri bzhi byung bar gyur te/ khri de dag las kyang lha'i (miras bcos bu'i ①rin po che'i ༅phrugs rnams bting ba dag byung bar gyur to/ /khri de dag las kyang lha'i me tog padma rin po che du mas (mispras pa/ de bzhin gshegs pas kha dog bsgyur ba dag byung ngo / /padma de dag las kyang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhi byung bar gyur te/ shar phyogs nas ni de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs pa byung / lho phyogs nas ni de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen tog byung /nub phyogs nas ni de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med byung / byang phyogs nas ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnga (6)sgra byung ste/ seng ge'i khri de dag las sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag byung ma thag tu/ de nas de'i tshe rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer chen po snang ba chen pos khyab par gyur to/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi bar dang / phyogs bcu kun tu 'jig rten gyi khams kyi bar dang /(3) phyogs bcu kun tu 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi bar dag snang bas khyab par gyur/ lha'i me tog dag gi (8)char yang bab/lha'i sil snyan gyi sgra yang 9 byung ngo / /sangs rgyas kyi mthus stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir sems can thams cad kyang lha'i bde ba dang ldan par gyur te/ sems can dbang po ma tshang ba rnams ni dbang po thams cad dang rmo/ tsholdan par gyur/ sems can dmus long dag ni mig 11gis gzugs rnams mthong / sems can 'on pa dag ni rna bas sgra rnams thos/sems can smyos pa dag ni dran pa so sor rnyed/ sems can sems g.yeng ba tshogedag ni sems mi g.yeng bar gyur/ sems can sgren mo dag ni gos bgos par 90—7

gyur / sems can bkres pa dag ni lto 'grangs par gyur/ sems can skom pa dag ni skom ngoms 6)par gyur/ sems can nad kyis btab pa dag ni nad dang bral bar gyur/ lus kyi dbang po nyams pa dag ni dbang po rnams ②tshang bar gyur te/ 'jig rten du ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos rnams rgya cher byung bar gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' mdzes pa'i tog gis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag mthong nas ngo mtshar rmad rmo du gyur te/ de tshim zhing mgu la yi 4)rangs shing rab tu dga' ste/ dga' ba dang yid bde ba skyes nas/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag rnams sgyu 5)rjes su dran la/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i yon tan rjes su dran zhing / bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i sku tshe'i tshad la the tshom za bar gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa 'di ltar lo brgyad cu zhig thub ste sku tshe thung ba 'di ji lta bu/ 'di ci zhig snyam du bsam pa de sems shing 'dug par gyur to/ /de sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis dgongs shing mkhyen bzhin du/ byang chub sems dpa' mdzes pa'i tog de tsho ril 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu khyod 'di snyam du/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa 'di ltar sku tshe thung ngo snyam du ma sems shig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ma gtogs (7dpar/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten dang / bdud dang bcas pa dang / tshangs pa dang bcas pa dang /tshan dge sbyong 99dang bram zer bcas pa'i skye dgu dang / lha dang mi dang lha ma yin du bcas pa'i nang na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub 90—8

pa'i sku che'i tshad kyi mtha'/ phyi ma'i mtha'i mu'i bar du yang rtogs par nus pa nged kyis su yang ma mthong ngo / /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis de bzhin 0)gshegs pa'i sku che'i tshad bshad pa brjod ma thag tu/ de nas de'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi mthus lha'i bu 'dod pa na spyod pa rnams dang / gzugs na spyod pa rnams dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang /nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po'i bar dag dang /byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong (miphrag du ma 'dus nas/ byang chub sems dpa' mdzes pa'i tog (kyegi khyim der lhags so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis ④thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de la/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i sku tshe'i tshad bshad pa tshigs su bcad de mdor bka' stsal pa / rgya mtsho'i (gechu rnams thams cad kyi/ /thigs tsho6pa dag ni bgrang bar nus/ /shākya thub pa'i sku tshe'i tshad/ /sus kyang bgrang bar mi nus so/ /ri rab rnams ni thams cad kyang / /phra rab rdul du bgrang bar nus/ /shākya thub pa'i sku tshe'i tshad / /sus kyang bgrang bar mi nus so/ /sa la gang dag yod pa yi no rab tu phra rdul ji 8)snyed pa/ /thams cad bgrang bar nus srid kyi/ /rgyal ba'i sku che3re tshad mi nus/ /gal te la las nam mkha' la/ /sna 'ga' zhig gis dpag 'dod kyang / /shākya thub pa'i sku tshe'i tshad/ /sus kyang bgrang bar mi nus so/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'di srid bzhugs/ /bskal 59)pa dag ni 'di snyed cig /bskal pa bye ba brgya dag cesango/ /grangs ni rnyed par mi rung ngo / /gang phyir de yi rgyu dang (7ni/ / rkyen yang rnam pa nyugeganyis yin / te/ /sdig pa'i 'tshe spub spangs pa dang / /kha zas mang po byin pa ste/ /de phyir bdag nyid chen po de'i/ /90—9

sku che'i tshad (1)grangs (mimi rnyed do/ /bskal pa 'di snyed cig ce 'am/ /grangs med pa yang ④de bzhin te/ /de bas the tshom med par 'gyur/ /the tshom cung zad ma za shigago /rgyal ba'i sku tshe tha ma yi/ /grangs ni gang du mi dmigs so/ /de nas de'i tshe 'khor der slob dpon lung ston pa bram ze kauṇḍi ⑧rgya zhes bya ba dang / bram ze stong phrag du mas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po'i sgra thos nas 'phral la 'dus (6)te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 59)zhabs gnyis la gtugs nas/ bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa/ gal te bcom ldan 'das sems can thams cad la thugs brtse ba/ thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa/ phan par bzhed pa/ sems can thams cad la pha ma lta bu/ mi mnyam pa dang mnyam par gyur pa/ zla ba lta bur 33snang bar 59tshomadzad pa/ shes rab dang ye shes chen po'i nyi ma shar ba lta bu lags 1 )shing / gal te khyod sems can thams cad la sgra gcan (1zin bzhin du gzigs na/ bdag la dam pa zhig stsal du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das cang mi gsung bar gyur to/ /de nas sangs rgyas kyi kyi mthus 'khor der litstsha bī 1snyegazhon nu 'jig rten 14thams cad kyis mthong na dga' ba zhes bya ba de spobs pa skyes nas / slob dpon lung ston pa bram ze kauṇḍi tshan la 'di skad ces smras so/ /ci bram ze chen po khyod/ bcom ldan 'das la dam pa cig yigasol lam/ bdag gis 1 khyod la dam pa zhig (1 sbyin no/ /bram zes smras pa/ litstsha bī 37gzhon nu bdag ni bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa dang ring bsrel )gyi phye ma bgos ( nyapa'i phyir / bcom ldan 'das kyi 22ring bsrel yungs na 'bru tsam la bsten par 'dod do / /ring bsrel yungs 2 'bru tsam de mngon par mchod na/ sum cu rtsa gsum 90—10

pa'i lha rnams kyi bdag po 'ba' zhig thob ces grags so0)/ /kye litstsha bī (migazhon nu gser 'od dam pa'i mdo nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis ri rishes par dka' ba/ khong du chud par dka' ba de lta bu'i mtshan nyid dang ④yon tan dang ldan pa gser 'od dam pa'i mdo 'chad ⑤ces grag gis (6)nyon cig /kye litstsha bī tsogazhon nu gser 'od dam pa'i mdo ni/ de ltar shes par dka' zhing rtogs par dka' bas na/ kho bo cag mtha' 'khob (8)kyi gling gi bram ze rnams ni/ gang bcangs pa 6)na sems can rnams myur du sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i bdag po 'thob par 'gyur ba'i ring bsrel yungs 'bru tsam za ma tog gi nang du bcug la bcangs kyang rung ngo / /kye litstsha bī mugazhon nu khyod ci de bzhin gshegs pa las ring bsrel yungs (nya'abru tsam gsol nas/ ring bsrel nyu2za ma tog tu bcug ste tu bcangs pas sems can rnams sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i bdag po thob par mi 'dod dam/ kye litstsha bī yigazhon nu kho bos ni dam pa de lta bu gsol to / /de nas litstsha bī snyigazhon nu 'jig rten thams cad kyis mthong na dga' bas / slob dpon lung ston pa bram ze kauṇḍi 8rgya la tshigs su bcad pa dag gis pho slar smras pa/ nam zhig gang gā'i chu rgyun la/ /me tog rnams tsho ni skye ba dang / /bya rog dmar por tsho 'gyur ba dang / /khu byug dung mdog 'drar 'gyur dang / /'dzam bur ta ( sala'i 'bru chags dang / /'bra gor a mra'i dogs 37pa chags/ /de yi tshe na yungs 'bru tsam/ /ring bsrel zhu du ni gsal bar 'gyur/ /nam zhig rus ( nyesngal spu rnams zhugelas/ /gos su legs par btags dgegyur te/ /dgun gyi grang ba sel byed pa/ /de tshe ring bsrel (3yod par 'gyur/ /nam zhig sbrang bu'i rkang lag las / /yang thog legs par byas gyur te/ /brtan 90wa 11

zhing rab tu mi g.yo ba/ /de tshe ring bsrel 0)yod par 'gyur/ /nam zhig srin bu padma kun/ /so ni dkar por (geskyes gyur te/ /rno zhing chen por gyur pa na/ /de tshe ring bsrel zhunyeyod par 'gyurangs/ /mtho ris su ni 'dzeg ༷ pa'i phyir/ /nam zhig ri bong rwa rnams las/ /skas ni legs par byas gyur ⑥pa/ /de tshe ring bsrel yod par 'gyur/ /nam zhig skas ni der 'dzegs te/ /byi bas zla ba bza' ba dang / /sgra gcan la yang gnod byed pa/ /de tshe ring bsrel 9)yod par 'gyur/ /grong na rgyu ba'i (8)sbrang bu yis/ /nam zhig rdza ma'i chang 'thungs te / /khyim na gnas par byed 'gyur ba/ /de tshe ring bsrel yod par 'gyur/ /nam zhig bong bu bde 'gyur po)la/ /mchu dmar bim pa 'drar gyur cing / /glu gar rnams la mkhas gyur pa/ /de tshe ring bsrel yod par 'gyur/ /nam zhig 'ug pa bya rog rnams/ /dben par dong nas rtse tsho/ )ba dang / /phan tshun mthun tustopar gyur pa na/ /de tshe ring bsrel nya yod par 'gyur32/ /pa la sha yi lo ma rnams / /rin chen sna gsum gdugs gyur mite/ /char 'bab skyabs 8su nam gyur pa/ /de tshe ring bsrel yod par 'gyur7/ /nam zhig rgya mtsho'i gru bo che/ /'khrul nya tsho'akhor dang ni g.yor 18mor bcas/ /thang la byung ste 39'gro ba na/ /de tshe ring bsrel 3 tshoyod par 'gyur/ /nam zhig bya ni lug pa yis/ /ri bo spos kyi ngad ldang ba/ /mchu tsho lhal thogs te 'gro 'gyur ba/ /de tshe ring bsrel yod par 'gyur / /slob dpon lung ston pa bram ze kauṇḍi 2rgyas tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag thos nas/ litstsha bī 2lhagazhon nu 'jig rten tha mas cad kyis mthong na dga' ba la tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis 3 )slar smras pa/ legs so legs so gzhon nu mchog /rgyal ba'i sras po tshig 25po che/ /dpa' zhing thabs la mkhas 90—12

ldan pa/ /lung bstan pa ni dam pa thob/ /'jig rten mgon po skyob 0)pa po/ /de bzhin gshegs pa che ba nyid/ /bsam gyis mi khyab go rims ②bzhin/ /gzhon nu bdag las mnyan ①par gyis/ /sangs rgyas yul ni bsam mi khyab/ /de bzhin gshegs rnams mtshungs pa med/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rtag tu zhi/ /sangs rgyas thams cad yang dag byung ④/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kha dog mtshungs / /'di ni sangs rgyas chos nyid yin/ /bcom ldan 'das (snyeni bcos ma min⑥/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ma skyes te/ /rdo rje lta bur sra ba'i sku/ /sprul pa'i sku ni ston par mdzad/ /drang srong chen po'i ring bsrel ni/ /yungs 'bru tsam zhes bya ba med/ /sku la rus pa khrag med na/ /ring bsrel 7)yod par ga la 'gyur / /sems can rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /thabs kyis ring bsrel bzhag par ⑧mdzad/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos kyi sku/ /de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi dbyings/ /chos ston tsaramadzad pa ci 'dra ba/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi 7sku de 'dral/ /bdag gis 'di thos shes nas ni/ /bdag gis dam pa gsol bar (stebyasal/ /de nyid kho na lung bstan phyir/ /gtam gleng ba ni bdag gis byas/ /de nas lha'i bu sum khri nyis sna stong gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku che'i tshad bstan pa zab mo de lta bu yonyede dag thos nas/ thams cad kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed de/ de dag yid kyis kun tu 8rtog pa rab tu dga' nas sgra dbyangs gcig tu tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /sangs rgyas mya ngan yong tshemi 'da'/ /chos kyang nub par mi 'gyur te/ /sems can yongs su smin mdzad phyir/ /yongs su mya ngan 'da' ba ston/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan bsam mi khyab/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rtag pa'i sku/ /sems 90—13

can rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /bkod pa rnam ①pa sna tshogs ston/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' mdzes pa'i tog ②gis/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag dang skyes bu dam pa de gnyis las bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i sku tshe'i tshad bstan pa thos nas/ tshim zhing mgu ⑧la yi rangs ④shing rab tu dga' ste ⑤dga' ba dang yid bde ba skyes nas dga' ba dang mgu ⑥ba rgya chen pos khyab par gyur to / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku che'i tshad bstan pa 'di bshad pa'i tshe/ sems can tshad med tso)grangs med pa 6)dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems skyes 6)so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de dag kyang mi snang bar gyur to//gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku tshe'i tshad bstan pa'i le'u zhes bya ba ste gnyis pa'o// //de nas byang chub sems dpa' mdzes pa'i tog gnyid kyis log pa'i rmi lam na / gser gyi rnga kun tu snang /lke stab 'di lta ste/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dra ba zhig mthong ngo / /phyogs thams cad na yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das grangs med dpag tu med pa dag rin po che'i shing drung na/ rin po che bai ḍūrya'i khri rnams la bzhugs shing 'khor brgya stong du mas yongs su bskor te/ mdun gyis bltas nas chos ston pa mthong ngo / /de nas yang skyes bu bram ze'i gzugs lta bu zhig rnga de rdung ba mthong ste/ rnga'i sgra de las bstan pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di lta bu dag byung ba thos so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' mdzes pa'i tog gnyid 17sad ma thag tu/ bstan pa'i tshigs su bcad pa de dag rjes su dran no/ /rjes su dran nas kyang de'i mtshan mo zad pa dang / rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer 90—14

chen po nas byung ste/ srog chags stong phrag du ma dang lhan cig tu bya rgod phung po'i ri ga la ba dang / bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/bcom ldan 'das kyi 6)zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal ②te/ bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas phyogs gcig ②tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig ①tu 'dug nas byang chub sems dpa' mdzes pa'i tog gis/ bcom ldan 'das ga la (nyab de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/ rmi lam na gang rnga'i sgra las bstan pa'i tshigs su bcad pa thos pa de dag gsol to/ /gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po las/ rmi lam mthong ba'i le'u zhes bya ba ste gsum pa'o// //nub gcig g.yel ba med par yang / /bdag gis ⑥mi lam rmis (7pa ni/ /mdzes pa'i rnga chen mthong ba ste/ /thams cad du ni gser gyi 'od/ / nyi ma ji lta (kyebazhin du 'bar/ /kun tu rnam par lhang 6)nge ste/ /phyogs bcu rnams su snang bar gyur/ /kun tu rin chen shing drung na/ /rin chen bee 'aḍūrya dag gi/ /khri la sangs rgyas rnams bzhugs te/ /brgya stong phrag ni du ma yi/ /'khor /mdabus mdun gyis bltas pa mthong / /bram ze'i gzugs ni 'dra ba zhig /rnga chen rab tu brdung tu ba mthong / /de yis de la brdungs pa tunyedang / /tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag byung / /gser 'od dam pa'i rnga chen sgra yis ni/ /stong gsum 'jig rten 'jig rten gsum 'di na/ /ngan song sdug bsngal gshin rje'i sdug bsngal dang / /dbul ba'i sdug bsngal ma lus 7zhi bar shog /rnga bo che yi sgra skad 'di yis ni/ /'jig rten rmongs pa thams cad zhi gyur cig /ji ltar 90—15

thub dbang 'jigs med 'jigs 1)zhi ltar/ /sems can 'jigs med 'jigs dang bral bar shog /ji ltar 'khor bar kun mkhyen thub dbang po/ /'phags pa'i yon tan kun dang ldan pa ltar/ /skye dgu ting 'dzin byang chub yan lag gi//yon tan ldan zhing yon tan rgya mtshor gyur/ /rnga bo che yi sgra skad 'di yis ni/ /sems can thams cad tshangs pa'i dbyangs ldan gyur/ /sangs rgyas byang chub dam pa mchog reg 2 shog /chos kyi 55)'khor lo dge ba 4)bskor gyur cig /bskal pa bsam gyis mi khyab bzhugs par shog /'gro la phan phyir chos kyang ston gyur cig /nyon mongs 'joms gyur sdug bsngal sel bar shog /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug zhi gyur cig /sems can gang dag ngan song sar gnas te/ /rus pa'i lus la me lce rab 'bar ba/ /de dag rnga chen bsgrags 5)pa thos gyur cig /sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal lo zhes nimog thos shog /sems can kun gyis cedro rabs brgya dag dang / /skye ba stong phrag bye bar skye dran shog /thub pa'i dbang po rtag tu dran (65gyur cing / /de dag gi ri ni rgya chen gsung thos shog /rnga bo che yi rin sgra skad 'di yis 9 ni/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang rtag tu 'grogs rnyed gyur/ /sdig pa'i las rnams rnam par spong bar lha tshoshog /bya ba dge ba rnams ni spyod gyur cig /mi dang lha dang srog chags thams cad kyis/ /de dag bsam dang smon lam gang yin pa/ /rnga bo che yi sgra 17skad 'di yis yi ni/ /de dag rnams kyi de 1 kun rdzogs gyur cig /sems can gang dag sems dmyal mi bzad tsheskyes / /lus la me lce kun tu rab tu 'bar/ /skyabs med mya ngan bcas shing yongs 'khyam pa/ /me rnams de dag rab tu zhi bar shog /sems dmyal yi dgas gemi yi 'jig rten na/ /sems can sdug bsngal mi bzad 7drag po gang / /90—16

rnga bo che yi sgra skad 'di yis ni/ /de dag rnams kyi sdug bsngal kun zhi shog /rten med dpung gnyen med pa dang / /skyabs med par yang gyur pa dag /de rnams la ni skyob pa dang / /dpung gnyen rten mchog bdag gyur cig /sangs rgyas rkang gnyis dam pa dag /thugs brtse thugs rje ldan pa'i thugs/ /gang dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na/ /bzhugs pa bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag gis (1)sngon cad (gesdig pa'i las/ /shin tu mi bzad (5cigang bgyis pa/ /stobs bcu'i spyan sngar ④bdag mchis te/ /de dag thams cad bshags par bgyi(5) / /pha ma dag tu mi 'dzin dang / /sangs rgyas rnams su mi 'dzin dang / /dge ba dag tu mi 'dzin pas/ /sdig pa bdag gis gang bgyis pa6/ /phyug pa'i rgyags pas dregs pa dang / /rigs dang longs spyod rgyags pa dang / /bzhin (7pa'i rgyags pas dregs pa yis/ /bdag gis sdig pa gang bgyis 87dang //nyes bsams nyes par smras pa dang / /nyes par bgyis (9pa'i las rnams dang / /nyes pa'i dmigs su ma bltas tshepas/ /bdag gis sdig pa gang bgyis dang / /byis pa'i blo yi hunya'ajug pa dang / /mi shes mun pa'i sems dang ni/ /sdig pa'i grogs po'i dbang gyur dang / /nyon mongs rnam par 'khrug sems dang / /rtsed mo dga' ba'i dbang nyid dang / /mya ngan dang ni nad dbang dang / /nor gyis mi chog nyes pa yis/ /bdag gis sdig pa gang bgyis dang / /'phags min skye bo 'dre ba dang / /phrag dog ser sna'i rgyu /lhadang ni/ /g.yo dang dbul ba'i nyes pa yis/ /bdag gis sdig pa gang bgyis 1 dang / /phongs pa byung ba'i dus kyi tshe/ /'dod pa rnams kyi 'jigs rgyu dang / /phyug po ma yin gyur pa yis/ /bdag gis sdig pa gang bgyis dang / /g.yo ba'i sems kyis 57dbang 90—17

nyid dang / /'dod dang khro ba'i 6)dbang dag dang / /bkres dang skom gyis ②nyen pa yis/ /bdag gis ④sdig pa gang bgyis dang / /bza' ba dag dang btung ba dang / /bud med rgyu dang gos kyi phyir/ /nyon mongs gdung ba sna tshogs kyis/ /bdag gis sdig pa gang bgyis ④dang / /lus dang ngag dang yid kyi 55 sdig /nyes par spyad pa rnam 6)gsum bsags/ /'di ⑦'dra'i tshul gyis gang bgyis pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag 'chags ⑧so/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang chos rnams nyunodang / /de bzhin nyan thos rnams la yang / /gus pa ma lags gang bgyis pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag 'chags 0so/ /gang yang rang sangs rgyas rnams dang / /byang chub sems dpa' rnams la yang / /gus pa ma lags bgyis pa rnams/ /de dag thams cad bdag 'chags khwa/ so/ /dam chos smra ba rnams la yang / /gus pa ma lags bgyis pa dang / /chos la'ang gus par ma bgyis pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag 'chags hu)so/ /bdag gis rtag tu mi shes pas/ /dam pa'i chos ni spangs pa dang / /pha ma rnams la ma gus dang / /de dag thams cad bdag 'chags 8so/ /blun pa dang ni byis pa dang / /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang / /nga rgyal dregs pas tsobasgribs bgyis pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag 'chags 8so/ /bdag gis 7phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten du/ /stobs bcu rnams la mchod par bgyi(nya/ /bdag gis phyogs bcur sems can rnams/ /sdug tunyebasngal kun las 'don par bgyi(6/ /sems can bsam gyis zhu )mi khyab kun/ /sa bcu la ni dgod par bgyi(nya/ /sa bcu la ni gnas nas kyang / /thams cad de bzhin gshegs gyur cig /ji srid sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las/ /de kun thar sostebagyi nus srid du/ /sems can 90—18

re re'i phyir yang ni/ /bskal pa bye bar spyad par bgyi/ /gser 'od dam pa zhes bgyi ba/ /las rnams thams cad byang bgyid (1)pa/ /zab mo dag ni ston pa ni/ /sems can de dag bstan par bgyi/ /gang gis bskal pa stong rnams su / /sdig pa shin tu mi bzad ( bgyis/ /lan cig rab tu bshags pa yis/ /de dag thams cad byang (5)bar 'gyur/ /gang gis las kyi sgrib pa rnams/ /myur du yang dag zad 'gyur ba/ /gser 'od dam pa dge ba yis④/ /bshags pa 'di dag bshags nas ni/ /rin chen 'byung gnas mchog bcu po/ /sa bcu la ni gnas par bgyi/ /sangs rgyas yon tan snang bar bgyi/ /srid pa'i mtsho las bsgral (༷5)bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas rgya mtsho chu bo dang / /yon tan rgya mtsho zab mo dang (nya/ /sangs rgyas yon tan bsam yas kyis/ /thams cad mkhyen du ri rirdzogs par bgyi/ /ting 'dzin brgya phrag stong rnams dang / /gzungs rnams bsam gyis mi khyab dang / /dbang stobs byang chub yan lag gi58)/ /stobs bcu dam par 'gyur bar bgyi/ /dgongs pa'i thugs kyis sangs rgyas rnams/ /bdag la rnam (9)par gzigs su gsol/ /thugs rje ldan pa'i thugs kyis ni/ /nongs par / byerab tu gzung du gsol/ /bdag gis bskal pa brgya rnams su/ /sngon chad sdig pa gang bgyis pa/ /de phyir bdag ni mya ngan sems/ /phongs dang mya ngan 'jigs pas nyu1gzir/ /sdig pa'i las la 'jigs 42par bgyid/ /yid ni rtag tu dman par 'gyur/ /gang dang gang du spyod bgyid pa/ /bdag ni gang du'ang dga' ma mchis/ /sangs rgyas thams cad thugs rje ldan/ /'gro ba kun gyi 'jigs sel bas/ /nongs par rab tu gzung du gsol/ /'jigs pa dag las bdag thar mdzod/ /bdag gi nyon mongs las rnams kyi12/ /dri ma 90—19

de bzhin gshegs pas shol1)/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis bdag la ni/ /snying rje'i chu yis bkru bar gsol/ /sdig pa thams cad bshags par bgyi/ /sngon chad bdag gis gang bgyis (midang / /da ltar bdag gi sdig pa gang / /de dag thams cad bdag 'chags (geso/ /nongs par bgyis pa'i las rnams kun/ /slan chad mi bgyid bsdam par bgyi/ /bdag gis nongs par bgyis pa gang / /sdig de bcab 45par mi bya'o(5)/ /lus kyi las ni rnam yigasum dang / /ngag gi rnam pa bzhi dag dang / /yid kyi rnam pa gsum po 9)rnams/ /de dag thams cad bdag 'chags 8)so/ /lus kyis ponyebagyis dang ngag gi lasayi/ /yid kyis rnam par bsams pa dang / /las rnams bcu (7po bgyis pa dag /de dag thams cad bdag 'chags 12so/ /mi dge las bcu spangs nas su/ /dge ba bcu po bsten nyugebagyis teng/ /sa bcu la bdag gnas par bgyi/ /stobs bcu mchog tu 'gyur bar bgyi/ /bdag gis sasdig pa'i las gang dag /mi 'dod 'bras bu thob bgyid pa/ /sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchis nas ni/ /de dag thams cad bshags par bgyi/ /'dzam bu'i sagling 'dir gang dag dang / /'jig rten khams ni gzhan dag tu/ /gang rnams dge ba'i las bgyid pa rte/ /de dag kun la yi 18rang ngo / /lus dang ngag dang yid kyis kyang / /bdag gis bsod nams gang bsgrubs pa/ /bdag ni tsho'odage ba'i rtsa ba des/ /byang chub mchog la reg par bgyi/ /srid 'gro nyam ngar byis pa'i blo yis ni/ /shin tu mi bzad tsho sdig pa gang bgyis pa/ /stobs bcu mi mnyam 9 stespyan sngar mchis nas ni//sdig pa de kun so sor bshags par bgyi/ /skye ba nyam nga srid pa nyam nga dang / /'jig rten nyam nga g.yo sems nyam nga dang 22/ /lus kyi spyod pa nyam nga sna tshogs 90—20

kyis / /bdag gis sdig pa gang bsags de 'chags (1)so/ /byis pa blun byas nyon mongs nyam nga dang / /sdig pa'i grogs dang phrad pa nyam nga dang / /srid pa nyam nga 'dod chags nyam nga dang / /zhe sdang nyam nga gti mug nyam nga dang / /ngal ba'i nyam nga dus kyi nyam nga dang / /bsod nams bsgrubs pa nyam nga dag gis kyang / /rgyal ba mi mnyam mngon sum mchis nas ni/ /sdig pa de kun so sor bshags par bgyi/ /sangs rgyas gser mdog ri snang /ri ri rab 'dra/ /yon tan rgya mtsho 'dra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba de dag rnams tshil skyabs su mchi / /rgyal ba de dag kun la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /gser mdog gser ni (4)dri ma med pa gser gyi 'od/ /dri med rnam dag bai zhe༄ḍūrya'i yan lag spyan/ /sangs rgyas nyi ma dpal gzi grags 'bar 'byung ba'i gnas/ /thugs rje'i 'od zer dag gis mun pa mun nag bsal/ /yan lag rab tu dri med rab bzang rnam par mdzes/ /sangs rgyas nyi ma yan lag dri med gser 'dras khyab/ /nyon mongs mes gdungs 6nyeyid can 'bar ba'i me 'dra ba/ /thub pa'i zla ba'i 'od zer dra bas tshim par mdzad/ /mtshan mchog sum cu gnyis kyis dbang po yan lag mdzes/ /dpe byad bzang po dag gis yan lag rnam par mdzes/ /dpal gzi bsod nams 'bar 'khrugs 'od zer dra ba yis/ /'jig rten gsum na mun khrod nyi ma bzhin du bzhugs(7)/ /dri med rgya chen kha dog sna tshogs (8sabai ḍūrya/ /skya rengs 6)dmar dang dngul dang shel bzhin yan lag dmar/ /'od zer dra ba rnam pa sna tshogs legs brgyan pas/ /thub chen khyod ni nyi ma bzhin du de bzhin mdzes7/ /mya ngan 'khrug pa 'chi chu rgal (stoba'i dba' rlabs can / /'khor ba'i klung chen phongs 4snyepa'i chu bor lhung 3geb la/ /sdug bsngal rgya 90—21

mtsho mchog tu rtsub cing shugs (1)drag pa/ /bde gshegs nyi ma'i 'od zer mang po rnams kyis skemasarin3/ /yan lag gser gyi mdog tu rnam par snang / /ye shes 'byung gnas 'jig rten gsum kun mchog /rab mdzes mtshan gyis yan lag rnams 58)spras pa/ /sangs rgyas gser sku 'bar la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji ltar rgya mtsho'i chu ni dpag med dang / /ji ltar sa la sa rdul mtha' yas dang / /ji ltar ri rab rdo mtha' mtshungs 4 med dang / /ji ltar nam mkha'i mtha' ma 'byematha' yas pa/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas yon tan mtha' yas te/ /sems can kun gyis shes par mi nus so/ /bskal pa du mar gzhal cing bsams kyang ni/ /yon tan mtha' ma shes par mi nus so/ /chu ni skra yi rtse mo'i tshad tsam dang / /rdor bcas rir 6bcas rgya mtshor bcas pa ni/ /bskal pa bgrangs tsa)na shes par nus kyang srid/ /sangs rgyas yon tan pha mthar 98)shes mi nus/ /yon tan kha dog snyan dang grags pa dang / /dge ba'i mtshan dzinogyis brgyan pa'i sku lus dang / /dpe 1 byad bzang po brgyad cus hu)brgyan pa yis/ /sems can thams cad de 'drar 'gyur bar 1 shog /bdag gi (snyedage ba'i las rnams 'di dag gis / /'jig rten mi ring sangs rgyas 'gyur bar bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir chos kyang bstan par bgyi/ /sems can sdug bsngal mang gzir thar bar bgyi/ /stobs bcas sder bcas bdud las rgyal bar bgyi/ /chos kyi 'khor lo dge ba mibaskor bar bgyi/ /bskal pa bsam gyis mi khyab gnas par bgyi/ /bdud rtsi'i chu yis sems can tshim par bgyi/ /ji ltar sngon gyi rgyal bas skurdzogs pa ltar/ /pha rol phyin drug bla med rdzogs par bgyi/ /nyon mongs gzhom zhing sdug bsngal bsal bar bgyi/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug zhi bar bgyi/ /skye ba brgya 90—22

dang 6)skye ba bye ba stong / /bdag ni rtag tu skye ba dran par bgyi/ /thub pa'i dbang po rtag tu dran par bgyi/ /de yi gsung ni rgya chen thos par bgyi/ /bdag ni dge ba'i las rnams 'di dag gis/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas 'grogs pa rnyed par bgyi/ /sdig pa'i las rnams rnam par spang bar bgyi/ /dge ba'i 'byung gnas dge rnams spyad par bgyi/ /zhing rnams kun na srog chags thams cad kyang / /'jig rten dag na sdug bsngal kun zhi gyur/ /sems can dbang po ma tshang yan lag nyams/ /de kun de'u re /nadabang po tshang bar shog /gang dag nad btab nyam chung lus nyams dang / /phyogs bcu dag na skyabs med gyur pa rnams/ /de kun myur du nad las thar gyur cig /nad med stobs dang dbang po rnyed par shog /gang dag rgyal po chom rkun bred bsdigs bsad thug dang / /sdug bsngal rnam pa sna tshogs brgya yis 54phongs gyur pa/ /sems can nyam thag gyur cing sdug bsngal de dag kun/ /'jigs mchog mi bzad brgya po de las thar gyur cig /gang dag brdegs shing bcing bas bcings gzir ba//phongs pa sna tshogs dag na gnas gyur cing 5ri/ /nyon mongs stong phrag du mas dkrugs nas kyang / /'jigs pa mi bzad phyimya ngan sna tshogs rnyed/ /de dag thams cad bcings las grol gyur cing / /brdeg ri pa dag ni brdeg las thar bar shog /bsad pa rnams kyang srog dang ldan gyur cig /phongs gyur thams cad 'jigs (8)pa med par shog /sems can gang dag bkres srid 9skom gyis gzir / /de dag zas skom sna tshogs rnyed par shog /long bas gzugs rnams sna tshogs mthong gyur cig /'on pas yid 'ong sgra rnams thos par shog /gcer bu rnams kyis sna tshogs tsho tshogos rnyed gyur/ /sems can dbul pos gter 90—23

rnams rnyed par shog /nor 'bru rin chen sna tshogs mang po yis0) sems can thams cad bde dang ldan par shog /gang yang sdug bsngal tshor bas gnod (snyem gyur/ /sems can thams cad blta na sdug (kyepa dang / /gzugs bzang mdzes shing tshul du shis par shog /rtag tu bde ba du ma rdzogs gyur cig /yid kyis zas skom rab 'byor bsod nams 3)dag /bsams ma thag tu de dag grub gyur cig /rdza rnga cang te'u pi bang ri sgra snyan dang / /chu mig mtshe'u dang rdzing bu lteng ka (6dang / /gser gyi padma utpal padma can/ /zas skom gos nor mu tig nor bu dbyig /rgyan gser rin chen sna tshogs bee ḍūrya/ /de dag bsams ma thag tu grub gyur cig /'jig rten gang na'ang sdug bsngal sgra ma byung / /sems can gcig kyang mi 'phrod mthong ma gyur/ /de dag thams cad kha dog rgya chen dang / /phan tshun du ni 'od byed gyur par mashog /mi yi 'jig rten phun sum tshogs gang yod/ /de dag gang du bsams par skye bar gyurazhu)/ /bsam pa thams cad bsams (9)ma thag tu yang / /bsod nams 'bras bu yongs su rdzogs par shog /spos dang phreng ba dag dang byug pa dang / /gos dang phye ma me tog sna tshogs dag /ljon shing dag las dus gsum 'bab par shog /sems can de dag len cing dgar gyur cig /de bzhin gshegs pa bsam yas thams cad dang / /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' nyan thos dang / /rdul bral dri med brtan 7pa'i chos la yang / /phyogs bcu rnams su mchod pa byed par shog /'gro ba dman pa 11thams cad spong gyur cig /mi khom brgyad po dag las 'das par shog /dal ba'i rgyal po dam pa thob gyur cig /rtag tu sangs rgyas 'grogs pa thob tsho12par shog /rtag tu mthon po'i rigs su skye bar 90wa 24

shog /nor dang 'bru yi mdzod rnams 'byor gyur cig /snyan dang grags dang gzugs dang kha dog gis/ /bskal pa du mar legs par brgyan (1par shog /bud med thams cad rtag tu phor gyur te/ /dpa' zhing rtul phod mkhas shing gsal bar shog /de kun rtag tu byang chub phyir spyod gyur/ /pha rol phyin pa drug la spyod par shog /phyogs bcu dag na rin chen shing dbang drung / /sangs rgyas bde bzhugs rin chen bai ḍūrya'i/ /khri la bzhugs pa dag ni mthong gyur cig /chos bstan pa yang de dag thos gyur shog /bdag gis sdig pa'i las rnams bsgrubs ( pa ni/ /srid pa nyam ngar sngon chad gang bsgrubs pa/ /sdig las gang dag mi 'dod 'bras thob pa/ /de dag thams cad ma lus zad gyur cig /sems can gang dag srid par bcings nas su/ /'khor ba'i zhags pa'i thag ①pas dam bcings pal/ /shes rab lag 5cigis bcings pa bgrol (6)bar shog /sdug bsngal rnams las myur du thar gyur 59)cig /sems can gang dag 'dzam bu'i gling 'di dang / /gang dag 'jig rten khams ni gzhan rnams na⑧/ /bsod nams sna tshogs zab mo rnams byed pa/ /de dag kun la rjes su yi 1)rang ngo / /lus dang ngag dang yid kyis bsgrubs pa yi/ /bdag gis 7rjes su yi 4kārang bsod nams de/ /bdag ni smon grub 'bras bu yod par shog / byang chub rdul nyunyebral bla med thob gyur cig /gang dag rtag dang dri ma bral ba dang / /dri med yid kyis phyag 'tshal bstod pa dang / /yongs su bsngo ba brjod pa 'di yis ni/ /bskal pa drug cur ngan song spong bar gyur/ /tshigs su bcad pa brjod pa 'di dag gis/ /skyes pa bud med bram ze rgyal rigs las/ /thal sbyar 'dug ste kyi rgyal ba gang bstod pa/ /tshe rabs kun tu skye ba dran par 90—25

'gyur / /yan lag dbang po kun gyis yan lag brgyan/ /bsod nams yon tan sna tshogs rnams dang ldan/ /mi dbang rgyal pos rtag tu de mchod de/ /de dang de dag tu ni de 'drar 'gyur/ /gang dag rna ba'i bu gar bshags pa 'di ni grags 15'gyur ba/ /de dag sangs rgyas gcig gi (gegan nas dge ba byas ma yin / /gnyis la ma yin bzhi la ma yin lnga min bcu la min/ /de ltar sangs rgyas stong gi gan nas dge ba byas ma 4)yin/ /gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po las bshags pa'i le'u zhes bya ba ri5༄ste bzhi pa'o// // 'phags pa gser 'od dam pa'i mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdone/ bam po gnyis pa/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rigs kyi 7lha mo byang chub yang dag par bsdus pa la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to / / rigs kyi nalha mo de'i tshe de'i dus na/ rgyal po gser gyi 9lag pa'i dbang po zhes bya ba des/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la bstod pa padma'i 'byung gnas 'dis/ 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la mngon par bstod do/ /rgyal ba gang dag sngar gyur gang byung dang / /phyogs nya bcu'i 'jig 17rten dag na gang bzhugs pa/ /rgyal ba de 12dag rnams la phyag 1 bgyi'o/ /rgyal ba de dag kun la bdag gis bstod/ /thub dbang zhi zhing rab zhi rnam 1 par dag /sku ni gser gyi amadog tu rab tu gda' / /dbyangs rnams kun gyis sangs rgyas gsung 7snyan te/ /tshangs (1 pa'i sgra dbyangs rab tu bsgrags 18pa'i gsung / /bung ba rma bya utpal sngon po'i dbu/ /mthon mthing 19lcang lo bya ni tsa sha 'dra/ /kha ba dung 27ltar rab tu dkar ba'i 90—26

tshems / /rtag tu gser ltar rnam par mdzes par gda'/ /spyan ni ring zhing mthon mthing zhi)dri ma med/ /utpal 97sngon po rab tu rgyas pa 'dra/ /ljags 55)ni che zhing legs la padma'i mdog /padma 'drar snang padma'i ze ④ba 'dra/ /zhal gyi (5mdzod spu padma dung dang 'dra/ /bee ḍūrya yi mdog 'dra g.yas su 'khyil/ /thub pa'i zla ba phra zhing zla ba zad (6)pa 'dra/ /sku yi lte ba bung ba gsal ba bzhin/ /zhal mtho'i tso)shangs ni rtag tu lhag ge (8)ste/ /'jam zhing sa la'i 49)gser ltar kha dog bzang / /rtag par rgyun du rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ /ro mchog 'jam nyu snazhing dam pa mchog rab 'phags/ /spu yi bu ga nas ni re re skyes/ /spu rnams skyes pa g.yas su 'khyil pa ste/ /mthon mthing 1ste'od 'bar 'tsher zhing lcang lo can / /rma bya'i mgrin sdug 'dra bar sngo la mdzes/ /bltams nyusnyem thag tu sku yis snang bar bgyis1snye/ /phyogs bcu'i la'ajig rten dag ni thams cad gang / /'jig rten gsum na sdug bsngal mtha' yas zhi/ /bde ba kun gyi 1shesems can rnams kyang tshim/ /sems dmyal 'gro dang dud 'gro'i 'gro ba dang / /yi dgas lha gnas mi yi 'gro rnams su/ /sems can de dag thams cad bde bas tshim / /ngan song 'gro ba rnams ni thams cad zhi/ /kha dog mdog bzang gser dang 'dra ba'i 'od/ /btso tshama'i gser ltar rab tu snang ba'i sku/ /bde gshegs zla ba rab tu dri med zhal/ /'dzum zhing rnam mdzes shin tu dri med zhal//gzhon nu btsas 'drar sku lus yan nyu lag 'jam/ /seng ge 'dra bar rtsal gyis gnon pa'i mchog /phyag ring phyag ni rab tu ring ba ste/ /sā /8la'i lcug ma rlung gis bskyod pa bzhin/ /'dom gang 'od 'bar 'od zer rab tu gtong 17/ /nyi ma stong ltar rab tu lhag ge'o/ /thub pa'i dbang po'i sku mchog dri ma med/ /90—27

zhing rnams mtha' 1)yas thams cad rab tu snang / /sangs rgyas 'od ni rnam ②par lhang nge tsho rabs/ /zhing rnams mtha' yas brgya stong rnams su yang / /mtshan byad ri nizla ba nyi ma mang po dag /de dag thams cad 'od ni med par gyur/ /sangs rgyas nyi ma 'jig rten sgron ma ste/ /sangs rgyas nyi ma brgya phrag stong rnams ni / /zhing rnams mtha' yas stong phrag brgya (5)dag na/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyi ma sems can mthong / /bsod nams 56)stong phrag brgya dang ldan pa'i sku/ /yon tan kun gyis rab tu brgyan pa'i sku/ /glang chen dbang po'i sna 'dra rgyal ba'i phyag /phyag dang zhabs 'od rab mdzes dri ma med/ /sa yi steng gi rdul ⑦dang mtshungs 'dra snyed/ /phra ba'i rdul (8)snyed sangs rgyas gang 'das dang / /gang dag phra ba'i rdul 9risnyed byung ba dang / /gang dag phra ⑩ba'i rdul (nyusnyed bzhugs pa yi/ /rgyal ba de dag la ni rab dang ba'i/ /ngag yid lus kyis me tog dbul ba dang / /spos hu rnams dbul dang bsngags pa brgya dag dang / /dge ba'i sems kyis kyang ni phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba'i yon tan gang dag dger gyur pa/ /snying po mchog rab sna tshogs du ma ste3ge/ /bdag gis bskal pa stong du lce brgya yis/ /sangs rgyas yon tan brjod par mi nus so/ /rgyal ba gcig gi 7yon tan rnams kyang ni/ /lce stong gis kyang cung zad brjod mi nus/ /bdag gis rgyal ba dag ni thams cad kyi15/ /yon tan lce brgyas tsobarjod par ga la nus/ /lhar bcas 'jig rten thams cad mtshor gyur te/ /srid pa'i rtse mo man chad chus gang ba/ /skra yi rtse mos dpag par nus srid kyi/ /bde gshegs rnams kyi 3 yon tan gcig la min/ /lus dang ngag yid rab tu dang ba yis/ /rgyal ba kun la bdag gis bsngags bstod pas/ /bdag gis bsod 90—28

nams hu)'bras bu mchog bsags gang / /des ni sems can rgyal ba reg gyur cig /de ltar rgyal pos sangs rgyas rnams bstod nas/ /rgyal po 'di ltar smon lam 'debs pa ni/ /ma 'ongs (gebaskal pa mtha' yas rnams su yang / /gang dang gang du bdag ni skye ba na/ /rmi lam du ni 'di 'dra'i rnga blta zhing / /der ni bshags pa 'di 'dra mnyan par bgyi/ /rgyal bstod padma 'byung rgyal 'di 'dra ba / / skye ba ①de dang der ni rnyed par bgyi/ /sangs rgyas yon tan mtha' yas mtshungs med dang / /gang yang bskal pa stong du rnyed dka' ba/ /de dag rmi lam du yang mnyan par bgyi/ /nyin gyur tshe yang de dag bshad par bgyi/ /sems can sdug bsngal mtsho las thar bar bgyi/ /pha rol phyin pa drug po rdzogs (gepar bgyi/ /phyi nas byang chub bla med thob par bgyi/ /bdag gi zhing ni lhod pa 5med gyur cig /rnga phul rnam (6)par smin pa'i 'bras bu dang / /rgyal ba thams cad la yang bstod pa'i rgyus/ /shākya thub dbang mngon du blta bar bgyi/ /der ni bdag gis lung bstan thob gyur cig /gser gyi lag pa'i dbang dang gser gyi 'od/ /bdag gi khye'u ni gang yin 'di gnyis kyang / /der ni bu pho de dag gnyi ga dang / /byang chub bla med lung bstan ri7thob par shog /sems can gang dag (nyaganas dang rten med cing / /skyabs ri9nodang bral nas phongs par gyur pa dgaci /de dag la yang ma 'ongs tsho1dus rnams nanyusnye/ /skyob nyusnyedang dpung gnyen skyabs dang rten gyur shogato /sdug bsngal kun 'byung zad par tshebyed gyur cig /dge 8ba kun gyi 'byung gnas gyur par pho 7shog /sngon mtha' 'das pa de dag ji srid pa/ /ma 'ongs bskal par byang chub spyad par bgyi/ /gser 'od dam pa yi ni bshags pa yis(1snye/ /bdag gi yi sdig tshopa'i rgya mtsho bskams ri tsā90—29

par shog /bdag gi 917las kyi rgya mtsho zad gyur cig /bdag gi nyon mongs rgya mtsho zad par shog /bdag gi bsod nams rgya mtsho rdzogs gyur cig /ye shes dri med snang ba dam pa yi(5)/ /bdag gi ye shes rgya mtsho rnam dag cing ①/ /yon tan 4kun gyi rgya mtshor gyur par phyirashog /byang chub yon tan ⑥rin (7chen rdzogs gyur cig ri /gser 'od dam 59)pa'i bshags khri )pa'i stobs kyis ni/ /bdag gi /nyabasod nams 1rtarab tu snang bar shog /bdag gi tunyebyang chub snang ba rnam rshadag gyur/ /ye shes dri med snang ba dam pa yisnyi/ /bdag gi yilus kyi 'od ni snang bar shog /bsod nams nya tshosnang ba lhag ger bya ba'i phyir/ /'jig rten gsum na khyad par 'phags gyur cig /bsod nams stobs dang rtag tu ldan par shog /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las ni sgrol ba dang / /bde ba kun gyi rgya mtsho 'dra ba yis/ /ma 'ongs bskal par byang chub spyad par bgyi/ /'jig rten gsum na sngon mthar ji snyed gshegs/ /de dag zhing ni rgyal ba thams cad kyi / /yon tan mtha' yas khyad 'phags ci 'dra ba/ /yon tan mtha' yas rnams kyis bdag gi 1 zhing / /ma 'ongs /)dus na de 'drar 'gyur bar zhu )shog /gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po las/ 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i 21 de bzhin gshegs pa ji rtethams cad la bstod pa me ( snyetog padma'i 'byung gnas kyi le'u zhes bya ba tsho )ste lnga pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gsungs so / /bsam gyis mi khyab mdo rnams gzhan dag tu/ /stong pa'i chos rnams rab tu rgyas bshad de/ /de lta na bas na mdo mchog dam pa 'dir/ /stong pa'i 90—30

chos rnams mdo tsam bshad pa yin/ /sems can blo chung rnam 6)par mi shes pas / /chos rnams thams cad shes par mi nus te/ /de lta bas na mdo mchog dam ②pa 'dir/ /stong pa'i chos rnams mdo tsam rab tu bshad( )/ /sems can kun gyis ci nas shes 'gyur dang / /sems can 'byung bya'i phyir ni snying rje'i dbang / /thabs dang tshul dang rgyu gzhan rnams kyis ni/ /mdo mchog dam pa dbang po 'di bshad do/ /lus 'di grong khyim stong pa ji bzhin te/ /dbang po rnams ni dmag dang chom rkun 6)'dra/ /de dag thams cad grong gcig 55gnas mod kyi/ /de dag phan tshun rnam par mi shes so/ /mig gi dbang po gzugs gyur rnams la rgyug /rna ba'i dbang po sgra la rnam par spyod(6)/ /sna yi dbang po sna tshogs (7dri rnams 'phrog /lce yi dbang po rtag tu ro la rgyug /lus kyi ⑧dbang po reg pa dag la rgyug /yid kyi dbang po chos rnams rnam par spyodapo) / /dbang po drug po 'di dag phan tshun du/ /rang rang yul la rab tu 'jug par byed/ /sems ni sgyu 7ma lta bur g.yo ba yin/ /dbang po drug ni yul la rnam spyod 7de/ /ji ltar mi zhig grong stong rgyug pa dang / /dmag dang chom rkun husredag dang gnas pa bzhin/ /ji ltar sems ni yul drug gnas bcas shing / /dbang po'i spyod yul dag kyang rab shes pa/ /de ltar sems ni yul drug gnas bcas te/ /dbang po'i spyod yul rnams kyang rab tu shes/ /gzugs dang sgra dang de bzhin dri rnams )snyedang / /ro dang reg bya de bzhin spyod yul chos/ /sems ni dbang po drug po thams cad la/ /dbang por bzhugs (skapa bya bzhin g.yo bar 'gyur/ /dbang po gang dang gang du gnas bcas pa/ /dbang po de ni shes par bdag nyid byed/ /lus ni g.yo ba med cing byed pa 90—31

med / /snying po med cing rkyen (1)las byung ba yin/ /yang dag ma yin yongs su rtog las byung / /grong stong las kyi 'khrul 'khor 'dra bar gnas/ /sa dang me dang chu dang rlung rnams ni/ /(9gzhan du (8)gnas te phyogs dang phyogs na gnas//dper na sprul gdug gnas gcig ji bzhin te/ /rtag tu phan tshun mthun pa ma yin bzhin/ /khams kyi sprul rnams bzhi po de dag kyang / /gnyis ni steng 'gro gnyis ni thur ༄du 'gro/ /phyogs dang phyogs mtshams (snyernams su gnyis gnyis te/ /khams sprul de dag thams cad 'jig par 'gyur/ /sa yi sbrul dang chu yi sbrul dag dang / /'di gnyis 'og tu zad par 'gyur ba yin/ /me yi sbrul dang rlung gi sbrul dag dang / /'di gnyis steng gi nam mkhar 'gro ba yin / /ji ltar sngon chad byas pa'i las rnams kyis/ /sems dang rnam yishes kun tu gnas nas dong / /lha dang mi dang ngan song gsum dag tu/ /ji ltar byas pa'i las kyis srid par skye/ /bad kun rlung dang mkhris pa zad gyur na/ /lus ni gcin dang ngan skyugs rnams kyis gang / /mngon par mi dga' srin bu'i phung por gyur/ /dur khrod dag na 'thor 57)ba shing bzhin gyur/ /lha mo khyod ni chos 'di rnams la ltos/ /'di la sems can de bzhin gang zag dang / /chos rnams 'di dag thams cad stong pa ste/ /ma rig pa yi rkyen las byung ba yin / /'byung ba chen po 'di dag che 'byung min/ /ma byung ba las byung zhing mi 'byung ste/ /gang gi phyir ni 'byung ba mi 'byung ba/ /de phyir 'byung ba che (kyezhes ngas brjod do/ / yod pa min zhing 59gzhar yang yod min la/ /ma rig pa yi rkyen las byung ba yin/ /ma rig 'di ni yod pa ma yin te/ /de bas ngas ni ma rig 'di bshad do/ /'du byed 1 rnam shes ming dang gzugs bcas dang / /skye 90—32

mched drug dang reg dang tshor ba dang / /sred (1)dang len dang de bzhin srid pa dang / /skye dang rga shi mya ngan gnod pa rnams/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /'khor ba'i 'khor lo ji ltar gnas pa dag /ma byung (geb las byung dang mi 'byung dang / /tshul bzhin ma yin sems kyis rnam dpyad tsho dang / /bdag gi ④lta bar gyur par bcad (5)par gyis56)/ /ye shes ral gris nyon mongs rgya mo grol4)/ /phung po'i gnas la stong par gyur par ltos/ /byang chub yon tan rgya chen reg 6)par gyis6)/ /ngas ni bdud rtsi (1 )grong khyer sgo yang phye / /bdud rtsi (nyakhu ba'i snod kyang kun tu bstan/ /nga nyusnyeni bdud rtsi'i grong khyer gnas der 'jug /ngas /9)ni bdud rtsi'i khu bas bdag tshim byas / /ngas ni chos kyi rnga chen dam pa brdungasali/ /ngas skyeni chos kyi dung gi mchog kyang bus/ /ngas ni chos kyi sgron ma mchog 'bar byas/ /ngas ni chos kyi char pa dam pa phab/ /nga tu 7ni nyon mongs dgra tu mchog rnams las rgyal/ /ngas ni chos kyi rgyal mtshan dam pa bsgreng / /srid pa'i mtsho las sems can rab tu bsgral/ /ngas ni ngan song gsum gyi lam rnams bkag /sems can nyon mongs me yis gdungs gyur pa/ /rten med gyur cing dpung gnyen med pa dgatsho) /srog chags nyon mongs mes gdungs zhi byas nas/ /bdud rtsi'i khu ba bsil shu snabs tshim par byas 0 / /gang phyir bskal pa du mar sngon chad ngas/ /'dren pa bsam gyis mi khyab mchod pa byas/ /chos kyi sku de yongs su tshol ba na/ /brtul zhugs brtan pas byang chub phyir spyad de/ /lag pa dang ni mig dang rkang pa dang / /yan lag mchog dang bu sdug bu mo dang / /nor dbyig nor bu mu tig rgyan dang gser / /bai ḍūrya dang rin chen sna tshogs btang / /stong gsum shing ljon 90—33

thams cad dang / /rtswa dang rtswa rnams thams cad dang / /nags tshal dag dang sa las ni/ / skye ba (1)thams cad bcad gtubs te/ /de dag thams cad phyer brlag 9rinas/ /rab tu phra ba'i rdul (8)'drar byas/ /nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor ji tsam par/ /phye ma'i phung po 54)spungs nas ni/ /'di la cha gsum dbye bar nus / /sa la rdul 5 ni yod pa rnams/ /stong gsum dag ni thams cad kyi/ /rdul 6)khams bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /sems can kun gyi shes pa gang / /de ni sems can gcig gir gyur/ /shes pa de yis rdul ⑦rnams kyi(8)/ /phye ma bgrang bar byed na ni/ /sems can kun las rab 'phags pa/ /ye shes rab ldan mi rnams kyis/ /thams cad bgrang bar nus srid kyi/ /rgyal ba'i mkhyen la lhokyemi nus so/ /thub pa chen po'i ye shes gang / /skad cig gcig la 'jug pa yang / /bskal pa bye ba du mar ni/ /gang du'ang bgrang bar mi nus so/ /gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po las/ stong pa nyid kyi le'u zhes bya ba ste drug pa'o// //de nas rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu dang / rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung dang / rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po dang / rgyal po chen po mig mi bzang rnams stan las langs te/ bla tsho gos phrag pa gcig tu bgos nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das gser 'od dam pa 1lhamado sde'i dbang po'i yi rgyal po 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsungs pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams 90wa 34

cad kyis gzigs pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dgongs pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad kyis yongs su bzung ba/ lha'i tshogs thams cad kyis phyag bgyis pa/ lha'i tshogs thams cad kyis mchod pa/ lha'i dbang po'i tshogs thams cad kyis mngon par bstod pa/ 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad kyis mchod cing bsngags pa (3)brjod nas rab tu bkur ba/ lha'i khang khyim thams cad snang bar bgyid pa/ sems can thams cad la mchog tu bde ba rab tu sbyin par bgyid pa/ sems can dmyal ba dang dud 'gro'i skye ②gnas dang gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi sdug bsngal thams cad rab tu (7skems pa/'jigs pa thams cad kyi rgyun gcod pa/ pha rol gyi dmag tshogs thams cad rab tu bzlog dupa/ mu ge'i dgon pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar bgyid pa/nad kyi dgon pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar bgyid pa/ gza' thams cad sel ba / mchog tu zhi bar bgyid pa/ mya ngan dang nyon mongs pa rab tu zhi bar bgyid pa/ gnod pa rnam pa sna tshogs rab tu zhi bar bgyid pa/ gnod pa brgya stong rab tu 'joms (9par bgyid pa lags so/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das gser 'od dam pa (6)mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di 'khor gyi nang du rgya cher yang dag par rab tu bshad na/ chos nyan pa chos bdud rtsi'i khu ba 'dis/bdag cag rgyal po chen po dpung dang g.yog tu bcas pa bzhi lha'i lus 'di (7gzi brjid (7chen pos rnam par 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /bdag cag gi lus la brtson pa dang stobs dang mthu yang skyed par 'gyur/ gzi brjid dang dpal dang phun sum tshogs pa yang de dag po)gi lus la 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag cag rgyal po chen po bzhi ni chos dang ldan pa chos smra 90—35

ba chos kyi rgyal po lags te/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag cag ni chos kyis lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang lha ma yin dang nam mkha' lding dang dri za dang mi 6)'am ci dang lto 'phye chen po rnams kyi rgyal po bgyi'o/ /'byung po'i tshogs mi bzad pa snying rje ma mchis pa gzhan gyi mdangs 'phrog pa rnams bzlog par bgyi'o/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag cag rgyal po chen po bzhi dang ②/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang gnod sbyin brgya stong phrag du ma dang lhan cig tu rtag par rgyun du lha'i mig rnam par dag pa/ mi las 'das pas 'dzam bu'i gling thams cad la blta bar bgyi/ bsrung bar bgyi/yongs su bskyang bar bgyi ste/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das de'i slad du/bdag cag rgyal po chen po bzhi 'jig rten skyong zhes ming du chags so/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das gang su dag 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir/ pha rol gyi dmag tshogs kyis yul 'joms ⑧par 'gyur ram/ mu ge'i gnod pa'am/ nad kyi gnod pa'am/ gnod pa sna tshogs brgya ④dang gnod pa stong dang gnod pa brgya phrag stong dag gis gtses par 'gyur ba na⑤/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag cag rgyal po chen po bzhis yigaser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di 'dzin pa'i dge slong chos smra ba de dag la bskul ba ⑦bgyi'o/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das nam bdag cag rgyal po chen po bzhis nirdzu 'phrul dang byin gyi rlabs 6)kyis dge slong chos smra ba de dag la bkur ⑩ba na/ yul gang dang gang du mchi tunyebar gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di yul de dang de dag tu rgya cher yang dag par ston par 'gyur te/ gang gnod pa sna tshogs brgya ⑫dang gnod pa stong yul du 'byung ba 'di lta bu 'di dag rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /90—36

btsun pa bcom ldan 'das mi'i rgyal po gang gi ①yul du mdo sde'i dbang po 'dzin pa'i dge slong chos smra ba de dag mchi bar 'gyur ba'i yul de dag tu gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di yang bsnyen par 'gyur ro/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das nam mi'i rgyal pos gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di nyan te thos nas/ mdo sde'i dbang po 'dzin pa'i dge slong de dag phyir rgol ba thams cad las kun tu bsrung bar bgyid/ yongs su bskyab pa dang / yongs su 'dzin pa dang / yongs su skyong bar bgyid na/btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag cag rgyal po chen po bzhis/ mi'i rgyal po'i yul de thams cad na gnas pa'i sems can rnams kun tu bsrung bar bgyi②/yongs su bskyab pa dang / yongs su gzung ⑧ba dang / yongs su bskyang ba dang tso/ zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur bar bgyi'o/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das mi'i rgyal pos linam/ dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen (snyenam / dge bsnyen ma mdo sde'i dbang po 'dzin pa la/ bde bar sbyar ba thams cad kyis ⑥bde bar bgyid na/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag cag rgyal po chen po bzhisasti/ mi'i rgyal po de'i yul thams cad na gnas pa'i sems can rnams la bde ba'i yo byad thams cad kyis/ bde ba dang yo byad thams cad phun sum tshogs par bgyi'o/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das nam mi'i rgyal pos dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma'am/mdo sde'i dbang po 'dzin pa la bsti nistang du bgyid/ bla mar bgyid/ rim gror bgyid cing mchod na/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag cag rgyal po chen po bzhis/ mi'i rgyal po de la rgyal po thams cad pas ches ⑨bste stang du bgyi/ 90—37

ches bla mar bgyi/ ches rim gror 1)bgyi/ ches mchod par bgyi ste yul thams cad du yang rab tu bsngags rin)par bgyi'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ①rgyal po chen po bzhi la legs so zhi)zhes bya ba byin te rgyal po chen po dag legs so legs so/ /rgyal po chen po khyod yang legs so legs so/ /'di lta ste khyod ni sngon gyi rgyal ba la lhag par bya ba byas pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams bskyed pa/sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag mang po (5)la bsnyen bkur byas pa chos dang ldan pa chos smra ba chos kyis lha dang mi rnams kyi rgyal po byas (6)pa'o 'di lta ste khyod ni 7)yun ring por sems can thams cad la phan pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ bde ba dang byams pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde bar bya ba'i lhag pa'i bsam pa la zhugs pa(8)/ mi phan pa thams cad 'gog pa/ sems can thams cad la bde ba thams cad nye bar bsgrub par brtson pa yin te/ rgyal po chen po khyed bzhis/ mi'i rgyal po gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di la mchod pa dang rim gro byed par brtson pa de dag la kun tu bsrung (9)bar gyis ⑩shig /yongs su bskyab pa dang /yongs nyu1su gzung 3 ba dang / yongs su bskyang ba dang / chad pa spang ba dang /(nyezhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur bar gyis shig /de nas tshergyal po chen po dpung dang / g.yog dang / gnod sbyin brgya stong phrag du ma dang bcas pa khyed bzhis 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis bochos kyi tshul kun tu bsrung bar 7'gyur ro/ /yongs su bskyang ba hurtedang yongs su gzung 1)bar yang 'gyur 7ro/ / de nas (bye rgyal po chen po dpung dang / g.yog dang / gnod sbyin brgya stong phrag du ma 90—38

dang bcas pa khyed bzhi lha dang lha ma yin du g.yul 'gyed pa na rgyal bar 'gyur ro / /lha ma yin rnams pham par 'gyur ro/ /'di ltar gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po pha rol gyi dmag tshogs 1)thams cad 'dul bar byed pa 'di'i phyir/ dge slong ngam dge slong ma'am dge bsnyen nam dge bsnyen ma mdo sde'i dbang po 'dzin pa/ de dag la kun tu bsrung ba (bgyis shig /yongs su bskyab pa dang / yongs su gzung ( ba dang / yongs su bskyang ba dang / zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur bar ④gyis shig /de nas rgyal po chen po rnam (5)thos kyi 96ribu dang / rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung 57)dang / rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po dang / rgyal po chen po mig mi bzang stan las langs te587/ gos phrag pa gcig tu bgos nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das ma 'ongs pa'i dus na 9rigaser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di/ grong ngam/ grong khyer ram/grong rdal lam/ ljongs sam/ yul 'khor ram/ pho brang 'khor gang du spyod par 'gyur ba dang / mi'i rgyal po gang dang gang gi 1 yul du spyod par 'gyur ba dang / btsun pa bcom ldan 'das mi'i tsho1rgyal por gyur pa gang la la zhig lha'i dbang po'i dam tshig rgyal po'i bstan bcos 'dis/ rgyal po bgyid cing rtag par rgyun du gser 'od dam pa hu mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di nyan tam/rim gro 1snyebagyid dam/ mchod pa 7bgyid dam/ gedage slong ngam/ dge slong ma 'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po tsha'adzin pa de dag la yang bsti stang bgyid/ btsun par bgyid/ rim gror ⑩90—39

bgyid cing mchod de rtag par rgyun du gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po nyan na/ chos mnyan pa'i chu bo'i chu chos bdud rtsi'i khu ba 'dis bdag cag rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / g.yog rnams dang gnod sbyin brgya stong phrag du ma'i lha'i lus 'di dag gzi brjid chen po rnam ①par 'phel bar 'gyur/bdag cag la brtson 'grus dang mthu dang stobs chen por yang bgyid par 'gyur/bdag gi gzi brjid dang dpal dang / phun sum tshogs pa yang rnam ②par 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag cag rgyal po chen po bzhi dpung dang g.yog tu bcas pa gnod sbyin brgya stong phrag du ma dang ①lus bltar mi gda' (pebar bgyis te/ da ltar dang ma 'ongs 0pa'i dus na grong ngam/grong khyer ram/ grong rdal lam/ ljongs sam/yi yul 'khor ram/ pho brang 'khor gang na/ gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di spyod par 'gyur ba de dag tu mchi bar bgyi'o/ /mi'i rgyal po gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di mnyan pa dang / rim gro ⑦bgyid pa dang / mchod pa ⑧bgyid pa de dag la kun tu bsrung 6)bar bgyi'o/ /yongs su bskyab pa dang /yongs su gzung ⑩ba dang / yongs su bskyang ba (7dang / chad pa spang ba dang /zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur bar bgyi'o/ /rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor de dag dang yul 'khor de dag dang tu)yul de dag kyang kun tu bsrung bar bgyi'o/ /yongs su bskyab pa dang / yongs su gzung 8ba dang / yongs su bskyang ba dang / chad pa spang ba dang / zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur bar bgyi'o/ /yul de dag kyang 'jig tshupa dang gnod pa dang / 'khrug 8pa thams cad las yongs su thar bar bgyi'o/ /pha rol gyi dmag tshogs ⑩rnams kyang slar bzlog 90—40

par bgyi'o/ /mi'i rgyal po gang la la gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di mnyan ①pa dang / rim gro bgyid pa dang / mchod pa bgyid pa de'i dgra zla 'dab ②nye ba'i rgyal po gzhan zhig mchis la/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das nam dgra zla 'dab ②nye ba'i rgyal po de 'di snyam du bdag dpung gi ④tshogs yan lag bzhi pa dang lhan cig tu ⑤yul der song ste/ yul de rnam par gzhig go snyam du sems bskyed na/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das de'i tshe de'i dus na / gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di'i gzi brjid kyi mthus dgra zla 'dab ⑥nye ba'i rgyal po de rgyal po gzhan dag dang g.yul 'gyed par 'gyur / rang gi yul du phyin na yang / yul 'khrug par 'gyur/ (7rgyal po'i 'khrug pa mi bzad pa yang 'byung bar 'gyur/ yul du gza' dang nad kyang 'byung bar 'gyur/ yul du brel ba sna tshogs 6)brgya dag kyang 'byung bar 'gyur rol/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das nam dgra zla 'dab 0nye ba'i rgyal po de rang gi yul du phyin pa na/ gnod pa sna tshogs 0brgya dang brel ba sna tshogs skyobargya 'di lta bu 'byung ngo / /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das dgra zla 'dab hunye ba'i rgyal po de yan lag bzhi pa'i dmag bsogs te/ pha rol gyi dmag tshogs tunyesu mchi ba'i slad du rang gi 7yul nas byung stesnyi/ dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa dang lhan cig tu yul der mchi 'tshal ba dang / gang na tsogaser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di gnas pa'i yul de rnam par gzhig 'tshal bar gyur ⑩na/btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag 8cag rgyal po chen po bzhi dpung dang g.yog tu bcas pa/ gnod sbyin brgya stong du ma dang lhan yicig tu lus mi gda' gu bar bgyis te der mchi bar bgyi'o/ /pha rol gyi dmag tshogs de yul 0du zhugs pa 90—41

las 6)kyang / de nyid nas ldog par bgyi'o/ /brel ba rnam pa 〈sna tshogs ①brgya dag kyang nye bar bsgrub par bgyi'o/ /bgegs kyang bgyi'o/ /'di lta ste yul der pha rol (padamag tshogs de mchi bar yang zhi)mi nus na/ yul gzhig par bgyid par lta ga la 'gyur/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po chen po bzhi po dag la legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ rgyal po chen po dag legs so yilegs so / /rgyal po chen po dag khyed yang legs te/ khyed bskal pa grangs med pa bye ba khrag 3)khrig brgya stong du yang dag par bsgrubs te(she/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'di'i phyir/ mi'i rgyal po gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di nyan pa dang / rim gro byed pa dang / mchod pa byed pa de dag la kun tu bsrung ba ༄9)gyis shig /yongs su bskyab pa dang / yongs su gzung ba dang / yongs su bskyang ba dang / chad pa spang ba dang / zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur bar nyu nogyis shig /rgyal 37po'i pho brang 'khor de dag dang /grong khyer de dag dang / yul 'khor de dag dang / yul de dag kyang kun tu srungs nyugeshig /yongs su bskyab pa dang / yongs su gzung ba dang / yongs su bskyang ba dang / chad pa spang ba dang / zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur bar (srigyis shig /yul de dag kyang 'jigs pa dang gnod pa dang 'khrug pa thams cad las yi riyongs su thar bar gyis shig /pha rol gyi dmag tshogs rnams kyang zlog cig /'dzam bu'i gling thams cad na gnas pa'i mi'i rgyal po dag mi 'thab pa dang / mtshang mi 'dru 8ba dang / mi rtsod rdzipa dang / mi 'gyed par bya ba la spro bar gyis shig /rgyal po chen po dpung dang g.yog tu bcas pa khyed bzhi'i ⑩'dzam bu'i gling 'dir nam grong khyer hu brgyad khri bzhi stong de dag na/ rgyal po 90—42

brgyad khri bzhi stong de dag rang rang gi yul la mngon par dga' ba dang / rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug des mngon par dga' ba dang / rang gi nor gyi phung pos phan tshun rnam ①par mi 'tshe ba dang / phan tshun rnam par 'tshe ba mi bskyed rdo pa dang / rang gis ji ltar sngon gyi las bsags ①pas rgyal po thob pa'i rang gi ri rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug gis dga' ba dang / phan tshun du yul 'jig par mi byed pa dang / yul gzhig (9pa'i phyir pha rol gyi gnod pa dang / nam 97'dzam bu'i 7gling 'dir grong khyer brgyad khri bzhi stong dag na rgyal po brgyad khri bzhi stong de dag phan tshun du byams pa'i sems su 'gyur/ byams pa'i sems dang phan pa'i sems su 'gyur te/ phan tshun du mi 'thab mtshang mi 'dru mi rtsod ( mi 'gyed par rang rang gi yul dag na dga' bar 'gyur 6nyen/ de'i phyir rgyal po chen po dpung dang g.yog tu bcas pa khyed bzhi 'dzam bu'i gling 'di rgyas par yo ri'agyur / lo legs tunyapar 'gyur/ nyams dga' bar 'gyur/ skye bo mang po dang mis gang bar 'gyur/ sa yang tu)mdangs can du 'gyur/ dus dang zla ba dang zla ba phyed dang lo khyud kor thams cad kyang yang dag pa'i dus dang ldan par 'gyur / gza' dang / rgyu skar dang / zla ba dang / nyi ma yang nyin mtshan du legs 0par rgyu bar 'gyur/ char pa'i rgyun yang sa la dus dus su 'bab par 'gyur / 'dzam bu'i gling thams cad na gnas pa'i sems can rnams kyang nor dang 'bru thams cad 'byor par 'gyur/ longs yispyod che ba dang / ser sna med par 'gyur/ gtong 8ba dang ldan par tso'agyur/ dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam dang ldan par 'gyur/ phal cher bde 'gro mtho ris lho kyi 'jig rten du skye bar 'gyur/ lha'i khang khyim rnams tunyekyang lha dang lha'i bu rnams hu kyis gang bar 90—43

'gyur ro/ /rgyal po chen po dag gang la la zhig mi'i rgyal por gyur la gser 'od dam pa hu)mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di nyan par gyur te/ rim gro bya sa/mchod pa ②byas/ dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen srinam/dge bsnyen gyum mdo sde'i dbang po 'dzin pa de dag la yang bsti stang ⑤byed/ bla mar byed/ rim gror (7byed/ mchod par ⑦byed cing / rgyal po chen po khyed bzhi dpung dang g.yog tu bcas pa gnod sbyin stong phrag du ma la snying brtse ba'i phyir rtag par rgyun du gser 'od dam ⑧pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di nyan na / chos nyan pa'i chu'i 595klung chos bdud rtsi'i khu ba 'dis tshukhyed cag gi lus 'di dag tshim par 'gyur ro/ /khyed kyi lha'i lus 'di dag gi gzi byin 7chen po yang rnam par 'phel lo/ /khyed kyi brtson 'grus dang mthu dang stobs kyang bskyed do / /khyed kyi gzi brjid dang dpal dang phun sum tshogs pa yang rnam par 'phel lo/ /mi'i rgyal po des de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa nga la yang mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rgya chen po yangs pa byas par 'gyur ro/ /mi'i rgyal po des 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du ma la yang yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab pa rgya che ba yangs pa thams cad kyis mchod pa ⑫byas par 'gyur ro/ /des na mi'i rgyal po de la bsrung ba chen po byas par 'gyur ro / /des na mi'i rgyal po de la kun tu bsrung ba dang / yongs su bskyab pa dang / yongs su gzung ba dang / yongs su bskyang ba dang / chad pa spang ba dang / zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ba byas par 'gyur ro/ /btsun mo dam pa dang / rgyal bu rnams (snyedang / btsun mo'i 'khor thams cad dang / rgyal 90—44

po'i pho brang 'khor thams cad kyang bsrung ba chen po byas par 'gyur/ yongs su bskyab pa dang / yongs su gzung ba dang / yongs su bskyang ba dang / chad pa spang ba dang / zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ba byas par 'gyur/ rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor na gnas pa'i lha thams cad kyang ches gzi brjid dang ldan pa dang ske/ ches stobs dang ldan pa dang / bde ba dang yid bde ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan par 'gyur/ dga' ba sna tshogs myong bar 'gyur/ grong khyer de dag dang yul 'khor de dag kyang kun tu bsrung bar hu)'gyur/ yongs su bskyang bar ②'gyur/ gnod pa med par 'gyur/ dgra med par 'gyur/ pha rol gyi dmag ①tshogs thams cad kyis mi rdzi ④ba dang gnod pa med pa dang 'khrug pa med par 'gyur ro/ /de skad ces ⑤bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu dang / rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung dang ske/ rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po dang / rgyal po chen po mig mi bzang (6)de dag gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das mi'i rgyal po gang la la zhig gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di yang nyan par du'atshal bar 'gyur/ bdag nyid la yang bsrung ba chen po bgyid du'atshal bar 'gyur/ btsun mo dam pa dang / rgyal bu rnams dang / rgyal po'i bu mo rnams dang / btsun mo'i 'khor gyi tshogs rnams la yang bsrung ba chen po bgyid 'tshal bar 'gyur/ rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor de dag ⑨thams cad la yang zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ba chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa mchog tu khyad par du 'phags pa bla na med pa bgyid 'tshal bar 'gyur/ tshe 'di la bdag gi rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnam par 'phel bar bgyid 90—45

'tshal bar 'gyur/ rgyal po nyid bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan par 'gyur①/bsod nams kyi phung po dpag tu ma mchis pa yongs su 'dzin 'tshal bar 'gyur②/bdag gi yul thams cad kyang kun tu bsrung 'tshal bar 'gyur/ yongs su bskyang 'tshal bar 'gyur(5)/ rang gi yul na gnod pa ma mchis pa dang / dgra ma mchis pa dang / pha rol gyi dmag tshogs kyis mi rdzi ④ba dang / nad 'go ba ma mchis pa dang / 'khrug pa ma mchis par bgyid 'tshal bar 'gyur phyin/btsun pa bcom ldan 'das mi'i rgyal po des g.yeng ba ma mchis pa'i sems dang gus pa dang bcas pa dang ri mo dang bcas pas gser 'od dam pa 6)mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di bsti stang du bgyid de 5she)mnyan par bgyi'o/ /gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di mnyan pa'i slad du/ mi'i rgyal po des rgyal po'i pho brang khyad par du 'phags par mchi bar 48)bgyi'o/ /der mchis nas kyang rgyal po'i pho brang spos chab sna tshogs kyis chag chag gdab cing me tog sil ma sna tshogs dgram par bgyi'o/ /spos chab sna tshogs kyis (9)chag chag btab pa der chos kyi khri mthon po rgyan sna tshogs kyis legs par brgyan pa bsham par bgyi'o/ /phyogs der gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan sna tshogs kyis legs par brgyan par bgyi'o/ /mi'i rgyal po des lus bkru bar bgyi'o/ /gos dri rab tu bda' sna rib gos sar pa mdzes pa bgos nas rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan (nyapar bgyi'o/ /bdag gi stan rab tu dma' ba gding bar bgyi ste/ stan de la mchis nas rgyal po'i rgyags pas dregs par mi bgyi'o/ /der rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug la chags par mi bgyi'o/ /rgyags pa dang nga rgyal dang dregs pa thams cad rnam par spangs pa'i sems kyis gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 90—46
