'di mnyan par bgyi'o/ /dge slong chos smra ba de la yang ston par 'du shes bskyed par bgyi'o/ /mi'i rgyal po des de'i tshe de'i dus na/ btsun mo dam pa dang —/ rgyal bu rnams dang / rgyal po'i bu mo rnams dang / btsun mo'i 'khor gyi tshogs rnams la sdug pa dang phan pas 0)blta bar bgyi'o/ /btsun mo dam pa dang / rgyal bu rnams dang / rgyal po'i bu mo rnams la tshig (gyisnyan pa smra bar bgyi'o / /btsun mo'i 'khor gyi tshogs thams cad la yang tshig ④snyan pa smra bar bgyi'o / /chos nyan pa'i mchod pa rnam pa sna tshogs sbyor du stsal bar bgyi'o/ /dga' ba bsam gyis mi khyab cing mtshungs pa ma mchis pas bdag tshim ④par bgyi'o / /dga' ba dang bde ba bsam gyis mi khyab pas bde bar bgyi'o/ /dbang po bde bar bgyi'o/ /bdag nyid don chen po thob par bsam par bgyi'o / /bdag dga' ba chen pos dga' bar bgyi'o/ /rab tu dga' ba chen po bskyed nas chos smra ba bsu ⑤bar bgyi'o/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po chen po bzhi la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rgyal po chen po dag de'i tshe de'i dus na/ mi'i rgyal po des gos thams cad dkar po sar pa mdzes pa bgo bar bya'o/ /spud pa dang rgyan sna tshogs kyis bdag legs par brgyan (7par bya'o/ /gdugs dkar po yang gzung bar bya'o/ /rgyal po'i mthu chen po dang rgyal po'i bkod pa chen pos bkra shis tha dad pa sna tshogs thogs te/ rgyal po'i pho brang de nas byung la (7)chos smra ba bsu ba'i phyir der 'gro bar bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ mi'i rgyal pos der gom pa ji snyed bor ba de snyed kyi bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gi 'khor ba phyir bsnyil bar 'gyur / de snyed kyi 'khor los sgyur (8)ba'i rgyal rigs bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong 90—47

thob par 'gyur/ der gom pa ji snyed bor ba de snyed du tshe 'di la rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phel bar 'gyur/ bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du mar gnas yangs shing rgya che ba lha'i gzhal med ①khang rin po che sna bdun las byas pa dag thob par 'gyur/ mi rnams kyi rgyal rigs lha'i rgya che zhing rgya che ba brgya stong phrag du ma thob par 'gyur/ skye ba thams cad du dbang phyug chen po thob par 'gyur/ tshe ring bar 'gyur/ yun ring du 'tsho bar 'gyur/ spobs pa dang ldan par 'gyur/ tshig ②gzung bar 'os par 'gyural/ grags pa dang ldan par 'gyur/ brjod pa shin tu rgya che bar 'gyur/bsngags par 'os par 'gyur/ lha dang mi dang lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten la phan par 'gyur/ lha dang mi rnams kyi bde ba rgya ①che zhing rgya 0che ba thob par 'gyur/ stobs che bar 'gyur/ tshan po che chen po'i stobs kyi shugs dudang ldan zhing gzugs ⑥bzang bar 'gyur/ mdzes pa dang blta ⑦na sdug pa dang / kha dog bzang po rgyas pa mchog (kyedang ldan par 'gyur/ skye ba thams cad du de bzhin gshegs pa dang phrad par 'gyur/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams rnyed par 'gyur/ bsod nams kyi phung po dpag tu med pa yongs su gzung 6)bar 'gyur te/ rgyal po chen po dag yon tan gyi phan yon 'di lta bu dag mthong nas/ mi'i rgyal po des dpag tshad tsam du chos smra ba bsu bar bya/dpag tshad brgya dang / dpag tshad stong du yang bsu bar bya/ chos smra ba de la ston par 'du shes bskyed par bya'o/ /'di snyam du yang de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa deng ⑩bdag 0gi rgyal po'i pho brang 'dir 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /deng de bzhin gshegs pa dgra 90—48

bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa bdag gi rgyal po'i pho brang 'dir bshos gsol bar 'gyur ro/ /deng bdag gis de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i chos 'jig rten thams cad dang mi mthun pa mnyan par bya'o/ /deng bdag gis chos nyan 6)pa 'dis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par bya'o / /deng bdag gis de bzhin gshegs pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du ma mnyes par byas par 'gyur ro/ /deng bdag gis 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la mchod pa chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa yangs ②shing rgya che ba byas par 'gyur ro/ /deng bdag gis sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas ①dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi sdug bsngal ④thams cad shin tu rgyun bcad ⑤par 'gyur ro/ /deng bdag gis tshangs pa'i dbang po'i rgyal po nyid kyi lus bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du ma 'thob pa de yidag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba'i rtsis bon bskyed par 'gyur ro / /deng bdag gis brgya byin nyid kyi lus bye ba khrag khrig (8)brgya stong phrag du (9)ma thob ⑩pa dag gi ⑩dge ba'i rtsa ba'i sa bon bskyed par 'gyur ro/ /deng bdag gis ⑩'khor los sgyur tsoba'i rgyal po nyid kyi lus bye ba 8khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du ma 'thob pa dag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba'i sa bon bskyed par 'gyur ro/ /deng bdag gis bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du ma 8'khor ba las yongs su thar bar byas par 'gyur ro/ /deng bdag gis bsod nams kyi phung po dpag tu med pa bla na med pa yangs shing ⑩rgya che ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa yongs su gzung ⑩bar 'gyur/ deng bdag 8gis btsun mo'i 'khor gyi tshogs 90—49

thams cad la bsrung ba chen po byas par 'gyur ro/ /deng bdag gis rgyal po'i pho brang 'dir zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa mchog tu khyad par du 'phags pa bla na med pa byas par 'gyur ro/ /deng bdag gis yul 'di thams cad kun tu bsrungs par 6)'gyur ro/ /yongs su bskyangs pa phyidang /gnod pa med pa dang / dgra med pa dang / pha rol gyi chadamag tshogs thams cad kyis mi rdzi 'a)ba dang / nad 'go ba med pa dang / 'khrug pa med par 'gyur ro snyam du sems bskyed par bya'o/ /rgyal po chen po dag ⑤dge slong ngam/dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen 6)nam/ dge bsnyen dum gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'dzin pa dag la mi'i rgyal po de dam pa'i chos la gus pa 'di lta bus bsti stang byed/ bla mar byed/ rim gror (shebyed/ mchod pa ⑨byed cing / rgyal po chen po khyed bzhi dpung dang g.yog tu bcas pa dang / lha'i tshogs de dag dang gnod sbyin brgya stong du ma dag la shas tu )kyi dam pa byin na/mi'i rgyal po de bsod nams mngon par 'du byed pa dang / dge ba mngon par 'du byed pa /spedang / tshe 'di'i lus (9kyi rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug chen po yibasam gyis mi khyab pa des rnam skyapar 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /tshe 'di la rgyal po'i gzi brjid chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /dpal dang phun sum tshogs pa dang gzi brjid kyis kyang brgyan par 'gyur ro/ /phyir rgol ba thams cad dang dgra thams cad chos dang mthun pas shin tu tshar gcod par 'gyur ro/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po chen po snyibazhi po de dag gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das gang la la zhig mi'i rgyal por gyur yil/ de chos la gus pa de lta bus 90—50

gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po nyan la dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam6)/ dge bsnyen ②ma mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po ①'dzin pa de dag la yang bsti stang bgyid/ bla mar bgyid/ rim gror ④bgyid / mchod pa (nyabagyid cing / rgyal po chen po bdag cag gi (6)slad du rgyal po'i pho brang de shin tu dag par phyag dar bgyid(7)/ spos chab sna tshogs kyis (3rachag chag legs par 'debs la/ bdag cag rgyal po chen po (9)bzhi dang lhan cig thun mong du chos nyan pa de nyan cing bdag dang lha thams cad kyi slad du dge ba'i rtsa bar ⑩shas cung zad cig sbyin pa bgyid na/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das dge slong chos smra ba de chos kyi stan la mchis ma thag tu mi'i rgyal po des bdag cag rgyal po chen po bzhi'i don gyi slad du spos sna tshogs kyis bdug 67par bgyi'o / /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po de la mchod pa'i slad du bdug tu)pas bdugs tsom thag tu spos sna tshogs rnams ④las spos dang bdug pa sna tshogs kyi 'khri 8shing dag 'byung yibar 'gyur te⑩ / de dag skad cig thang cig yud tsam de la bdag cag rgyal po chen po bdag cag bzhi'i rang rang gi khang pa'i steng gi bar snang la spos dang bdug pa sna tshogs kyi 'khri 8shing dag gi gdugs 4)rnams su gnas par 'gyur/ spos dri rgya chen po yang mnam par 'gyur/ gser gyi kha dog lta bu'i snang ba 8 —ri'abyung bar 'gyur zhing snang (lhab des bdag cag gi zhugekhang pa rnams kyang snang ba bgyis par 'gyur ro/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das spos dang bdug pa sna tshogs kyi 'khri sushing dag skad cig thang cig yud tsam de la mi mjed du — )kyi bdag po tshangs pa dang lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin dang / lha mo chen mo dbyangs can dang / lha mo 90—51

chen mo brtan ma dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po yang dag shes dang /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / lha'i bu dbang phyug chen po dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po nor bu bzang dang / 'phrog (1)ma'i bu lnga brgya'i 'khor dang ldan pa dang / klu'i rgyal po chen po ma dros pa dang / klu'i rgyal po chen po rgya mtsho dang / de dag gi rnarang rang gi khang pa'i steng gi bar snang la byung ste/ spos dang bdug ripa sna tshogs kyi 'khri 4)shing gi gdugs rnams su gnas par 'gyur/spos dri sna tshogs rgya chen po yang mnam par 'gyur/ khang pa rnams kyi nang du gser du snang 5ba 'byung bar 'gyur zhing snang ba des gnas thams cad snang ba bgyis 6par 'gyur ro/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po chen po bzhi la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rgyal po chen po dag rgyal po chen po khyed bzhi'i rang rang 7gi khang pa rnams kyi steng gi bar snang 98)la spos dang bdug 9pa sna tshogs kyi 'khri 1 tshoshing de dag gdugs rnams su gnas par ma zad do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rgyal po chen po dag mi'i rgyal po des gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di la mchod pa'i phyir/ spos sna tshogs de dag gis 11bdugs ma thag tu lag na spos /nasnod gcig thogs pa de las spos dang bdug pa sna tshogs kyi 'khri 1 shing rnams 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de skad cig thang cig yud tsam de la stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di thams cad na gang na zla ba bye ba phrag brgya dang / nyi ma bye ba phrag brgya dang /rgya mtsho chen po bye ba phrag brgya 1 dang / ri'i rgyal po ri rab bye ba phrag brgya lkudang / ri'i rgyal po khor 10yug dang / khor 1 yug chen po bye ba phrag brgya dang /90—52

gling bzhi 6)pa chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba phrag brgya (2)dang / rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha bye ba phrag brgya dang / sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha sa bye ba phrag brgya nas 'du shes med 'du shes med min du nye bar song ba'i bar gyi lha bye ba phrag sgyu brgya dang / stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams de dag thams cad du sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha'i ris bye ba phrag brgya po thams cad na lha dang /klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye (5richen po'i tshogs rnams kyi ri skurang rang gi khang pa dag gi steng gi bar snang la spos dang bdug pa sna tshogs kyi 'khri shing de dag gdugs rnams su gnas par 'gyur/ spos dri rgya chen po yang mnam par 'gyur / lha'i khang pa rnams su gser gyi kha dog lta bu'i snang ba yang 'byung 57bar 'gyur zhing snang ba des kyang lha'i khang pa rnams snang ba byas par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po chen po dag 'di ltar stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na lha'i khang pa thams cad kyi steng gi bar snang la spos dang bdug pa'i 'khri shing de dag gdugs rnams su gnas pa de bzhin du/ gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di la mchod pa'i phyir mi'i rgyal po des naspos sna tshogs de dag gis bdugs 9)ma thag tu gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di'i gzi brjid kyi mthus 1 )spos dang bdug 11pa sna tshogs kyi 'khri sna shing dag 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de dag skad cig thang cig yud tsam de la kun tu phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams du ma gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba khrag khrig brgya phrag stong 1 rnams su de bzhin gshegs pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du ma gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag gi steng gi bar snang la 90—53

spos dang bdug pa sna tshogs kyi 'khri shing gi gdugs hu)rnams su gnas par 'gyur / de dag kyang sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du ma la spos dang bdug pa sna tshogs rgya che zhing (0rgya che ba mnam par 'gyur/ gser gyi kha dog lta bu'i snang ba 'byung bar 'gyur zhing snang 55)ba des kyang sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba khrag khrig stong phrag du ma gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag snang ba byas par 'gyur ro / /rgyal po chen po dag cho gi)'phrul de lta bu de dag byung ma thag tu de bzhin gshegs pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong (9phrag du ma gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag chos smra ba de la dgongs par 'gyur/ skyes bu dam pa legs so legs so/ /skyes bu dam pa khyod gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po'i 0tshul 'di lta bu/ zab mor snang ba 'di lta bu'i (7yon tan bsam gyis (8)mi khyab pa dang ldan pa (9༄'di lta bu 'di rgya cher yang dag par rab tu 'chad par 'dod pa khyod yang legs so malegs so zhes bya ba nyu)sbyin par 'gyur ro/ /su tha na gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di nyan pa'i sems can de dag kyang dge ba'i rtsa ba ngan ngon dang ldan par mi 'gyur na/ gang dag 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang /12 'chad pa dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / 'khor la rgya cher yang dag par rab tu ston pa lta smos kyang ci dgos/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ skyes bu dam pa gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di thos ma thag tu byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du ma bla na med pa yang dag par 12rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// //'phags pa gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po zhes bya ba theg pa 90wa 54

chen po'i mdo/ bam po gsum pa/ de nas phyogs bcu 1)kun tu sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du ma gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ de bzhin gshegs pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du ma rang rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing na bzhugs pa dag gis de'i tshe de'i dus (shen/ tshig gcig 95)dang ngag gcig (gedang sgra skad gcig (5)gis dge slong chos smra ba chos kyi stan la 'dug pa de la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /skyes bu dam pa khyod ma 'ongs pa'i dus ci'adin byang chub kyi snying por 'gro bar 'gyur/ skyes bu dam pa khyod byang chub kyi snying po mchog dam par song ste/ shing gi rgyal po'i drung du 'dug nas 'jig rten gsum po thams cad las khyad par du 'phags pa/ sems can thams cad las rab tu 'das pa'i brtul zhugs dang dka' thub spyod pa'i stobs bskyed tsa)pa'i byin gyis (8nibarlabs dka' ba spyod pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du ma dag ston par 'gyur/skyes bu dam pa khyod byang chub kyi snying po legs par brgyan par 99)byed par 'gyur/skyes bu dam pa khyod stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad yongs su skyob par 'gyur/ skyes bu dam pa khyod shing gi rgyal po'i drung du 'dug ste bdud kyi sde bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ gzugs rab tu 'jigs 'jigs ltar 'dug pa mi sdug pa ston pa/ gzugs mi sdug pa sna tshogs dag las rgyal bar 'gyur / skyes bu dam pa khyod byang chub kyi snying po mchog dam par song ste/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub dpe med pa rab tu zhi ba rdul dang bral ba zab mo mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur/ skyes bu dam pa khyod rdo rje'i gdan snying po brtan pa la 'dug ste/ chos kyi 'khor los sgyur bob thams cad kyis mngon par bstod pa/ mchog tu zab pa bla na med pa rnam pa 90—55

bcu gnyis rab tu bskor bar 'gyur/ skyes bu dam pa khyod chos kyi rnga chen po bla na med pa rdung 1bar 'gyur/ skyes bu dam pa khyod chos kyi dung bla na med pa (ge'abud par 'gyur/ skyes bu dam pa khyod 55)chos kyi rgyal mtshan chen po bsgreng giribar 'gyur/ skyes bu dam pa khyod chos kyi sgron ma (5nibla na med pa 'bar bar byed par 'gyur/ skyes bu dam pa khyod chos kyi char bla na med pa 'bebs 565par 'gyur / skyes bu dam pa khyod nyon mongs pa'i dgra stong phrag du ma las rgyal bar 'gyur / skyes bu dam pa khyod sems can bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du ma shin tu 'jigs su rung ba 'jigs pa chen po'i rgya mtsho las sgrol bar 'gyur/ skyes bu 7dam pa khyod sems can bye ba khrag khrig brgya (89stong phrag du ma dag 'khor ba'i 'khor lo las yongs su thar bar byed par 'gyur/ skyes bu dam pa khyod sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du ma dag mnyes 9)par byed par 'gyur ro/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po chen po bzhi po de dag gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das mi'i rgyal po gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po'i yon tan tshe 'di dang ma 'ongs pa na 'byung ba 'di lta bu 'di dag mthong ba sangs rgyas stong phrag brgya la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa/ bsod nams kyi phung po dpag tu ma mchis pa yongs su 'dzin par 1 mthong nas snying brtse ba'i slad du/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag cag rgyal po chen po bzhi dpung dang g.yog tu bcas pa dang / gnod sbyin brgya stong phrag du ma rang rang gi khang pa na mchis pa dag spos dang bdug pa sna tshogs kyi 'khri 11shing dag gi 1 gdugs kyis 1 bskul ma thag tu lus mi gda' 1 skubar bgyis te/ mi'i rgyal po de 15khang pa brtsegs pa phyag dar ma mchis pa 90wa 56

legs par phyag dar bgyis pa/ spos chab sna tshogs kyis 91)chag chag legs par btab pa/ rgyan sna tshogs kyis rdo legs par brgyan pa'i rgyal po'i pho brang ga la ba der chos mnyan (7pa'i slad du mchi bar ci)bgyi'o/ /mi mjed sa kyi bdag po tshangs pa dang lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin dang / lha mo chen mo dbyangs can dang / lha mo chen mo sno)dpal dang / sa'i lha mo brtan ma dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po yang dag shes dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / lha'i bu dbang phyug chen po dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po nor bu bzang 7dang / 'phrog ma'i bu lnga brgya'i 'khor can dang / klu'i rgyal po ma dros pa dang /klu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho dang / lha bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du ma dag lus mi gda' 8bar bgyis te/ mi'i rgyal po de'i pho brang rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa 9ga la ba dang / chos smra ba de'i chos kyi khri mthon po rgyan 1 sna tshogs kyis legs par brgyan pa/ me tog bkram pa'i sa la 11bshams par 'gyur ba ga la ba der chos mnyan pa'i slad du mchi bar bgyi'o/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag cag rgyal po chen po bzhi dpung dang g.yog tu bcas pa/ gnod sbyin brgya stong phrag du ma de dag thams cad mthun par bgyis te mi'i rgyal po dge ba'i grogs nyanabagyid pa/ dge ba 'thob par bgyid 12pa/ bla na med pa chos kyi sbyin pa chen po sbyin pa de la/ chos kyi 57bdud rtsi'i khu ba 'dis tshim par gyur 15ma thag tu/mi'i rgyal po de sal kun tu bsrung bar bgyi'o17/ /yongs su bskyab pa dang /yongs su gzung 18ba dang / yongs su bskyang ba dang / zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur bar 19bgyi'o/ /rgyal po'i pho brang de dang grong khyer de dang yul de yang 90—57

kun tu bsrung bar bgyi'o/ /yongs su bskyab pa dang / yongs su gzung ba dang / yongs su bskyang ba minodang / zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur bar bgyi'o / /chad pa spang bar yang bgyi'o/ /yul de yang 'jigs pa dang gnod pa dang nad 'go ba dang 'khrug pa thams cad las yongs su thar bar bgyi'o/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das gang la la zhig mi'i rgyal por gyur te②/ mi'i rgyal po de'i yul du gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di byung la/btsun pa bcom ldan 'das mi'i rgyal po de dge slong dang dudage slong ma'am dge bsnyen 4stanam dge bsnyen (5rim gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di 'dzin pa dag la bsti stang mi bgyid/ bla mar mi bgyid/ rim gro mi bgyid/mchod pa mi bgyid na/ bdag cag rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / gnod sbyin bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du ma chos nyan pa 'di dang chos bdud rtsi'i khu ba 'dis (6)tshim par mi bgyid/ rim gro mi bgyid/ lha'i lus 'di dag gi gzi yang rnam par 'phel bar mi bgyid/ bdag cag gi brtson 'grus dang mthu ⑦dang stobs kyang mi bskyedan / bdag cag gi lus la gzi brjid dang dpal dang phun sum tshogs pa yang rnam par 'phel bar mi bgyid do/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag cag rgyal po chen po bzhi dpung dang g.yog tu bcas pa dang /gnod sbyin bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du ma dag gis yul de yal bar dor bar bgyi'o/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis kyi༄yul de yal bar bor na yul na gnas pa'i lha'i tshogs thams cad kyis kyang yul de yal bar 'dor 1 chibar 'gyur ro/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das lha rnams kyis 7yul de yal bar bor na yul der yul rnam par 'khrug pa sna tshogs 'byung bar 'gyur/90—58

rgyal po'i 'khrug pa mi bzad pa dag 'byung bar 'gyur/ yul na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad kyang 'thab pa skye ba dang mtshang 'dru ba skye ba dang rtsod pa skye bar 'gyur/ rdzogs 6)pa dang 'gyed par 'gyur ba dang gza' dang nad rnam pa sna tshogs yul du 'byung bar 'gyur/ phyogs tha dad pa nas skar mda' ltung bar 'gyur/ gza' dang rgyu skar rnams kyang phan tshun mi mthun par gda' bar 'gyur②ske/ dgung zla 'char ba de'ang gnyi ma lta bur gda' bar 'gyur/ zla ba'i gza' dang nyi ma'i gza' 'byung bar 'gyur/ nyi ma dang zla ba nam mkha' la gnas pa yang rtag par rgyun du sgra gcan gyi gnod pa dang ldan par 'gyur/dus dus su nam mkha' la 'ja'i kha dog lta bu 'khyil bar (4)'gyur/ sa yang ltarigayo bar 'gyur/ sa la gnas pa'i khron pa yang sgra 'byin par grag par 'gyur/yul du rlung drag po ldang bar 'gyur/ char drag po 'bab par 'gyur/ yul du mu ge'i dgon pa 'byung bar 'gyur/ pha rol gyi dmag tshogs kyis yul 'joms ne par 'gyur/ yul de phung bar 'gyur/ sems can de dag kyang nyon mongs pa mang ⑦bar 'gyur/ yul de nyams mi dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag cag rgyal po chen po bzhi dpung dudang g.yog tu bcas pa dang /gnod sbyin brgya 6)stong phrag du ma dang yul na gnas ⑩pa'i lha dang klu rnams kyis yul de yal bar bor na/ yul der 'di lta bu'i gnod pa rnam pa sna tshogs brgya dang gnod pa sna tshogs 7stong 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das gang la la zhig mi'i rgyal por gyur tsol/ de bdag nyid la kun tu bsrung ba chen po bgyid 'tshal bar 'gyur/ rgyal po'i bde ba sna tshogs yun ring por myong bar tu 'tshal bar 'gyur/ bde ba thams cad bstabs pa'i sems kyis 90—59

rgyal po nyid bgyid 'tshal bar 'gyur/ yul na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad bde bar bgyid 'tshal bar 'gyur/ pha rol gyi dmag 6)tshogs thams cad pham par bgyid 'tshal bar 'gyur/ yul thams cad yun ring du yongs su skyong 'tshal bar 'gyur/ chos kyi rgyal po nyid bgyid 'tshal (2)bar 'gyur/ rang gi yul yang 'jigs pa dang gnod pa dang nad 'go ba dang 'khrug pa thams cad las yongs su thar bar bgyid 'tshal bar 'gyur na/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das mi'i rgyal po des gdon mi 'tshal bar gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di mnyan par bgyisku / dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/dge bsnyen 5nam/ dge bsnyen 6ma mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal (75po 'dzin pa de dag la yang bsti stang bgyi/ bla mar bgyi/ rim gro bgyi/ mchod pa bgyi/bdag cag rgyal po chen po bzhi dpung dang g.yog tu bcas pa rnams kyang chos mnyan pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba bsags pa 'di dang rinachos bdud rtsi'i khu ba 'dis tshim 9par bgyi/ bdag cag gi lha'i lus 'di dag gi gzi chen po yang rnam par 'phel bar bgyi'o/ /de ci'i phyir khozhe na/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das mi'i rgyal po des gdon mi 'tshal bar gser 11'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di mnyan par bgyi ste/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das tshangs pa'i dbang pos 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bstan bcos rnam pa sna tshogs ji snyed bstan pa dag dang / lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis bstan bcos rnam pa sna tshogs ji snyed bstan 1 pa dag dang / drang srong mngon par shes pa lnga can rnam pa sna tshogs dag gis sems can dag gi don gyi slad du 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bstan bcos rnam pa sna tshogs ji snyed 1 bstan pa 90wa 60

dag las 1)ches mchog ches khyad par du 'phags pa gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di ni/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das tshangs pa'i dbang po brgya phrag (bstong de dag dang brgya (5)byin bye ba khrag khrig brgya pastong phrag du ma dang drang srong mngon par shes pa lnga can bye ba khrag khrig brgya phrag stong thams cad pas ches mchog ches 5khyad par du 'phags pa'i de bzhin gshegs pas sems can rnams kyi don gyi slad du rgya cher yang dag par bshad pa lags so/ /ji ltar na (neri'adzam bu'i gling thams cad na gnas pa'i mi 97)rnams kyi 87rgyal pos rgyal po nyid bgyi ba dang / ji ltar sems can thams cad bde bar 'gyur ba dang / ji ltar rang gi yul kun tu bsrungs par 59)'gyur ba dang / yongs su bskyangs par / 'gyur ba dang / ji ltar yul thams cad na gnod pa dang dgra ma mchis 11par 'gyur ba dang / ji ltar pha rol gyi dmag tshogs rnams pham ste phyir phyogs par 'gyur ba dang / ji ltar yul de dag na nad 'go ba ma mchis shing 'khrug pa ma mchis par 'gyur ba dang / ji ltar yul thams cad chos kyis 'khrug 12pa ma mchis shing mi rdzi sna bar 'gyur ba dang / ji ltar mi'i rgyal po de dag gis rang rang gi 516yul rnams su chos kyi sgron ma 15chen po 'bar bar bgyis shing snang bar bgyis par 'gyur ba dang / ji ltar lha'i khang khyim thams cad lha dag dang lha'i bu rnams kyis gang bar 'gyur ba dang / ji ltar bdag cag rgyal po chen po bzhi dpung dang g.yog tu bcas pa dang / gnod sbyin brgya stong phrag du ma dang /'dzam bu'i gling na gnas pa'i lha'i tshogs thams cad tshim pa dang rim gro bgyid par 'gyur ba dang / ji ltar bdag cag gi lha'i lus 'di dag gzi brjid chen po tsharnam par 'phel bar 'gyur ba dang / ji ltar bdag cag gi 1 lus la brtson 90wa 61

'grus dang stobs dang mthu chen po bskyed 1)par 'gyur ba dang / ji ltar bdag cag gi lus la gzi brjid dang dpal dang phun sum tshogs pa rab tu 'jug par 'gyur ba dang / ji ltar 'dzam bu'i gling thams cad lo legs shing nyams dga' ba dang skye bo dang mis gang bar 'gyur ba dang / ji ltar 'dzam bu'i gling thams cad na gnas pa'i sems can rnams bde bar 'gyur ba dang / dga' ba sna tshogs myong bar 'gyur ba dang / ji ltar sems can thams cad bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du mar lha dang mi'i bde ba rgya che zhing rgya che ba myong bar 'gyur ba dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang lhan cig ②gnas par 'gyur ba dang / ma 'ongs pa'i dus na bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya labar 'gyur ba de dag ④thams cad de lta ldan bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis tshangs pa'i dbang po bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong dag pas ches 'phags pa'i thugs rje chen po'i stobs dang ldan pa'i byin gyi rlabs 56)dang brgya byin bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong dag gi lha'i shes pa bas ches 'phags pa sku/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mkhyen pa bla na med pa dang drang srong mngon par shes pa lnga can rnam pa sna tshogs bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du ma thams cad pas ches 'phags pa'i byin gyi rlabs (nyekyis de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis sems can thams cad kyi don gyi slad du/ gser 'od dam pa (9)mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir rgya cher yang dag par rab tu bshad do/ /mi'i rgyal po'i dgongs nyu ripa dang rgyal po'i bstan bcos dang rgyal po'i bgyi ba gang dag 'dzam 90—62

bu'i gling thams cad na 6)mchis pa dang / gang dag gis sems can 'di dag thams cad bde bar 'gyur ba de dag thams cad bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis (migaser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang ①po 'di ④nye bar bstan/ yongs su brjod/ yang dag par rab tu bshad do/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das rgyu de dang rkyen (5)des mi'i rgyal po des gdon mi 'tshal skyobar gser 'od dam pa (nyamado sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di gus par mnyan par bgyi/ gus par rim gror (nyabagyi/ gus par mchod par bgyi'o/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po chen po bzhi la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /de'i phyir rgyal po chen po khyed bzhi dpung dang g.yog tu bcas pas 6)gdon mi za bar mi'i rgyal po gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di nyan pa dang rim gro byed pa dang mchod pa 7byed pa de dag kun tu bsrung ba'i phyir spro ba cher gyis shig /rgyal po chen po dag⑩ /dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma 'am/ dge bsnyen (glenam/ dge bsnyen pho ma mdo sde'i dbang po rgyal po 'dzin pa 8de dag kyang / sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa 'dzin du chug cig tsodang / de dag lha dang mi dang lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten 'di la sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa byed par 'gyur/ gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di yang ⑩rgya cher yang dag par rab tu tsho 7'chad par 'gyur te/ rgyal po chen po khyed bzhis 6)ci nas mdo sde'i dbang po 'dzin pa'i dge slong dang dge slong ma dang dge bsnyen 67dang dge bsnyen ༷ snam bsrung ba 31dang / gnod pa med pa dang / nad med pa dang / 'khrug pa med pa dang /sems bde bar 'gyur zhing / gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 90—63

'di yang dag par rab tu ston par 'gyur bar dge slong ngam dge slong ma 'am dge bsnyen 1stanam dge bsnyen tshonarim mdo sde'i dbang po 'dzin pa de dag kun tu bsrung bar bya/ yongs su bskyab par bya/ yongs su gzung (cib dang / yongs su bskyang ba dang / zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur bar bya'o/ /de nas rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu dang / rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung tshogadang / rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po dang / rgyal po chen po mig mi bzang stan las langs te bla (5)gos phrag pa gcig ri tu bgos nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/bcom ldan 'das ga la 57rib de 585logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/ de'i tshe mngon sum du tshul 9dang mthun pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod do/ /rgyal ba zla ba dri ma med pa'i sku/ /rgyal ba nyi ma 'od zer stong gi 'od/ /rgyal ba padma dri ma med pa'i spyan/ /rgyal ba me tog pad rtsa rdul med tshems/ /rgyal ba'i yon tan rgya mtsho lta bu ste/ /rin po che ni du ma'i 'byung gnas gyur1 / /rgyal ba 11rgya mtsho ye shes chu yis gang / /ting 'dzin brgya 12phrag stong gis kun tu gang / /rgyal ba'i zhabs ni 'khor lor bris pa ste/ /khor 1 yug mu khyud de bzhin rtsib bom stong / /phyag dang zhabs ni dra bas spras pa ste/ /zhabs kyi dra ba ngang pa'i dbang po bzhin/ /gser gyi ri bo lta bur rab tu gda'/ /rgyal ba dri med gser gyi ri dbang po/ /yon tan thams cad ri rab 'dra ba ste/ /sangs rgyas ri dbang rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba nya ba lo'adra/ /nam mkha' dang yang mtshungs shing 'dra ba ste/ /sgyu ma smig rgyu lta bu chags med pa/ /rgyal ba dri ma med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po chen po bzhi la tshigs su 90wa 64

bcad de bka' stsal pa/ stobs bcu dag gi gser 'od dam pa yi 11 mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po rab mchog 'di/ /'jig rten skyong ba khyed cag rnams kyis ni/ /brtson 'grus rab tu brtan pas bskyang bar bya/ /'di ltar mdo sde dkon mchog zab mo 'di/ /sems can kun la bde ba sbyin byed pa/ /sems can rnams la phan dang bde ba'i phyir/ /'dzam bu'i gling 'dir yun ring gnas par 'gyur/ /'di ltar stong gsum gyi ni stong chen gyi(na/ /'jig rten dag na ngan song sdug bsngal dang / /sems can dmyal ba'i sems can rnams kyi ni/ / sdug bsngal (gyithams cad zhi bar byed pa'o/ /gang dag 'dzam bu'i gling ni 'di na yang / /'dzam bu'i gling gnas rgyal po thams cad kyis/ /rab tu dga' ba chen po bskyed nas ni/ /chos rnams kyis ④ni yul dag bskyang bar gyis/ /gang gis 'dzam bu'i gling 'di bde ba dang / /shin tu lo legs nyams kyang dgar 5de'agyur zhing / /'dzam bu'i gling ni thams cad dag na yang / /sems can thams cad bde bar 'gyur bar gyis/ /'di ni mi yi dbang po gang rnams ni/ /yul na dga' dang bdag bde dga' ba dang / /rgyal srid rnam par 'byor pa nedaga' ba des/ /mdo sde'i dbang po 'di ni mnyan par bya/ /pha rol dgra ni yang dag zad byed pa/ /pha rol dgra tshogs zlog pa dge byed pa/ /mchog tu 'jigs pas phongs (me pa sel byed pa/ /mchog tu dge byed mdo sde'i dbang po 'di'o / /ji ltar rin chen shing ljon rab mdzes pa/ /yon tan kun 'byung khyim na yod pa ltar/ /rgyal po yon tan 'dod pa rnams kyis kyang / /mdo sde'i dbang po'i mchog 'di de ltar blta/ /ji ltar chu grang sgom pa sel byed pa/ /tsha bas nyam thag che 8na rnyed pa ltar/ /yon tan dag gis skom pa'i rgyal po la/ /90—65

mdo sde'i rgyal po'i mchog 'di de bzhin no/ /ji ltar rin chen thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /rin chen snod ni lag mthil yod pa ltar/ /mi yi dbang po'i tshogs la gser 'od mchog /mdo sde'i dbang po'i mchog 'di de bzhin no/ /'di ni lha yi tshogs kyis ①mngon mchod pa/ /mdo sde'i dbang po lha dbang phyag byas (gepa/ /'jig rten skyong ②ba rdzu 'phrul chen po la④/ /bzhi po dag gis kun tu bsrungs pa yin/ /phyogs bcu dag na sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang —/ /mdo sde'i dbang po 'di ni rtag tu dgongs/ /mdo sde'i dbang po 'di ni bshad pa na/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis legs zhes ⑤brjod pa byin/ /gnod sbyin bye ba stong phrag brgya rnams kyis/ /phyogs bcu dag tu yul yang srung ⑥bar byed / /rab tu dga' zhing rab tu mgu sems kyis/ /mdo sde'i dbang po 'di ni nyan par byed/ /'dzam bu'i gling na gnas par gyur pa yi/ /lha yi tshogs rnams bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /lha tshogs de dag kun kyang rab dga' bas/ /mdo sde'i dbang po 'di ni nyan par byed/ /chos rnams mnyan par bya ba 'di yis (7ni/ /gzi brjid phu)dang ni stobs 6)dang brtson 'grus thob/ /gzi brjid ⑩chen po yi 37ni lha yi lus/ /shin tu rgyas shing rnam par 'phel bar 'gyur/ /de nas rgyal po chen po bzhis bcom ldan 'das la 8tshigs su bcad pa 'di lta bu 'di dag thos pa dang ngo mtshar du gyur rmad du byung bar gyur dga' bar gyur te/de dag chos kyi 4 shugs kyis yud tsam zhig ngus nas tsomachi ma phyis te/ de dag lus 'phar 'iyan lag 'dar zhing dga' ba dang bde ba dang yid bde ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan par gyur nas kyang bcom ldan 'das la lha'i me tog man dā ra ba dag gis gtor mngon par gtor to/ /gtor mngon par gtor nas 90—66

kyang stan ①las langs te gos phrag pa gcig tu bgos nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de (7logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag cag rgyal po chen po bzhi ①rgyal po chen po re re yang gnod sbyin lnga brgya lnga brgya dang chos smra ba de bsrung ba dang yongs su bskyang ba'i slad du rtag tu dge slong chos smra ba'i slad bzhin 'brang bar bgyi'o/ /gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po las/ rgyal po chen po bzhi'i le'u zhes bya ba (4)ste bdun pa'o// //de nas lha mo chen mo dbyangs can gyis (snyegos phrag pa gcig tu bgos te pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs yinas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to / /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das lha mo chen mo dbyangs can bdag gis kyang dge slong chos smra ba de'i tshig brgyan pa'i slad du spobs pa nye bar bsgrub par bgyi/gzungs kyang stsal bar bgyi/ nges pa'i tshig gi brjod pa kun tu gzhag (7)par bgyi / dge slong chos smra ba de la ye shes kyi snang ba chen po bgyi'o(gyi/ /gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di las tshig gam yi ge gang yang rung ba dag cig yongs su nyams par gyur tam/ bskyud na bdag gis tso)dge slong chos smra ba de'i nges pa'i sgra dang tshig dang yi ge de dag thams cad bsgrub par bgyi'o / /de ⑩ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das brgya stong dag la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun pa'i sems can de dag gi don gyi slad (7du gser 'od dam pa hunyamado 90—67

sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di 'dzam bu'i gling na yun ring du gnas shing myur du nub par mi 'gyur ba dang / sems can du ma dag gis gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di thos nas shes rab rno ba bsam gyis mi khyab par 'gyur ba dang / shes rab kyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab pa thob par 'gyur ba dang / tshe 'di la tshe phun sum tshogs pa rab tu thob par 'gyur ba dang / srog la phan gdags pa dang / bsod nams kyi phung 1)po dpag tu ma mchis pa rab tu 'dzin par 'gyur ba dang / thabs sna tshogs rab tu 'tshal bar 'gyur ba dang / bstan bcos thams cad la mkhas par 'gyur ba dang (ge/ bzo'i bgyi ba sna tshogs phun sum tshogs pa rab tu dzodasathob par 'gyur ba dang / bskyud pa ma mchis par bgyi ba'i slad du de la gzungs kyang stsal (3)bar bgyi'o/ /dge slong chos smra ba de dang sems can chos nyan pa de dag gi don gyi slad (gedu sngags dang sman dang ldan pa'i khrus kyi las brjod par bgyi ste(6 / gza' dang / rgyu skar dang / skye ba dang /574 'chi ba'i gnod pa dang / 'thab pa dang / rnyog pa dang / 'khrug long dang / khrag khrug dang / rmi lam ngan pa dang / log 'dren gyi gnod pa thams cad dang / byad dang ro langs thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur/ gang gis mkhas pa dag (8)khrus bgyid du stsal ba'i sman dang sngags ni 'di dag ste/ shu dag gi'u 9wang 'u su dang / /sha myang 7sha mi shi ri sha /dbang po'i lag dang skal ba che/ /dzha ma shing tsha a ga ru/ /shi ri be /rtasta sra rtsi dang / /gu gul ra sa bla la 12kyi/ /rdo dreg lo ma rgya spos dang / /tsandan dang ni ldong ros dang / /gi wang bcas dang ru rta dang / /gur gum gla sgang yungs kur 12dang / /sbyi mo sug smel na la da/ / /nā ga ge sar u shi skar/ /'di 90—68

dag cha ni mnyam bgyis nas/ /skar ma rgyal la btags (1)par bgyi/ /phye ma la ni sngags tshig 'di/ /lan brgya (2mngon par gdab par bgyi/ /tad ya thā/su kṛ (5)te kṛ (geta ka ma la nī la dzi na ka ra (5)te/ haṃ ka rā te/ ind+ra dza 56)li/sha kud dre ba shad dre(7)/ a brta ka si ke/ na ku tra ku/ ka bi la ka bi la ma ti/shī la ma ti(8)/ san dhi dhu dhu ma ma ba ti/ shi ri shi ri/ sa 5)kya sbi te swā hā/lci ⑩bas dkyil 'khor bgyis nas ni/ /me tog sil ma dgram par bgyi/ /gser gyi snod hunyedang dngul snod du/ /mngar hu)ba'i khu ba gzhag par bgyi/ /skyes bu go cha bgos pa ni/ /bzhi zhig der yang gzhag par bgyi/ /rab tu brgyan pa'i bu mo bzhi/ /bum pa thogs (2pa gzhag par bgyi/ /rtag tu gu gul bdug par bgyi/ /sil snyan sna lnga bgyid du stsal/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan gyis/ /lha mo de ni legs par brgyan/ /bar bar dag tu me long gzhag /mda' dang tsomadung rtse rna brang hu9gzhag /de nas mtshams yokyang gcad hu 7par bgyi/ /de yi 'og tu dgos pa brtsam/ /sngags kyi las ni 'di dag gis/ /mtshams bcad hu pa yang brtsam par bgyi/ /stod 46ya the dan/ a ra ke /na ya ne/ hi le/ mi le/ gi le/ khi khi le swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das kyi snam zhu)logs su khrus bgyis nas sngags 'di bzlas brjod bgyis na khrus kyi zhi bar sbyor 411ro/ /tad 'a ya thā/ sa ga she(2nye/ bi ga khes / bi ga ta ba 5ti swā hā/ phyogs bzhi dag na gang gnas pa'i/ /rgyu skar dag gis tshe sungs 2dzishig /btsas pa'i skar ma'i gnod pa dang / /phung po'i 2 las kyi 'jigs 'byung dang / /'byung po'i sa)khams rnams 'khrug bgyid pa/ /'jigs sa pa mi bzad ri zhi gyur cig / tabya thā/87 sha ra me/ bi sha ri me swā hā/ sa ga ṭi /90—69

bi ga ṭi 6)swā hā/ su kha ti na te swā hā/ sā ga ra saṃ bhū tā ②ya swā hā/ skan dha ma tā g.ya swā hā/ nī la kuṇḍa 4)ya swā hā/ a pa ra dzi ta bīrsā (snyeya swā hā/ hi ma ba ta (6)rma bhū tā 57༄ya swā hā/ a ni mi la bka tā laya swā hā/ na mo bha 6)ga ba te/ brahma ṇi / na maḥs ra swa (13 de byi siddhi 8tu mant+ra 8pa da8/ rda brahma a nu ma n+ya tu swā hā/ dge slong chos smra ba de bsrung ba dang chos mnyan 8pa de dag dang /yi ger 'dri tsheb de dag gi don gyi slad du khrus kyi las 'dis bdag nyid der mchi bar nyu bgyi'o/ /lha'i tshogs thams cad dang lhan cig tu grong ngam grong khyer ram grong rdal lam/ gtsug lag khang der nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar bgyi'o / /ji ltar dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma mdo sde'i dbang po 'dzin pa de dag gi srog la phan gdags par 'gyur ba dang / 'khor ba las 'byung ba thob 8par 'gyur ba dang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ba dang / myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub hu7mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur bar gza' dang / 'thab pa dang / rnyog pa dang /btsas pa'i skar ma'i gnod pa dang / rmi lam ngan pa dang / log 'dren gyi gnod pa thams cad dang / byad dang / ro langs thams cad tshurab tu zhi bar bgyi'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lha mo dbyangs can la/ lha mo chen mo dbyangs can khyod skye bo mang po la phan pa dang skye bo mang po la bde ba'i phyir zhugs te/ khyod kyis sngags dang sman dang ldan pa'i tshig 'di 'dra ba bshad pa ni legs so legs so zhes bya ba byin no/ /lha mo dbyangs can gyis bcom ldan 'das kyi 37zhabs la phyag 'tshal rtenas phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /de nas slob 90—70

dpon lung ston pa bram ze kauṇḍi ①rgyas lha mo dbyangs can de bkug go/ /lha mo chen mo dbyangs can mchod 'os dka' thub che/ /'jig rten kun tu rnam grangs mchog (0sbyin yon tan che/ /rtser gnas mdzes ma dar ba rtswa yi (gyigos bskus pa/ dar gi)ba rtswa yi gos gyon rkang pa gcig gis gnas/ /lha rnams thams cad lhags nas 'di skad ces smras te/ /sems can rnams la dge ba'i tshig shod ⑤lco khrol cig /rsād 6)ya the dan/ mu re/ tsi re/ a ba dze/ a ba dza ba te⑦/ hi gu (8)le/ mi 6)gu le/ pi yig la ba ti/ ma tumagu she/ ma ri tsi / sa ma ti/ da sha ma ti/ a gri ma gri/ ta ra/ tsi ta (rter/ tsa pa ti//snyetsi tsi ri/ shi ri mi ri/ ma ri tsi/ pra ṇa liye/ lo ka dzreṣṭha(snye/ lo ka shiṣṭhalo/lo ka tu 〉sri ye/ sid dhi pri nyushete/ bi ma mu khi shu tsi kha ri4)/ a pra ti zhu snaha te/a pra te ()ha ta( )/ bud dhe/ na mu tsi/ na mu tsi/ ma hā de bī ( dpra ti gritna na ma ska ro( )/ bdag gi du sriblo thogs pa med par gyur cig /bstan bcos dang tshigs su bcad pa'i rgyud dang / sde snod dang snyan dngags (sgyel sogs pa bdag gi rig sngags dngos grub tu gyur cig /tarya bzhi)/ ma hā pra bha pānusnye/ hi li hi li / mi li mi li/ bcom ldan 'das ma lha mo dbyangs can gyi mthus bdag rnam par rgyal du 7bar gyur cig /ka ra ṭi ke yu re/ ke yu ra ba ti/ hi li mi li/hi li mi li/ hi li hi li/pu 7 sangs rgyas kyi nunyabaden pa dang / chos kyi bden pa dang / dge 'dun gyi bden pa dang / dbang po'i bden pa dang / chu lha'i bden pas lha mo chen mo dgug par bya'o/ /gang dag 'jig rten na bden pa smra ba de dag gi bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig ()gis lha mo chen mo dgug par bya'o / /tarya thā/ hi li hi li/'arte gyi li mi li/ hi li mi li/ bdag rnam 90—71

par rgyal 1—tshobar gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das ma lha mo chen mo (gyedabyangs can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag la gsang sngags kyi tshig rnams grub par gyur cig swā hā/de nas slob dpon lung ston pa bram ze kauṇḍi (5)rgyas lha mo chen mo dbyangs can la tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis mngon par bstod ④do/ /'byung po'i tshogs rnams thams cad nga la nyan 5)par gyis/ /lha dang dri za lha dbang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na/ /bud med dam pa lha mo mchog gi rab gang yin/ /lha mo dam pa mchog tu mdzes pa'i zhal la bstod/ /yon tan rnam pa sna tshogs bsags pas yan lag brgyan/ /dbyangs can zhes bya spyan ni yangs 3)shing bsod nams 'bar / /dri med ye shes yon tan rnams kyis rnam par tsas3)/ /rin chen sna tshogs tha dad lta bu blta ba'i phyir/ /mchog rab ngag gi yon tan khyad par de bstod ri rido/ /dam pa mchog gi dngos grub byed pa dang / /yang dag bsngags dang yon tan byed pa dang / /dri med mchog dang padma 'bar ba dang / /mig mchog dang ni mig gi dam pa dang / /dge ba'i gnas dang dge ba mthong ba dang / /yon tan bsam du 95med pas brgyan pa dang / /zla ba 'dra dang dri ma med 'od dang / /ye shes 'byung gnas dran pa dam pa dang / /seng ge mchog dang mi la zhon (bopa dang / /lag pa brgyad rnams kyis ni brgyan pa dang / /zla ba nya ba lta bur snang ba dang / /yid du 'ong ba'i ngag dang dbyangs snyan nyurkedang / /shes rab zab mo dang ni ldan pa dang / /dgos mchog sgrub byed sems can dam pa dang / /lha dang lha min dbang pos mchod pa dang / /lha dang lha min tshogs kun gnas brjod dang / /'byung po'i tshogs kyi 12gnas rtag mchod pa'i phyir swā hā / /bdag cag lha mo 'di la phyag bya'o/ /bdag la yon tan khyad par kun tuge90—72

455 cig /dgos pa kun tu bdag la dngos grub 465/ /dgra rnams khrod na bdag la rtag tu srungs0)/ /yi ge rdzogs shing tshig rgyas (mi'adi dag ni/ /nang par langs nas gtsang mar brjod par bya/ /bsam pa dang ni nor 'bru thams cad rnyed/ /dngos grub dge ba rgya chen thob par 'gyur/ /gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal ( po las/ dbyangs can gyi le'u zhes bya ba ril ste brgyad pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das la lha mo chen mo (5skadapal gyis 'di skad ces gsol to / /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das lha mo chen mo dpal bdag gis kyang / ci nas chos smra ba'i dge slong de yo byad thams cad phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ba dang / brel/ (6)phongs ma mchis pa thob par 'gyur ba dang / sems brtas 7par 'gyur ba dang / sems bde bar gdugs mtshan bas par 'gyur ba dang /gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di las tshig (2nyedang yi ge rnam pa tha dad pa dag chub par 'gyur ba dang / rnam par rtogs (9dpar 'gyur ba dang me/ yang dag par brjod 17par 'gyur ba dang / sangs rgyas brgya stong dag la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun pa'i sems can de dag gi /pogedon gyi slad du/gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal zhu po 'di 'dzam bu'i gling du yun ring du gnas par 'gyur zhing / myur du nub par mi 'gyur ba dang / sems can rnams kyang gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di nyan par 'gyur ba dang / bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du mar lha dang mi'i bde ba myong bar 'gyur ba dang / mu ge ma mchis par 'gyur ba dang / lo legs 90—73

par 'gyur ba dang / sems can rnams kyang bde bar sbyar ba thams cad kyis bde bar 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dang 'grogs par 'gyur ba dang / ma 'ongs pa'i dus na bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba dang / sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi sdug bsngal thams cad shin tu chad par 'gyur ba gang 'di tsa)gos dang / zas dang /mal cha dang / na ba'i gsos sman dang / yo byad dang / 'tshog chas gzhan dag gis kyang dge slong chos smra ba de spro bar bgyi'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen ②me tog yon tan rgya mtsho bai ḍūrya dang / gser gyi ri kha dog dkyibazang po gser du snang ba'i dpal zhes bya ba de la lha mo chen mo dpal gyis dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed de/ des da ④ltar phyogs gang dang gang du sems pa dang / phyogs gang dang gang du lta ba dang /phyogs gang dang gang du 'gro ba'i phyogs de dang der sems can bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du ma dag bde bar sbyar ba thams cad kyis bde bar 'gyur /zas dang / skom dang / nor dang / 'bru dang / 'gron (5)bu dang /gser dang / nor bu dang / mu tig dang / bai ḍūrya dang / dung dang /man 565shel dang / byi 57༄ru dang / dngul dang / sa le sbram dang / yo byad gzhan dag gis kyang mi phongs par 'gyur/ sems can de dag yo byad thams cad kyang na'abyor par 'gyur ro/ /lha mo chen mo dpal gyi mthus de bzhin gshegs pa de la mchod par bya/ spos dang me tog dang bdug 49pa yang dbul bar bya/ lha mo chen mo dpal gyi ming nas lan gsum brjod cing de la spos dang /90—74

bdug pa dang me tog kyang 6)byin la ro bro ba (5)sna tshogs kyang byin na de'i 'bru'i phung po chen po rnam par 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ sa la sa yi bcud dag rnam par 'phel/ /lha rnams rtag par rab tu dga' bar 'gyur / /'bras bu lo tog (gyilhum sdong ljon lha rnams/ /lo tog (4shin tu sna tshogs rnams kyang bskyed(snye/ /gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po'i ming brjod pa'i sems can de dag la lha mo chen mo dpal sems par 'gyur/de dag la dpal chen por byed par 'gyur ro/ /lha mo chen (6)mo dpal ni lcang lo can gyi pho brang 'khor na skyed (7)mos tshal dam pa bsod nams kyi me tog 'od ces bya ba na rin po che sna (nyabadun las byas pa'i khang pa dam pa gser gyi rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba na gnas te/ mi gang la la 'bru'i phung po spel bar 'dod pa des rang gi khyim phyag dar legs po)par bya/ khrus legs par bya/ gos dkar po gtsang ma bgo bar bya/ gos dri rab tu zhim pa bgo bar bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen me tog yon tan rgya mtsho bai ḍūrya dang / gser gyi ri mkha dog bzang po gser du snang ba'i dpal de la phyag 'tshal zhing mtshan nas kyang lan gsum brjod/ lha mo chen mo dpal gyi lag nas de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod par 17byed/ me tog dang bdug pa dang spos kyang dbul8/ ro bro ba sna tshogs kyang dbulayin/ gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po'i ming yang lan gsum brjod/ bden pa'i tshig kyang brjod / lha mo chen mo dpal la yang mchod cing me tog dang bdug pa yang 'bul / ro bro ba sna tshogs kyang 'bul na gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal 8po 'di'i mthus/ de'i tshe lha mo chen mo dpal khyim de la sems par 90—75

'gyur / de'i 'bru'i phung (1)po chen po yang 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /lha mo chen mo dpal dgug par 'dod pa des rig 75)pa'i gsang sngags 'di dag dran par bya'o//'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byams pa la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phyag 'tshal lo / /de dag la phyag 'tshal nanas/ rig pa 'di dag la sbyor bar bya ste/ rig du risngags 'di rnams bdag la 'byor bar gyur cig / stad ya the danas / pra ti 6)pū ra ṇa bā re/ sa manta dar sha ne/ ma hā bi ha ra ga te97)/ sa manta/ be da na ga te/ ma hā kāru dpra ti 95pra ba ṇi / satwa arba sa rma tā /lhan pra pū 3 re/ā 1 yā na dharma 1 tā ma hā 15sto gi 7ne/ ma hā mi tre u pa saṃ hi he/ he tai 3) ṣi/saṃ gra hi te te 1 sa mar thā nu pā lā ni17/ 'di dag ni spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i chos nyid kyi gsang sngags 2 rikyi tshig gcig tu de kho na yang dag par sgrub par sbyin 1pa mi slu ba'i don gyi tshig ste/ sems can bar ma la sbyor ba ri 2rnams dge ba'i rtsa ba kha na ma tho ba med pa dag gis lo bdun du 'don cing 'dzin pa dag yan lag brgyad pa'i bsnyen par gnas pa la bsnyen te lhe/ bdag dang sems can 2 thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir snga dro dang phyi dro sangs rgyas thams cad la me tog dang spos rnams kyis rnagemachod nas/ des bdag gi bsam pa 'di 'byor par gyur 0cig /myur du 'byor par gyur cig /gtsug lag khang ngam dgon pa'i gnas kyang rung ste/ khyim de shin tu gtsang mar byas la lci bas dkyil 'khor byas te/ spos dang bdug pa yang dbul 2shebar bya/stan gtsang ma yang gding bar bya'o/ /sa la me tog sil ma bkram nas bsdad 90—76

par bya'o/ /de nas skad cig de nyid la dpal 1'ongs nas der gnas par 'gyur ro/ /de phyin cad khyim mam/ grong ngam/ grong khyer ram/ grong rdal nalam / gtsug lag khang ngam/ dgon pa'i gnas su nam yang brel cing phongs pa med par byed do/ /'gron 5)bu dang / gser dang / rin po che dang /nor dang / 'bru dang / yo byad thams cad 'byor pa dang / bde bar sbyar ba thams cad kyis (4)bde bar 'gyur ro/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba gang dag byed pa de dag thams cad las lha mo chen mo dpal la shas kyi mchog sbyin par bya ste/ des na de ji srid 5)'tsho'i bar du de na gnas par 'gyur/ phongs par 6mi 'gyur/de dag gi bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po las/ lha mo chen mo dpal gyi le'u zhes bya ba ste dgu pa'o// //bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen gtsug tor can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dri ma med par 'bar ba rin chen gser gyi 7)'od zer snang ba'i tog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'dzam bu na gser gyi rgyal mtshan gser du snang ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gser du snang ba'i snying po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyi ma brgya'i 'od zer snang ba'i snying po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gser rin chen 'byung gnas gdugs brtsegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gser gyi me tog 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyi tog 9la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sgron ma chen mo 1 la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de 90—77

bzhin gshegs pa rin chen tog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' mdzes pa'i tog ces bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' gser 'od dam pa zhes bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' gser gyi snying po zhes bya ba dang /byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngu zhes bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' chos 'phags zhes 6)bya ba dang / shar phyogs na de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs pa zhes bya ba dang / lho phyogs na de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen tog ces bya ba dang / nub phyogs na de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med ces bya ba dang /byang phyogs na de bzhin gshegs pa rnga sgra zhes bya ba ste/ su gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di las de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan dang / byang chub sems dpa'i 57ming 'di dag 'dzin tam/ klog gam/ khong du chud par byed na de rtag tu tshe rabs dran par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la sa'i lha mo brtan mas 'di skad ces gsol to(mi/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i ④rgyal po 'di da ltar dang ma 'ongs pa'i dus na grong ngam/ grong khyer ram/ grong rdal lam/ ljongs sam/ dgon pa'i phyogs sam/ ri'i sman ljongs sam/ pho brang 'khor gang du gnas par 'gyur ba'i gegrong ngam/ grong khyer ram/ grong rdal lam/ ljongs sam/dgon pa'i phyogs sam/ ri'i sman ljongs sam/ pho brang 'khor der btsun pa bcom ldan 'das sa'i lha mo brtan ma bdag mchi bar skyobagyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das gang na gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di rgya cher yang dag par rab tu 'chad par 'gyur ba dang / sa phyogs gang dang gang na dge slong chos smra ba de'i chos kyi khri shom par 'gyur ba dang / gang dang gang du chos 90—78

smra ba de stan la mchis nas gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di rgya cher yang dag par rab tu ston par 'gyur ba der/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das sa'i lha mo brtan ①ma bdag sa phyogs de dang de nyid du mchi bar bgyi'o(mi//lus 'di mi gda' ①bar chos kyi khri'i bya'og logs su mchis te/ yan (5)lag gi dam pa mgos dge slong chos smra ba de'i rkang mthil nas brten (7par bgyi'o/ /bdag kyang chos mnyan (7pa dang chos bdud rtsi'i khu ba 'dis tshim par bgyi/yang dag par rim gro (kyebagyi/ yang dag par mchod par 6)bgyi'o/ /bdag tshim par gyurakyi/ rim gro ⑩bgyi ba bgyis par ⑩gyur/ rab tu dga' bar gyur nas/sa'i phung po dpag tshad stong phrag drug cu rtsa brgyad po 'di nas sa'i gzhi rdo rje la thug pa'i bar du sa'i bcud kyis 8rnam par 'phel bar bgyi/ yang dag par rim gro 8bgyi yongs su rdzogs par bgyi'o/ /steng du yang rgya mtsho'i mtha' la thug pa'i sa'i dkyil 'khor 'di tsosa'i bcud kyi 7snum gyis brlan par bgyi'o/ /sa chen po 'di rab tu mdangs dang ldan par bgyi'o/ /des na 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir rtswa dang shing gel pa dang sman dang nags tshal sna tshogs rnams mdangs dang rab tu ldan par 'khrungs par 6)'gyur/ kun dga'i ra ba dang /nags 8tshal dang / shin (7ljon pa thams cad dang / lo ma dang / me tog dang —/ 'bras bu dang / lo tog nu )rnam pa sna tshogs thams cad kyang rab tu mdangs dang ldan par 'gyur/ dri dang rab tu ldan pa dang / snum dang rab tu ldan pa dang / ro zhim por 'gyur ba blta (nyen rab tu sdug pa dang rab tu che bar 'gyur ro/ /sems can de dag kyang btung ba dang bza' ba rnam pa sna tshogs de dag 'tshal nas/ tshe dang stobs dang kha dog dang dbang po 22rnam par 90—79

'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /gzi brjid dang stobs dang kha dog dang gzugs dang ldan par gyur nas kyang sa la mchis pa'i dgos pa rnam pa sna tshogs tha dad pa 'byebargya stong du ma dag bgyid par 'gyur/ brtson par 'gyur/ 'bad par 'gyur(5) / stobs su bgyid pa'i las rnams bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das rgyu des 'dzam bu'i gling thams cad zhi ba dang lo legs pa dang rgyas pa dang nyams dga' bar 'gyur( )/ mi'i skye bo mang pos gang bar 'gyur/'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can thams cad bde bar 'gyur/ dga' ba rnam pa (4)sna tshogs myong bar 'gyur/ sems can de dag gzi brjid dang stobs dang kha dog dang gzugs dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /(3)gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di'i slad du dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma mdo sde'i dbang po 'di 'dzin pa de dag chos kyi stan la mchis pa'i gan du mchi bar 'gyur/ mchis nas kyang sems rab tu dang bas sems can thams cad kyi don dang phan pa dang bde ba dang gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di rgya cher yang dag par rab tu bshad par bgyi ba'i ri zislad du chos smra ba de dag la gsol ba 'debs par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i slad du zhe ṅge/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di rab tu bshad na/ sa'i lha mo brtan ma bdag g.yog dang bcas te/ rab tu mdangs dang ldan pa dang / rab tu stobs dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /bdag cag gi lus la stobs dang / brtson 'grus dang /mthu chen po bskyed par 'gyur/ bdag cag gi lus la gzi brjid dang dpal dang / phun sum 7tshogs pa yang rina'ajug par 'gyur ro/ /btsun pa bcom 90—80

ldan 'das sa'i lha mo brtan ma bdag chos bdud rtsi'i khu ba 'dis tshim par gyur/gzi brjid dang stobs dang / brtson 'grus dang mthu dang shugs chen po thob par gyur na/ sa chen po'i 6)dpag tshad stong phrag bdun pa'i 'dzam bu'i gling 'di'i ②sa'i bcud chen po ①rnam par 'phel bar 'gyur/ sa chen po mdangs dang rab tu ldan par 'gyur ro/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das sa la brten pa'i sems can de dag thams cad kyang 'phel zhing rgyas la yangs par 55'gyur/chen por yang 'gyur ro/ /sa la gnas pa'i sems can de dag chen por gyur nas kyang / longs spyod dang yongs su spyod pa sna tshogs la spyod par 'gyur/bde ba yang myong bar 'gyur ro/ /de dag thams cad bza' ba dang / btung ba dang bca' ba rnam pa sna tshogs dang / gos dang mal cha dang / gnas dang ⑥/ khang pa 4)dang / gzhal med khang dang / skyed 587mos tshal dang / chu bo dang / rdzing dang / chu mig dang / mtshe'u dang / mtsho 9)dang / lteng ka 1 dang / 'di lta bu'i yo byad bde ba rnam pa sna tshogs sa tshonyal gnas kyi pa sa las byung ba sa la brten (snyepa 'di dag la spyod par 'gyur ro/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das rgyu des sems can de dag thams cad kyis bdag la byas pa gzo bar bgyi'o / /gdon mi 'tshal bar gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di bsti bistang du bgyis te/ mnyan bipar bgyi/ bkur stir tshabagyi/ bla mar bgyi/ rim gror hu thobagyi/ mchod par bgyi'o/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das gang gi tshe sems can de dag chos smra ba de'i gan du mchi ba'i slad du/rigs tha dad pa dang khyim tha dad pa dag nas 'byung ste/ mchis nas gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di mnyan par gyur la/ thos nas 90—81

kyang rang rang gi rigs dang / khyim dang grong dang ①gong rdal tha dad pa dag tu zhugs nas/ rang rang gi khyim na gnas pa dag phan tshun du 'di skad ces bdag cag gis de ring chos mnyan pa zab mo thos so/ /de ring bdag cag gis bsod nams kyi phung po bsam gyis ②mi khyab pa yongs su bzung ngo / /bdag cag gis chos mnyan pa des de bzhin gshegs pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du ma dag mnyes (kyepar byas so/ /deng bdag cag gis ④chos nyan ⑤pa 'dis sems can dmyal ba las yongs su thar toyi/ /dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang /gshin rje'i 'jig rten dang / yi dgas kyi yul las yongs su thar to④/ /deng bdag cag chos nyan pa 'dis ma 'ongs pa'i dus ⑧na/ tshe rabs ⑨brgya stong phrag du mar lha dang mir skye ba yongs su bzung bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gtam zer bar 'gyur ro/ /khyim tha dad pa na gnas par 'gyur ba de dag sems can gzhan dag la gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di las tha na dpe gcig brjod dam/ gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di las tha na le'u gcig gam/ sngon byung ba gcig gam/ tha na byang chub sems dpa'i ming gcig gamatso/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan gcig gam/ tha na tshig bzhi ⑩pa'i tshigs su bcad pa gcig gam/ tshig gcig gis 8sems can gzhan dag la thos par bgyid dam/ tha na gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di'i (nye mtshan gzhan dag la rab tu ston tam/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das gang dang gang na sems can rnam pa tha dad pa de dag sa phyogs rnam pa tha dad pa dag tu mdo sde'i gtan tshigs 8rnam pa sna tshogs 'di lta bu 'di dag gcig la gcig brjod dam/ thos par bgyid dam/ gtam brgyud 8brjod na/90—82

btsun pa bcom ldan 'das sa phyogs de dag thams cad shin tu mdangs dang ldan pa dang shin tu snum par 'gyur ro/ /sa phyogs de dang de dag tu sems can thams cad kyi phyir/ sa'i bcud rnam pa sna tshogs dang yo byad thams cad rgyas par skye bar 6)'gyur/ rnam par 'phel bar 'gyur/ shin tu rgyas par 'gyur/sems can de dag thams cad kyang bde bar 'gyur ro/ /nor che ba dang /longs spyod che ba dang / sbyin pa la mos par 'gyur/ dkon mchog gsum la mngon par dad par 'gyur ro/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis sa'i lha (9mo brtan ma la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sa'i lha mo sems can gang la la dag gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di las tha na tshig gcig (minyan na de dag mi'i 'jig rten 'di nas shi 'phos nas sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha'i ris kyi ④nang du lha'i ris gang yang rung ba zhig tu skye bar 'gyur ro/ /sa'i lha mo sems can gang la la dag gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di la mchod pa'i phyir/ gnas de dag legs par brgyan par byed dam/ tha na gdugs gcig gam/ ba dan gcig gam/ ras bcos bu gcig gis ⑤g.yogs na sa'i lha mo rtag tu brgyan pa'i gnas de dag 'dod pa na spyod pa'i lha'i ris bdun po de dag tu lha'i rin po che sna bdun gyi gzhal med khang rgyan thams cad kyis legs par brgyan pa dag tu gnas par 'gyur ro/ /gang gi tshe sems can de dag mi'i 'jig rten 'di nas shi 'phos te/rin po che sna bdun gyi gzhal med khang de dag tu skye ba de'i tshe/ sa'i lha mo rin po che sna bdun gyi gzhal med khang re rer yang lan bdun bdun du (6)skye bar 'gyur ro/ /lha'i bde ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa yang myong bar 'gyur ro/ /de nyan90—83

skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la sa'i lha mo brtan mas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das des na sa'i lha mo brtan ma bdag dge slong chos smra ba chos kyi stan la mchis pa de'i chos kyi stan gyi 'og ①logs kyi sa phyogs de dang de dag tu gnas par bgyi'o/ /ci nas kyang sangs rgyas brgya stong dag la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun pa'i sems can de dag gi ②don gyi slad du gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di 'dzam bu'i gling du yun ring du gnas shing myur du nub par mi 'gyur ba dang / sems can rnams ⑧kyang gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di nyan par 'gyur ba dang /ma 'ongs pa'i dus na bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya ④stong phrag du mar lha dang mi'i bde ba bsam gyis (gemi khyab pa myong bar 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dang 'grogs par 'gyur ba dang ma 'ongs pa'i dus na bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba dang /sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi sdug bsngal thams cad shin tu chad par 'gyur bar lus mi gda' (7bar bgyis te/ dge slong chos smra ba de'i rkang pa la yan lag gi dam pa mgos brten par bgyi'o/ /gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po las/ sa'i lha mo brtan ma'i (7)le'u zhes bya ba ste bcu pa'o// //de nas gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po yang dag shes gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang lhan cig tu stan las langs te/ gos phrag pa gcig tu bgos nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ bcom ldan 'das ga 90—84

la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das da (1)ltar dang ma 'ongs pa'i dus na / gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di grong ngam/ grong khyer ram / grong rdal lam/ ljongs ②sam/ dgon pa'i phyogs sam/ ri'i sman ljongs sam/ pho brang 'khor gang du 'byung bar 'gyur ba der btsun pa bcom ldan 'das gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po yang dag shes bdag (naganod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po nyi shu rtsa brgyad po de dag dang lhan cig tu grong ngam/ grong khyer ram / grong rdal lam/ ljongs sam/ dgon pa'i phyogs sam/ ri'i sman ljongs byasam/ pho brang 'khor der mchi bar 55)bgyi'o/ /lus mi gda' (phyi bar bgyi ste rdzidage slong chos smra ba de bsrung bar bgyi'o/ /yongs su bskyab pa dang /yongs su gzung ba dang / yongs su bskyang ba dang / chad pa spang ba dang /zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur bar bgyi'o/ / skyes pa'am (8bud med dam khye'u 'am bu mo chos nyan pa de dag thams cad dang / gang su dag gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di las tha na tshig bzhi pa'i tshigs su bcad pa gcig nyan pa dang tha na tshig gcig dang / tha na gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di las byang chub sems dpa'i ming gcig gam/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan gcig thos par gyur te/ gzung ba dang tha na gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di'i ga9ming thos par gyur te/ gzung ba de dag thams cad kyang 7kun tu bsrung bar bgyi'o/ /yongs su bskyab pa dang /yongs su gzung 37ba dang / yongs su bskyang ba dang / chad pa spang ba 12dang /zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur bar bgyi'o/ /rigs de dag dang / khyim de 90—85

dag dang / grong de dag dang / grong khyer de dag dang / grong rdal de dag dang / dgon pa de dag dang / pho brang 'khor de dag kyang kun tu bsrung bar bgyi'o / /yongs su bskyab pa dang / yongs su gzung 6)ba dang / yongs su bskyang ba dang / chad pa spang ba dang / zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur bar bgyi'o / /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das rgyu gang dag gis/ bdag gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po yang dag shes zhes ming du chags par gyur ce na/ 'di ni btsun pa bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi mngon sum mo/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag gis chos thams cad 'tshal to/ /chos thams cad yongs su 'tshal to/ /chos thams cad khong du chud do/ /chos thams cad ji snyed pa dang / chos thams cad ji lta ba dang gnas pa gang lags pa dang / ②chos thams cad kyi rigs gang lags pa dang / btsun pa bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad bdag la mngon sum mo/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad la bdag gi ye shes snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /ye shes kyi zhugasal ba bsam gyis mi 8khyab bo / /ye shes kyi rgyu ba bsam gyis mi 8khyab bo/ /ye shes kyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad la bdag gi ye shes kyi yul 'jug pa bsam gyis 46)mi khyab bo/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das ji ltar bdag chos thams cad yang dag par 'tshal ba dang / yang dag par yongs su brtags (7༄pa dang / yang dag par yongs su 'tshal ba dang / yang dag par rnam par bltas pa dang / yang dag par khong du chud pa'i rgyu des na/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po yang dag shes zhes ming du chags so/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag gis (8)dge slong chos smra 90—86

ba de'i tshig brgyan par bgyi ba'i slad du spobs zhi)pa nye bar bsgrub par bgyi'o/ /ji ltar chos smra ba de'i phyilus mi ngal bar 'gyur ba dang / lus kyi dbang po bde bar 'gyur ba dang / rab tu dga' ba skye bar 'gyur ba dang / gang gi slad du sangs rgyas brgya stong dag la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun pa'i sems can rnams kyi don gyi slad du/ gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di 'dzam bu'i gling du yun ring du gnas shing myur du nub par mi 'gyur ba dang / sems can rnams kyang gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di nyan par 'gyur ba dang / ye shes kyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab pa thob par 'gyur ba dang /shes rab dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / bsod nams kyi phung po rab tu 'dzin par 'gyur ba dang / ma 'ongs pa'i dus na bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya (gyistong phrag du stimar lha dang mi'i bde ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa myong bar 'gyur ba dang /de bzhin gshegs pa dang 'grogs par 'gyur ba dang / ma 'ongs pa'i dus na bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba dang / sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang /gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi sdug bsngal thams cad shin tu rgyun (5)chad par 'gyur bar de'i spu'i bu ga rnams su mdangs stsal bar bgyi'o/ /de'i lus la mthu dang stobs dang brtson 'grus chen po bskyed par bgyi'o/ /de'i ye shes kyi snang ba bsam gyis 6)mi khyab par bgyi'o/ /de'i dran pa khong du chud par bgyi'o/ /de cher ( )spro bar bgyi'o/ /gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po las/yang dag shes kyi le'u zhes bya ba ste bcu gcig pa'o// //90—87

'phags pa gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ bam po bzhi pa/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen me tog yon tan rgya mtsho bee ḍūrya dang gser gyi ri kha dog bzang po gser du snang ba'i dpal de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yon tan bye ba khrag khrig brgya (2)stong phrag du mas sku legs par brgyan pa/ gang chos kyi sgron ma 'di 'bar bar mdzad pa shākya thub pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha mo chen mo dpal yon tan gyi 'bru dang bkra shis pa dpag tu med pa phun sum tshogs pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha mo chen mo dbyangs can shes rab kyi yon tan dpag tu med pa 'dus pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang de'i tshe de'i dus na rgyal po stobs kyi dbang po'i tog gi (gebu rgyal po mdzes pa'i tog dbang bskur nas ring por ri nom lon pa rgyal srid la ④gsar du gnas pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bu gang ngas 5)sngon dbang bskur nas ring por 4)ma lon pa zhig na/ yab mchog gi dbang po'i tog las blangs pa rgyal po'i bstan bcos lha'i dbang po'i 57༄dam tshig ces bya ba zhig yod de/ ngas rgyal po'i bstan bcos lha'i dbang po'i dam tshig des lo nyi khri'i bar du rgyal po nyid byas par gyur te/tha na sems kyi skad cig gcig tsam gyi tshod kyang sngon chos ma yin pas phyogs 'ga' zhig la gnas par ma shes so/ /bu rgyal po'i bstan bcos lha'i dbang po'i dam tshig ces bya ba de gang zhe na/ des na rigs kyi lha mo de'i tshe de'i dus 8)na rgyal po stobs kyi dbang po'i tog gi ri9)bu rgyal po mdzes pa'i tog khol rgyal po'i bstan 11bcos lha'i dbang po'i dam tshig ces bya ba'i 12tshigs su bcad pa 'di 90—88

dag gis rgya cher yang dag par rab tu bstan to/ /sems can kun la phan byed pa / /the tshom thams cad gcod pa po/ /nyes byas 6)thams cad 'jig byed pa/ /rgyal po'i bstan bcos bshad par bya/ /rgyal po thams cad so so nas/ /dga' ba'i sems su 'gyur byos la/ /lha yi dbang po'i dam tshig kun/ /thal mo sbyar te mnyan par byos/ /rdo rje'i 'byung gnas ri dbang 'dir/ /lha yi dbang po 'dus pa na/ /tshangs dbang la ni dri ba'i phyir/ /'jig rten skyong ba rnams kyang langs/ /khyod ni lha gtso tshangs pa ste/ /khyod ni lha rnams dbang phyug lags/ /khyod ni bdag cag the tshom gcod/ /bdag cag dogs pa gcad 'a)du gsol/ /mir skyes pa yi rgyal po la/ /ji lta ①bur na (4)lha zhes bgyi / /gang gi rgyus na rgyal po la/ /lha sras zhes ni bgyi bar 'gyur/ /gal te lha ni ji lta bur/ /mi yi 'jig rten 'dir skye zhing / /mi bdag gyur te mi rnams la/ /rgyal po nyid ni bgyid par 'gyur/ /'jig rten skyong bas tshangs dbang la/ /de skad yongs su dris (5)pa dang / /lha yi gtso bo tshangs pa des/ /'jig rten skyong la 'di skad smras/ /de ltar 'jig rten skyong 96)rnams kyis/ /da ltar bdag la dris pas na/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /bstan bcos dam pa kho bos bstan/ /mi yi gnas su skyes pa yi(7)/ /rgyal po rnams kyi skye ba dang / /rgyu gang gis nan yul rnams su/ /rgyal por 'gyur ba bshad par bya / /lha dbang rnams kyis byin rlabs 997kyis/ /ma yi rum ⑩du 'jug 'gyur te / / lha yis /rtasngar ni byin brlabs 32nas/ /phyi nas mngal du 'jug par 'gyur / /mi yi 'jig rten skyes kyang ni/ /mi yi dbang por gyur pa yin/ /lha las skyes par gyur pas na/ /de nilha yi sras zhes bya/ /khyod ni lha kun bu 90—89

yin zhes/ /sum cu rtsa gsum lha dbang gis/ /rgyal po'i skal ba byin nas ni/ /mi rnams kyi ni dbang por sprul/ /nyes pa byas pa rnam 'gog pa/ /chos ma yin pa gzhig pa dang / /sems can legs byed dgod pa dang / /lha yi gnas su dgye ba'i phyir/ /mi yi dbang po mi shas 6)dang / /lha yi shas dang dri za'i ②shas / /gdol pa'i shas dang srin shas kyis/ /nyes par byed pa zlog par byed/ /legs par bya ba byed rnams la/ /mi yi dbang po pha ma'i shas / /rnam smin 'bras bu bstan pa'i phyir/ /lha yi ④rgyal po byin gyis brlabs/ /tshe 'di'i legs par byas pa dang / /nyes par byas (snyepa'i las rnams kyi/ /rnam smin 'bras bu bstan pa'i phyir/ /lha yi rgyal po byin gyis brlabs/ /yul na nyes byed gnas pa dag /gang tshe rgyal pos yal bor zhing ⑥/ /sdig pa can gyi skye bo la / /mthun pa'i chad pas mi gcod cing / /nyes par byas pa yal bor ba/ /de tshe chos min shin tu 'phel/ /'thab ⑦mo dang ni g.yo rnams kyang / /yul 'khor de ni phyir phyir 'byung / /sum cu rtsa gsum khang pa na/ /lha yi dbang po 'khrug par 'gyur/ /yul na nyes byed gnas pa dag /gang tshe rgyal pos yal ⑧bor ba/ /de tshe g.yo ni mi bzad pa/ /drag po rnams kyis yul 'joms ⑨'gyur / /pha rol dmag tshogs lhags tsonas su/ /yul 'khor de ni rnam par 'jig /longs spyod rnams lcogedang rigs kyang 'jig /gang gis 8nor bsags yod pa yang / /g.yo byed rnam pa mang po yis/ /phan tshun du ni 'phrog par 'gyuratso / /bya ba gang gis rgyal po nyid/ /bya ba de ni mi byed na/ /glang chen dbang pos rdzing tsobu bzhin/ /rang gi yul 'khor rnam par 'jig /ma rungs pa yi rlung ldang 7zhing / /ma rungs pa 7yi char pa 'bab/ /nyi ma dang ni zla ba 90—90

dang ske/ /gza' dang rgyu skar ma rungs 'gyur0)/ /rgyal pos yal bar bor na der / /sa bon lo tog ②me tog 'bras/ /legs par smin par mi 'gyur zhing / /mu ge dag kyang 'byung bar 'gyur/ /yul na nyes byed gnas pa dag(8) /gang tshe rgyal pos yal bor ba/ /de tshe lha rnams ④khang pa na/ /yid ni dga' bar mi 'gyur ro/ /lha rgyal dbang pos ⑤de dag kun/ /rgyal 'di chos dang mi ldan te/ /chos min phyogs la gnas pa zhes/ /phan tshun du ni smra bar 'gyur56)/ /rgyal 'dis ring ④por mi thogs (kyepar/ /lha rnams 'khrug par 6)byed par 'gyur/ /lha ⑩rnams rab tu 'khrugs pas na/ /de yi yul ni rnam par 'jig /yul du chos min 'byung 'gyur zhing / /mtshon chas kyang ni 'jig par 'gyur/ /g.yo rnams dang ni 'thab mo dang / /nad kyang kun tu 'byung 67bar 'gyur/ /lha yi dbang po rab khros shing ⑫/ /lha rnams tu)kyis kyang yal bar 'dor/ /yul 'khor de ni 'jig par 'gyur/ /rgyal po de ni mya ngan rnyed/ /spun nam yang na bu yang rung / /sdug pa rnams yidang bral bar 'gyur/ /sdug pa'i chung ma dang yang bral/ /yang na bu mo 'chi bar 'gyur/ /skar mda' dag kyang ltung bar 'gyur / /de bzhin nyi ma 'dra ba 8'byung / /pha rol gyi ni dmag (7tshogs dang //mu ge shin tu 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de yi blon po phangs 4 7pa dang / /glang po phangs pa 'chi bar 'gyur/ /de yi 'og tu rnga mo ni/ /phangs pa dag kyang 'chi bar 'gyur/ /khyim dang longs spyod nor rnams ()kyang / /phan tshun du ni 'phrog 19par 'gyur/ /yul yul du ni mtshon cha yis/ /phan tshun dag tu 'debs par 'gyur / /'thab 4)mo dag dang rtsod 0dang g.yo/ /yul rnams na su ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /yul 'khor du ni gdon 'jug cing / /mi bzad pa yi nad 90—91

kyang 'byung / /de yi 'og tu sbyin gnas kyang / /chos dang ldan pa ma yin 'gyur / /de yi 'khor dang blon po yang / /chos dang ldan pa ma yin 'gyur/ /chos dang mi ldan skye 0)bo la/ /de yi 'og tu mchod byed 'gyur/ /chos dang ldan pa'i sems can la/ /rtag tu chad pas gcod par 'gyur/ /chos dang mi ldan skye bo bkur/ /chos ldan chad pas bcad pa (min/ /der ni chu dang rgyu skar rlung / /rnam gsum rnam par 'khrug par 'gyur/ /chos min skye bo bzung bas na / /dam chos ro yi snying po mdangs/ /sems can mdangs nidang sa yi bcud / /dngos po rnam gsum rnam par 'jig /skye bo ngan pa rab bkur cing / /skye bo dam pa smad pas na/ /'chi dang lce 'bab mu ge dang / /rnam pa gsum ni der 'byung 'gyur/ /'bras bu lo tog 54)ro dang mdangs⑤/ /de yi 'og tu med par 'gyur/ /sems can nad pa mang po dag /yul rnams ⑥su ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /mngar zhing che ba'i 'bras bu dag /yul rnams spyin ni yod pa yang / /kha ba dang ni tsha ba dang / /chung ba dag ni nyid du 'gyur/ /rtse dang rgod dang dga' ba dang / /sngan (8)chad dga' ba'i dngos po dag /dga' ba'i nyams ni mi dgar 'gyur/ /nyon mongs brgya yis kyi༄rnam par 'khrugs/ /lo tog rnams khodang 'bras bu yi/ /snum dngos khu ba zad pas na/ /lus dang khams dang dbang po la/ /de ltar tshim par mi 'gyur ro/ /sems can rnams (lhani mdog ngan zhing / /mthu chung 8shin tu rid par 'gyur/ /kha zas mang po zos kyang ni/ /tshim par 'gyur ba ma yin no/ /stobs dang mthu dang brtson 'grus dang / /de yi 'og tu med par 'gyur/ /sems can brtson 'grus nyams pa dag /yul rnams su ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /sna tshogs nad kyis 90—92

gzir ba yi/ /sems can nad mang 'byung bar 'gyur/ /srin po sna tshogs (1las gyur pa'i②/ /gza' dang rgyu skar 'byung bar 'gyur/ /chos min phyogs la rab gnas te/ /rgyal po chos dang mi ldan pas/ /'jig rten gsum gyi dkyil 'khor na/ /khams gsum rnam par 'jig par 'gyur/ /gang tshe rgyal po'i da phyogs gnas te/ /nyes byed yal bar 'dor ba'i tshe/ /'di 'dra'i nyes pa du ma rgyadag /yul rnams su ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /dgos pa gang phyir lha dbang gis / /rgyal po byin gyis brlabs pa yi/ /rgyal po nyid ni mi byed cing / /nyes byed yal bar 'dor na ni/ /legs (5)par byas pas sems can rnams/ /lha yi gnas su lhar yang skye/ /nyes par byas pas yi dgas dang / /sems can dmyal dang dud 'gror skye/ /gang tshe rgyal po yul rnams na/ /nyes byed yal bar 'dor ba'i tshe/ /sum cu rtsa gsum lha gnas nas/ /nyes par ri byas pas ltung bar 'gyur/ /rgyal po nyid ni mi byed na/ /de ni bu yang ma yin la/ /lha yi rgyal po pha rnams kyis57ri/ /gnas la nyes dang bcas par 'gyur/ /g.yo ni shin tu mi bzad pas/ /gang tshe yul 'khor 'jig 'gyur ba/ /de phyir lha yi dbang po yi'u)/ /mi gnas rgyal po byin gyis brlabs/ /nyes pa byas 9zhi bya ba'i phyirayi/ /legs par byed la 'dzud pa ste/ /tshe 'di la ni sems can la/ /rnam smin bskyed pa rgyal po yin/ /legs byas dang ni nyes byas kyi/ /las kyi rnam par smin pa'i 'bras/ /rnam pa tha dad nyu1bstan pa'i phyir/ /byed pa gang yin rgyal por brjod/ /bdag gi nyu2don dang gzhan don dang / /yul gyi chos kyi don gyi phyir/ /lha tshogs rnams kyi nyu byin gyis brlabs/ /lha rnams 1 dag kyang rjes yi tsherang / /yul 'khor rnams na skye bo ni/ /sdig can g.yon can 90—93

'dul ba dang / /yul gyi chos kyi don gyi phyir/ /srog dang rgyal srid rnams ①kyang btang / /chos ma yin pas bzod byed cing / /shes bzhin yal bar 'dor ba ni/ /yul na 'jigs ⑧pa mi bzad pa/ /de 'dra gzhan ni yod ma yin / /ji ltar g.yo rnams byung ba la/ /g.yo byed chad pas ma bcad ①na/ /yul du shin tu mi bzad pa'i/ /g.yo rnams ④phyir zhing 'byung bar 'gyur/ /glang chen rnams kyi ardzing chen bzhin/ /yul 'khor de ni rnam par 'jig /lha dbang rnams (6)kyang khro bar 'gyur/ /lha yi gnas ni rnam par 'jig /yul du dngos po thams cad ni/ /ma rungs par nyu)yang 'gyur bas na/ /de phyir sdig pa byed pa rnams/ /nyes pa'i rim bzhin gdul bar bya/ /chos kyis yul 'khor bskyang bar bya/ /chos ma yin pa spyad mi bya/ /srog kyang yongs su gtang bya zhing / /nye 'khon (8)bya bar mi bya'o/ /skye bo gnyen dang skye bo gzhan/ /yul 'khor skye bo thams cad la/ /rgyal pos tho)phyogs kyang gcig ⑩bya yi/ /phyogs su lhung bar gyur ta re/ /rgyal po chos dang ldan pa yi/ /grags pa 'jig rten gsum gang ste/ /sum cu gsum gyi yiganas rnams na/ /lha yi dbang po dgar 'gyur te/ /'dzam bu'i gling na nged kyi bu/ /'di ltar chos ldan rgyal po yin/ /chos kyi yul 'khor der bstan /rtenas/ /legs par byed la skye bo bkod8/ /rgyal po de ni legs byed pas/ /skye bo dag ni 'dir 'gyed de/ /lha dang lha yi bu rnams yikyis/ /lha gnas gang bar byed snyam mo/ /chos kyi yul 'khor der bstan pas/ /rgyal po rnams ni rab tu dga'/ /lha dbang rab tu dang gyur pas / /mi yi rgyal po de la bsrung tī/ /nyi zla dang ni de bzhin du/ /rgyu skar legs par rgyu bar 'gyur/ /rlung yang dus yisu ldang 'gyur zhing / /char pa'ang 90—94

dus su 'bab par 'gyur/ /lha gnas rnams dang de bzhin du/ /yul 'khor rnams ①su lo ②legs byed/ /lha dang lha yi bu rnams ①kyis/ /lha yi gnas rnams gang bar byed/ /de lta bas na rgyal po yibya/ /bdag gis phangs pa'i srog btang gisaphyi/ /bdag gis 'jig rten bder 'gyur ba/ /dkon mchog chos ni mi btang ste/ /yon tan rnams kyis phyogang brgyan pa/ /chos dang ldan pas bsten par bya/ /rang gis ⑦skye bo ④rtag dga' ⑨ba/ /rtag tu sdig pa rnam par spangs0/ /chos kyis 7yul 'khor bskyang bar bya/ /chos kyang yang dag bstan par bya/ /legs par byed la sems can dgodakyi/ /nyes byed las ni bzlog par bya/ /gang tshe sdig pa byed pa rnams/ /tshul bzhin 'dul bar byed pa'i tshe/ /yul 'khor du ni lo legs shing / /rgyal po gzi brjid ldan par 'gyur / /rgyal po grags dang ldan 'gyur zhing / /skye dgu rnams kyang bde bar skyong ske/ /gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po las rgyal po'i bstan bcos lha'i dbang po'i dam tshig ⑩ces bya ba'i le'u ste bcu gnyis pa'o// //gang tshe 'khor los sgyur 8ba'i rgyal por gyur/ /de tshe rgya 8mtshor bcas pa'i sa rnams btang / /gling bzhi rin chen gang bar bcas pa yang / /sngon gyi rgyal ba dag la ngas phul lo/ /chos kyi sku de yongs su btsal ba'i phyir/ /gang sngon yid du 'ong zhing phangs ⑩pa yi/ /dngos po de dag ngas ni ma btang medam/ /bskal pa du mar phangs ⑩pa'i srog kyang btang / /ji ltar sngon gyi bskal 8pa bsam yas na/ /rin chen gtsug tor can gyi bde bar gshegs/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i bde bar gshegs pa ⑩de'i/ /bstan la legs byung zhes pa'i 90—95
