rgyal po byung / /de ni gling bzhi'i dbang ba'i (1)'khor los sgyur6)/ /rgya mtshor thug pa'i sa la rab tu ston/ /rgyal dbang gsung phyir rgyal po'i pho brang na/ /de tshe rgyal po dam pa gnyid kyis log /rmi lam du ni sangs rgyas yon tan thos/ /chos smra rin chen sog nasapa gnyid dkyil na(4)/ /rnam par lhang (genger mdo sde'i dbang po 'di/ /rab tu 'chad cing 'dug pa mthong bar gyur6༄/ /rgyal po de ni gnyid kyis 97log las ri risad/ /de yi lus kun dga' bas khyab par gyur6nye/ /mgu nas rgyal po'i nyu khab nas mngon byung ste/ /nyan thos dge 'dun mchog gi gnas su song / /rgyal ba'i nyan thos rnams (1la mchod byed cing / /'phags pa'i dge 'dun 'di ni rin chen sog1ge /yon tan ldan pa'i dge slong gang yod ces / /chos smra rin chen sog 1 pa kun tu dris/ /de yi tshe na rin chen sog 8pa ni / /phug gzhan zhig gi nang na 'dug gyur tesko/ /mdo sde'i rgyal po 'di ni rnam sems la/ /kha ton byed cing bde bar rab tu 'dugayo /dge slong chos smra rin chen sog sna 7pa de/ /phun sum gzi brjid dpal gyis (nyusherab 'bar zhing / /phug gzhan zhig gi 19nang na 'dug gyur pa ri/ /de yi tshe na rgyal po de la bstan / /'di na chos smra rin chen sog ni pa 'di/ /rgyal po'i spyod yul zab mo 'dzin pa ste/ /gser 'od dam pa zhes ni bya ba yi/ /mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po rtag tu ston/ /rin chen sog 2pa'i rkang la phyag 'tshal te/ /rgyal po legs (3par byung bas 'di skad smras/ /gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal/ /zla ba nya ba'i zhal 'dra bshad du gsol/ /rgyal po legs par byung du rib de nyid la / /rin chen sog 5pas khas ni blangs pas na/ /stong gsum pa yi 'jig rten thams na cad du/ /lha rnams thams 2 cad rab tu dga' bar 'gyur she/ /90wa 96

de tshe mi yi dbang pos sa phyogs ni/ /gtsang zhing mchog tu khyad par 'phags pa der/ /rin chen chu dang spos chus chag chag btab/ /me tog sil ma bkram ste khri bshams nas/ /rgyal pos 0)khri de gdugs chadang rgyal mtshan dang / /dar yug stong phrag du mas legs ①par brgyan/ /rgyal pos khri der 54)tsan dan dam pa dag /rnam pa sna tshogs dag zhi)kyang mngon par gtor/ /lha dang klu dang lha min mi 'am ci/ /gnod sbyin dbang dang mkha' lding (6)lto 'phye ches/ /lha yi me tog man dā ra ba'i char/ /khri de la ni mngon par rab tu phab/ /chos 'dod lha ni bye ba khrag khrig stong / /bsam gyis mi khyab gang dag lhags 77gyur pa / /rin chen sog (8)pa mngon par byung ba na/ /sā (9)la'i me tog dag gis mngon par 'thor⑩/ /chos smra rin chen sog 7pa de nyid kyang / /shin tu lus bkrus tsogatsang ma'i gos bgos te/ /khri der nye bar song bar sna byas nas ni/ /thal mo sbyar ba byas te phyag kyang 'tshalayi/ /lha dbang dang ni lha dang lha mo rnams / /bar snang 'dug nas me tog man dā ra'i/ /char pa 'bebs shing sil snyan brgya stong phrag /bsam gyis mi khyab pa dag rab tu sgrogs/ /rin chen sog 8pa dge slong chos smra des/ /phyogs bcu dag gi sangs rgyas bye ba stong / /bsam gyis mi khyab pa dag 7dran byas nas/ /de ni mngon par 'dzegs (7 te 'dug par gyur(5/ /sems can kun la snying brtse bskyed nas ni/ /snying rje'i sems kyang yang dag bskyed byas te/ /rgyal po legs par byung ba de la ni / /de yi tsotshe na mdo sde 'di bstan te/ /rgyal pos thal mo sbyar byas btud nas su/ /tshig gcig gis ni rjes su yi tsho phorang ste/ /chos kyi shugs 21kyis mig nas mchi ma phyung (zhu / /de yi lus ni dga' bas khyab par gyur/ /mdo sde 'di 90—97

la mchod pa bya ba'i phyir/ /de tshe rgyal po legs 0)par byung ba yis② yid bzhin nor bu rin chen rgyal po blangs/ /sems can rnams phyir smon lam btab pa ni/ /rin chen bdun dang ldan pa'i rgyan rnams nidang / /gang yang 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir sems can rnams/ /bde bar 'gyur ba'i nor ni chen po yi/ /char pa de ring 'dzam bu'i gling du phob/ /de yi tshe na rin chen sna bdun dang / /dpung rgyan dang ni do shal rna cha mchog /de bzhin zas dang skom dang gos rnams 4kyang / /gling bzhi dag tu rab tu 'bab (gepar gyur/ /rgyal po legs par byung bas 'dzam gling du/ /rin chen char pa 'bab pa de mthong nas/ /gling bzhi rin chen gang bar bcas pa ni/ /rin chen gtsug tor can gyi bstan ⑥la phul/ /de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa nga / /rgyal po legs par byung zhes bya bar gyur(7)/ /gling bzhi dag ni rin chen gang bcas kyi/ /sa 'di de tshe nga yis yongs su btang / /gang gis rgyal po legs par byung de la/ /de tshe mdo sde 'di ni rab bstan pa/ /rin chen sog ⑧pa chos smra'i 6)dge slong de/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs tsoder gyur to/ /ngas gang de tshe mdo sde 'di thos shing / /tshig gcig 31gis ni rjes su yi (rterang ste/ /nga ni dge ba'i las ni de nyid dang / /chos nyan pa dang rjes su yi rang bas/ /gser gyi mdog dang bsod nams brgya yi mtshan/ /blta na sdug cing mig tu mngon mdzes la/ /lha stong bye ba rab tu dga' byed pa/ /skye bos mthong na dga' lus rtag 8tu thob/ /bskal pa dag ni bye ba brgya stong phrag /dgu bcu rtsa dgur 'khor los sgyur ④rgyal gyur/ /bskal pa brgya stong du ma mang por yang / /ngas ni khams kyi rgyal po myong bar gyurage/ /bskal pa bsam gyis mi khyab brgya byin gyur/ /tshangs pa'i 90—98

dbang po yid bzhin 0)de bzhin no/ /gang dag tshad ni nam yang yod min pa'i/ /stobs bcu dpag med ngas ni brnyes par byas(snye/ /ngas gang mdo thos rjes su yi phyirang ba/ /bsod nams phung po de ltar tshad med mang / /bsam pa ji bzhin ngas ni byang chub thob/ /chos sku dam pa yang ni ngas thob bo/ /gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po las legs (4)par byung ba'i le'u zhes bya ba ste bcu gsum pa'o// //dpal ldan lha mo rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo dad pa can (5)gang la la zhig /'das pa dang ma 'ongs (7pa dang da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams nyal yo byad thams cad kyis (8)mchod pa chen po shin tu rgyas 95shing rgya che ba bsam gyis ⑩mi khyab pa byed par 'dod cing (2/ 'das pa dang ma 'ongs 12pa dang da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams tu kyi sangs rgyas kyi spyod yul zab mo yongs su shes par 'dod pa des gtsug lag khang ngam dgon pa'i phyogs yikyang rung ste/ gang na gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di rgya cher yang dag par rab tu ston pa'i phyogs der/ des gdon mi za bar g.yeng ba med pa'i sems kyis borna ba blags 7te gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di mnyan par bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 1 don 'di nyid 'khor la nyu rgya cher brjod pa'i phyir/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gsungs so/ /gang zhig sangs rgyas thams cad la/ /bsam yas 1mumachod pa byed 'dod cing / /sangs rgyas kun gyi spyod yul ba/ /zab mo rab tu shes 'dod pas/ /gtsug lag khang ngam gnas khang ngam/ /gang na gser 'od 90wa 99

dam pa yi/ /mdo sde dam pa 'di ston pa/ /sa phyogs der ni 'gro bar bya/ /mdo sde /1)bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ /yon tan rgya mtsho gomatha' yang yas/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho du ma las/ /sems can thams cad thar bar byed/ /mdo sde yi ni thog ma dang / /dbus dang de bzhin tha ma mthong / /mdo sde'i dbang po rab zab ste/ /'di la dpe (8)ni yod ma yin/ /gang gā ④dang ni sa rnams ⑤dang / /rgya mtsho dang ni nam mkha' la/ /gnas pa'i rdul ni gang yang rung / /dper bya ba (65ni mi nus so/ /chos kyi dbyings la 'jug pa yig/ /de yi tshe na 'jug par bya/ /chos kyi bdag nyid mchod rten ni/ /zab mo rab brtan ⑧gang yin pa/ /mchod rten (9)de yi dbus na ⑩ni/ /rgyal ba shākya thub pa mthong / /yid du 'ong ba'i dbyangs kyis tunyesu/ /mdo sde 'di ni rab tu ston8/ /grangs med bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /bskal pa bye ba ji snyed par/ /lha yi ⑫dang ni mi rnams kyis7/ /bde ba dag ni rjes su myong / /gang zhig mdo sde 'di nyan pa/ /de ltar bdag gi 8bsod nams kyitshu/ /phung po bsam yas bsgrub nyu snyam du/ /de tshe des tsho)ni de ltar shes/ /mes gang 'obs kyis yibaskor ba yi/ /dpag tshad brgya dag 'da' byed cing / /tshor ba drag po bzod byas dhi nas / /mdo sde mnyan par gang nus pa/ /gtsug ( sprelag khang ngam gnas khang du / /zhugs nas de ma thag tu ni/ /sdig pa rnams ni med par 'gyur/ /rmi ngan mtshan nyid thams cad dang / /gza' dang rgyu skar gnod pa dang / /byad dang gdon ni mi bzad kyang / /zhugs nas de ma thag tu ni/ /thams cad gzhan du phyogs par 'gyur/ /klu yi rgyal po rnams kyis ()ni/ /rmi lam bstan pa ci 'dra bar/ /der ni padma 'dra ba'i khri/ /de lta bur yang bsham (nyapar bya/ /90—100

khri de la ni 'dug nas su/ /mdo sde 'di ni rab tu bstan/ /yi ger bris pa bklag 6)par bya/ /de bzhin yongs su chub par bya/ /khri de las ni babs nas su / /yul gzhan song bar gyur na yang / /khri de la ni yod pa yi/ / cho 'phrul rnams ①kyang snang bar 'gyur / /chos smra ba yi gzugs su yang / /de ni res 'ga' stisnang bar 'gyur/ /res 'ga' (9sangs rgyas gzugs su ste/ /res 'ga' (5)byang chub sems dpar g.yang / /res 'ga' (8)kun tu bzang po dang / /de bzhin 'jam dpal gzugs su ste/ /res 'ga' 5)byams pa'i gzugs su yang —/ /khri de la ni snang bar 'gyur/ /res 'ga' yo )'od ni 'ba' zhig snang / /res 'ga' tunyelha rnams (nyesnang bar 'gyur/ /yud tsam zhig ni der yonasnang nas/ /de nas mi snang bar yang 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas mthong na bsngags mi(par 'gyur/ /thams cad du yang grub par byed/ /'bru mdang bkra shis phun sum tshogs/ /mtshan ma sangs rgyas sprul ⑩pa yin/ /rgyal dang dpal dang grags par byed/ /phyir rgol ba yang ldog par byed/ /pha rol dgra tshogs rab tu 'joms1 / /g.yul du dgra rnams phung bar byed/ /rmi ngan thams cad zhi bar byed/ /sdig pa thams cad rab tu 'jig /sdig pa thams 68cad rab zhi byed/ /g.yul 'gyed pa na yirgyal bar byed/ /'dzam bu'i gling 'di thams cad du/ /grags pas rab tu gang bar 'gyur/ /de yi dgra rnams thams cad ni/ /shin tu pham pa nyid du 'gyur/ /rtag tu dgra ni choms )par 'gyurasanya/ /sdig pa thams cad rnam par (nyaspangs/ /g.yul ngo'i rtse las rnam par rgyal/ /dgra dang bral zhing mchog tu dga'/ /tshangs dbang sum cu rtsa gsum dbang / /de bzhin 'jig rten skyong rnams dang / /lag na rdo rje gnod sbyin dbang / /rgyal ba khyu mchog 90wa 101

yang dag shes/ /klu yi dbang po ma dros dang / /de bzhin du ni rgya mtsho dang / /mi 'am ci dbang lha min dbang / /de bzhin nam mkha' lding dbang po/ /de dag la ni sogs 3)pa dang / /lha rnams (bde dag thams cad kyang / /chos kyi mchod rten bsam yas la/ /rtag tu mchod pa byed par 'gyur/ /zhe chasar bcas pa'i sems can rnams(4ra/ /mthong nas shin tu dga' bar 'gyur/ /lha yi dbang po mchog de dag /thams cad 'di snyam sems par 'gyur/ /lha rnams 55)de dag thams cad kyang / /phan tshun du ni smra byed pa/ /bsod nams dpal dang gzi brjid dag(phyir /bsags pa de dag kun la ltos/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba sbyangs pa yi77ri/ /mi rnams 8)de dag 'dir lhags 6)te/ /gang dag mdo sde zab mo 'di/ /nyan pa'i phyir ni 'dir lhags pa/ /dad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas / /chos kyi mchod rten gus dang bcas/ /de dag 'jig rten snying rje ldan/ /de dag sems can phan byed pa/ /de dag zab mo'i chos rnams kyisati/ /dam pa'i chos kyi ro yi snod/ /chos kyi dbyings la 'jug pa yis(skye/ /de dag rab tu 'jug pa yin/ /gang dag gser 'od dam pa'i mdo/ /dge ba dam pa 'di nyan pa/ /de dag sngon chad sangs rgyas ni/ /brgya stong rnams 4)la mchod pa yin / /dge ba'i rtsa ba de yis 1 ni/ /mdo sde 8nyan pa de dag la/ /lha dbang rgyal po de kun dang / /dbyangs can dang ni de bzhin du/ /dpal dang rnam thos bu kedang ni/ /de bzhin rgyal po bzhi rnams tshudang / /gnod sbyin brgya phrag stong po dag /stobs chen rdzu 'phrul ldan rnams /mekyis/ /phyogs bzhi dag ni kun nas kyang / /bsrung nyugeb shin tu byed par 'gyur/ /dbang po zla ba gshin rje dang / /rlung dang chu lha nyid dang ni/ /skem byed 'jug sel dbyangs can 90—102

gis sa'i ngos la brdabs te/ bsnun ma thag tu sa rnam pa drug tu g.yos te nor bu dang gser dang dngul las byas pa'i mchod rten zhig de nas byung ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ①tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/kun dga' bo ②mchod rten 'di phye zhig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos ①bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar mnyan nas/ mchod rten de phye ba dang des der gser gyi 'phra ④can gyi nor bu dang 6)mu tig gis khebs ⑥par g.yogs 57)pa'i gser gyi za ma tog cig mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gser gyi za ma tog cig (8)mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑨bka' stsal pa/ za ma tog bdun po 'di dag thams cad phye shig⑩ /de bzhin du thams 'o)cad phye ba dang des der rus pa'i kha dog kha ba dang me tog ku mu da dang ⑩'dra ba dag cig (srimathong ngo / /mthong nas kyang bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das rus pa dag cig gda'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis 8bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo skyes rtebu chen po'i rus pa rnams tsokhyer te shog /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos 0rus pa de dag blangs te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la phul ba dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis rus pa rnams tu dge 'dun gyi mdun du bsnams te phyag tu bzhes te ⑩bka' stsal pa/ rus pa 'di dag yon tan mchog rab tshogs ldan blo gros mchog /dul dang bsam gtan ( ) bzod pas spro ba grags pa dam pa mchog /phyir zhing byang chub 'di la rtag tu blo gros ldan byas shing / /spro brtan 27mos dang blo gros rtag tu sbyin la dga' ba'i ⑥yin/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams ( nyel bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag byang chub sems dpa'i 90—129

rus pa tshul khrims (1)dang yon tan gyis yongs ②su bsgos pa/ mchog tu mthong bar dka' ba bsod nams kyi zhing du gyur pa rnams ①la phyag 'tshol ④cig /de nas dge slong de dag gis thal mo sbyar te 'dun pa'i yid kyis rus pa rnams ⑤la phyag 'tshal (6)to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos thal mo sbyar te bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa ni / 'jig rten thams cad las mngon par 'phags pa sems can thams ⑦cad kyis phyag bgyis 50pa lags na/ ji ltar de bzhin gshegs pa nyid rus pa 'di dag la phyag bzhes/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 0tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dzol 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /kun dga' bo rus pa 'di dag gis nga 67'di ltar myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /kun dga' bo tu)sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na rgyal po shing rta chen po zhes bya ba bzhon pa dang stobs du ma dang ldan pa thogs pa med pa'i stobs kyis yo pha rol gnon pa zhig byung ste/ de la bu lha gzhon nu dang 'dra ba gsum zhig yod de sgra chen po dang lha chen po dang sems can chen po'o/ /de nas rgyal po rtse ba'i phyir skyed 8mos tshal gyi sar byung ba dang / gzhon nu de dag skyed mos tshal de'i yon tan la chags shing me tog 'dod pas maphan tshun rgyu ste/ nags stug po chen po bcu gnyis su zhugs so/ /de nas rgyal po'i bu dag dong ba dang gzhon nu'i rim gro pa rnams kyang rgyal bus bskrad nas phan tshun dong ste/ kun tu bsrungs pa'i ⑩skyed mos tshal chen po'i nags mastug po bcu gnyis su zhugs hunyeso/ /de nas sgra chen pos nu bo gnyis la smras panyunye/ kho bo'i snying 'jigs hūṃ — )pas non na 'dir bdag cag gcan gzan 90—130

gyis gsad ①du 'ong gis ②tshur shog /lha chen pos smras pa/ bdag la 'jigs kun)pa ni ma mchis skyin/ skye bo sdug pa dang bral ba snyam bgyid pa'i snying du gyur to/ /sems can chen pos smras pa/ thub pas bsngags pa'i nags (5)khrod dben pa 'dir / /bdag ni mi 'jigs mya ngan ma mchis kyi6)/ /shin tu rgyas mchog don chen rnyed snyam ste/ /bdag gi ④snying 'di rab tu dga' bar gyur(8)/ /de nas rgyal bu gzhon nu de dag nags stug 6)po bcu gnyis po de dag gi khrod du rgyu ba na stag 7mo bu byung nas zhag bdun lon pa zhig bu lngas (1bskor te/ bkres shing skom pas nyam tsomad nas lus mchog tu nyam (stechung bar gyur pa de 'dra ba zhig mthong ngo / /mthong nas sgra chen pos 0smras pa/ kye ⑩ma'o nyon mongs tsom 'di bu byung nas zhag drug gam zhag bdun 8lon par tsho)gyur la/ da 5)ltar zas ma rnyed pas yang na ni rang gi bu la za bar 'gyur/ yang na ni bkres zhu )pas 'chi ba'i dus byed par 'gyur ro/ /sems can chen pos ( nyasmras pa/ nyon mongs ma 'di'i zas ci/ sgra chen pos smras pa/ 'di ltar ( stegang sha sar pa dang khrag dron po yod na de ni stag dang dom dang dred dang seng ge rnams ()kyi zas yin no zhes zer ro/ /lha chen pos smras pa/ 'dir nyon mongs ( stebakres pa dang skom pa dang ldan pa'i lus su gyur pas srog gi lhag ( snyem cung zad cig lus te/ rab tu nyam chung ba (nye'adis gnas 'dir zas skom ( nyetshol ni mi nus na 'di'i srog yongs shesu bsrung ba'i phyir su zhig rang gi lus yongs su gtong zhu)bar byed cig gu gu/ sgra chen pos ⑩smras pa/ kye rang gi (2lus yongs su btang ba ni bya dka' ba'o/ /sems can chen pos (nyesmras pa/ bdag cag lta bu srog dang lus la mngon par chags pa blo chung ba rnams (9la ni tshul 'di bya dka' ba lags kyi gzhan lus 90—131

yongs su gtong ba la zhugs pa gzhan la phan par brtson pa'i skyes ①bu dam pa rnams la ni (bdaka' ba ma lags so/ /yang snying brtse snying rje las byung 'phags pa'i sems can dag /lha yul dang ni sa 'dir rang lus rnyed snyam ste / /gzhan gyi srog phyir mthun par dga' ba'i yid kyis ni/ /'gyur ba med par 'dir ni rnam pa brgya yis rtse(ge/ /de nas rgyal bu gzhon nu de shin tu mi dga' duste / stag (6)mo de la mig mi 'dzums 4)par ring zhig tu bltas nas song ngo / /de nas sems can chen po 'di snyam du sems te/ da ni bdag gi lus 'di ⑧yongs su gtong kyi ba'i dus la bab bo/ /de ci'i phyir zhe ⑩na/ 'jig ⑩cing 'gyes tu pa'i chos can mthar 'gyed (nyamatha' ngan pa/ /rnag can lus 'di zas dang skom dang mal cha dang / /bzhon yipa 'os pa chen po dag gis ring bsrungs ⑫kyang / /snga med rang gis tsorang bzhin spre 7mi 'dor byas don med/ /yang thams cad du mi gtsang bar gyur pas na de'i 'tsho ba med kyisatso/ da bdag gis ⑩de las bzang po nol sbyar bar bya'o/ /de'i phyir bdag skye ba dang 'chi ba'i rgya mtsho las rgal (7ba'i gru bo che lta bur 'gyur ro/ /yang snying po med lus dbu ba 'dra la zhugesrin bu brgyas gang byas pa chud gzon pa/ /'bras 'dra ba yi srid pa brgya ldan gcin dang phyi sas gang ba 'di btang ste( nye/ /mya ngan med cing 'gyur med phung med dri med bsam gtan nastel sogs yon tan gyisatso/ /kun tu gang ba'i chos sku yon tan brgyas gang rdul dang bral ba thob par bya/ /de snying rje mchog dang ldan pa'i snying du zhu nyagyur pas de ltar brtul hu rtenas khyod gnyis gshegs su gsol / bdag ni rang gi khri༄bgyi ba zhig gi slad du nags 0stug po bcu gnyis su 'jug go zhes de gnyis bskrad do/ /de nas rgyal bu gzhon nu sems can chen po 90—132

nags 'dab ①de nas slar log ste/ stag gi gnas su song nas nags kyi yal ga la gos gzar ②te/ bdag ni 'gro la phan phyir byang chub mtshungs pa ri med pa zhi ba ④thob 'dod de/ /gzhan gyis btang bar dka' ba'i lus ni blo gros 'gyur ba med pa'i snying rjes sbyin/ /bdag gis skyon med byang chub rin dzo med rgyal sras rnams kyis gnyer ba thob ⑥par shog /bdag gis srid pa'i rgya mtsho rab tu 'jigs las 'jig rten gsum po bsgral bar bya/ /zhes smon lam btab bo / /de nas sems can chen po stag mo'i mdun du nyal ba dang / de nas byams pa dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la stag mos ci yang ma byas so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas ④kye ma'o 'di ni nyam (kyechung bas mi nus so snyam nas langs ①te/ snying brtse ba'i blo gros kyis mtshon cha btsal na gang nas kyang mtshon cha ma rnyed nas des 'od ma'i yal ga lo brgya lon pa sra ba zhig blangs hu byete/bdag gi mgul pa bcad nas stag mo'i mdun du 'gyel to/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'gyel ma thag tu chu'i dbus su son pa'i gru rlung gis bskyod tuskrepa bzhin du sa 'di rnam pa drug tu g.yos so/ /nyi ma yang sgra gcan gyis zin pa bzhin du 'od zer rnams kyis mdzes pa med do/ /lha'i spos dang phye (nyam dang 'dres yonapa'i me tog gi char yang bab bo/ /de nas lha zhig gis ngo mtshar ④du gyur pa'i yid kyis byang chub sems dpa' la bstod 8pa/ blo gros bzang po khyod 'dir ji ltar thugs 0rjes sems can rnams khyab ste0/ /mi yi dbang po rab tu dgyes pas ji ltar sku 'dir tsobatang bas na/ /skye ba dang ni 'chi ba'i don dang bral ba zhi ba gnas kyi mchog /zhi ba gtsang ma khyod kyis hunye'adir ni tshegs 6 )med ring por mi thogs brnyes 0/ /de nas stag mo des 'byang chub sems dpa'i lus khrag gis 90—133

sbags pa la bldags 0)nas/ yud tsam gyis sha dang khrag med par rus pa tsam zhig lus par byas so/ /de nas sgra chen pos sa g.yos pa de dag la ②bsams nas lha chen po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /ji ltar phyogs ①bcu'i rgya mcho'i mthar 57thug rgya mtshor bcas pa yi/ /sa 'di rab tu g.yos shing nyi ma'ang 'od ni med gyur la/ /me tog char pa bab ⑤cing kho bo'i yid kyang 'khrugs pas skyon/ /da gzod (7)bdag gi nu bos (sherang gi lus ni btang yang dag6) /lha chen pos smras pa/ de ni ji ltar snying rje'i ⑩tshig smra la/ /bkres dang ldan zhing sdug bsngal brgyas 4lhagatses pa/ /shin tu nyam ()chung rang gi bu la yang za bar chas la lta bas hu bdag kyang dogs/ /de nas rgyal bu gzhon nu de gnyis rab tu mya ngan gyis non nas mchi mas mig gang ste lam de nyid nas slar log nas stag mo'i drung du phyin pa dang / gos thams 8cad ni 'od ma'i yal ga la gzar/rus pa rnams ni bye 57zhing bral/ khrag ni rdzab tu gyur/ skra ni phyogs dang phyogs mtshams 7su 'thor bar mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang brgyal 4)te rus pa'i steng tsodu 'gyel nas ring zhig 17lon pa dang / 'du shes rnyed de langs nas lag pa bsgreng ste nyam ri thag pa'i sgra phyung ngo / /kye ma'o nu bo sdug pa dang ni rgyal po dang / /de bzhin du ni bu la rab tu gdung (7ba'i ma/ /padma 'dra ba'i mig ring khyod kyi 4 gegar bzhag ces/ /ma ni bdag cag la yang tha chungs 'dri 0bar 'gyur / /kye ma bdag cag gnyis ni sa phyogs tso'adi nyid du/ /shi na legs kyis dgegason na 89de lta ( bem yin no/ /sems can chen po med par gyur pas bdag cag la/ /pha ma dag gis ji ltar lto ba ster bar 'gyurazhi/ /de nas rgyal bu gzhon nu de gnyis kyis ( )snying rje rje skad du rnam pa mang por ngus nas dong ngo //90—134

de nas rgyal bu gzhon nu'i rim gro 1)pa rnams kyang gzhon nu tshol zhing phyogs (midang phyogs mtshams ②su rgyug pa dang / gcig gis gcig mthong nas/ gzhon 47nu ga re gzhon nu ga re zhes 'dri'o/ /de'i tshe btsun mo mal na nyal ba'i rmi lam na sdug pa dang bral bar rmis pa 'di lta ste/ nu ma gnyis bcad pa dang / so phyung ba dang / thi ba'i phru gu skrag pa (snyegasum zhig rnyed pa las gcig 56)khras khyer bar mthong ngo / /de nas btsun ⑦mo sa g.yos pas snying dngangs (8)te mod la sad nas sems pa la zhugs te/ 'byung po'i rten ma rgya mtsho'i gos can 'di ni kun tu rab g.yo ci zhig gu/ /nyi ma 'od zer med par gyur pas nga yi snying la mya ngan 'gyur bar ⑨ston/ /nga yi lus ni zhum zhing mig kyang g.yo la rang gi 7nu ma bcad rmis pa/ /nga yi bu rnams (nyanags khrod tunye'adir ni rtser dong ba la dge bar 'gyur ram ge/ /de nas de snyam bsams 8pa dang bran mo yang snying myos te 'ongs tsonas btsun mo la smras pa/ jo mo gzhon nu'i rim gro pa dag gzhon nu tshol zhing mchis na jo co 8stor ces gda'o/ /de skad ces ⑩thos ma thag tu btsun mo'i snying 'dar zhing mig dang gdong mchi mas gang ste rgyal po'i gan du song nas smras pa/ lha bdag gi bu sdug pa stor ces thos so/ /rgyal po yang snying 'dar zhing shin tu myos te kyi hud bdag gi bu sdug pa dang bral ba lta zhes smras so//de nas rgyal pos btsun mo dbugs dbyung // ba'i phyir nga tsogazhon nu btsal ba la nan tan du byed kyis (7bzang mo mya ngan ma byed cig /der gzhon nu tshol ba la zhugs pa na skye bo'i tshogs dag jod rod por gyur to( )/ /de nas ring por ma lon par rgyal pos rgyal bu gzhon nu gnyis rgyang ring po nas 'ong ba mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang smras pa gzhon nu de dag ni 'ong na thams cad ni ma yin te/ kyi 90—135

hud bu dang bral ba lta zhes bya ba ni sdug bsngal ba'o/ /ji ltar bu dang bral bar gyur na yid ni mi bde ba/ /mi rnams bu rnyed pa ni de ltar dga' ba ma yin no/ /'jig rten na ni 0)gang dag bu med pa dang shi ba 'am/ /mi rnams gang dag bu gson de dag bde ba yin nam (0ci/ /de nas btsun mo shin tu mya ngan gyis non nas rnga mo gnad du bsnun pa bzhin du shin tu ①mi bzad ④pa'i sgra phyung ngo / /de ltar bu gsum dag ni g.yog gi tshogs bcas te/ /me tog rnams kyis gang ba'i nags khrod zhugs pa las/ /bdag gi bu dge tha chungs ⑤'ongs par ma gyur na/ /bdag gi snying dang 'dra ba'i tha chungs ⑥de ga re/ /de nas de gnyis lhags 57༄pa dang rgyal pos bu la dris pa/ khye'u tha chungs (8)ga re zhes gzhon nu gnyis la dris pa dang / de nas mya ngan gyis nyam ⑨thag cing mig mchi kyims gang ste rkan dang mchu dang kha dang so skams nas cang mi zer ro/ /btsun mos smras pa/ kho mo'i bu sdug tha chungs yonyede ga re/ /kho mo'i snying 'di gas la thug gyur cing / /lus ni mi bzad yinarab tu gzir ()gyur te/ /kho mo'i dran pa nyams 'gyur myur du smros/ /de nas gzhin nu de gnyis kyis ji ltar gyur pa de zhib tu smras so/ /de thos ma thag tu rgyal po dang btsun mo myos par gyur 8te/myos pa sangs nas snying rje rje skad du ngu zhing 7phyogs der dong ngo / /de nas rgyal po dang btsun mos rus pa de dag sha dang khrag dang rgyus pa med cing skra phyogs dang phyogs mtshams su 'thor ⑩ba mthong nas shing rlung gis btab pa bzhin du 'gyel to/ /de nas nye phan dang blon po dag gis de ltar gyur pa de mthong nas chu dang ri ma la ya'i tsandan gyi 'de nyunyegus rgyal po dang btsun mo'i lus bsil bar ༷rshabyas so/ /de nas ring zhig lon pa dang 'du shes rnyed nas rgyal po 90—136

langs te snying rje rje skad ①du 'bod pa/ kye ma bu sdug yid 'ong mthong dga' ba//'chi bdag dbang du ci phyir de myur song / /'chi bdag ci phyir nga la sngar ma 'ongs / /nga ②la sdug bsngal 'di las gzhan mi 'byung / /btsun mo yang myos pa las sangs nas skra gzhig ③cing lag pa gnyis kyis brang brdungs te/ nya thang la phyung dub bzhin du sa'i steng na 'gre ༷ldog cing ma he be'u stor ba dang rnga mo rnge'u stor ba bzhin du snying rje rje skad du ngu'o⑨/ /kye ma sdug cing gces pa'i bu ni ⑦padma 'di/ /su yis sa yi steng du bshig nas rab tu gtor/ /yid 'ong mig ldan zla 'dra'i bzhin can bdag gi bu/ /bdag gi dgra bo (8)gang gis de ring sa 'dir bcom/ /kye ma sa 'dir bu mchog bsad mthong naponye/ /lus 'di ci phyir de ring zhig ma gyur/ /sdug bsngal 'di 'dra mthong yang ma gas pas/ /bdag 7gi snying 'di lcags ni yin yang dgayi /de ring rmi lam du ni bdag gi nu ma 'ga' zhig gis ni ral gris bcad/ /so yang phyung bas de ring bdag gi nyu2bu sdug de ni myur du ma rung gyur/ /bdag gis thi ba'i phrug 6)gu gsum zhig rnyed pa gcig ④'dir ji ltar khras khyer bzhin/ /bdag gi 'bu gsum dag gis bskor ba las kyang gcig ⑩ni de ring 'chi bdag khyer(nye/ /kye ma ho nyunyesdig pa can gyi rmi lam de yi 'bras bu grub pa 'di yin no/ /de nas rgyal po dang btsun mo snying rje rje skad du rnam pa mang por smre zhing rgyan thams cad bgrol nas skye bo'i tshogs chen po dang lhan cig tu bu'i rus bu (7la mchod pa byas nas/ gzhon nu'i rus pa rnams rdzu )phyogs 'dir bzhag go/ /kun dga' bo de'i tshe de'i dus na rgyal bu (nyugazhon nu sems can chen po zhes bya bar gyur pa de gzhan zhig yin pa snyam du khyod sems na 'de de ltar mi blta'o(nye/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ nga risananyid 90—137

de'i tshe de'i dus na rgyal bu gzhon nu sems can chen po zhes bya bar gyur to/ /kun dga' bo 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug las yongs su ma grol ba de'i tshe yang / sems can dmyal ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal las ngas 'gro ba mtha' dag la phan btags na4)/ skyon thams cad dang bral te yang dag par rdzogs par lasangs rgyas pa da (gyiltar lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de ltar sems can re re'i phyir yang sems can dmyal ba rnams su bskal par gnas par spro zhing skye bo 'khor ba las rnam par bsgral ④yo/ /sems can gyi snying pos shin tu bya dka' ba rnam pa sna tshogs du (5)mas 'gro ba mtha' dag la phan btags ⑥so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gsungs so/ /byang chub mchog 'di yongs su tshol ba na/ /bskal pa mang po rangs ⑦ni lus btang (8༄ste/ /ji ltar rgyal po dang ni rgyal bur gyur/ /de ltar ngas ni lus rnams yongs su btang / /sngon gyi skye ba rnams ni rjes dran te/ /shing rta chen po zhes bya'i (9)rgyal po byung / /de la bu ni gtong ba che ldan pa/ /sems can che zhes bya ba dam pa yod/ /de la phu bo dag ni gnyis yod de/ /ming ni sgra chen po dang lha chen po/ /dpung 7tshogs de dag nags tshal (1stug por dong / /de dag stag mo bkres pas gzir nyurteb mthong / /de la sems can mchog de snying rje skyes//stag mo 'di ni bkres tu skom gzir 7bas na/ /bdag bu de dag za bar 'gyur 'ong gis/ /de ltar bdag lus da 7ni gtang yibar bya/ /shing rta che 7bu sems can che/ /stag mo bkres mthong stag phrug rnams/ /thar bar bya phyir snying rje yis / /ri ngos gzar nas mchongs tu pa dang / /sa ni ri dang bcas su g.yos16 / /bya tshogs rnam mang rnam par 'thor( bye/ /ri dgas tshogs skrag 90—138

'jig rten 'di/ /mun pas 6)thibs por gnas par gyur/ /de yi phu bo sgra chen dang / /de bzhin lha chen de gnyis kyis/ /nags mchog chen po der bltas na/ /sems can chen po ma rnyed nas/ /shin tu mya ngan zug rngu'i snying / /dran med nags kyi ②nang na rgyu/ /nu bo de ni yongs tshol zhing / /gdong la mchi zag nags ①khrod rgyu/ /sgra chen de bzhin lha chen po/ /rgyal bu gzhon nu de dag gnyis/ /stag mo nyam byachung gar nyal ba/ /der ni nye (5)bar song ba dang //stag mo dang ni stag phrug gi/ /stag gi mchu la khrag yichags mthong / /skra dang rus pa cung zad cig /sa la rnam par 'thor ba stimathong / /de yi khrag gi thigs pa ni/ /nyung zhig sa la yod par gyur/ /rgyal po'i bu ni de gnyis kyis/ /khrag chags pa yi sa de (nyamathong 5)/ /rab tu brgyal 7te sa de la/ /'gyel nas yid ni nyams par gyuranyunye/ /lus rnams la ni rdul gyis gos/ /dran dbang nyams shing sems kyang myos/ /de dag gi ni 'khor rnams kyang / /snying rjer ngu zhing mya ngan non8/ /de dag chus ni rab 'thor zhing / /lag pa sgreng ste yo ngu zhing gnas/ /de ni 'gyel ma thag tu yang / /btsun mo gces mchog skyed pa'i ma / /bud med dag ni lnga brgya dang / /pho brang nang na bder 'dug pa/ /nu sor gnyis ku'i 8rtse mo nas/ /'o ma khrag tu 'byung zhing 'dzag /de yi lus dang yan lag kun/ /khab kyis gtsags skipa bzhin du tsha/ /snying ni rab tu mya ngan gang / /bu bral mya ngan drag mdas phog /rgyal po'i gan du nyer song ste/ /mya ngan rab gdungs yid mi dga'/ /snying rje'i sgra yis rab ngu zhing / /rgyal po shing rta che la smras/ /mi dbang rgyal po bdag la gson/ /bdag lus mya ngan me yis tshig /bdag gi nu 7sor rtse gnyis nas/ /'o ma khrag tu rab tu 'byung / /90—139

bdag lus khab kyis gtsags 6)bzhin tshal/ /bdag gi snying yang gas la thug /ji ltar sdug pa'i bu rnams ni/ /phyin cad mi mthong 'di 'dra'i ltas/ /bdag gi bu rnams de ltar 'tshal/ /thugs rje mdzod de bdag srog stsol/ /de ring bdag gi rmi lam na/ /thi ba phrug gu gsum rnyed na/ /bdag gi thi ba ②phug gu ni / /sdug cing yid 'ong gang lags pa/ /der ni khra mchis bdag gi ni/ /thi ba buphrug gu de khras 'tshal/ /bdag gi rmi lam de 'dra ba'i/ /mya ngan snying 'dir rab tu zhugs/ /sems ni mya ngan rab gdungs pas/ /bdag ni ring por mi thogs 'gum/ /bdag gi bu rnams de ltar 'tshal/ /thugs rje ldan pa dubadag srog stsol/ /de skad smras nas btsun mo mchog /brgyal yinas sa der 'gyel bar gyur/ /dran pa'i dbang po rnam ⑦par nyams/ /sems kyang stor zhing dran pa med/ /btsun mo'i 'khor tshogs thams cad kyang / /snying rje'i skad kyis rab tu ngu / /btsun mo dam pa brgyal gyur te/ /sa la 'gyel ba mthong nas ni/ /de ma thag tu rgyal dbang de/ /bu dang bral ba'i mya ngan non/ /blon po dang ni 'khor rnams kyang / /gzhon nu rnams ni btsal phyir dong / /grong khyer kun gyi skye bo dag /tha dad khyim nas byung zhing 'khod/ /ngu zhing gdong nas mchi ma zag /lam khar sems can che de 'dri/ /gson nam 'on te shi 'am ci/ /sems can chen po de (kyegar song / /bdag cag de ring mthong zhig gam/ /yid 'ong sems can mthong re dga'/ /de'u re mi snyan thos 'gyur zhing / /yul 'dir mya ngan mi bzad rlung / /sgra mi phyin cing sgyu mtha' yas / /drag po'i sgrar bcas ldan 7zhig gam/ /rgyal po shing rta che langs te/ /mya ngan non cing ngu bzhin du/ /btsun mo dam pa sar 'gyel la/ /bdag nyid 90—140

chu yi rgyun kyang 'thor/ /ji srid dran rnyed ldan ①'gyur ba/ /de srid du ni chu yis gtor/ /bdag bu gum mam ②gson zhig ces / /zhum pa'i yid kyis 'dri bar byed/ /rgyal po shing rta chen po yis/ /btsun mo mchog la 'di skad smras / /blon po dag dang 'khor rnams kyang / /gzhon nu rnams ni tshol phyir dong ske/ /khyod ni rab tu yid zhum zhing / /rtag tu mya ngan snying ma byed/ /de ltar shing rta chen po yis/ /btsun mo dam pa spro bsrings te/ /rgyal po lipho brang nas dubyung nas/ /mya ngan non cing ngu dubazhin du/ /blon rtsipo'i tshogs kyis yongs bskor te/ /yid ni rab zhum lus kyang zhanadu/ /srog chags brgya phrag mang po yang / /ngu zhing mchi ma zag bzhin rgyug /rgyal bu rnams ni btsal ba'i phyir / /grong khyer gyi ni mchog nas byung / /rgyal po byung ba mthong nas ni/ /rgyal po'i phyi stibazhin kun tu 'brang / /rgyal po shing rta chen po ni/ /grong khyer nas byung de ma thag /sdug pa'i bu ni blta ba'i phyir/ /rgod ⑩pa'i mig gis phyogs su bltas/ /mgo bregs yan lag khrag sbags shing / /lus la rdul gyis gos gyur la/ /gdong la mchi zag ngu bzhin du/ /'ong ba'i mi zhig mthong nas ni / /shing rta chen po'i snying la yang / /rab tu mi bzad mya ngan gnas/ /ngu zhing gdong la mchi ma zag /lag pa bsgreng ste ngu zhing 'dug /de nas blon po gzhan zhig ni/ /rgyang ring myur du rings ⑩par 'ong / /'ongs nas mi dbang rgyal po ni/ /shing rta che la 'di skad smras/ /mi dbang thugs ngan ma mdzad cig /khyod sras yid du 'ong ba mchis/ /ring por mi thogs khyod kyi gan 'dir ni/ /sras mchog yid 'ong mchi ba khyod 8kyis gzigs/ /rgyal po yud tsam tsolam du zhugs pa dang / /de nas blon po chen po gnyis pa 'ongs/ /rdul 90—141

chags dri ma can gyi gos gyon cing / /mchi ma'i gdong gis rgyal la 'di skad ces / /rgyal po chen po khyod kyi sras gnyis ni/ /mya ngan me yis ①rab tu gdungs shing gnas/ /rgyal po khyod kyi sras mchog gcig mi gda'/ /sems can chen po mi rtag nyid kyis zin/ /stag mo bu byung ring por ma lon pa/ /rang gi bu rnams za bar 'dod pa mthong / /de dag la ni gzhon nu sems can ches / /snying rje chen po ldan pas ②sems bskyed nas/ /byang chub tu ni smon lam che btab pa/ /sems can thams cad bdag gis dgrol bar bya byang chub zab mo rgya chen 'dod pa la/ /ma 'ongs dus na bdag gis reg ①par bya/ /sems can chen po ri ngos ④gzar nas mchongs/ /stag mo bkres pas non pa de langs te/ /yud tsam gyis ni lus la sha med byas/ /rgyal po'i bu ni rus pa nyi tshe lus/ /ma rungs pa yi tshig ni de thos nas/ /rgyal po shing rta chen po brgyal gyur te/ /sa la 'gyel nas sems kyang stor bar gyur/ /mya ngan me ni shin (shetu mi bzad 'bar/ /'khor dang blon po snying rje'i skad kyis ni/ /ngu zhing mya ngan non bzhin de dag kyang / /chus 'thor lag pa bsgreng ste rab tu ngu //blon po gsum pas rgyal la smras pa ni/ /bdag gis de ring gzhon nu gnyis po dag /nags chen de na rab tu brgyal 6)gyur cing / /sa la 'gyel te sems kyang stor mthong nas/ /dran pa rnyed de langs kyi bar du ni/ /bdag cag rnams kyis ri7༄chab kyis rab tu gtor/ /phyogs bzhi dag nas kun nas 'bar bar mthong / /yud tsam 'greng rinasanas slar yang sa la 'gyel/ /snying rje'i skad kyis smre sngags rab tu 'don6nye/ /rtag par lag pa bsgreng ste gnas nas ni/ /nu bo de yi bsngags ⑩pa rab tu brjod/ /rgyal po de ni rab tu sems zhum zhing / /90—142

bu bral mya ngan non nas sems kyang 'khrugs/ /mya ngan rab tu gdungs shing smre sngags 'don①/ /rgyal po de ni 'di snyam yongs su sems/ /bdag bu sdug cing yid 'ong gcig ①po ni/ /sems can chen po mi rtag nyid kyis zin/ /bdag gi bu ni gnyis po de dag kyang / /mya ngan me yis srog ni zad 'ong gis/ /'di ltar bdag ni myur du der dong la/ /mthong na dga' ba'i bu dag blta bar byas ske/ /bzhon 0pa mgyogs pas rgyal po'i pho brang gi/ /rgyal po'i khab tu myur du bkri dubar bya/ /de dag rnams ni bskyed pa'i ma yi snying / /mya ngan me (6)yis gas par 'gyur du 'ong (pe/ /bu gnyis mthong nas zhi ba thob 'gyur te/ /srog dang bral bar 'gyur ba ma yin no/ /rgyal po blon po'i tshogs kyis yongs bskor nas / /glang chen zhon ②te bu rnams blta phyir song / /bu gnyis snying rje'i skad kyis rab ngu zhing / /nu bo'i ming 'bod lam nas 'ong ba mthong / /rgyal pos bu de gnyis ni khrid nas su/ /rab tu ngu zhing khyim du song nas ni/ /de yis skyen ⑨par la gor myur du yang / /btsun mo la ni rang gi bu rnams bstan/ /shākya thub pa de bzhin gshegs pa nga / /sngon gyi rgyal po shing rta chen po yi/ /bu de ⑩sems can chen po mchog gyur cing / /gang gis stag mo bde bar byas 17pa yin / /rgyal po'i dbang po dam pa zas gtsang ni/ /shing rta che zhes bya ba'i rgyal por gyur/ /btsun mo'ang btsun tsho)mo dam pa sgyu mar gyur/ /sgra chen po ni byams par gyur pa yin/ /rgyal bu lha chen po yang de bzhin du/ /de ni 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa yin/ /stag mor gyur pa skye dgu'i bdag mo che/ /stag phrug rnams ni dge slong lnga por gyur/ /de nas rgyal po shing rta chen po dang btsun mos 8snying rje bar smre sngags rnam pa mang po bton chanas/ rgyan thams 90—143

cad bkrol 6)te skye po'i tshogs chen po dang lhan cig tu bu'i rus pa la mchod pa byas nas/ sems can chen po de'i rus pa de dag sa phyogs 'di nyid du bzhag ste / rin po che sna bdun gyi mchod rten 'di byas so/ /sems can chen po 'dis stag mo la lus yongs su btang nas lus yongs su btang ba 'dis phyis ma 'ongs pa'i dus bskal pa bgrang ba las shin tu 'das pa rnams su yang /sems can rnams ②la sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa bya'o/ /zhes smon lam 'di ①skad btab bo/ /bstan pa 'di bshad pa na lha dang mir bcas pa'i skye dgu'i sems can grangs med dpag tu med pa dag /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /mchod rten 'di 'dir bstan pa'i rgyu ni 'di yin no/ /rkyen ni 'di yin no/ /mchod rten de yang sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs ④kyis sa de nyid kyi nang du zhugs so/ /gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po las/ stag mo la lus yongs su btang ba'i le'u zhes bya ba ste bcwa (5)brgyad pa'o// //de nas byang chub sems dpa' brgya stong phrag du ma de dag /de bzhin gshegs pa gser dang rin po che'i 'byung gnas gdugs brtsegs ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa gser dang rin po che'i 'byung gnas gdugs brtsegs kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal yite phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /phyogs gcig tu 'khod nas kyang byang chub sems dpa' brgya stong phrag du ma de dag gis thal mo sbyar te/ de bzhin gshegs pa gser dang rin po che'i 'byung gnas gdugs brtsegs de la tshigs su bcad pa 'di 90—144

dag gis mngon par bstod do/ /rgyal ba'i sku mdog btso hu)ma'i gser 'dra ste/ /sku lus gser gyi mdog tu rnam par gda'/ /gser gyi ri dbang lta bu'i (9gser gyi mdog /thub pa padma dkar po gser mdog can/ /bzang po'i mtshan gyis ①sku lus rab tu brgyan/ /dpe byad sna tshogs bzang pos sku lus spras / /gser gyi 'od ltar mdzes pa rnam par 'bar/ /shin tu dri med zhi ba ri dbang 'dra/ /tshangs pa'i sgra dang sgra snyan tshangs pa'i dbyangs/ /seng ge'i sgra dang 'brug sgra bsgrags pa'i dbyangs/ /yan lag drug cu bsgrags ④sgra dri med sgra / /rgyal dbyangs rma bya ka la ming ma'i sgra/ /shin tu dri med dri bral gzi 'od mdzes / /rgyal ba bsod nams brgya pa'i mtshan gyis brgyan/ /mkhyen pa'i rgya mtsho dri med dri bral mchog /rgyal ba yon tan kun ldan ri rab 'dra/ /sems can rnams la phan par ⑤thugs brtse mchog /'jig rten dag na bde ba (bephyin pa'i dumachog /rgyal ba dam pa'i don rnams ston pa ste/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i bde la 'dzud pa lags/ /'chi ba med pa'i bde ba 46pa ba ste/ /rgyal ba bdud rtsi'i chos ni rab tu ston/ /'chi ba med pa'i grong khyer 'dzud pa ste/ /bde ba kun gyi 'byung gnas bde ba'i gnas/ /rgyal bas (8)'gro ba sdug bsngal thar bar mdzod / /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las ni skye dgu sgrol/ /zhi ba'i lam la skye dgu rab tu 'dzud/ /skye dgu rnams la bde ba kun stsol ba/ /khyod la dpe ni bgyi bar mi nus te/ /ji nyusnyed 'dren pa'i yon tan ye shes mtsho/ /srog chags kun la khyod kyi thugs rje dang / /byams pa'i stobs dang thabs dang brtson 'grus dang //khyod kyi yon tan ye shes rgya mtsho las/ /bskal pa bye ba stong phrag mang por yang //yon tan thigs pa gcig tsam rab bstan par/ /lhar bcas 'gro ba'i nang na 90—145

nus ma mchis/ /yon tan mtsho las yon tan thigs blangs te①/ /de ltar ②bdag gis mdor bsdus cicung zad bshad/ /bdag gis bsod nams gang bsags de yis ni/ /sems can de dag byang chub mchog reg lashog /gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po las/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bstod pa'i le'u zhes bya ba ste bcu dgu pa'o// //de nas byang chub sems dpa' mdzes pa'i tog stan las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar (snyenas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la dubatsugs te/bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su tshuthal mo sbyar ba btud nas tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod do/ /thub dbang khyod ni bsod nams brgya pa'i mtshan/ /dpal stong mdzes pa'i duyon tan rnams kyis brgyan/ /kha dog rgya chen mchog tu zhi ba ston/ /nyi ma stong ltar 'od ni rnam par 'phro/ /'od zer du ma 'bar bas la'od kyis khyab/ /kha dog sna tshogs dang yibs rin chen 'dra/ /sngon po dkar po gser 'od bee ḍūrya/ /zangs dang skya rengs (geshel gyi 'od lta bus(nye/ /rdo rje ri dbang ri rab thal mdzad cing / /zhing rnams bye ba du mar snang mdzad de/ /sdug bsngal mi bzad drag po zhi bar mdzad/ /bde ba mchog gis sems can tshim par mdzad/ /mdog dang dbang po gsal bag tu blta na mdzes/ /gzugs bltas mi ngoms skye bos blta na dga'/ /rma bya'i mdog 'dra'i yidabu skra rnam par mdzes/ /bung ba mang pos gang ba'i 'od dang 'dra/ /thugs rje rnam dag yon tan rnams 8kyis brgyanam/ /ting 'dzin byams pa bsod nams yidam pa bsags/ /dpe 0byad 90—146

bzangadang kha dog sna tshogs ldan/ /ting 'dzin byang chub yan lag yon tan brgyan / /khyod ni rab tu tshim mdzad phan pa mdzad/ /bde mdzad bde ba kun gyi ①'byung gnas 'byung / /yon tan zab mo sna tshogs rnams kyis brgyan/ /zhing rnams bye ba dag du lhang ②nge ste/ /me yi 'od ltar 'od zer rnams ( kyikyis mdzes / /ji ltar nam mkhar nyi dudakyil rdzogs pa bzhin/ /ri rab lta bur yon tan kun ldan par/ /'jig rten khams rnams kun tu rab tu gda'/ /ba zho ku mu da dung zla 'dra zhing / /kha ba'i mdog dang dkar po bzang 'dra ba'i / /tshems ⑤kyi phreng ⑥bas khyod kyi zhal mdzes pa/ /ngang pa'i rgyal po ⑦bar snang ji bzhin no/ /khyod kyi zhi zhal mtshams nas ⑧za ba 'dra/ /g.yas su 'khyil zhing khong chud 'dra ba lags/ /bee ḍūrya 'dra'i spu 'od dkar rnams kyis / /nam mkha'i dkyil na nyi ma lta bur mdzes/ /gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i ①rgyal po las/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la bstod pa'i le'u zhes bya ba ste nyi shu pa'o// //de nas rigs kyi lha mo byang chub yang dag par bsdus pas/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis bcom ldan 'das la bstod pa/ rnam ⑩par dag pa'i chos la spobs ⑩pa'i blo mnga' ba/ /las ngan lam dang bral ba'i bdag nyid blo mnga' zhing / /srid dang srid min mkhyen pa rnam dag blo mnga' ba sangs rgyas rnam dag blo mnga' ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kye ma'o kye ma'o sangs rgyas gzi brjid mtha' yas te/ /kye ma'o kye ma'o rgya mtsho (nyedang ni ri rab 'dra/ /kye ma'o kye ma'o sangs rgyas spyod yul mtha' yas te/ /u dum bā (gera'i me tog bzhin du 90—147

dang / /klu'i rgyal po chu skyes dang / klu'i rgyal po stag re dang / klu'i rgyal po lag bzang dang / klu'i rgyal po ri rab dang / klu'i rgyal po nyi 'od dang /klu'i rgyal po zla 'od dang / klu'i rgyal po bzang sdug dang / klu'i rgyal po ngar ba dang / klu'i rgyal po hu)'brug sgrogs ②dang / klu'i rgyal po glog 'byin dang /klu'i rgyal po rgyas byed dang / klu'i rgyal po char 'bebs dang / klu'i rgyal po dri med dang / klu'i rgyal po stobs chen mgo dang / klu'i rgyal po lcang lo can gyi mgo dang / klu'i rgyal po rta ①mgo dang / klu'i rgyal po bal glang ④mgo dang /klu'i rgyal po ri dgas mgo dang / klu'i rgyal po glang po che'i mgo dang / klu'i rgyal po rlan ⑤stobs can dang / klu'i rgyal po skye bo 'tshe dang / klu'i rgyal po ris bkra dang / klu'i rgyal po mig bkra dang /6) klu'i rgyal po sna tshogs sde dang / klu'i rgyal po mi gtong ba dang / klu'i rgyal po gtong po dang /⑨ klu'i rgyal po btang (nyabazung dang / klu'i rgyal po sgra sgrogs kyi po)bu dang / klu'i rgyal po rtogs ⑩pa'i bu dang / klu'i rgyal po dpal dang / klu'i rgyal po dpal can dang / klu'i rgyal po 'phyang ⑩ba dang / klu'i rgyal po srin tunyebu dang / klu'i rgyal po mtha' yas dang / klu'i rgyal po gser dang / klu'i rgyal po ()glang po'i rtsal ④dang / klu'i rgyal po dkar gsal dang / klu'i rgyal po ser skya 8dang / klu'i rgyal po e la'i 'dab dang / klu'i rgyal po dkar po dang / klu'i rgyal po dung dang / klu'i rgyal po sog ma med dang / klu'i rgyal po nag po dang / klu'i rgyal po nye gnag yidang / klu'i rgyal po stobs lha dang / klu'i rgyal po srid med kyi bu dang / klu'i rgyal po la ba dang / klu'i rgyal po skrag byed dang / klu'i rgyal po ⑩srin po dang / klu'i rgyal po brag lag dang / klu'i rgyal po gang gā yonyedang /90—302

klu'i rgyal po mi'i bla ma dang /6) klu'i rgyal po glang po che dang / klu'i rgyal po mi ma yin pa dang / klu'i rgyal po gzings dang / klu'i rgyal po mchog dang /klu'i rgyal po ba lu ka dang / klu'i rgyal po a lu ka dang / klu'i rgyal po hu phyilu dang / klu'i rgyal po e la can gdang / klu'i rgyal po e la'i lo ma dang / klu'i rgyal po 'gro sgra dang / klu'i rgyal po 'chi sgra dang / klu'i rgyal po gzi can dang /klu'i rgyal po stobs kyi rgyu dang / klu'i rgyal po ser skya dang / klu'i rgyal po zhi ba 'dzin dang / klu'i rgyal po me tog utpal dang / klu'i rgyal po sen mo can dang /klu'i rgyal po 'phel ba dang / klu'i rgyal po thar pa dang / klu'i rgyal po blo can dang / klu'i rgyal po rab thar dang / klu'i rgyal po la 4)ba dang / klu'i rgyal po mgyogs rab dga' (5nyedang / klu'i rgyal po e la dang / 'dus pa dag dang /klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang / nye dga' bo dag (zhedang / klu'i rgyal po gsal ba can dang / klu'i rgyal po blta mdzes chen po dang / klu'i rgyal po mchog can dang / klu'i rgyal po mchog ldan grog ma dang / klu'i rgyal po bzhin bzang ⑦dang / klu'i rgyal po me long gdong can (8)dang / klu'i rgyal po sa 'dzin dang /klu'i rgyal po seng ge 'dzin dang / klu'i rgyal po 'gro lding dang / klu'i rgyal po nag po gnyis dang / klu'i rgyal po dkar po gnyis dang / klu'i rgyal po nye dkar gnyis dang / klu'i rgyal po de dag dang / gzhan yang gang dag sa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir dus dus su 'brug sgrogs tsapa/ dus dus su glog 'byin pa / dus dus su tu )char 'bebs pa/ dus dus su lo tog bsgrub (nyapa/ sangs rgyas mthong ba/ bslab pa'i gzhi bzung (snyeb/ gsum la skyabs su dong ba/nam mkha' lding gi 'jigs pa dang / me dang bye /snyema'i 'jigs pa dang / rgyal 90—304

po'i las kyi 'jigs pa las thar ba/ sa 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i gzhal med khang chen po na gnas pa/ tshe ring ba bskal par gnas pa/ dbang che bar grags pa/ rdzu 'phrul che ba/ longs spyod che ba/ 'khor phal che ba/ dgra'i dpung rab tu 'joms pa/ rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa/ 'od dang ldan pa/ kha dog dang ldan pa/ grags ①pa dang ldan pa/ rdzu 'phrul che ba/ lha dang lha ma yin gyi g.yul dag kyang myong bar byed pa dag ste/ klu'i rgyal po bu dang bcas pa/tsha bo dang bcas pa/ spun dang bcas pa/ blon po dang bcas pa/ sde dpon dang bcas pa/ pho nya dang bcas pa/ mngag ②pa dang bcas pa/ g.yog dang bcas pa/ 'khor dang bcas pa/ de dag gis kyang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'dis bdag la bsrung chab gyis shig④ /lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig /ston brgya mthong bar shog shig⑤ /gtsang sbra ma byas pa dang / gtsang sbra byas pa dang / myos pa dang / rab tu myos pa dang / 'gro ba dang 'greng ba dang /'dug pa dang / nyal ba dang / mi nyal ba dang / 'ongs pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dge bar gyur cig /rgyal po'i 'jigs pa dang / chom rkun gyi 'jigs ⑥pa dang / me'i 'jigs pa dang / chu'i 'jigs pa dang / mi mdza' ba'i 4)'jigs pa dang / gsod pa'i (kye'ajigs pa dang / phyir rgol ba dang / dgra'i 'jigs pa dang / 'joms pa'i 'jigs pa dang / pha rol gyi dgra'i 0tshogs kyi kyi'ajigs pa dang / mu ge'i 'jigs pa dang / dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa dang / sa g.yo ba'i 7'jigs pa dang / gcan gzan 8khro bo'i 'jigs pa las bdag bde legs su gyur cig /lha'i 'jigs pa dang / klu'i 'jigs pa dang / lha ma yin gyi 'jigs pa dang / rlung lha'i 90—305

'jigs pa dang / nam mkha' lding gi 'jigs pa dang / dri za'i 'jigs pa dang ske/ mi 'am ci'i 'jigs pa dang / lto 'phye chen po'i 'jigs pa dang /gnod sbyin gyi 'jigs pa dang / srin po'i 'jigs pa dang / yi dgas kyi 'jigs pa dang / sha za'i 'jigs pa dang / 'byung po'i 'jigs pa dang /grul bum gyi 'jigs pa dang / srul po'i 'jigs pa dang / lus srul po'i 'jigs pa dang / skem 6)byed kyi 'jigs pa dang / smyo byed kyi 'jigs pa dang / grib gnon gyi 'jigs pa dang / brjed ②byed kyi 'jigs pa dang /gnon po'i 'jigs pa las bdag bde legs su gyur cig /gshed byed dang /sgyur (miba'i las dang / byad dang / g.yengs dubyed dang / ro langs dang /sems sgyur (geb dang / sbod gtong rjodang / bza' gnyes dang / skyug nyes dang / gnod sgrib dang / gnod bltas dudang / bri nyes dang / bsgom ⑨nyes dang / smad pa'i 'jigs pa las bdag bde legs su gyur cig /shu ba dang / g.ya' ba dang / mdze dang / 'brum bu phra mo dang / phol mig dang /g.yan pa dang / me dbal dang / lhog pa'i 'jigs pa las bdag bde legs su gyur cig /mtshan mo bde legs nyin bde legs/ /nyi ma'i gung gi bde legs dang / /nyin mtshan kun gyi ⑩bde legs dag(te /sangs rgyas kun gyis ⑫bdag la stsol(ste/ /sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal byang chub phyag 'tshal lo/ /grol gyur phyag 'tshal grol la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhi gyur phyag 'tshal zhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam grol phyag 'tshal grol la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bram ze gang dag sdig pa'i chos rnams bsal bar gyur pa de dag la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /de dag gis kyang bdag la bsrung 8ba dang / bskyab pa gyis ⑩shig swā hā/ kun dga' bo rig 90—306

yongs su bskyab pa dang / yongs su gzung ①ba dang / yongs su bskyang ba dang —/ zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ba dang / chad pa spang ba dang /mtshon cha spang ba dang / dug gzhil ba dang / dug gsad ②pa dang /mtshams gcad ②pa dang / sa bcing ba gyis shig /lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig /ston brgya mthong bar shog shigadu /kun dga' bo rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' byams pas bshad cing rjes su yi durang ba'o / /tabya thā/ shi ri shi ri dushi rig/ bha drel/ byo ti byo ti 'byo ti bha dre/ha re ha re ha re/ hā 0ri ṇi/ darnyi/ sha ba re/ shi be/ shu la pā 0ṇi ni/bo dhi bo dhi/ bo dhi bo dhi/ be dhi be dhi/8 sa 8te bo dhi/ pa ri tsā ra ni ye ⑫swā hā/ kun dga' bo rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'di ni mi mjed ⑩kyi bdag po tshangs pas smras shing rjes su yi ⑩rang ba'o/ /tarya thā/ hi li hi li/mi li mi li/ mi ⑩li ni/ rtsa tsoka ri/ ki ri ki ri ki ri ki ri ki ri ki ri ki ra yeñtsa / bra rmā ye/ ratna ④ka raṇḍa ke/ be ḍo 0hu phumatshu/ dha ra dha ra/ sa ra sa ra/0 ha ra ha ra/ ha la ha la/0 phu ru phu ru/ phu ru phu ru phu ru phu ru tsoswā hā/ dug bcom mo/ /dug nges par bcom mo/ /sangs rgyas kyi gzi brjid kyis tsodug nges par bcom mo/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi gzi brjid kyis dug bcom mo / /dgra bcom pa'i gzi brjid kyis dug bcom mo/ /phyir mi 'ong ba'i gzi brjid kyis dug bcom mo/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i gzi brjid kyis dug bcom mo / /rgyun du zhugs pa'i gzi brjid kyis 0dug bcom mo/ /bden par smra (nyeba'i gzi brjid ⑦kyis dug bcom mo/ /tshangs pa'i me dbal gyi zhugazi brjid kyis dug bcom mo/ /dbang po ⑥rdo rje'i gzi brjid kyis dug bcom mo/ /khyab 90—309

'jug gi ①'khor los dug bcom mo/ /gshin rje'i be con gyis ②dug bcom mo / /chu lha'i zhags pas dug bcom mo/ /lha ma yin gyi sgyus dug bcom mo/ /klu'i rig sngags kyis ①dug bcom mo/ /drag po'i mdung rtses dudug bcom mo/ /skem byed kyi dumadung thung gis dug bcom mo/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mos dug bcom mo/ /dug nges par bcom mo/ /dug sa'i nang du song shigadu /bdag dug thams cad dang / be'u lta bu'i dug dang / ha la ha la'i dug dang /nag po brtsegs ⑦pa'i dug dang / mche ba'i dug dang / rtsa ba'i dug dang /kha zas kyi dug dang / phye ma'i dug dang / lta ba'i dug dang / glog gi dug dang ske/ sprin gyi dug dang / sbrul dang / byi ba dang / srin bu ki ta dang /lu ta dang / ka na bha ba dudang / sbal pa dang / sbrang bu dang / bung ba dang / ba ta ri dang / tre ma bu ga dang / tree la ta'i dug dang / mi'i dug dang / sdig pa'i dug dang / mi ma yin pa'i dug dang / dogs pa'i dug dang / sman gyi ①dug dang / rig sngags kyi dug las bde legs su gyur cig /dug thams cad las bdag bde legs su gyur cig /kun dga' bo rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'di ni lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis smras shing rjes su yi rang ba'o⑩/ /tarya thā/ dza lā/ dzantu le mā lā0/ dzantu le/ tsa pe ṭi/dzantu le/ ma tha 6)ni/ gha tunyeta ni/ gra sa ni/ ha ri shi 8ri/ hu titi shi ri/ta ru ta ru ṇa ba ti/ ha ha ha ha ha/ sing te/ dhi ti dhi ti/ skyaku ru ku ru /bas tsore badzre/ tu ṭa tu ṭa situ)/ ba ṭa ba ṭa si( )/ si li si li/ ka pi li/ka pi li/ mū 9 7le/ hā zho nyegli hū/ sdang ba dang / rab tu snang ba thams cad rab tu rmugs par bya'o/ /lag 0pa dang / rkang pa dang / yan lag dang /90wa 310

nying lag dang / sum cu 6)pa'i lha dang bcas te chad pas gcad ②par bya'o/ /uṣṭi gi ni/ su ra pa te / brti/ badzra badzra badzra badzra badzra pa ta ye swā hā/kun dga' bo rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'di ni rgyal po chen po bzhis smras shing rjes su yi rang ba'o/ /tarya thā/ dzwa la dzwa la na④/ ta pa ta pa na/ ma tha ma tha na/tso dha ma dha ma na/ sa ra sa ra ṇa/ ki ṭi ki ṭisti/ ku ṭi ku ṭi/mu ṭi mu ṭi/ mi ṭi mi dhiṭi/ pi ṭi pi ṭi/du sa ra sa ra/ ma ra ma ra ha ra ha ra/ ta ra ta ra/ ti ri ti ri/ ṭā ṭā ṭā ṭā tākhya/ dā dā dā dā dā/ bā bā bā bā bā/ ha la ha la ha la ha la ha la/ sirnyi/ sidhi/ sidhi/ siddhi/sidhikyi / swa sti/ swa ste/ swa sti/ swa ste/ swa sti/ sbod gtong yidang /gshin rje'i 8lo nya dang / mtshan mo nag mo dang / dus kyi zhags pa dang /'chi bdag gi 'chad pa dang / tshangs pa'i chad pa dang / dbang po'i chad pa dang —/ drang srong gi chad pa dang / lha'i chad pa dang / klu'i chad pa dang /lha ma yin gyi chad pa dang / rlung lha'i chad pa dang / nam mkha' lding gi chad pa dang / dri za'i chad pa dang / mi 'am ci'i chad pa dang / sto 'phye tsochen po'i chad pa dang / gnod sbyin gyi 8chad pa dang / srin po'i chad pa dang /yi dgas kyi chad pa dang / sha za'i chad pa dang / 'byung po'i chad pa dang /grul bum gyi chad pa dang / srul po'i chad pa dang / lus srul 8po'i chad pa dang ske/ skem byed kyi chad pa dang / smyo byed kyi chad pa dang / grib gnon gyi chad pa dang / brjed byed kyi chad pa dang / gnon po'i chad pa dang / ro langs kyi chad pa dang / rgyal po'i chad pa dang / chom rkun gyi chad pa dang /me'i chad pa dang / chu'i chad pa dang / chad pa thams cad las bdag la 90—311

bsrung ①ba gyis shig /lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig /ston brgya mthong bar shog shig② /kun dga' bo khyod kyis klung gi rgyal po rnams kyi ming zung ①shig /'di lta ste/ klung gi rgyal po gang gā ④dang / klung gi rgyal po sin ཿdhu dang /klung gi rgyal po pakṣa khyedang / klung gi rgyal po sī ta ⑦dang / klung gi rgyal po mda' 'byung dang / klung gi rgyal po khyim ldan dang / klung gi rgyal po gshin rje sel dang / klung gi rgyal po gya gyu ⑧dang / klung gi rgyal po rgyas 'bab dang /klung gi rgyal po zhags 0bral dang / klung gi rgyal po zhi ba 'dzin dang / klung gi rgyal po sa ldan dang / klung gi rgyal po zla ba'i cha dang / klung gi rgyal po dbyangs can dang / klung gi rgyal po rus 7sbal can dang / klung gi rgyal po chu dron can dang / klung gi rgyal po chu mchog can dang / klung gi rgyal po zangs yi'adab dang / klung gi rgyal po sbrang rtsi can dang / klung gi rgyal po spa ldan dang /klung gi rgyal po bu ram shing ldan tsodang / klung gi rgyal po ba lang tsoldan dang /klung gi rgyal po 'phags pa can dang / klung gi rgyal po rtse sbyin dang / klung gi rgyal po mdza' bzang dang / klung gi rgyal po kun gyi ④bshes dang / klung gi rgyal po 'chi med dang / klung 8gi rgyal po me tog padma dang / klung gi rgyal po rnga ⑩len dang / klung gi rgyal po dngos bzang dang / klung gi rgyal po rab bzang ⑩dang ske/ klung gi rgyal po dka' thub sbyin dang / klung gi rgyal po dri bral dang /klung gi rgyal po skyon bral dang / klung gi rgyal po klung chen dang / klung gi rgyal po gser ldan dang / klung gi rgyal po ba lang sbyin mchog can tsodang / klung gi rgyal po gsang srung dang / klung gi rgyal po ba lang can dang / de dag dang gzhan yang gang dag sa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir 'bab pa'i chu klung de dag thams 90—312

cad la gang dag rgyun du gnas pa dang ①/ gzugs tha dad pa/ gzugs mi sdug pa/ gzugs mang ba/ gzugs mtha' yas pa/ 'dod dgur sgyur ②ba'i gzugs canag/ gzugs sna tshogs pa'i lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang /lha ma yin rnams dang / rlung lha rnams dang / nam mkha' lding 0rnams dang /dri za rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams dang / mi'am ci rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / srin po rnams dang / yi dgas rnams dang / sha za rnams dang / 'byung po rnams dang / grul bum rnams dang / srul po rnams dang / lus srul po rnams dang / skem dubyed rnams dang / smyo byed rnams dang / grib gnon rnams dang / brjed byed rnams dang / gnon po rnams dang / zas su mdangs za ba rnams dang / zas su mngal za ba rnams dang ske/ zas su khrag 'thung yib rnams dang / zas su sha za ba rnams dang /zas su tshil za ba rnams dang / zas su zhag za ba rnams dang / zas su rkang za ba rnams dang / zas su btsas pa za ba rnams dang / zas su srog 'phrog mepa rnams dang / zas su gtor ma za ba rnams dang / zas su phreng ba za ba rnams dang / zas su 'bras bu za ba rnams dang / zas su me tog za ba rnams dang ske/ zas su dri za ba rnams dang / zas su bdug ⑧pa za ba rnams dang /zas su lo tog za ba rnams dang / zas su sbyin sreg za ba rnams dang / zas su rnag 'thung ba rnams dang / zas ⑨su phyi sa za ba rnams dang / zas su gcin 'thung ba rnams dang / zas su mchil ⑩ma za ba rnams dang / zas su ngar snabs za ba rnams dang / zas su snabs za ba rnams dang / zas su lhag ma za ba rnams dang / zas su skyugs ⑩pa za ba rnams dang / zas su mi gtsang 90—313

ba za ba 0)rnams dang / zas su stor ②khung nas 'bab pa 'thung ba de dag gis kyang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'dis bdag la bsrung ba ①gyis shig /lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig /ston brgya mthong bar shog shig④ /kun dga' bo khyod kyis ⑤ri'i rgyal po rnams kyi ⑥ming zung ④shig /'di lta ste/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab dang / ri'i rgyal po gangs can dang / ri'i rgyal po spos kyi ngad ldan ⑧dang / ri'i rgyal po rtse brgya pa dang / ri'i rgyal po seng ldeng can dang / ri'i rgyal po gser logs dang / ri'i rgyal po 'od 'dzin dang / ri'i rgyal po mu khyud 'dzin dang / ri'i rgyal po khor yug dang / ri'i rgyal po khor yug chen po dang / ri'i rgyal po dbang po'i brag dang / ri'i rgyal po tshangs pa ldan dang /⑨ri'i rgyal po dpal ldan dang / ri'i rgyal po blta na sdug dang / ri'i rgyal po shin tu rgyas yidang / ri'i rgyal po rin chen 'byung gnas dang / ri'i rgyal po srin bu can dang / ri'i rgyal po nor bu rdza dang / ri'i rgyal po thags bzangs ⑩ris dang / ri'i rgyal po rdo rje 'byung gnas dang / ri'i rgyal po 'gram pa ldan dang ske/ ri'i rgyal po lha min 'bab dang / ri'i rgyal po glog 'od dang / ri'i rgyal po khyab gnas dang / ri'i rgyal po zla 'od dang / ri'i rgyal po brag bzang dang / ri'i rgyal po nyi ma mdzes dang / ri'i rgyal po thigs pa dang / ri'i rgyal po 'bigs byed dang / ri'i rgyal po zla ba'i brag dang / ri'i rgyal po sna tshogs 'bartsegs dang / ri'i rgyal po ma la ya dang / ri'i rgyal po gser gyi rtse mo dang / ri'i rgyal po kun nas 'gro dang / ri'i rgyal po lag bzang tsodang /ri'i rgyal po nor bu ldan dang / ri'i rgyal po sde bzang dang / ri'i rgyal po tshangs pa'i mchu yidang / ri'i rgyal po rig byed srung tsodang / ri'i rgyal po ba 90—314

lang rna dang / ri'i rgyal po sna tshogs phreng dang / ri'i rgyal po mi 'jigs sna tshogs dang / ri'i rgyal po ral gri dang / ri'i rgyal po gdung ba dang / ri'i rgyal po mig bsku ①dang / ri'i rgyal po muñdza ②dang / ri'i rgyal po ri dgas can dang / ri'i rgyal po 'joms byed dang / ri'i rgyal po ti se dudang / ri'i rgyal po mi mjed dang / ri'i rgyal po nye dkar dang / ri'i rgyal po tsandan phreng dang / ri'i rgyal po stobs 'dzin dang / ri'i rgyal po dbang chen dang /ri'i rgyal po dus 'bri byabyed dang / ri'i rgyal po skem byed phyidang / ri'i rgyal po ba lang sung yidang / ri'i rgyal po bya rog sgra can ⑦dang / ri'i rgyal po bstan pa 'dzin dang / sa'i dkyil 'khor 'di na duri'i rgya po 'di ⑨dag dang / gzhan ⑩dag kyang yod pa de la lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang ske/ rlung lha rnams dang / nam mkha' lding rnams dang / dri za rnams dang ske/ mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / srin po rnams dang / yi dgas rnams dang / sha za rnams dang / 'byung po rnams dang / grul bum rnams dang / srul po rnams dang /lus srul yipo rnams dang / skem byed rnams tsodang / smyo byed rnams dang /grib gnon rnams dang / brjed byed rnams dang / gnon po rnams dang /rig sngags 'chang grub pa rnams dang / rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa gang dag rgyun du gnas pa de dag gis kyang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'dis bdag la bsrung 8ba gyis shig /lo brgya 8'tsho bar gyur cig /ston brgya mthong bar shog shigatso /sdig pa thams cad sol cig /dge ba rnams snang bar gyur cig /mi dge ba skyesol cig /don rnams la snang bar gyis ⑩shig /gnod pa 90—315

rnams sol cig /mtshan mo bde legs nyin bde legs/ /nyi tsho1)ma'i gung gi bde legs dang / /nyin mtshan kun gyi bde legs dag /sangs rgyas kun gyis bdag la 455 swā hā/ kun dga' bo khyod kyis ②rgyu skar gang dag nam mkha' la rgyu zhing snang bar byed pa (kyernams kyi ming zung ④shig /'di lta ste/ smin drug dang ni snar ma dang / /mgo dang lag dang nab ⑤so dang / /rgyal ni bkra shis phun sum tshogs/ /de bzhin skag ste bdun po yiyin/ /de ltar rgyu ⑦skar bdun po 'di dag ni shar gyi sgo na gnas pa dag ste/ gang dag shar phyogs srung duzhing yongs su skyong bar byed pa dag go/ /de dag gis kyang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'dis phyorabadag la bsrung ba 7gyis shig /lo brgya ⑩'tsho bar gyur cig /ston brgya yonamathong bar shog shigayonye /mchu ni mi mdza' ④'joms pa dang / /de bzhin gre dang dbo gnyis dang / /me bzhi nag pa sa ri dang / /sa ga ste ⑩ni bdun pa yin/ /de ltar rgyu 'askar bdun po 'di dag ni/ lho phyogs kyi sgo na gnas pa dag ste/ gang dag lho phyogs srung tunyezhing yongs su skyong bar byed pa dag go/ /de dag gis hunyekyang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'dis yibadag la bsrung ( )ba gyis 87shig /lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig /ston brgya 6)mthong bar shog shig2ge /lha mtshams ni )gzi brjid 32chen mo dang / /de bzhin ston dang snrubs cigadang ni/ /chu stod dang ni chu smad dang / /de ltar byi bzhin 6)gro bzhin tsono / /de ltar rgyu tsho 6skar bdun po 'di dag ni nub phyogs kyi sgo na gnas pa dag ste / gang dag nub phyogs srung ( cizhing yongs su skyong bar byed pa dag go/ /de dag gis kyang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'dis bdag la bsrung (1ba gyis (nyeshig /lo brgya 'tsho lhabar gyur cig /ston brgya mthong bar shog shigatso /mon 90—316

gru dang ni mon gre dang / /de bzhin khrums stod khrums 6)smad dang / /nam gru dang ni tha skar dang / /bra nye ste ②ni bdun pa yin/ /de ltar rgyu skar bdun po 'di dag ni byang gi ③phyogs na gnas pa dag ste/ /gang dag byang phyogs srung (rwazhing yongs su skyong bar byed pa dag go/ /de dag gis kyang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'dis bdag la bsrung (nyab gyis 6)shig /lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig /ston brgya mthong bar shog shig⑦ /kun dga' bo khyod kyis gza' gang dag rgyu skar rnams kyi khrod na rgyu zhing 'grib pa dang / 'phel ba dang / bde ba dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / lo legs pa dang / lo nyes pa dag kyang ston (8)pa rnams kyi ming zung 0shig /'di lta ste/ gza' nyi ma dang / gza' zla ba dang ske/ gza' phur bu dang / gza' pa bsangs yidang / gza' spen pa dang /gza' mig dmar dang / gza' gza' hu)lhag turnyedang / gza' lha min dbang po sgra gcan 'dang / gza' du ba mjug rings so8/ /rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad ni / /de ltar phyogs na bdun tsobadun no/ /skar ma gza' bdun de bzhin te/ /rdzu 'phrul che zhing dka' thub che/ /nyi ma dang ni zla ba dang / /sum cu 8rtsa bdun tshang ba dag /'char ba dang ni nub pa ni⑩/ /'khor lo mtshon cha bzhin du rgyu/ /'jig rten du ni zad 'phel byed/ /gzi che rdzu 'phrul chen po dag /rab tu dang ba'i sems kyis su/ /rig tunyesngags rjes su yi rang byosayi/ /de dag gis kyang rig 0sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'dis bdag la bsrung ⑥ba gyis shig /lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig /ston brgya mthong bar shog shig(nye /kun dga' bo drang srong rnying pa brtul (nyazhugs grub pa/ rig sngags grub pa/ grags pa 'bar ba④/ klung dang ri la gnas pa/ dmod pa'i mtshon cha can/ dka' 90—317

thub grags 3pa/ rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa/ mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan pa/nam mkha' la 'gro ba de dag gi ming brjod kyis 0khyod kyis zung ⑧shig /'di lta ste / drang srong chen po brgyad rigapa zhes bya ba dang / drang srong chen po g.yon phyogs pa zhes bya ba dang / drang (9srong chen po g.yon phyogs lha zhes bya ba dang /drang srong chen po lha skyabs kyi bu zhes bya ba dang / drang srong chen po 'od zer can zhes bya ba dang / drang srong chen po kun gyi bshes zhes bya ba dang / drang srong chen po gnas 'jog ces bya ba dang / drang srong chen po grog mkhar ba zhes bya ba dang / drang srong chen po 'drob 7skyong gi bu zhes bya ba dang / drang srong chen po 'drob (7skyong gi bu rgan po zhes bya ba dang / drang srong chen po ngan spong zhes bya ba dang / drang srong chen po ngan spong dga' zhes bya ba dang / drang srong chen po 'gro 'dzin ces bya ba dang / drang srong chen po 'gro dga' zhes bya ba dang ske/ drang srong chen po 'jigs ⑧can zhes bya ba dang / drang srong chen po skal ldan shing rta zhes bya ba dang / drang srong chen po rgyun shes kyi bu zhes bya ba dang / drang srong chen po mdun du bdar zhes 6)bya ba yidang / drang srong chen po mgo bo che zhes bya ba (skyedang / drang srong chen po gshin rje'i me zhes bya ba tsodang /drang srong chen po gnyis 'thung gi bu zhes bya ba dang / drang srong chen po gnyis 'thung nag po'i bu zhes bya ba dang / drang srong chen po ljang sngo'i bu zhes bya ba dang / drang srong chen po ljang sngo'i tsha bo nyustezhes bya ba dang / drang srong chen po ngag mnyam zhes bya ba dang / drang srong chen po 'phags po zhes bya ba dang /drang srong chen po yang dag 'phags po zhes bya ba dang / drang srong chen po bzod pa smra zhes bya ba dang / drang srong chen po grags pa zhes bya ba dang / drang srong 90—318

chen po rab grags zhes bya ba dang / drang srong chen po bla ma zhes bya ba dang /drang srong chen po grub pa zhes bya ba dang / drang srong chen po gru 517'dzin ces bya ba dang / drang srong chen po rta bu zhes bya ba dang / drang srong chen po gangs (mican zhes bya ba dang / drang srong chen po mig dmar zhes bya ba dang / drang srong chen po cha byad 'dzin zhes ②bya ba dang / drang srong chen po gos ngan zhes bya ba dang —/ drang srong chen po mda' ltar snang ba zhes bya ba dang / drang srong chen po rgyags pa zhes bya ba dang / drang srong chen po 'od ces bya ba dang / drang srong chen po pa ba sangs zhes ④bya ba dang / drang srong chen po phur bu zhes bya ba dang /drang srong chen po rtsibs kyi mu khyud ces bya ba dang / drang srong chen po spen pa zhes bya ba dang / drang srong chen po gza' lhag ces (5)bya ba dang / drang srong chen po dug sel zhes bya ba dang / drang srong chen po sa 'dzin zhes bya ba dang /drang srong chen po rwa gcig pa zhes bya ba dang / drang srong chen po drang srong rwa (6)zhes bya ba dang / drang srong chen po gyur mid (7)kyi bu zhes bya ba dang / drang srong chen po gar ldan gyi bu zhes bya ba dang / drang srong chen po sgra'i bu zhes bya ba dang /drang srong chen po 'jigs byed ces bya ba dang / drang srong chen po 'jigs byed glang po zhes bya ba dang / drang srong chen po ser skya zhes bya ba dang / drang srong chen po gi phyin ma zhes bya ba dang / drang srong chen po rta dmar zhes bya ba dang /drang srong chen po gyis pa rtse zhes bya ba dang / drang srong chen po mis byin gyi bu zhes 6)bya ba dang / drang srong chen po ri bo zhes bya ba dang / drang srong chen po srin bu 'dzin ces bya ba yiste/ kun dga' bo drang srong chen po rnying pa 'di dag ni rig 7byed rnams byed pa/ gsang sngags rnams byed pa/ dmod pa 12'dor 90—319

ba / brtul hu)zhugs grub pa/ gzi brjid che ba grub pa/ pha rol gnon pa grub pa dag ste/ de dag gis kyang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'dis ②bdag la bsrung ①ba gyis shig /lo brgya 'tsho ④bar gyur cig⑤ /ston brgya mthong 6)bar shog shig⑦ /tarya thā/ hi ri hi ri/ khi ri khi ri/ mi ri mi ri/phu ri phu ri/ su ri su ri/ hi li hi li/ mi li mi li/ si ri si ri/ ḍabyudu/ḍabyul / ḍa ḍabyuti/ gra sa ni/ ma tha yini/ da ma ni/ da ha ni/ ghā ta ni/pa 8tsa ni/ pā 8tsa ni/ ta pa ni/ tā ④pa ni/ ha na ni/ da ha ni/ dā ha ⑩ni/ da hā da hā da hāX/ da la da la tunyenā la ni/ pā 8ṭa ni mo ha yini/stambha ni/ dzambha ni/ swa yasbru gu swā hā/ kun dga' bo khyod kyis skye dgu'i tshubadag po chen po gang dag lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / rlung lha rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang / nam mkha' lding rnams dang / dri za rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye 'chen po rnams dang / gnod 0sbyin rnams dang / srin po rnams dang / mi dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas pa rdzidang /sems can dmyal ba rnams kyi dge ba dang / mi dge ba la sogs pa'i dge ba'i khyad par grangs med (nyepa dag gis 'jig rten gsum du rnam par gzhag ⑩pa rnams kyi ming zung 4)shig /'di lta ste/ skye dgu'i 32bdag po tshangs pa dang /skye dgu'i zhu)bdag po bu can dang / skye dgu'i ( — )bdag po za tshul gyi bu dang /skye dgu'i (nyabadag po me dang / skye dgu'i bdag po gso ba dang /du skye dgu'i ⑫bdag po mdun du bdar dang / skye dgu'i 6nabadag po spu zing sel dang / skye dgu'i (gebadag po go byed dang / skye dgu'i (nyabadag po mdzes gnas dang / skye dgu'i ( nabadag po zin po dang / skye dgu'i (stebadag po lus mdzes dang / skye 90wa 320

dgu'i ①bdag po rab dga' dang / skye dgu'i ②bdag po mkhas pa dang / skye dgu'i ①bdag po gus ④yod dephyi/ kun dga' bo yiskye dgu'i rdzibadas/ ngo bdag nyid chen po ⑧'di dag ni gnas pa dang / 'gro ba'i 'byung po'i tshogs bsrung (9)ba'i phyir gnas pa dag go/ /de dag gis kyang rig sngags ⑩kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'dis bdag la bsrung ⑩ba gyis shig /lo brgya 'tsho ke/bar gyur cig /ston brgya mthong tsobar shog shigatso /thogs pa med pa'i gsang sngags 'di dag gis kyang bsrung 8ba gyis ⑩shig /tarya thā/ hi ri hi ri/ khi ri khi ri/ mi ri mi ri/phu ri phu ri/ su ri su ri/ hi li hi li/ mi li mi li/ si ri si ri/ ḍabyuyon/ḍabatso / ḍa ḍabyuhū/ gra sa ni/ ma tha ( )ni/ da ma ni/ da ha ni/ ghā ta ni/pa tsa ni/ pā tsa ni/ ta pa ni/ tā pa ni/ ha na ni/ dā ha zhu〉ni/ dā ha nishe/ da ha da ha da ha/ da la da la/ dā la ni〈rte/ pā ṭa ni/ mo ha ni( —ste/stambha ni/ dzambha ⑤ni swā hā/ kun dga' bo khyod kyis du nyadug chen po rnams kyi ming zung ⑥shig /tabya thā/ aṇḍa ( nyerā/ paṇḍa ( rten/ kā ra ḍā ri tsho/ ke yu rā61/ bhū gigerta ga mā/ bhu ta pa ti/ bind+ra 4)pa ti/ si ri pa ti/ te dze pa ti/ te dzo gra pa te④ / ya sho pa te'u/ ya sho gra ba te/ a ra 769/ ta ra 76rte/ ta ra ta ra 79 / danta/ dza hā 0rdza hā/ dzo lā/ mi lā/ ha 4 )lnga/ pha 4sprelā/ gu la (nyehā/ru tsi rā/ dan du rā/ i 'ari ki tsi kā/ kumbha ༄ste/ sha ta das (ge'o/ bi pu lebyam/ na ku le/ ki ri pi/ ta raṃ gā ris( sna/ a mra ma ti dzām bru (gem ti ci /ma dhu ma ti/ ka ma le(gye/ bi ma le/ kuṇḍa stsole/ a hi/ tu hi/ du hi/ bske bskye ()dru de(3/ bad sa nā bhe/ ma hā ga re/ tu lambi/ du larbhe(9/ su lambi swā hā/ kun dga' bo 'di dag ni dug chen po dag ste/ de dag gis kyang 90—321

rig sngags kyi rgyal mo ①ma bya chen mo 'dis bdag la bsrung ②ba gyis ①shig /sba ba dang / yongs su bskyab dupa dang / yongs su gzung dub dang / yongs su bskyang ⑥ba dang / zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ba dang / chad pa spang ba dang —/ mtshon cha spang ba dang / dug gzhil ba dang / dug gsad ⑦pa dang /mtshams gcad ⑧pa dang / sa bcing 6)ba gyis ⑩shig /lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig /ston brgya mthong bar shog shig⑩ /kun dga' bo khyod kyis shing ljon pa rnams kyi ming zung 8shig /'di lta ste/ shing ljon pa chen po gser zhes bya ba dang —/ shing ljon pa chen po ser skya zhes bya ba dang / shing ljon pa chen po khyab gnas zhes bya ba dang / shing ljon pa chen po spre'u gnas zhes bya ba dang / shing ljon pa chen po padma dkar po zhes bya ba dang / shing ljon pa chen po ser po zhes bya ba dang / shing ljon pa chen po mya ngan 'tshang 8zhes bya ba dang / shing ljon pa chen po rna ldan byed ④ces bya ba dang / shing ljon pa chen po rgyas byed ces bya ba dang / shing ljon pa chen po bil ba zhes bya ba dang / shing ljon pa chen po tsū ⑫ta zhes bya ba dang / shing ljon pa chen po de dag dang gzhan dag la lha gang dag gnas pa de dag gis kyang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'dis ⑩bdag la bsrung nyu 7ba gyis (3shig /lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig /ston brgya mthong ⑩bar shog shig9 ) /kun dga' bo rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'di ni 0yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bdun gyis gsungs shing rjes su yi rang ba ste/'di lta ste/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs kyis gsungs shing rjes su yi rang ba'o/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gtsug tor sdo stecan gyis gsungs shing rjes su yi rang ba'o/ /yang dag par rdzogs 90—322

pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad skyob kyis gsungs shing rjes su yi rang ba'o yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig ①gis gsungs shing rjes su yi rang ba'o/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gser thub kyis chagasungs shing rjes su yi rang ba'o/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gis dugasungs shing rjes su yi rang ba'o/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa ngas kyang da ltar bstan cing rjes su yi rang ba'o/ /kun dga' bo ④rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' byams pas kyang bshad cing rjes su yi rang ba'o/ /mi mjed (9kyi bdag po tshangs pas kyang smras shing rjes su yi rang ba'o/ /lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis kyang smras shing rjes su yi rang ba'o/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi po dag gis kyang smras shing rjes su yi rang ba ⑥ste/ dri za'i rgyal po yul 'khor srung ⑦gis kyang smras shing rjes su yi rang ba'o/ /grul bum gyi bdag po 'phags skyes pos kyang smras shing rjes su yi (sherang ba'o/ /klu'i rgyal po mig mi bzang gis kyang smras shing rjes su yi kyi)rang ba'o//gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po rnam thos kyi bus kyang smras shing rjes su yi rang ba'o/ /dri za'i sde dpon nyi shu rtsa brgyad dag dang / grul bum gyi sde dpon nyi shu rtsa brgyad dag dang / klu'i sde dpon nyi shu rtsa brgyad dag dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon nyi shu rtsa brgyad dag dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lngas 7rtsen dang / 'phrog ma 67bu lnga brgya'i 'khor can gyis kyang smras shing rjes su yi rang ba'o/ /kun dga' bo rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'di ni lha'i gdon dang / klu'i gdon dang / rlung lha'i gdon dang / lha ma yin gyi gdon dang / nam mkha' lding gi gdon dang / dri za'i gdon dang / mi 'am ci'i gdon dang / lto 90—323

'phye chen po'i gdon dang / gnod sbyin gyi gdon dang / srin po'i gdon dang / yi dgas kyi gdon dang / sha za'i gdon dang / 'byung po'i gdon dang ske/ grul bum gyi gdon dang / srul po'i gdon dang / lus srul ①po'i gdon dang / skem byed kyi gdon dang / smyo byed kyi gdon dang / grib gnon gyi gdon dang / brjed byed kyi gdon dang / gnon po'i gdon gyis 'gal bar bya ba ma yin no/ /gdon thams cad kyis 'gal bar bya ba ma yin pa'ol/ /mdangs 'phrog ②pa rnams dang / zas su mngal za ba rnams dang /srog 'phrog pa rnams dang / zas su gtor ma za ba rnams dang / zas su sha za ba rnams dang / zas su khrag 'thung ba rnams dang / zas su zhag za ba rnams dang / zas su tshil za ba rnams dang / zas su rkang za ba rnams dang / zas su btsas pa za ba rnams dang / zas su dri za ba rnams dang / zas su me tog za dub rnams dang / zas su 'bras bu za ba rnams dang / zas su lo tog za ba rnams dang / zas su sbyin sreg phyiza ba rnams dang / zas su rnag 'thung ba rnams dang / zas su phyi sa za ba rnams dang / zas su gcin 'thung ba rnams dang / zas su mchil (snyem za ba rnams dang / zas su ngar snabs skyoza ba rnams dang / zas su snabs za ⑦ba rnams dang / zas su lhag ma za ba rnams dang /zas su skyugs (7pa za ba rnams dang / zas su mi gtsang ba za ba rnams dang /zas su stor 6)khung nas 'bab pa 'thung ba rnams kyis 'gal bar bya ba ma yin no//gshed byed dang / sgyur ⑩ba'i las dang byad dang / g.yengs 7byed dang / ro langs dang / sems sgyur ba tunyedang / sbod gtong tsodang / bza' 8nyes dang / skyug tshunyes dang / gnod sgrib dang / gnod bltas ⑩dang / bri nyes 90—324

dang tso/ bsgom ①nyes dang / gnod ②pa rnams kyis 'gal bar bya ba ma yin pa'o / /rims nyin gcig ②pa dang / nyin gnyis pa dang / nyin gsum pa dang / nyin bzhi pa dang / nyin bdun pa dang / zla ba phyed pa dang / zla ④ba gcig pa dang / nyi ma phyed pa dang / nyin mo pa dang / yud tsam pa dang /rtag pa'i rims ⑤dang / rims drag po dang / 'byung po'i rims dang /rlung las gyur pa dang / mkhris ⑥pa las gyur pa dang / bad kun las gyur pa dang ske/ 'dus pa las gyur pas 'gal bar bya ba ma yin pa'o/ /rims thams cad kyis 'gal bar bya ba ma yin pa'o/ /klad ⑦pa na ba dang / gzhogs phyed na ba dang / yi ga 'chus ⑧pa dang / mig nad dang / sna nad dang /6) kha nad dang / mgul yind dang / snying nad dang / lkog ma'i lha gor na ba dang ske/ rna ba na ba dang / so na ba dang / snying na ba dang / rtsib logs na ba dang / rgyab na ba dang / lto ba tunyan ba dang / mkhur 8ba na ba dang / chu so na ba dang / skye gnas na ba dang / rab tu skye gnas na ba dang /⑫ rked pa na ba dang /④ brla tson ba dang / byin pa na ba dang / lag pa na ba dang /rkang pa na ba dang / yan lag na ba dang / nying lag na ba las ⑩'gal bar bya ba ma yin no/ /shu ba yidang / g.ya' ba dang / 'brum bu phra mo dang /mdze tsodang / 'bras dang / phol mig dang / g.yan pa dang / me dbal dang / lhog pa rnams kyis 'gal bar bya ba ma yin pa'o/ /nad thams cad dang / dug thams cad dang / sdang ba thams cad dang / 'jigs pa thams cad dang / yams kyi nad thams cad dang / 'thab pa dang / rtsod pa thams cad dang / gnod pa dang / nad 'go yib dang / 'khrug pa thams cad kyis 90—325

'gal bar bya ba ma yin pa'o/ /kun dga' bo gang gis ①rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo 'di las 'gal bar byas na lag na rdo rjes de'i mgo bo tshal pa bdun du 'gems ( par 'gyur ro / /sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / nyan thos thams cad kyi gzi brjid kyis de'i snang ba ma rungs par (7'gyur ro/ /sems ma rungs par ⑤'gyur ro/ /'phags pa'i gang zag rnams bslus par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi po dag gis kyang gshur (7zhes bya ba la thug gi bar gyi gsang sngags rnams kyis de la sdug bsngal spyichen po byed par 'gyur ro/ /lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya (nyebyin yang sum cu po)rtsa gsum pa'i tshogs kyis bskor te/ rdo rjes de'i mgo 'gems ⑩par 'gyur ro/ /tshangs pa'i gzi brjid kyis kyang de'i 'byor pa thal bar rlog (7par 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo 9/)su zhig gis rig sngags kyi rgyal mo ()rma bya chen mo 'dis bsrung 7ba byas sam/ skud pa btags na de bsad pa'i rigs 8pa ni chad pas bral 7bar 'gyur ro/ /chad pas bcad ()pa'i rigs pa ni gzhu btsog tunyepas so/ / gzhu btsog (7pa'i rigs ( )pa ni spyo bas so/ /spyo ba'i rigs 0pa ni dam bca' bas so/ /dam bca' ba'i rigs 6)pa ni spu zing zhes bya (nyebs so/ /spu zing zhes bya ba'i rigs (stepa ni de bzhin du thar bar 'gyur ro/ /de la rgyal po'i 'jigs pa 'byung bar mi 'gyur te/ chom rkun ( stegyi 'jigs pa mi 'byung /me'i 'jigs pa mi 'byung ngo / /chus 'chi ba'i dus byed par mi 'gyur ro/ /de'i lus la dug gis mi tshugs te/ mtshon gyis kyang ma yin no/ /bde bar gnyid kyis log cing bde bar sad par 'gyur ro/ /bde ba dang / gnod pa med pa dang / 'jigs pa med par 'gyur ro/ /phyir rgol ba bcom pa dang /90—326
