༄rga /'phags pa rig pa'i rgyal mo so sor 'brang ba chen mo/hunye༄dzi /rgya gar skad du/ ārya ma hā pra ti sa rā bityā rā 0rnyi/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa rig pa'i ①rgyal mo so sor 'brang ba cichen mo/ sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dudus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje'i lhun po chen po'i zom na/ khang pa brtsegs pa rdo rje chen po'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sa'i gnas/ rdo rje ①chen po'i dpag bsam gyi shing ljon pas legs par brgyan 9)pa/ rdo rje chen po'i rdzing gi rin po che dang / padma'i 'od kyis snang bar byas pa/ sa phyogs rdo rje chen po'i bye ma bdal ba/ rdo rje chen por byin gyis brlabs pa/ 'khor gyi khyams rdo rje chen po las byas pa/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyi rdo rje'i seng ge'i khri chen po bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gis rnam par mdzes pa/ chos bstan pa dang /cho 'phrul can sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin gyi rlabs kyi 6)byin gyis po)brlabs pa/90—355

chos thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid la 'jug pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyis ①nges par 'byung ba na②/ byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag brgyad cu ②rtsa bzhi thams cad kyang skye ba gcig gis thogs pa/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa/ mthu chen po thob pa/rdo rje chen po'i rnam par thar pa dang / ting nge 'dzin gyis dusangs rgyas kyi zhing du mar rnam par 'phrul pa dang / cho 'phrul ②chen po kun tu ston pa/ sems kyi skad cig thang cig yiyud tsam cig ⑦la sems can thams cad kyi sems dang /spyod pa'i rjes su 'jug pa'i chos ston ⑧pa sna tshogs snyan cing rgya che la zab cing yangs pa 6)dang / spobs pa dang / cho 'phrul dang ldan pa/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing du mar de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa chen po'i sprin gyis mchod pa dang /rnam par thar pa'i sgo dang / gzungs dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / dbang po ⑩dang ske/ mngon par shes pa dang / ma 'dres pa dang / byang chub kyi yan lag dang / lam dang / sa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa dang / thabs la mkhas pa dang ske/ bsdu ba'i dngos po dang / byams pa dang / snying rje dang / dga' ba dang / btang snyoms dang / byams pa'i stobs dang bden pa dang / yongs su byang ba'i sems kyi rgyun dang ldan pa sha stag la 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i snying po dang / rdo rje'i lus dang / rdo rje'i blo gros dang / lag na rdo rje dang / rdo rje 'dus pa dang / rdo rje mthu bo che dang / rdo rje rnam par 'phrul pa dang / rdo rje brtsegs pa dang / rdo rje phung po dang —/ rdo rje bzang po dang / byang yichub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i tog dang / de dag la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig 90—356

'bum phrag brgyad cu ①ma bzhi dang / nyan thos chen po rab tu mang po thams cad kyang dgra bcom pa/ zag pa zad pa/ srid par ⑧kun tu sbyor ba/ yongs su ②chad pa/ yang dag pa'i shes pas sems shin tu rnam par grol ba/rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs dang / cho 'phrul dubasam gyis mi khyab pas rnam par 'phrul pa'i mthu chen po thob pa/ lta ba chags pa med pa/ thams cad kyang dri ma dang bral ba thob pa/ kun nas nyon mongs pa'i bag chags kyi sa bon nges par bsregs 0pa sha stag la 'di lta ste/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu dang / tshe dang ldan pa byams ma'i bu gang po dang / tshe dang ldan pa ka pi na dang / tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor dang / tshe dang ldan pa mod gal (7gyi bu chen po dang / tshe dang ldan pa skul ⑦byed dang / tshe dang ldan pa dga' byed dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung ⑧dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'od sung 6)chen po dang / tshe dang ldan pa lteng rgyas tso'od srung yidang / de dag la sogs pa nyan thos chen po rab tu mang po dang / lha'i bu dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu grangs med dpag tu med pa8/ brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa dag dang / mi mjed 8kyi bdag po tshangs pa la sogs pa tshangs ris kyi lha'i bu rnams dang / lha'i bu rab 'thab bral g.yog 'thab bral gyi ④ris kyi lha'i bu dang bcas pa dang / yongs su dga' ldan dang / 'phrul dga' dang /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed dang / lha'i dbang po brgya byin lha'i bu thams cad kyi 'khor can dang / lha ma yin gyi dbang po thags bzangs 8ris dang / stobs can dang / rab sim dang / sgra gcan dang / rnam par snang byed dang / de dag la sogs pa lha ma yin gyi dbang po tshad med/ grangs med/ dpag tu 90—357

med pa rnams dang / klu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho dang / 'jog po dang / nor rgyas kyi 6)bu dang / dung skyong dang / stobs kyi rgyu dang / padma dang / padma chen po dang / de dag la sogs pa klu'i rgyal po tshad med grangs med dpag tu med pa rnams dang / mi 'am ci'i rgyal po chaljon pa mi 'am ci'i rgyal po g.yog du ma can dang / dri za'i ①rgyal po zur phud lnga pa dri za'i rgyal po g.yog du ma can dang /rig ④sngags 'chang gi rgyal po don thams cad grub pa rig sngags 'chang gi rgyal po g.yog du ma can dang / nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po gser mig nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po g.yog du ma can dang / gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po rnam thos kyi bu dang ske/ nor bu bzang dang / gang ba bzang dang / lngas rtsen duganod sbyin gyi rgyal po g.yog du ma can dang / 'phrog ma bu lnga brgya'i g.yog du ma can dang /'jig rten gyi ma bdun dang / srin mo chen mo bdun dang / drang srong gi mchog chen po bdun dang / bar snang la rgyu ba'i rgyu skar dang / gza' thams cad kyi lha rnams dang / phyogs kyi lha rnams dang / phyogs mtshams ⑥kyi lha rnams dang / sa'i lha ⑦dang / dbyangs can (shedang / 'byung po rnams dang /bgegs rnams dang / log 'dren rnams dang / yi dgas 6)rnams dang /'byung po rdzu 'phrul chen po rnams dang / ri'i yirgyal po thams cad dang /'jig rten skyong ba chu lha g.yog rgya mtsho'i lha thams cad dang bcas pa dang /'phags skyes po dang / mig mi bzang dang / lag na be con dang / bden bral dang / me'i lha dang / rlung gi lha chen po tunyebadun dang / dbang bdag chung ma dang bcas pa g.yog bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma can dang / sred med kyi bu g.yog dang bcas pa dang / byin pa po dang / phreng ba can dang /90—358

zla ba can dang / lcags can dang / tshogs kyi bdag po chen po dang / sprin ta la la dang / log 'dren gyi dbang po bgegs log 'dren gyi dbang po g.yog du ma can dang / shing gseb ①kyi lha drug cu ②dang / sring mo bzhi (0ming po dang bcas pa dang / rdo rje'i lu gu rgyud dang / rdo rje'i pho nya mo drug cu ④tsa bzhi dang / rdo rje'i sde dang / lag bzang ⑤dang / gtsug gis 'gro rdo rje'i ris kyi 'khor du ma dang bcas pa dang / de las gzhan pa sangs rgyas dang /chos dang / dge 'dun la mngon par dad pa'i lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye yichen po dang / 'byung po dang / yi dgas ⑦dang / sha za dang ske/ grib gnon dang / smyo byed dang / brjed (8)byed dang / skem byed dang —/ sgrub pa dang / sbrul 'dzin bcas pa dang / gnon 6)po tshad med grangs med dpag tu med pa dag dang / lha'i bu nyi ma dang / lha'i bu zla ba dang / nub ma'i lha dang / nang bar gyi lha dang / dus kyi lha thams cad dang /sa'i lha dang thabs cig tu bzhugs 0te/ bcom ldan 'das des (7chos kyi 'khor lo ni shin tu bskor/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa ni shin tu yongs su mthar phyin / bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs ni shin tu yongs su rdzogs/ thams cad mkhyen pa ni shin tu yongs su bzung ⑫/ byang chub chen po'i phyir pha rol tu phyin pa dang sa ni brnyes/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan 8sum cu 8rtsa gnyis kyis brgyan yipa'i sku ni rab tu 'bar/ yan lag dang nying lag thams cad ni dpe tshu byad bzang po brgyad cus ⑩rnam par spras/ dbu'i gtsug ni sems can thams cad kyis bltar tu)mi mthong / bdud kyi las thams cad la ni mkhas/ sems 90—359

can thams cad kyi sems dang spyod pa ni shes/ spyan rnam pa lnga ni mnga'/rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ni ldan/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang ni ldan/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad dang ni ldan/ bdud dang phas kyi rgol ba'i tshogs thams cad ni bcom/ grags pa dang / sgra dang / tshigs su bcad pas ni 'phags/ khyu mchog dang / seng ge'i sgra ni sgrogs①/ ma rig pa'i mun pa ni kun tu bsal②/ bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag grangs med dpag tu med par sbyin pa dang / tshul khrims dang / bzod pa dang /brtson 'grus dang / bsam gtan dang / shes rab chadang / thabs dang /stobs dang / smon lam dang / ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bya dka' ba'i spyod pa las ni phyir ma log④ /sku ni skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu ⑤tsa gnyis dang / dpe byad ⑥bzang po brgyad cus brgyan ⑦te/ rab tu mdzes shing rdo rje rin po che'i padma'i snying po'i seng ge'i khri chen po rdo rje rin po che dang /mu tig dang / dril bu g.yer ku'i dra ba du ma sgra 'byung ba/ rtsa ba'i drung na rdo rje rin po che'i stegs bu du ma shin tu brtan ⑧par gnas pa/ rdo rje ⑨rin po che'i chu srin du ma'i kha nas byung ba'i mu tig dmar po'i phreng ba bres pa'i phang 4)bshams pa/ rin po che du ma ⑩padma'i snying po la chags pa 8rin po che ke ke ru dang ske/ ke ke ru chen po dang / an da rnyil dang /⑩ an da rnyil chen po dang —/ dun las kyi 'od zer chen po 'tsher bas snang bar byas te kun nas mdzes pa/ gdugs rtsa ba dang bcas pa/ rdo rje rin po che'i shar bu du mas rnam par brgyan 8pa/ bye tsob khrag 'khrig 'bum phrag du mas rnam par brgyan ⑩pa / bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du mas kun nas bskyabs pa/ dpag bsam gyi 90—360

shing du mas rgyas par mdzes par byas pa/ rdo rje rin po che'i khri ri rab tsam la bzhugs te/ gser gyi ri bo'i rgyal po ltar dpal ni rab tu tu)'bar sa phyogs ni nyi ma stong bas lhag pa'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyis rnam par brgyan②/zla ba nya ba ltar 'jig rten thams cad la sdug par ni snang / dpag bsam gyi shing ljon pa chen po ltar/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams ni shin tu rgyas shing chos ston te/ tshangs par spyod pa/ thog mar dge ba/ bar du dge ba/ tha mar dge ba/ don bzang po/ tshig 'bru bzang po/ ma 'dres pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ yongs su dag pa/ yongs su byang ba/ yang dag par rab tu ston tol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi smin mtshams ②kyi mdzod spu skyinas 'od zer gyi dra ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zhing kun tu ston pa zhes bya ba bkye ste/ 'od zer gyi dra ba des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di snang bas khyab par byas par dugyur to/ci /sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang dag na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dag seng ge'i khri bkod pa du ma'i khang pa brtsegs pa'i gzhal med khang na nyan thos dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dang /dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma dang /lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang /nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po thams cad dang thabs cig 0tu chos ston pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang gā'i 7klung gi ⑤bye ma snyed dang mnyam pa de dag thams cad kyang snang ba des khyab par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor phal po che la bka' stsal pa/ sems can kun la snying brtse'i phyir/ /nyes par byas dang gnod pa kun/ /rab 'joms so sor 90—361

'brang ba yi/ /gzungs 'di rab tu bshad par bya/ /'di ni thos pa tsam gyis kyang ske/ /sdig pa kun ni zad par 'gyur/ /sems can kun la bde ba sbyin/ /nad do cog las grol bar byed/ /sems can kun la snying brtse bas/ /lus can ngan 'gror 'gro ba rnams①/ /de dag thams cad bskyab ②pa'i phyir/ /'jig rten dag gi nimagon pos gsungs/ /'di yis bsrung ④ba byas na ni/ /lha ma yin gyi gnas su 'jug /de bzhin lcang lo can dang ni/ /srin po'i gnas kyi sar yang 'gro/ /'byung po klu dang sha za rnams/ /mi bzad 'jigs pa'i g.yul 'gyed ⑤par/ /'byung po ⑥tshogs rnams thams cad dang / /dgra bo cog gis mi tshugs so/ /ming tsam bzung 0ste brjod byas kyang / /skem byed smyo byed brjed nibyed dang / /mkha' 'gro ma dang sha za dang / /gdon rnams rab tu brlag par 'gyur/ /so sor 'brang ba'i gzi brjid kyis/ /gzi chen mdangs rnams za ba dang / /mi yi skye dgu ⑨rnams 'tshe ba/ /de dag thams cad rengs 0byed 'gyur/ /byad stems mi bzad gang yin dang / /pha rol dmag tshogs phung bar byed/ /sngags kyi las kyis gnod mi 'gyur/ /rtsa ba'i las las rnam par grol/ /dug dang dug sbyar mes mi tshugs/ /mtshon dang chus kyang tshugs mi 'gyur/ /lce 'bab glog gis mi tshugs te/ /dus kyi rlung gis gnod mi 'gyur/ /rig pa'i rgyal mo'i gzi brjid kyis/ /dgra kun rab tu 'joms spre)par 'gyur/ / de yis 8don rnams thams cad 'grub/ /rtag tu rgyal ba phonyethob par 'gyur/ /gang gis rtag tu mgul pa'am/ /lag par rig pa btags na ni/ / de yi yidagos pa yod do cog /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tsom ⑫med / /byang chub sems dpa' chen po dang / /sangs rgyas rnams dang rang 90—362

'dren dang / /de bzhin klu yi hu)rgyal po dang / /lha dbang rnams ②ni rtag tu bsrung ①/ /so sor 'brang ba'i gzungs 'dzin la/ /nyan thos dusangs rgyas thams cad dang / /rig pa'i lha mo rdzu 'phrul che/ /rtag tu srung ⑤ba byed par 'gyur / /lag na rdo rje gnod sbyin dbang / /de bzhin rgyal po bzhi rnams kyang rjo/ /de la nyin dang mtshan rnams su/ /srung cu)bar byed de the tsom nimed/ /brgya byin lha dang bcas pa dang / /tshangs pa khyab 'jug dbang chen dang / /dga' ba'i dbang po nag po che/ /smin drug bu dang tshogs kyi dbang / /ma mo'i tshogs rnams thams cad dang / /de bzhin bdud ris gzhan rnams dang / /drang srong gzi brjid che rnams dang / /rdzu 'phrul chen po'i lha rnams dang / /de kun so sor 'brang ba yi/ /gzungs 'dzin de la srung ⑨bar byed/ /sangs rgyas bdag nyid che rnams dang / /rig pa'i lha mo stobs chen dang / /bdag gi ma dang khro gnyer dang / /lha mo sgrol ma lcags kyu dang / /rdo rje lu gu rgyud yidang dkar / /de bzhin dkar mo chen mo dang / /nag mo che dang pho nya dang / /de bzhin rdo rje pho nya gzhanayi/ /zhags pa bzang dang rdo rje zhags/ /lag na rdo rje stobs po che/ /rig pa ⑩lha mo rdo rje phreng / /bdud rtsi thab 0sbyor byed pa dang / /gzhan gyis mi thub lha mo che/ /rna ba nag mo stobs chen mo/ /dpal yon ldan pa skal chen dang ⑫/ /rna cha gdub kor padma 'dra/ /me tog so can nor bu gtsug /skra mdog mdzes dang kham tshupa mo/ /lha mo gzi brjid chen mo dang / /dpal yon ldan pa glog phreng can/ /srin mo tsoral pa gcig pa dang / /sangs rgyas bsrungs zhes ⑩bya ba dang / /skal ba chen po mi thod can/ /lang ku'i bdag po dpal yon can/ /gzhan yang lha mo mang po rnams/ /sems can 90—363

rjes su 'dzin byed dag /rig pa gang gi ①lag na gnas/ /de la srung ba ②byed par 'gyur/ /'phrog ma dang ni lngas rtsen dudang / /dung can dang ni so brtsegs ma/ /dpal gyi lha mo dbyangs can yang / / de yi durjes 'gro rtag tu bsrung ⑤/ /so sor 'brang ba chen mo 'di/ /bud med gang zhig rtag 'chang na/ / de yi ⑥thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /rtag par mngal na bu pho chags/ /mngal rnams na yang bde bar skye/ /sbrum ma dag kyang bde bar 'gyural/ /nad dang sdig pa thams cad kyang / /'jig par 'gyur te the tsom ⑧med/ /bsod nams ldan zhing stobs dang ldan/ /nor dang 'bru yang rtag tu 'phel/ /tshig ku'o)kyang gzung du 'os pa dang / /mchod pa'i 'os su 'gyur ba yin⑩/ /bud med dang ni skyes pa'ang rung / /gtsang ma gang zhig 'chang bsrel yin/ /de ni sems can thams cad dag /thar bar bya phyir brtson par 'gyur/ /rtag tu bde bar 'gyur ba yin/ /nad do cog kyang rnam par spangs/ /slas dang skye bo ⑫mang bcas pa'i/ /rgyal po'ang de yi yidabang du 'gyur/ /phun sum tshogs pa rtag tu 'bar/ /bsod nams phung po rnam par 'phel/ /de ④yi bsam pa thams cad 'grub/ /dkyil 'khor kun tu zhugs pa yin/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi bka' bzhin du/ /de ni kun tu dam tshig shes/ /rmi tsolam ngan pa rmi mi 'gyur//sdig pa thams cad 'phrog pa'i mchog /sdig pa rnams dang de bzhin du/ /dgra yang rab tu phung bar byed/ /gza' kun rnam par gzhig pa'i phyir/ /ye shes dbang phyug chen pos gsungs/ /'dod pa thams cad sbyin par byed/ /de phyir rtag tu bcang bar bya/ /'byung po'i tshogs rnams nga la nyon/ /da ni rab tu 'di brjod do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo sangs 90—364

rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / sangs rgyas dang /chos dang / dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal lo/ / tarya thā/① ma bi pu la bi ⑤pu la garbhe / bi pu ①la bi ma le/ bi pu la garbhe/④ tha ma 0le/ dza ⑥ya garbhe/badzra dzā lā dugarje/ ga ti dug ha neyonye/ ga ga na bi sho dha de⑩/ sarba shyapā pa bi sho dha de8/ o gu ṇa 8pa ti/ ga ga na/ pi tsā ri ṇi/ ga ga ri ṇi/ gi gi 8gi ri / gi ri ṇi gi ri ṇi/ ga ma ri/ ga ma ri/ ga ha ga ha/ garga ri garga 8ri/ga ga ri/ ga ga ri/ gi ⑩bha ri/ gi ⑩bha ri/ ga gi ga gi/ ga hi ga hi/ ga ma ni/ ga ma ni/tso ga ri ga ri/ gu bha gu bha/ gu ha gu ha/ gu ru gu ru gu ru 0ṇi/ tsa le 0gu ha ṇi tī/ gu ha ṇiñtsa/ gu ru ṇi/ tsu lu tsu lu/ tsa le tsa le'u / mu tse ④le mu tse tshule/ dza ye bi dza ye/ sarba ⑩bha ya bi ga te/ satwa sarba garbha saṃ rakṣa ṇizhu/ si ri si ri/ bhi ri bhi ri/ mi ri mi ri mi ri mi ri'ugi ri gi ri/ ghi ri ghi ri/ ghi ri ghi ri/ sa manta parṣa ṇi/ ⑩ bcom ldan 'das ma sems can 'dren ma/ kun nas 'dren ma/ dgra thams cad 'joms par mdzad ma/ bdag 'jigs pa thams cad dang / gnod pa thams cad dang ske/ nad 'go ba thams cad dang / nad thams cad las bsrung ( )du gsol/bsrung 0du gsol/ tsi ri tsi ri/ bi ri bi ri/ dhi ri dhi ri/ bi ga ta/ ā ba dur ṇi0/ bi sho dha ne'u/ bi bi dha/ ā pa ra ṇamyi/ bi nā sha ni/ mu ri mu ril/ mu tsi mu tsi/ mu li mu li/ tsi li tsi li/ ki li ki li/ mi li mi yis/ka ma le/ bi ma le/ dza ye bi dza ye/ bi 0dza yā/ ba he dza ya ba ti/ bi she ṣa ba ti/tso bcom ldan 'das ma rig pa chen po'i 0cod pan dang / phreng ba mnga' 0ba cha byad rnam pa sna tshogs mang po mnga' rgyab/ bcom ldan 'das ma 90—365

rig pa'i lha mo chen mo/ sdig pa thams cad rnam par sbyong ba/ bdag la thams cad du kun nas bsrung du gsol/ bsrung du gsol/ hu ru hu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ rakṣa rakṣa ma ma/(7 mgon ma mchis pa/ skyabs ma mchis pa/dpung gnyen ma mchis pa/ bdag la bsrung ②du gsol/ bsrung gdu gsol/bdag sdug bsngal thams cad las (gethar bar mdzad du gsol/ tsaṇḍi tsaṇḍiX/ tsaṇḍi tsaṇḍi46ri/ tsaṇḍi ṇi/ tsaṇḍi ṇi47/ be ga ba ti6)/ sarba 6)duṣṭa ni bā ⑩ra ṇi/bi dza ya/ bā hi ni/ hu ru hu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ tsu ru tsu ru/ tu ru tu ru/ā yuḥhu pā li ni/ su ra ba ra pra ma tha ni/ sarba 8de ba ga ṇa pū dzi te0/ tsi ri tsi ri/ dhi ri dhi ri/ sa manta a ba lo ki teyi/ pra bhe pra bho/ su pra bhe/ su pra bha / bi shud dhe/ sarba pā pa bi shudhe/tso sarba ༅pā pa ⑩ba sho dha ne'u/ dhu ru dhu ru / dha ra ni37/ dha re dha res tsho/ dha ra/ su mu su mu/0 su mu su mudu/ mu su mu su/22 ru ru ( chetsa le/ tsā ( gal ya/ dpal gyi sku mnga' ba/ bdag la gnod par sems pa tsho nyalas bskyab tu gsol/ bdag gi grortebasam pa rdzogs par mdzad du gsol/ dza ya ka (shem le/ kṣi ni kṣi ni( )/ pa ra da/ e ku she0/oṃ padma bi shud dhe/ sho dha ya sho dha ya/ shud dhe shud dhe/ bha ra bha ra/ bhi ri ⑥bhi ridage/ bhu ru bhu ru/ maṅga rusal bi shud dhe/ pa bi tra mu khi/ khaṅge skyini khaṅge ni(sri / kha ra kha ra/ dzwa li ta(lha/ shi kha re/ sa manta a ba lo ki ta pra te0/su pra bha bi shud dhe/ sa manta pra sā ri ta/ ā bā bha khri si ta shud dha()/ dzwa la dzwa la / sarba dhe ba ṭaṃ rig ṇa/ gra ha na kṣa tra/ sa ma ā kursha (nyani/ sa tya pra ti(gye/oṃ trī traṃ (rnyita ra ta ra/ tā ra ya tā ra ya/6 ) glang po che'i lta stangs 8kyis gzigs ma/ bdag mi'i gnod pa las bsgral (9du gsol/ la hu la hu/ hu 90wa 366

lu hu lu/ hu du hu du/ tu ru tu ru/ ki ṇi ki ṇi0)/ kṣi ṇi kṣi ṇi4mi/ hu ṇi hu ṇizhu/ sarba ④ga ha bha kṣa ṇi45)/ dzi tsistag li/ dzi ri ga linano/ mu tsu mu tsu/ tsu mu tsu po)mu/ 0su bi tsa re(1/ ta ra ta ra/ bcom ldan 'das ma glang po /nyeche'i lta tistangs kyis gzigs ma/ thams cad du kun nas phyogs thams cad yibacing ba dang / rdo rje'i ra ba dang / rdo rje'i zhags pa'i bcing bas bdag 'jigs pa chen po brgyad las bsgral du gsol/ badzra dzā lā mabi shud dhe/ bhu ri bhu ri/ dha ra dha ra/ ti ri ti ri/ tu ru tu ru/⑩ bha ga ba ti/ garbha bi shud dhe/tshu garbha saṃ ()sho dha (17ni/ ku kṣi sam pū 4 )ra ṇipu spre/ dzwa la dzwa zhugel/ tsa la tsa la/ dzā duli ni/ lha'i (9chus kun tu char dbab tu gsol/ a mṛ ta ༄ lhabarṣa ṇi de 49ba ta/ a ba tā ru kār ṇi/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab ( snyebadud rtsi mchog gi sku dang ldan pa bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ 'thab pa dang / 'thab ( )mo dang / rtsod pa dang / 'gyed khri pa dang / rmi lam ngan pa dang ske/ ltas ngan pa dang / bkra mi shis pa dang / sdig pa thams cad rnam par sbyong ba/ gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / klu thams cad 'joms pa/gnod pas (nya'ajigs skrag pa/ bdag 'jigs pa thams cad dang / gnod pa thams cad dang / nad 'go ba thams cad dang / nad thams cad las thams cad du rtag par bsrung (nyedu gsol/ bsrung sastedu gsol/ ba la ba la ba la ba ti/ dza ya dza ya/ bi dza ya/ bi dza ya/ thams cad du dus kun tu bdag du hergyal bar mdzad du gsol/ bdag la rig zhunyepa chen mo 'di grub par mdzad du gsol / dkyil 'khor chen po bsgrub 59tu gsol/ gsang sngags rnams bsgrub zhu tu gsol/ bgegs rnams gzhom du gsol/ dza ya dza ya/ sid dhi sid dhiji lta/90wa 367

sirgya sisgru/① burgya buskyo/② sru tsa ya sru tsa ya/① pū ra ya pū ra ya/④ dus ra ṇi pū ra ṇi/ bdag gi bsam pa rdzogs par mdzad du gsol/ rig pa thams cad las byung ba'i sku can/ rgyal ba lhag par rgyal ba can/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po rnam par dag pa bcom ldan 'das ma bzhugs su gsol/bzhugs su gsol/ dam tshig bskyang du gsol/ 'jigs pa mi bzad pa chen po brgyad las bdag la gzigs su gsol/ sa ra sa ra/ pra sa ra pra sa stir/ sarba ā dub ra ṇa nibi sho dha ni/ sa manta ā ka ⑨ra maṇḍa la bi shud dhe/ bi ga te bi ga te⑩/ bi ga ta ma le/ sarba ma ⑩la bi sho dha ni/ kṣi ṇi kṣi ṇi0/sarba 'apā pa 'bi shud dhe/ ma la bi tsog ti0/ dza ya ba ti/⑩ te dzo te 'dzo ba ti/ badzra badzra ba ti swā hāyi/ 'jig rten gsum du byin gyis brlabs pa la swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 0spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba la swā hā / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis 0dbang bskur ba la swā hā/ lha thams cad kyis dbang bskur ba la swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying pos byin gyis brlabs ⑤pa la swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis tsodam tshig grub pa la swā hā/ dbang po dang ldan pa dbang pos rnam par bltas pa la swā hā/ tshangs pa dang tshangs pa la phyoganas pa la swā hā/ khyab 'jug gis phyag byas pa la swā hā/ dbang phyug chen pos phyag 'tshal zhing mchod pa la swā hā/rdo ⑤rje 'dzin lag na rdo rje'i stobs dang brtson 'grus kyis byin gyis brlabs pa la swā hā/ yul 'khor srung tsol swā hā/ 'phags skyes po la swā hā/ mig mi bzang phyal swā hā/ rnam thos kyi bu la swā hā/ rgyal po chen po bzhis phyag byas pa (nyel swā hā/ gshin rje la swā hā/ gshin rjes mchod cing phyag byas pa tshul swā hā/90—368

chu ①lta la swā hā/ rlung lha la swā hā/ rlung lha chen po la swā hā/ me lha la swā hā/klus rnam par bltas pa la swā hā/ lha'i tshogs rnams la swā hā/ klu'i tshogs rnams la swā hā/ gnod sbyin gyi tshogs rnams la swā hā/ gshin rje'i tshogs rnams la swā hā/la srin po'i tshogs rnams la swā hā/ dri za'i tshogs rnams la swā hā / lha ma yin gyi tshogs rnams la swā hā/ nam mkha' lding gi tshogs rnams la swā hā/ mi 'am ci'i tshogs rnams la swā hā/ lto 'phye chen po'i tshogs rnams la swā hā/ mi rnams la swā hā/ mi ma yin pa rnams la swā hā/ gdon thams cad ②la swā hā/ 'byung po thams cad la swā hā/ yi dgas ④la swā hā/ sha za la swā hā/brjed byed la swā hā/ gnod byed ⑤la swā hā/ grul bum la swā hā/ o dhu ru dhu ru swā hā/ tu ru tu ru swā hā/ mu ru mu ru swā hā/ ha na ha na sarba ⑥sha rghaṃ stiswā hā/da ha da ha sarba duṣṭa ṭwāṃ duswā hā/ pa tsa pa tsa sarba pra kyarji kā pra hye mi hā ṭwāṃ swā hā/⑨gang dag bdag la mi phan par 'dod pa de dag thams cad kyi 7lus dzwa (nyal ya sarba du/ tsi tā ṭwāṃ 8swā hā/ 'bar ba la swā hā/ rab tu 'bar ba la swā hā/ rdo rje 'bar ba la swā hā/ me lce 'bar ba la swā hā/ kun tu 'bar ba la swā hā/nor bu bzang la swā hā/ gang ba bzang po la swā hā/ nag po chen po la swā hā/ma tsomo'i tshogs la swā hā/ gnod sbyin mo rnams la swā hā/ srin mo rnams la swā hā / nam mkha'i ma mo rnams la swā hā/ rgya mtsho na gnas pa rnams la swā hā/mtshan mo rgyu ba rnams la swā hā/ nyin mo rgyu ba rnams la swā hā/ dus gsum du rgyu ba rnams la swā hā/ dus su rgyu ba rnams la swā hā/0 dus ma yin par rgyu ba rnams la swā hā/ zas su mngal za ba rnams la swā hā/ mngal 'dzin pa el swā hā / hu lu hu lu swā hā/ oṃ swā hā/ suḥ8swā hā/ bhuḥ()swā hā/ bhu baḥ4)swā hā/90—369

thā ga ta hre 6)da ya/ a dhiṣṭha na/(gyi sa rnyisbyi ti ①badzre swā hā/ bram ze chen po ④rig pa'i rgyal mo so sor 'brang ba chen mokhya/ kun nas me lce'i phreng ba rnam par dag pas rgyas pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu yiphyag rgya dang / snying po gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i gzungs ⑦'di rigs nikyi bu 'am/ rigs kyi bu mos thos ma thag tu sdig pa thams cad las rnam par grol bar 'gyur ro/ /bram ze chen po rig pa 'di gang gi snying la gnas par gyur pa de'i lus rdo rjer rig par bya'o/ /de'i lus la mes mi tshugs so/ /ci mngon zhe na/ gang gi tshe grong khyer chen po ser skya'i gnas na/ gzhon nu sgra gcan 6)zin bzang po mngal du zhugs pa de'i tshe shākya'i bu mo sa 'tsho ma bdag nyid me'i nang du mchongs ⑩pa dang / der padma dag byung ste/ de'i tshe gzhon nu sgra gcan zin (nyubazang po mngal na gnas bzhin du rig pa 'di yid la byas so/ /rig pa 'di rjes su dran pa tsam gyis me de skad cig de nyid la bsil bar gyur to/ /de nas shākya'i bu mo sa 'tsho tunyema'i lus la mes ma reg go/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rig pa 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis tunyebyin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /bram ze chen po rgyu des na mes mi tshig yigo/ /dug gis kyang srog dang 'bral bar mi nus so/ /de ci lta zhe na/bram ze chen po gang gi tshe grong khyer chen po bde bar pha rol tu 'gro ba zhes bya ba na / tshong dpon mdzod stobs can gyi bu rig pa smra bar gyur to/ /de'i rig pa'i stobs des klu'i rgyal po 'jog po bkug go/ /bkug snyinas kyang bag med pa'i dbang gis ma bcings pas des khros nas de la bzung ba dang / de tshor ba mi bzad pa myong yinas ji ltar yang bdag ni srog dang bral lo snyam du shes so/ /de nas smra ba can mang po bos kyang 'ga' tsam gyis kyang dug las gso bar ma 1rte90—371

nus so/ /de nas grong khyer chen po bde bar pha rol tu 'gro ba ①na dge bsnyen ②ma dri ma med par dag pa zhes bya ba snying rje chen po dang ldan pa zhig gnas pa des rig pa'i rgyal mo chen mo 'di kha ton du shes so/ /de de'i gnas su song ste phyin pa dang / rig pa chen mo du'adi brjod dudo/ /des de la lan cig dubarjod pa tsam gyis de dug med par byas shing de dran pa rnyed par byas te/ sdug bsngal chen po de las yongs su thar bar byas nas 0rig pa chen mo'i snying po 'di cho ga ci ⑦ltar bka' stsal pa bzhin du tshong nidapon gyi ①bu de'i snying la gnas par byas sotso / /bram ze chen po gzhan yang ci ⑩ltar yongs su shes zhe tson/ rgyal po tshangs pas byin zhes bya ba'i grangs su chud pa zhig grong khyer chen po bā rā ṇa sī ⑫na sngon yongs su rgyu ba'i tshe/ de'i shar phyogs kyi mtshams ④kyi stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur 8ba'i rgyal po des dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa go bskon te/grong khyer chen po bā rā ṇa sī tsokun nas bskor te⑩/ gzhom par bshams so/ /de nas rgyal po tshangs pas byin de la blon po rnams kyis smras pa/ lha pha rol gyi dmag tshogs kyis grong khyer 'phrog la thug 8na thabs gang gis pha rol gyi dmag tshogs gzhom par bgyi/ bka' stsal du gsol zhes byas pa dang rgyal pos khyed 'tsher 'grib chung ngur gyis shig /rig pa'i rgyal mo so sor 'brang ba chen mo zhes bya ba yod deyi/ ngas des dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa gu 'di pham par bya'o / /thal ba bzhin du 0bya'o zhes bsgo ba dang / blon po rnams kyis tsomago btud de rgyal po chen po sngon bdag cag dugis nam yang ma thos pa 'di ci zhig lags zhes ( nyesmras pa dang / rgyal pos dungs de mngon sum du bya'o zhes bsgo'o/ /de nas rgyal po tshangs pas 0byin spos chu sna tshogs kyis dumago bkrus te/ gos 90—372

gtsang ma bgos nas rig pa'i rgyal mo chen mo 'di ①cho ga bzhin du bris te/mgo'i gtsug gi skra'i nang du bzhag ②nas rig pa'i rgyal mo chen mo 'di nyid kyis go cha byas te②/ g.yul gyi nang du zhugs pa dang / gcig pus rjodapung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa thams cad pham par byas te/ ji srid skyabs su ⑤dong ba de srid du 'dis tshar bcad nas stobs kyi ⑥'khor los sgyur 9)ba'i rgyal po de gcig ⑤pu btang ngo / /bram ze ①chen po de ltar na rig pa'i rgyal mo chen mo de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po dang / phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs pa/mthu chen po 'di mngon sum du gyur pa yin te/ mngon sum du gyur to snyam du gzung tibar bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang mtshungs pa nyid du blta bar bya'o/ /phyi ma'i tshe phyi ma'i dus na sems can tshe thung ba rnams dang /bsod nams chung ba rnams dang / longs spyod chung ba rnams la phan par 'gyur bar ⑩blta'o/ /bram ze chen po gang la la zhig rig pa'i rgyal mo so sor 'brang ba chen mo 'di cho ga bzhin du bris te lag pa'am/ mgul tsodu btags tson de de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis ④byin gyis brlabs 8par rig par bya'o/ /de de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi skur rig par bya'o/ /rdo rje'i lus yin par rig par bya'o/ /de de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ring bsrel gyi snying po can 8yin par rig par bya'o/ /de de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi spyan yin par rig par bya'o/ /de rdo rje chen po'i lus su rig par bya'o/ /de 'bar ba 'od 'phro ba'i 0lus dang ldan par rig par bya'o/ /de mi shigs tunyepa'i go cha can du rig par bya'o/ /de dgra thams cad rab tu 'joms par tu)rig par bya'ol/ /de sgrib pa dang sdig pa thams cad 'joms 0par rig par bya'o/ /de 90—373

sems can dmyal ba'i 'gro ba rnams sbyong bar rig par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sngon yongs su shes pa yo)yin te/ bram ze chen po phyogs gzhan zhig na dge slong ma dad pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs la bslab pa 'dral ba/ ma byin par len pa②/ bza' ba 'du ba'i sgo 'phrog pa/ dge 'dun gyi dang /phyogs bzhi dang / tshogs kyi rdzas gsu gyur pa de thams cad gang dag gir ④byin gyis brlabs te za ba zhig dus phyagazhan zhig na nad tshabs yichen pos btab pa dang / sdug ⑦bsngal chen po'i tshor ba myong ngo / /nyon mongs te skyabs ⑧med dpung gnyen med nas ku co'i sgra chen po 'byin to/ /bram ze chen po de nas phyogs de na 6)dge bsnyen zhig gnas pa des sgra de thos so/ /thos nas kyang dge slong de ⑨ ga la ba der song ste phyin nas rig pa'i rgyal mo so sor 'brang ⑩ba chen mo 'di bris te/ dge slong de'i mgul du btags so/ /rig pa'i rgyal mo so sor 'brang ba chen mo dge slong de'i mgul du btags tu)ma thag tu tshor ba thams cad ni rab tu zhi/ nad thams cad las ni yongs su thar te(ste/ sos par gyur nas de'i mtshan mo zad pa dang / dran pa shin tu nye bar bzhag ste 'chi ba'i dus byas so/ /lus de bor ba dang / sems can dmyal ba chen po mnar med par skyes so/ /de'iro de yang dge slong dag gi sgang tsobu zhig la bzhag go/ /rig pa chen mo so sor 'brang ba chen mo de yang de'i mgul du btags cipa bzhin du gnas so/ /dge slong de mnar med pa der skyes ma thag tu sems can dmyal ba'i sems can de dag gi 6sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba thams cad rab tu zhi nas sems can dmyal (1ba'i sems can de dag thams cad bde ba thams cad kyis tshim par gyur to/ /mtshams med pa'i me'i hunyephung po chen po 4)gang yin pa de 90—374

dag thams cad kyang yongs su zhi bar gyur to/ /de nas gshin rje'i mi de dag thams cad ngo mtshar skyes nas chos kyi rgyal po gshin rje la nges pa'i tshig 6)'di dag rgyas par brjod dophyi/ /sems can las ③las skyes pa yi/ /sdug bsngal mi bzad rab tu zhi/ /shin tu ngo mtshar 'di ni lha/ /sems dmyal nyam nga rnams na gda'adhi/ /lus (snyecan lus la rtag gnas pa'i/ /me ma mur de rab tu zhi/ /sog le rnams kyis gshegs stim mchis/ /spu gri'i sos yang ( )gcod mi bgyid/ /lcags sdong ③shal ma ri yang chag /lcags zangs thams cad rab tu zhi/ /ral gri lo ma can nags na/ /las skyes lo ma gnod mi 'gyur/ /chos kyi rgyal po gshin rje khyod/ /mi rnams la ni chos kyi 6)ston/ /rgyu 'di mi chung bdag cag latshul/ /khyod kyis brjod par mdzad pa'i rigs/ /de nas chos kyi bdag nyid can / /chos nges chos kyi rgyal po des/ /snying rje'i bsam pa nyams (nyarnams kyi/ /'di 'dra'i tshig de thos gyur nas/ /myur du 'di ni ci yin smrosatso/ /'di ni ci 'dra yang smros shig /de nas mi bzad gshin rje'i mi/ /gnod pa'i rgyun can de dag gis/ /chos kyi rgyal po gshin rje la/ /'di skad kyi tunyeni tshig smras so/ /mnar med rab tu nyam nga bar/ /sems can chen po 'di skyes lha/ /gang gi tī ming ni mnar med pa/ /des na de ni nyam ngar brjod/ /gang gis lisems can bde bgyis pa/ /rnam pa sna tshogs las la gzigs/ /'di ni kun tu bde gyur nas/ /slar yang lha yi tsoganas su mchisatunye/ /chos kyi rgyal po gshin rjes (shekyang glu/ /mthong nas ngo mtshar smras pa ni/ /'di ni rdzu 'phrul che ba ste/ /'di ni tshe rabs snga lus tshe/ /ci ⑩ltar sku gdung brgya mang pos/ /ston pa'i mchod rten mdzes pa ltar/ /so sor 'brang ba mgul btags pas/ /de yi lus ni de 90—375

bzhin mdzes/ /de nas sems can dmyal ba'i srung ①ma gnod sbyin ②de dag gis chos kyi rgyal po gshin rje la 'di skad ces smras so/ /lha ci ②ltar na 'di so sor 'brang ba zhes bgyi/ chos kyi rgyal pos smras pa/ gang gi 0tshig rnams so sor dran/ /de ni ngan 'gror 'gro mi 'gyur/ /so sor 'brang ba bsgoms dupa yi / /shes rab can de bde 'gror ⑥'gro/ /sems can ⑦dmyal ba'i srung ⑧ma khyed⑨ske/ /rab tu rgyas dang ldan par dong ⑩/ /der ni sgang 0bu mthon po la/ /lha rnams kyis ni bskor ba ltos/ /de mthong tsosems can thams cad la/ /byams pa'i sems su 'gyur bar gyis/ /de nas gshin rje'i mi de dag de 8nyid kyi nub mo rgyas pa dang ldan par ④dong ngo / /de 8tshe der ni de dag gis/ /rgyal po'i pho brang 8nye ba na/ /sgang bu de yi khor yug na/ /'bar ba gcig gis gang bar mthong / /mi ro zhig gi ⑩mgul pa na/ /so sor 'brang ba btags pa'ang mthong ske/ /lha dang klu dang dri za dang / /gnod sbyin srin po 8mi 'am cis/ /kun nas 'khor bar bskor nas ni/ /bla na med pa'i mchod pa byed/ /de la gnod sbyin de dag gis/ /so sor 'brang ba'i sgang ⑩zhes btagasaX/ /de nas gnod sbyin de dag gis chos kyi rgyal po gshin rje'i nges pa de rtogs te 0slar log nas lha khyod kyis tsobaka' stsal pa bzhin no zhes rgyas par brjod do/ /de skad ces smras ma thag tu tshig 0de smras pa'i tha ma la sems can chen po de sems can dmyal ba'i lus de bor nas sum cu phyirtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi nang du skyes so/ /rgyu des na sngon so sor 'brang ba'i lha'i bu zhes bya'o/ /bram ze chen po des na sngon chad yongs su shes so/ /de'i phyir so sor 'brang ba chen mo 'di gdon mi za bar gzung ⑤bar bya'o/ /yi ger bri bar bya/ bklag par bya'o/ /cho ga 90—376

bzhin du rtag tu lus la btags ①nas bcang bar bya ste/ de rtag tu sdug bsngal zhing nyam ②thag pa thams cad las yongs su thar bar 'gyur/ ngan 'gro'i 'jigs skrag ①pa thams cad las rgal bar 'gyur ro/ /glog gis 'gyel bar byed mi nus so/ /glog gis ci dultar mi nus zhe ⑤na/ bram ze chen po sngon yongs su shes te/ grong khyer chen po'i mchog shing kun rdzib yin/ tshong dpon chen po dri med dung zhes bya ba nor mang ba/ gser shin tu 'byor pa/ mdzod dang —/ bang ba kun tu ⑦gang zhing phun sum tshogs pa zhig gnas te/ ded dpon zhes bya bar grags so/ /de nas ded ⑧dpon chen po des ⑨gru bo che de rnyed ⑩nas/ rgya mtsho chen por zhugs pa dang / nya mid ⑩rnams kyis de'i gru de bzung nas/ rnam par gzhig par 'dod pa'i klu rnams kyang 'khrugs te/'brug sgra chen po sgrog go/ /glog dang skar mda' yang gtong ngo / /rdo rje'i lce 'bebs par yang bshams so/ /de nas tshong pa de dag sdug bsngal chen pos sems non to/ /klu 'khrugs ⑩pa chen po de dang / glog dang skar mda' dang /rdo rje'i lce 'bebs pa dang / nya mid de dag gis kyang gru bo che bzung 8bar mthong nas 8ku co'i sgra chen po bton te④/ de dag lha khyad par can rnams la gsol ba btab kyang 'ga' tsam yang de dag gi dpung gnyen du ma gyur to/ /de nas de dag tshong dpon sems rab tu brtan pa'i gan du song nas/ de dag gis snying rje rje skad du tshig 'di skad smras so/ /sems can chen po khyod kyis bdag cag bskyab ⑩cing 'jigs pa chen po las thar bar mdzad du gsol/ de nas ded dpon chen po sems brtan pa blo gros chen po des tshong pa 'khrugs 4)par gyur pa rnams la tshig ()'di skad smras so/ /ma 'jigs ma 4)'jigs tshong pa 90—377

rnams / /khyed cag brtan par dengs yo)shig dang / /khyed rnams sdug bsngal chen po yi/ /rgya mtsho che las ngas bsgral phyilo/ /de nas yid ni brtan gyur nas//tshong pa rnams kyis tshig 'di smras/ /sems can chen po 'di ci lags/ /bgegs bral myur du bka' stsol cig /blo gros chen po khyod kyi mthus/ /bdag cag ji srid 'tsho ba'i tshe/ /ye shes che ba'i bdag nyid gsungs/ /slad na khyod kyis ci zhig bgyi/ /de nas 'gron ①mang bdag po yis/ /de dag la ni tshig 'di brjod/ /nga ④la so sor 'brang ba yi/ /rig pa chen por ⑤grags pa yod/ /gnod byed thams cad sel bar byed/ /stobs chen pha rol gnon byed pa/ /des ni rab tu sdug bsngal ba'i/ /'jigs pa che las ngas bsgral 9lo/ /de nas ded dpon chen po ⑦de'i tshe rig pa'i rgyal mo chen mo ⑧'di bris nas rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la btags 6)pa dang / rig pa'i rgyal mo chen mo so sor 'brang ba chen mo ⑩rgyal mtshan gyi rtse timo la btags tsom thag tu nya mid tu)de dag thams cad kyis gru bo che de me lce gcig tu gyur pa chamathong ngo / /de nas klu de dag byams pa'i yid kyis de dag gi drung du lhags nas mchod pa bya bar bshams 8so/ /nya mid 8de dag kyang rig pa'i rgyal mo tu 7so sor 'brang ba chen mo 'di nyid kyi mthus tshig nas byer te zhi bar gyur to/ /'gron tu po phal po che de dag kyang 6)klu chen po de dag gis rin po che'i gling chen por phyin par byas so/ /de ltar na ye shes dang ldan pa rig pa chen mo so sor 'brang ba chen mo ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis so )byin gyis brlabs pa ste/ bram ze chen po rgyu des na 'di rig pa chen mo zhes grags so/ /'di ni nges par rgyal mtshan gyi 0rtse mo la btags te bcang bar bya'o/ /rlung dang / grang ba dang / dus ma yin pa'i sprin dang /90—378

glog dang / lce 'bab pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar ①byed do②/ /lha dang /mi dang / lha ma yin gyi 'thab pa dang / rtsod ③pa las yongs su thar bar byed do / /sbrang bu mchu rings ④dang / sha sbrang dang / byi ba dang / srog chags kyi rigs gzugs rnam pa sna tshogs lo tog ⑤ma rung bar byed pa thams cad mthu med cing rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /ri dgas yidang / bya dang / gcan gzan ⑦gnod par sems pa (kyithams cad rnam par 'jig 6)par 'gyur ro/ /me tog dang / 'bras bu dang / lo ma dang / nags tshal dang / sman dang /lo tog la sogs pa thams cad 'phel bar 'gyur te/ rab tu bro zhing zhim pa dang 'jam par 'gyur ro/ /legs par yongs su smin par 'gyur ro/ /ha cang char che ba dang / char dkon pa'i nyes pa rnams yongs su mi 'byung ngo / /char dus su 'bab cing / dus ma yin par ⑩mi 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /yul de'i klu chen po gang yin pa de dag kyang dus dus su char gyi rgyun legs par 'bebs so/ /yul gang na rig pa'i rgyal mo so sor 'brang ba spyichen mo zhes bya ba 'di spyod pa'i 7yul der sems can de dag gis shes par bya ste0/ spos sna tshogs dang / bdug pa sna tshogs dang / me tog sna tshogs kyis mchod cing bste ④stang byas la/ tshon sna tshogs kyis dkris te rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la btags nas glu dbyangs dang / rol mo sil snyan byas te/ bskor ba byas nas lha rnams dang / brgya byin dang / tshangs pa la sogs pas 8sems can chen po de dag gi bsam tripa ji lta ba bzhin du/ re ba yongs su rdzogs par byed par 'gyur ro/ /cho ga ci hunyelta ba bzhin du de lta de lta bur 'grub ste/ bu pho 'dod na'ang khye'ur tunya'agrub/ /mngal na 'dzin pa dam par 'gyur/ /mngal na bde 90—379

bar skye ba 6)dang / /mngal nas bde bar btsas par ②'gyur/ /mngal na dus bzhin skye ba dang / /dus bzhin rab tu btsas par ②'gyur/ /cis dumangon zhe na/ bram ze chen po snga ma bzhin du de nyon cig /yul ma dug dhā du'adi nyid na/ rgyal po lag brkyang zhes bya ba de bu med par gyur gto/ /ci'i phyir lag brkyang zhes bya zhe nadu/ rgyal po de btsas ma thag tu lag pa brkyang ⑨nas ma'i nu zho la bzung ste/ nu zho ngoms ngoms su 'thungs so/ /nu ma de gnyis la reg ma thag tu gser gyi kha dog tu gyur to/ /dus kun tu nu zho 'phel tsobar gyur to/ /rgyu des na rgyal po lag brkyang zhes bya bar btags par gyur to/ /gzhan yang gang gi tshe rgyal po'i gan du skye bo slong 0mo pa 'ongs pa de'i tshe rgyal po de lag pa g.yas pa bar snang la brkyang tsob dang / rgyal po byang chub sems dpa' de rgyu des sangs rgyas la mngon par dad pa'i lha rnams kyis lha'i rin po che khyad par 'du 'phags pa gser dang / nor bu rnams kyis lag pa gang bar byed do/ /rgyal po des kyang skye bo slong ④mo pa lhags pa rnams la rab tu byin no/ /bsams ⑩pa tsam gyis slong tsomo pa thams cad la 'dod pa bzhin du bde ba phun sum tshogs pa thams cad byin normya/ /bu pho 'dod pa'i phyir lha rnams la mchod pa dang / bsti stang tu)cher byas kyang bu pho ma rnyed nas de sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dag gi 6)mchod rten rnams kyi mdun du bsti ( )stang bya bar brtsams te mchod pa dang / bsti (rdu1stang chen po byas so/ /sbyin pa yang byin to 2/ /bsnyen gnas la yang nye bar gnas so/ /bsod nams chen po byas so/ /sbyin pa chen po de dag kyang mi zad par byin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na / bram ze chen po sngon byung ba yul ma ga dhā zhuge'adi nyid na/ gyad yul zhes bya 90—380

ba'i grong khyer ku sha'i byutshong dus chen po'i mchog na bcom ldan 'das rin chen mang gi bstan pa la zhugs pa tshong dpon chos kyi blo gros zhes bya ba chos la ①sems pa'i ②sems can chen po zhig gnas pa de sems can thams cad la snying rje chen po'i sems nye bar gzhag dunas rig pa chen po ④so sor 'brang ba ⑤'di nyid las brtsams te chos ston to/ /de nas mi dbul po zhig gis chos de thos nas tshong dpon chen po de la tshig 'di skad ces bdag jo bo'i khab tu gla bgyi'o/ /chos kyang nyan toskyo/ /gang gi tshe bdag gis cung zad rnyed par gyur pa de'i tshe bdag chos la mchod pa ⑦bgyid do/ /zhes smras nas/ de'i khyim na las byed cing chos kyang nyan to/ /dus gzhan zhig na de la tshong dpon des di na phyir cig 6)byin pa dang / des sems can thams cad yongs su bskyab ⑩pa'i phyir byang chub kyi sems bskyed nas/ sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas nas rin po che yisnyim pas so sor 'brang ba 8chen mo la phul nas sbyin pa'i 'bras bu chen po 'dis skyebadag dang sems can thams cad kyi yidabul ba kun tu gcod par gyur cig ces smon lam de skad 8kyang btab bo/ /rgyu des na sbyin pa de yongs su mi zad ⑩par gyur to/ /de ltar bsod nams mngon par 'du bya ba rnam pa mang po rnam pa du ma byas te/ lha rnams kyang mchod pa nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bar du mchod pa dang / de'i tshe gnas tshugatsang ma'i ris kyi lha rnams kyis rmi ltas 8su bstan te/ 'di skad du/ kye rgyal po chen po so sor 'brang ba ⑪chen mo zhes bya ba kun nas me lce'i phreng ba rnam par dag pas rgyas pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu zhu phyag rgya 0dang / snying po gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i gzungs chen mo rig pa'i rgyal mo cho ga las ji skad 'byung ba bzhin du cho ga bzhin 'bris la 90—381

btsun mo dam pa smyung (7)ba byas la/ cho ga bzhin du lus la btags na khyod bu pho yod par 'gyur ro zhes bsgo'o/ /de nas rgyal po de ②sad de mtshan mo zad nas rtsis dang / yi ge'i 'bru dang / rgyu skar ( tadang / gza' rnam par 'byed pa'i bram ze rnams bsogs nas cho ga las 'byung ④ba bzhin du rgyu skar gyi rgyal po rgyal gyi nyin par btsun mo dam pa lus shin tu legs par bkrus te/ smyung ⑤ba byas nas rig pa'i rgyal mo chen mo so sor 'brang ba 6)'di yang cho ga bzhin du bris te thobatsun mo dam pa'i mgul (nyedu btags po)so/ /sangs rgyas kyi mchod ⑩rten rnams la mchod pa chen po byas so/ /rin po che khyad par can du ma ⑩yang sems can rnams la sbyin pa byin no/ /de nas zla ba dgu lon pa dang bu pho gzugs bzang ba/ mdzes pa/ blta na sdug pa/ kha dog bzang po rgyas pa mchog dang ldan pa zhig btsas so(rte/ /bram ze chen po de ltar shes nas rig pa'i rgyal mo chen mo de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis mchod pa/ 'dod pa thams cad du 'gro ba/ gzhan gyis mi thub pa so sor 'brang ba tsochen mo dkon mchog ces grags so/ /'di ni rtag tu brgya byin gyi gtsug gi nor bu yin no/ /gang gi tshe lha'i dbang po brgya byin lha ma yin rnams dang / g.yul chen po 'gyed par 'dod pa de'i tshe 'di nyid kyis go cha byas nas spyi gtsug tu btags te/ lha ma yin thams cad pham par byas/ pha rol pham par byas nas dge ba dang /bde bas bde bar lha'i grong khyer du 'jug steng)/ lha ma yin thams cad kyis mi tshugs pa yin no/ /bram ze chen po de ltar na sems dang po bskyed yipa nas bzung 7ste/ rig pa'i rgyal mo chen mo nyu so sor 'brang ba ()chen mo 'di 'chang ba'i byang chub sems dpa' la bdud thams cad kyis mi tshugs so(nye/ /'di gang 90—382

gis ①lus la btags (gyisam/ mgul du btags ①pa de de bzhin gshegs pa 541thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs (5)par 'gyur ro(ye/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' thams cad yang dag par bsrung (7bar 'gyur ro(kye/ /lha dang / mi dang /rgyal po dang / rgyal po'i blon (1)po dang / bram ze dang / khyim bdag thams cad ⑩kyis kyang rtag par rgyun du phyag bya zhing mchod pa dang / rim gro byed par 'gyur ro/ /lha dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang —/ lto 'phye chen pos rjed yonyecing mchod par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das bdud kyi dpung rab tu 'joms pas kyang de la sems can chen po zhes gsungs so8ske/ /nad thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /de la yams kyi (snyend dang /gnod pa thams cad dang / nad 'go ba thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /sems can chen po de mya ngan thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /de la lha thams cad kyang rtag par rgyun du sung beb dang / skyob 8pa dang sbed par byed par 'gyur ro/ /des gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i gsang sngags chen po'i snying po 'di dag bris te/ rtag par rgyun du lus la gdags shing bcang bar bya/ rtag par rgyun du yid la bya'o/ /kha ton du bya'o/ /bsam pa thag pa nas bsgom tshapar bya'o/ /sdug bsngal ba dang / rmi tsho lam ngan pa dang / ltas ngan pa dang /bkra mi shis pa'i dngos po thams cad rnam tshonapar 'joms 16par 'gyur ro/ /bde ba phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'di ni gsang sngags kyi gzhi las thams cad byed pa dge ba rnams rdu mogrub pa'o/ / tarya thā/(lha.oṃ a mṛ sro te/ a mṛ ta ( ci ba re/ ba re ba re snye/ pra ba re rinasabi shud dhe/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ a mṛ ri gta bi lo ki ni garbhe tsu so rakṣa ṇi/ ā 28karṣa ṇi shushāsbyi hūm̐ 90wa 383

phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ gzhan gyis 6)mi thub pa'i snying po'o/ /oṃ bi ma le bi pu ②le/dza ①ya ba gore/ dza ya bā hi ni/la sa mṛ (7te/ bi ra dze/9) rgyu hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ bha ra bha ra/ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra/ ind+ra zho)ya ba la bi sho dha ni/ ru ru tsa le hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ nye ba'i snying po'i rig pa'o/ /oṃ ma ṇi dha ri/badzre ṇi ma hā pra ti po)sa re hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ rab tu gsang yiba'i snying po'o/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' ma lus pa thams cad thabs cig (1tu 'dus nas sgra dbyangs gcig tu gzungs kyi gsang sngags kyi gzhi 'di dag gsungs so(ge/ /gsang sngags 'di dag ni rig pa'i rgyal mo chen mo so sor 'brang ba tu chen mo'i snying po dang go cha'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ④phyag rgyas btab pa'o/ /'di thos par yang rab tu dka' na yi ger bri snyib dang /tshig tu 'don pa dang / klog pa dang / 'chang ba dang / gzhan la yang ston pa lta ci smos te/ de ni tsosangs rgyas la bya ba byas par rig par bya'o/ /'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis rab tu bsngags tu 7so/ /rjes su yi rang ngo //lung bstan 6)to/ /so sor 'brang ba 7chen mo gzhan gyis (rtemi thub pa'i gzungs (27'di mchog tu dkon pa'o/ /so sor 'brang ba nurtechen mo (rte'adi'i ming thos par yang shin tu dka' ste/ gzungs chen mo (ste'adi ni sdig pa thams cad byang bar byed pa/ stobs che ba/ pha rol gnod ( snyepa/ gzi brjid zho 9che ba/'od che ba/ yon tan brjod par che ba/ mthu che ba/ bdud kyi ris kyi lha thams cad rnam par 'joms ( 9)par byed pa/ bag chags kyi mtshams (2)sbyor ba'i bdud kyi zhags ri 7pa gcod pa/ pha rol gyi sngags dang / phyag rgya dang /dug dang / byad dang / g.yengs 5 )byed kyi sbyor ba dang / gnod 51par bya ba 90wa 384

dang glu/ drag shul du spyod pa (1)gnod pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams rnam par sbyong bar ②byed pa/ sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang /'phags pa'i tshogs thams cad la mchod pa dam pa byed par mngon par dga' ba rnams la yongs su skyong ①bar byed pa/ theg pa chen po 'dzin pa dang / yi ger 'dri ④ba dang / klog pa dang / tshig tu 'don pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang ske/ nyan pa dang / 'chang bar mngon par brtson pa rnams 5la yongs su skyong stiba'o/ /bram ze chen po so sor 'brang ba chen mo rig pa'i rgyal mo 'di ni sangs rgyas kyi rtsibyang chub kyi bar du yongs su rdzogs par byed pa ste/ gang du yang thogs (kyepa med do/ /ston pa dgra las rgyal ba nga ci 95lta ba bzhin 1 du thams cad du yang mchod pa chen po thob par 'gyur ro/ /cis 31mngon zhe na/rig pa chen mo yo bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad rnam par 'joms 15par byed pa 'di ni sngon yongs su shes te/ gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rgya cher rab tu bzhad yipa'i zhal nor bu dang / gser dang / rin po che 'bar ba'i 'od zer snang ba mngon par 'phags pa'i rgyal po dang po mngon par sangs rgyas nas byang chub kyi snying po ga la ba der gshegs te/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis 15bsngags pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor 7bar bzhed pa de'i tshe/ bcom ldan 'das de la bdud g.yog dang bcas pa bdud bye ba khrag khrig brgya 1 stong du mas bskor ba gzugs sna tshogs mi sdug pa/ 'jigs 'jigs ltar 'dug pa/sgra mi snyan pa/ bdud kyi yul rnam pa sna tshogs rnam par 'phrul par byin gyis 18rlob pa/ mtshon cha rnam pa sna tshogs kyi char 'beb pa19tsho/ mngon par sprul nas 90—385

lhags te/ phyogs bzhi nas bskor nas ①bar chad bya bar brtsams pa dang /de nas bcom ldan 'das rgya cher rab tu bzhad ②pa'i zhal nor bu dang /gser dang / rin po che 'bar ba'i 'od zer snang ba mngon par 'phags pa'i rgyal po yud tsam zhig cang mi chagasung bar bzhugs nas rig pa'i rgyal mo so sor 'brang ba ①chen mo 'di yid kyis lan bdun brjod do/ /rig pa'i rgyal mo chen mo so sor 'brang ba chen mo du'adi brjod ma thag tu skad cig de nyid la bdud sdig can de dag thams cad kyis ⑥bcom ldan 'das kyi ba spu'i bu ga re re nas skyes ⑦bu go cha gyon pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya dustong du ma ral gri dang / dgra sta dang /zhags pa dang / tho ba dang / rtse gsum pa 'bar ba lag na thogs pa sha stag yonyetshig 'di skad du gang dag bcom ldan 'das la gnod par byed pa/ bdud gnod 0sems can rnams zung shig zung ⑩shig /cings shig chings shig /gnod par sems pa thams cad rab tu choms ⑩shig /gnod sems can dang /gza' dang / bgegs dang / log 'dren thams cad kyi srog phye mar gyis shig /ces 'dzer cing 'thon tu)pa mthong ngo / /de nas bdud de dag thams cad byams pa'i ral gris yimangon par btul nas/ la las ni bslab pa'i gzhi rnams bzung ba yinas/ la las ⑩ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan pa'i bar du'o/ /de la mthu che ba gzhan dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i ba spu'i bu ga nas 'thon 1)pa'i skyes bu chen po de dag mthong nas/grong khyer de nyid du spa gong tunyebar gyur/ rdzu 'phrul yongs su nyams shing tu)spobs pa dang / stobs dang rtsal ( )med par gyur cing / mda' gzhu dag kyang chag nas byer ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 0bgegs dang / log 'dren 90—386

dang ske/ bdud sdig can thams cad rab tu bcom nas sangs rgyas gzhan ①dag ji lta ba bzhin du chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor to②/ / brgal to ①pha rol tu rab tu gshegs so/ /bram ze chen po de ltar na rig pa'i rgyal mo so sor 'brang ba 0chen mo stobs kyi drag shul che ba/ rdzu 'phrul gyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dran pa tsam gyis ④sems can (6)bsam pa yongs su dag pa rnams dang / gzhan gnod sems can rnams tho)kyang sdug bsngal ba dang / 'jigs skrag ④pa thams cad las ⑨yongs su thar bar byed do/ /bram ze chen po de lta bas na rtag par rjes su dran pa'i yid la byed pas yid la bya'o/ /yi ger bris te rtag tu lus la gdags shing bcang bar bya'o/ /cis 7mngon zhe na/ snga ma bzhin du nyon cig rgyal po tshangs 7pas byin gyi yul na grong khyer chen po 'phags rgyal du mi zhig la nyes pa byung nas rgyal po tshangs pas byin gyis gshed ma'i mi rnams yonyel khyed (nyekyis mi 'di sod cig ces bsgo'o/ /de nas gshed ma'i mi de 8dag gis rgyal pos bsgo ba bzhin du mi de khrid de ri sul zhig tu phyin nas/ ral gri shubs ⑫ nas phyung ste bsad ⑩par bshams pa dang / de'i tshe mi des rig pa'i rgyal mo ⑩so sor 'brang ba chen mo 'di yid la dran no/ /yi ger bris nas lag pa g.yas pa la btags nyugeshing 'dug go/ /sems can chen po nyu7de'i rig pa 'di'i mthus/ral gri me lce gcig tu gyur nas rdul gtor ba bzhin du dum bu 63 dum bur gyur to / /de nas gshed ma'i ( —stemi de ( rtedag gis nges pa 'di rgyal po la zhib tu bsnyad do / /de nas rgyal po de rab tu 'khrugs nas/ kye mi 'di nunyedag sa phyogs zhig ( sten gnod sbyin gyi phug yod de/ de na gnod sbyin brgya 'astong mang po sha rjen za ba gnas kyis ⑩/ der khrid de 'or 4)cig ces bsgo'o/ /de nas mi de gshed ma tso90—387

mi de dag gis gnod sbyin gyi phug der bor ro/ /gnod sbyin gyi phug der bor ma thag tu de nas gnod sbyin de dag thams cad yid dga' ste/ mi sha bza'o snyam du brgyugs pa dang / de dag gis so sor 'brang ba 'di'i mthus mi de la me lce gcig tu gyur pa'i bya'od 'phro bar ②rab tu 'bar bar mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang thams cad dngangs dunas rang rang gi lus tshig par yang dumathong ngo de nas gnod sbyin de dag ngo mtshar duskyes nas mi de khrid de sgo'i phyi 0rol du bzhag nas bskor ba bya bar brtsams pa nas gshed ma'i ⑦mi de dag gis rgyal po la zhib tu bsnyad pa'i bar du snga ma bzhin no/ /de nas rgyal po cher 'khrugs te rngams ⑧nas gal te de ltar na khyed cag deng ⑨la mi 'di chings te/ chur bor cig ces bsgo ba dang / gshed ma'i ⑩mi de dag gis 7khrid de chur bor ro/ /mi de chu ⑫bor ma thag tu mi de ji ltar thang la 'dug pa bzhin du chu med par gyur to/ /chings ma 8de dag kyang ④dum bur chad do/ /rgyal pos de skad thos pa dang /de nas rgyal po ngo mtshar du gyur nas mig tshugs su bltas te/ /e tsoma'o mi 'di ngo mtshar to/ /'di la rgyu ci zhig yod snyam ⑩du rnam par rtog par gyur to/ /zhes smras so/ /de nas rgyal po des mi de ⑩bkug ste/ kye mi khyod ci zhig shes zhes de skad smras so/ /mi des smras pa rgyal po chen po rig pa chen mo so sor 'brang ba chen mo 'chang ba las gzhan ni ci yang ma 'tshal te/ lha de ni de'i mthu ⑫lags so/ /rgyal pos smras pa ngo mtshar tsoche'o/ /rig dupa chen mo dge bar gsungs 3—/ /'chi bdag nan tur 'armongs byed pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis dubyin gyis brlabs/ /sems can thams cad rab tu sgrol/ /nad dang sdug bsngal (stethar bar byed/ /rig pa chen mo dugazi brjid tsoche/ /dus min 'chi 90—388

las rab tu sgrol/ /nad chen rnams 6)ni zlog ②byed pa/ /mgon po thugs rje can gyis gsungs/ /de nas rgyal po rab tu dga' ba'i yid kyis gerig pa'i rgyal mo chen mo duso sor 'brang ba chen mo la mchod nas mngon par bstod do/ /mi de yang blon thabs byin te/ rang gi gnyen gyi mdun du grong khyer gyi gtso bor dbang bskur to/ /bram ze chen po de ltar na rig pa'i rgyal mo so sor 'brang ba chen mo 'dis thams cad du yang mchod pa chen po rnyed do/ /sems can gnod sems can thams cad kyis kyang 'gal bar mi bya'o/ /de ltar na rig pa'i rgyal mo chen mo 'di yongs su shes te/ gang du yang thogs pa med do/ /de lta bas na gdon mi za bar rtag tu lus la gdags shing bcang bar bya'o/ /bram ze chen po skar ma bzang po la cho ga legs ⑤par byas te/ rig pa'i rgyal mo 'di bri bar bya'o / /de nas bram ze chen po de yid rab tu dga' nas bcom ldan 'das la yan lag lngas phyag 'tshal te zhus pa/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das rig pa'i rgyal mo chen mo du'adi'i cho ga ni ⑦ji ltar bgyis te bri bar bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bram ze chen po khyod nyon cig /sems can kun la snying brtse'i ⑤phyir/ /ngas ni khyod la bshad par bya/ /gang gis ⑨sems can bde byed cing / /nyam nga ba yi tshulas las 'grol/ /nad rnams las kyang thar bya dang te/ /bud med sbrum mar 'gyur ba dang / /sems can rnams kyi dbul ba yi7ske/ /rma rnams gso 8bar bya phyir ro/ /bsnyen gnas dag la gnas gyur nas//rgyu skar rgyal du shes pa la/ /sangs rgyas mchod la brtson byas te/ /byang chub phyir ni sems kyang bskyed(nye/ /snying rjes kun tu brlan sems dang / /byams pa dang yang ldan gyur nas/ /rtag tu sems can thams cad la④/ /phan pa bskyed ⑫90—389

pa brtson par bya/ /tsandan dang ni gur gum dang / /gla rtsir ①bsres pa'i chus bkrus te/ /bdug pa rnams kyis bdugs pa yiphyi/ /gos gtsang rnams ni nibago bar bya/ /sa dang lci ④ba bsres pa yis⑤/ /de yi 'og tu dkyil 'khor bya/ /bum pa gang ba bzhi bzhag ste/ /lnga pa dkyil 'khor dbus su gzhag /de la rin thang chen po yi/ /me tog bdug pa spos rnams gsol/ /tsandan spro stika de bzhin du/ /a ka 9)ru dang du ruskal/ /sha kha ra dang lnga sbyar ba'i/ /bdug pa cho ga bzhin du 'bul6nye/ /cho ga ci ⑩bzhin dus bzhin bya/ /lo tog ⑩rnam pa sna tshogs rnams/ /me tog 'bras bu sa bon dang / /spos rnams 8kun gyis ⑫legs par brgyanatso/ /mar dang sbrang rtsi 'o ma dang / /nas thug 'o thug la ⑫sogs pas/ /gtor ma'i bum pa dgang bar bya/ /mtshan ma ⑩shin tu bkra shis pa / /phyogs bzhi rnams su gzhag ⑩par bya/ /lnga pa dkyil 'khor dbus su gzhagatunye /spos kyis ()bkang ba'i por pa ( ri )rnams/ /grwa bzhi dag tu gzhag ⑥par bya/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni 'gram logs su/ /seng ldeng phur bu bzhi btsugs la/ /tshon skud kha dog sna lnga yis/ /'khor bar dam du dkri ( )bar bya/ /gal te bdag 'grub 'dod na ni/ /bram ze (nyede ltar byas nas bri/ /kha zas dkar po zos nas su/ /phan par 'dod pas ( 9byi bar bya/ /dar ram ras sam gro ga 'am/ /ci yang rung ba gzhan la bri/ /bud med dag la bu 'dod na/ / gi'u wang gis ( steni legs par bri/ /dbus su khye'u zhig bris nas ni/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /de bzhin rin chen gang ba'i snod/ /lag pa g.yon na thogs par (7bya/ /padma rab tu rgyas gyur cing ( rte/ /brgyan pa la ni de 'dug bya/ /nor bu do shal gser dag dang / /rin chen sna tshogs rnams nu)90wa 390

kyis brgyan①/ /gdul bar shin tu dka' ba bri/ /grwa bzhi dag tu ri bo bri/ /gal te bde bar 'tsho 'dod na/ /rab tu bsgrims te de ltar bri/ /bye brag tu ni skyes pa rnams/ /gur gum gyis ni bri bar bya/ /de yi dgos pa 'dod pa rnams / /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tsom (mimed/ /padma gnyis sam yang na ①gsum / /bzhi 'am yang na lnga bris te/ /padma la ni phyag rgya'i mtshan/ /rnam pa sna tshogs gzugs su grili/ /de bzhin du ni padma rnams/ /ze bas ( kun tu 'khor bar bri/ /padma 'dab ma rab rgyas la/ /sdong bu dar gyis bcings par briphyo / /padma la ni rtse gsum pa/ /zur brgyad la ni dar dpyangs ⑦mi/ /de bzhin padma dgra star (shebacas/ /'dab ma brgyad dang ldan par bri/ /padma 6)bcas pa'i tshural gri bri/ /padma de ni dkar por nyunyabya/ /padma'i steng du dung yang bri / /thams cad du yang rgyas par bya/ /kun tu cho ga'i mtshan ma rnams/ /mkhas pa dag gis bri bar bya/ /gang la gnod pa'i sems 'byung ba/ /byis pa'i gzugs rnams mi bri'o/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis brgyan pa yi8/ / lha yi ⑫gzugs ni bri bar bya/ /dge slong phyir ni rdo rje 'chang / /gnod sbyin bsdigs 8par brtson par bri/ /rgyal po tsochen po bzhi rnams kyang / /ngos bzhi rnams su bri bar bya/ /bram ze'i phyir ni dbang ldan no/ /rgyal rigs la ni dbang phyug che / /dmangs rigs tsophyir ni rtag zhi ba/ /khyab 'jug legs par bri bar bya/ /rje'u rigs phyir ni rnam thos bu/ / lha yi ⑩dbang phyug dbang po bri/ / khye'u yi (3phyir ni skye dgu'i yibadag /blo gros chen po bri bar bya/ /sngo bsangs (3 mdog ni gang yin pa/ /de yi ched du khros pa bri/ /dkar mo'i phyir ni grags ldan pa(ye/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i gzugs su bri/ /sbom mo'i phyir ni nor bu bzang 4)/ /90—391

rab tu bsgrims te bri bar bya/ /skem mo'i phyir ni gang ba bzang / /rang 'byung nga yis bstan ①par bri/ /sbrum ma'i phyir ni nag mo ②che/ /tshangs lha rnams kyang bri bar bya/ /gzhan yang ci ③ltar cho ga las/ /gong du bshad pa bzhin du bri/ /las kyi cho ga mthong nas ni/ /rab tu bsgrims te de bzhin bri/ /rtag tu mgul dudu btags ⑤na ni/ /de ni bde bar 'gyur ba yin/ /rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i padma la / /yid bzhin nor bu 'bar ba bri/ /padma'i snying por zhags pa dang / /de bzhin 'khor lo'ang bri bar bya/ /padma'i steng du rdo rje dang / /padma'i snying po dutho ba bri/ /cho ga las ni 'byung ba bzhin/ /padma'i steng du mdung thung bri/ /cho ga las ni brjod pa bzhin/ /nor bu thams cad rtse mo 'bar/ /'od zer 'phro bas rgyas pa dang / /dar gyis bcings ⑦pa bri bar bya/ /klu mgo gdengs ⑧ka dgu yod la/ /nor bu rab tu 'bar ba dang / /de dag kun gyi snying gar ⑨yang ske/ /rdo rje gnas par bsgrims te bri/ /rgyal po rnams phyir stobs can dang ske/ /ded dpon mkhas pas rtag tu bri/ /rig pa 'dzin pa thams cad kyiyi/ /rig pa'i lha mo rnams 7kyang briX/ /zla ba nyi ma rgyu skar bcas/ /sgra gcan mjug rings gza' brgyad 'bri/ /cho ga bzhin du nges bris khyil/ /blo gros ldan pa'i mis bsrel 8na/ /za ma dang ⑩ni ma ning yang / /bu pho rnyed par 'gyur ba yin / /'dis ⑩ni thams cad 'grub par byed/ /shis shing sdig pa zhi bar byed / /rang byung 8gi ni bka' tu)bzhin du/ /gnas kyi dam pa thob par 'gyur//'jig rten 'di na'ang mchog tu bde/ /'jig rten pha rol shin tu bde/ /sum cu ( )rtsa gsum gnas la sogs/ /lha gnas de yi gnas su 'gyur/ /'dzam gling bzang zhing nyams dga' bar/ /khyad par can rigs 0grags pa dang / /90—392

rgyal rigs khyad par 'phags pa dang / /bram ze khyad par 'phags rnams su/ /bdag nyid chen po de skyes te/ /rtag tu rig dang bde bar 'gyur/ /so sor 'brang ba ①'chang ba'i mis/ /bsod nams thob pa gang yin pa/ /sangs rgyas dag ni thams cad kyisal/ /bsod nams phung po brjod mi nus/ /sems can dmyal ba'i sgo rnams bcad/ /mtho ris sgo rnams rab tu phye/ /bde ba phun sum tshogs pa dang / /blo gros chen por 'gyur ba yin/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpas ①kyang / /rtag tu dbugs ni 'byin par 'gyur/ /lus ④kyi bde ba phun sum tshogs/ /stobs kyang che bar 'gyur ba yin⑤/ /rgyal bas ji zhuskad gsungs ⑦pa ltarani/ /'khor los sgyur ⑨bar 'gyur ba yin/ /mi dang lha rnams dbugs 'byin te/ /gnod par sems pa 7skrag ⑩par byed/ /gang phyir rig pa legs bshad pa/ /de ni ring por tsomi thogs so/ /de ni mtshon gyis mi tshugs te/ /dug dang mes kyang tshugs mi 'gyur/ /dus min 'chi ba'i sdig pa yang / /de las thag ni ring du 'gro/ /rnam pa kun tu nyan pa 'am/ /mthong ba dang ni reg 8pa'ang rung / /'byung po gdon dang rtsod pa skyidang / /chu dang me yis 8'jigs pa dang / /gcan gzan ⑩sprul dang seng ge dang / /klu ⑩dang nad ni mi bzad rnams/ /gang la rig pa legs bshad pa/ /de la de dag kun mi 'byung / /de dag sems can kun mchog 'gyur/ /bdud rnams kun gyis thams cad du/ /mchod par 'gyur ba'i 'os yin te/ /yang dag bshad kyis mnyan par byos/ /rig 8pa'i rgyal mo so sor 'brang ba chen mo'i cho ga rdzogs sotso// //de nas sems can thams cad la snying brtse ba'i phyir rig zhu sngags 'chang ba 90—393

bsrung 6)ba'i tshul gyi ②cho ga bshad par ②bya'o/ /bsrung ④ba'i cho ga gang zhig gis / /dngos grub chen po 'grub 'gyur ba/ /gang dang gang du bsrung 0byas nayi / /don yod 'gyur te the tshom ⑨med/ /'jigs med rims kyis mi btab ste(gyi / /gza' rnams thams cad zlog ⑨par byed/ /rgyu skar rnams kyang mthun ⑩par 'gyur/ /las kyi lu gu rgyud kyang gcod/ /bza' 7nyes pa dang sgom 8nyes dang —/ /dgra tshogs kun gyis byas pa dang / /gnod par bltas tsodang bri nyes dang ske/ /byad dang gang yang mi bzad dang / /phye ma sngags kyis btab pa dang / /dug 'thung ba tsodang sbyar ba'i dug /gang zhig bsrung byab 'chang de la/ /de dag thams cad zhi bar 'gyur/ /gang zhig rig tsolas 'gal byed pa/ /yan lag rnams la rnam par smin/ /so sor 'brang ba'i dmod ⑩bsdigs na/ /pha rol 'khor ni mi bzad tsodang / /'jigs pa chen po dgra yi rnams/ /de dag thams cad rab tu 'bros/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mkhyen pa dang / /byang chub sems dpa' des pas bsrung ⑩/ /nyan thos dka' thub chen po dang / /rang sangs rgyas kyis bsrung zhu bar 'gyur/ /gzhan yang rnam pa mang po yi lha klu rdzu 'phrul chen po rnams/ /'di la rtag tu brtson byed pa/ /de la sung 0ba byed par 'gyur/ /rig pa yi ni rgyal mo 'di/ /thos pa tsam gyis mi mchog rnams / /kun tu 'jigs pa med 'gyur zhes/ /thub pa yis duni de skad gsungs / /rmi (nyalam ngan dang ngan byas dang / /gang yang nad 'go ④mi bzad dang —/ /nad kyis ( nyebatab dang nad chen gyis/ /gang dag zin cing khrag skyugs ( 9dang / /gzhan yang rnam pa mang po'i nad/ /'bras dang shu ba skem po dang / /gang yang gnod pa mi bzad pas/ /mi yi skye dgu ( )zin pa dang / /mi rnams ma 90—394

rungs yo)bya ba'i phyir/ /mchog ②tu mi bzad chaganod byed rnams/ /bsrung ④ba stobs chen ga la bar/ /de dag thams cad mi 'byung ngo / /'di las bsrung ⑤ba byas nas duni/ /bcings pa dag kyang grol bar 'gyur/ /so sor 'brang ba bris pas kyang / /gal te dus kyi zhags pa yis/ /bzung ⑦nas gshin rje'i gnas khrid pa/ / de yi ①tshe ni rnam par 'phel/ /gang zhig tshe ni zad gyur tam / /zhag bdun na ni 'chi 'gyur ba/ /yi ge bris pa'i bar tsam gyis/ /'tsho bar 'gyur 6)te the tshom 0med/ /cho ga bzhin du bsrung byas pa'am7/ /yang na thos pa tsam gyis kyang / /kun tu dge ba thob par 'gyur/ /'dod pa bzhin du bde bar 'tsho/ /gang dag sum cu 8rtsa gsum lha/ /stong phrag drug cu ⑫rtsa brgyad dang / /bye ba khrag khrig phrag brgya ④dang / /brgya byin mdun 8nas 'gro ba kun/ /sems can de la bsrung ba'i phyir/ /phyi bzhin 'brang zhing tsoganas par byed/ /'jig rten skyong ba bzhi po dang / /lag na rdo rje stobs chen yang ske/ /rig pa'i rigs ni brgya dag dang / /lhan cig rtag tu srung ⑩bar byed//zla ba yid bzang 8nyi ma dang / /tshangs pa khyab 'jug dbang phyug che/ /nor bu bzang dang gshin rje dang / /stobs kyi lha ni stobs chen dang / /gang ba bzang po dpal chen dang / /'phrog ma bu dang bcas pa dang / /lnga 'dzin pa dang lngas rtsen phyedang / /smin drug bu dang tshogs dbang dang / /lha mo chen mo ⑥dpal can dang / /rnam thos bu dang dbyangs can dang / /dung can dang ni me tog go0/ /de bzhin ral du pa gcig pa dang / /gnod sbyin chen po dudapal yon can/ /rtag tu sung tsob byed par 'gyur/ /za ma rnams kyi bu yang skyedabya/ /mngal na gnas pa bde bar byed/ /de ni ji srid 'tsho ba'i bar/ /'di ni 90—395

bsrung hu)ba chen por 'gyur/ /'jigs med 'thab mo'i (migayul 'gyed par/ /dpa' bo rnams la rtag rgyal sbyin/ /chos la nges pa'i lha rnams la/ / 'dis ni snang ②ba sbyin par byed/ /sdig pa rnam par gzhig pa'i phyir/ /gus par byed de bris ④na ni/ /de bzhin gshegs dang de bzhin du/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'ang blta (gebar 'gyur/ /de yi grags pa rnam par 'phel/ /bsod nams dang ni tshe yang 'phel/ /nor rnams dang ni 'bru dag kyang / /'byor par 'gyur te the tshom ⑥med/ /bde bar gnyid kyis log pa dang / /bde bar rab tu sad par 'gyur/ /'byung po'i tshogs rnams thams cad dang / /dgra kun gyis kyang mi rdzi'o⑦/ /g.yul 'gyed pa yi nitshe na yang / /rig pa sgrub ⑨pa byas na ni/ /bsrung ⑩ba bla na med pa 'dis/ /rtag tu rgyal bar 'gyur bar byed/ /bde bar rig pa sgrub 0byed cing / /de la bgegs ni 'byung mi 'gyur/ /de yis 8bsam pa thams cad 'grub/ /dkyil 'khor kun tu zhugs pa yin/ /skye ba dag ni thams cad du/ /de ni myur du dam tshig shes/ /rgyal ba'i yon tan 'dzin pa'i phyir/ /de ni yid brtan 'os yin no/ /bkra ⑩shis thams cad rab tu rdzogs8/ /bsam 8pa thams cad grub par byed/ /'di ni bris pa tsam gyis tsokyang ske/ / bde ba lho thams cad 'byor par 'gyur/ /bde bar 'chi ba'i dus byas nas/ /mtho ris su ni 'gro bar tunye'agyur/ /'thab pa dang ni rtsod ⑩pa dang / /'gyed rdzu )pa mchog tu mi bzad par/ /'jigs pa kun las grol 'gyur te / /rgyal bas ji skad gsungs bzhin no/ /skye ba rnams su skye ba na0/ /rtag tu skye dran the tshom dumed/ /rgyal po btsun mo 'khor bcas pa/ / 'di yi ⑫dbang du 'gyur ba yin/ /'jig sgosterten dge bar grags pa yin/ /rtag tu thun 90—396

mong 'gyur ba yin/ /de ni kun la sdug par 'gyur/ /lha dang mi ni gang yang rung ske/ /nyin dang mtshan rnams rtag par yang ①/ /de la srung ba byed par ②'gyur / /yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gsungs/ /sngags tshig 'di dag 'dir ①'grub bo/ /sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa 'phel bya'i phyir/ /de la gus pas duphyag 'tshal nas/ /sems can kun la snying brtse'i phyir/ /da ⑤ni nga yis brjod par bya / /rig pa zhugazi brjid chen po ⑦'di/ /stobs chen pha rol gnon pa steni/ /rdo rje gdan la thug ⑨pa yis/ /'di ni gsungs ma thag tu yang / /bdud dang bdud kyi ris ⑩rnams dang / /gza' dang log par 'dren pa dang / /bgegs rnams ji snyed yigang yod pa/ /thams cad de yi 8mod la 'byeratso/ /tarya thā/oṃ gi ri gi ri/ gi ri ṇi yigi ri ṇi/ gi ri ba ti/ guṇa 8ba ti/ ā kā sha ba ti/⑩ā kā sha bi shud dhe/ sarba 0bā pa yonyeji ga te4)/ ā kā shagu /ga ga na ta 0le/ā kā sha bi tsā ⑥ri ṇi/ dzā duli ta shi kha re/ /ma ṇi musti gtso /kha tsi ta mo ⑤li dha re/ su ke she/ me ke she su ṣa phyesu bste0/ su ne tre/ su brje/⑤ su baṇḍi ⑦gi rigu / a tī te/ a nubarnye/0 a nā ga te/ pratu6rje na mdu/na maḥsarbe aṣān/ buddhā nān dzwa li ta'u/ te dza sā nadu/ burnye/ su budhe/bha ga ba ti/ su rakṣa ṇiñtsa/ su kṣa medu)/ su pra bhe/ su da 9me/ su rādhe0/ba re brtebya/ bha ga ba ti(7/ bha dra 9ba ti/ bha dre 9su bha dre'u/ bi ma le/90—397

ni mirnya yo)ri/ tri ⑧lo ka /da ha ni/ tri nilo ka ā lo ka kā ④ri/ tree dhā tu ka byā dub lo ki ⑥ni/ badzre/ pa ra shu/ pā sha /muṅga ra/ khan/ shaṃ kha / tsa kra / tri shu la/ tsin tā 9)ma ṇi/ ma hā biṅgā dha ri ṇil/ bdag thams cad du gnas thams cad na gnas pa na ma rungs pa thams cad dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa'i 'jigs pa thams cad dang / nad thams cad dang / 'jigs pa thams cad las bsrung 5)du gsol bsrung ⑩du gsol/ badzre badzre badzra tshonyupa ti/badzra 'apā ṇi dha re/ hi li hi li/ mi li mi li/ ki li ki li/ tsi li tsi li 8/bi li bi li/ si li si li/ ba ra ba ra/ ba ra deyi/ sarba 8tra/ dza ya la ba dhe swā hā/ sarba pā payi/ bi dā zhunari ṇi turnyeswā hā/ sarba tu)tra/ sarba ( )byu dhi ha ra ṇi 0swā hā/ sarba tra/ sarba sha tt+waṃ zhu1bha ya ha ra ṇi nusriswā hā/ sarba zhugebha ra ṇi swā hā/zhugeswa cistir bha ba tu māṃ zhus hā/ shārnyi ka ri 4)swā hā/ puṣṭi ()ka ri swā hā/ ba la bar dha ri ṇi swā hā/ dza ya tu/ dza ye dza yinu )/ dza ya bha pu nyeti/ ka ma le/ bi ma le/ bi pu le swā hā/ sarba sa ta thā ga ta munti zhunyes hā/ oṃ bhu ri ma hā shārnyi dbyuswā hā / o bhu ri bhu ri/ badzra ba ti(snye/ sarba ri cigata thā ga ta ṣṭṛ 6 phod ya/ pū sunyer ṇi/ ā yuḥsan dhā (nyer ṇi4 )/ ba la ba la/ ba ༄nyal ba ti/ dza ya bi rdzu(nya/ hūm̐ hūm̐/phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ bram ze chen po gang la la zhig gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku rig 9pa'i gsang sngags kyi gzhi'i 4 3gzungs 'dis yongs su bsrung gegeb byas shing yongs su bskyab pa dang / yongs su gzung 4nyab dang / yongs su bskyang ba dang / zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ba dang / dbyug pa spang ba 5)dang /mtshon cha spang ba byas na/ de tshe yongs su zad pa las kyang rnam par 'phel te ring du bde bar 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /dran pa phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ro/ /90wa 399

bskrad ①pa tsam dang / rdo rjes ⑧byabs pa tsam gyis ①dus ma yin par 'chi ba dang / nad chen po las yongs su thar bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i nad thams cad kyang rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyun ring du na dub la yang byabs 0pa tsam gyis rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /nyin gcig bzhin du kha ton du bton dun shes rab chen por 'gyur ro/ /gzi brjid dang / stobs dang / brtson 'grus dang /spobs pa phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ro/ /de'i sdig pa dang las kyi sgrib pa gdon mi za bar myong bar 'gyur ba thams cad kyang ma lus par yongs su zad par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas dang / byang chub ⑦sems dpa' dang / lha dang /klu dang / gnod sbyin la sogs pa thams cad kyang de'i lus la gzi brjid dang /stobs dang / brtson 'grus snon ⑧par 'gyur ro/ /dga' ba chen dhipo mang bar 'gyur ro/ /bram ze chen po tha na rig ⑩pa chen mo'i gsang sngags kyi gzhi 'di dud 'gro'i skye gnas su song ba ri dgas ⑩dang / bya'i rna lam du thos na yang de dag thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur na/ so sor 'brang ba chen mo'i gzungs 'di la dad pa'i rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo'am/ dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/⑫dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen tsoma'am/ rgyal po'am/ rgyal po'i blon po 'am/bram ze'am/ rgyal rigs sam/ de las gzhan pa 'ga' zhig gis lan cig ⑫thos te/ thos nas kyang dad pa chen po dang / gus pa dang / lhag pa'i bsam 8pas yi ger 'dri 'amatshu/ yi ⑩gor 'drir tso'ajug gam/ 'chang ngam/klog gam/ yid drag pos sgom pa 'am7/ gzhan dag ( )la yang 0rgya cher duyang dag par rab tu ston pa lta ci smos te/ bram ze chen po de la dus ma yin par 90wa 400

'chi ba brgyad rnam ①pa thams cad du 'byung du ②ma dogs shig /de'i lus la nad chen po rnams 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de'i lus la mes mi tshugs/dug gis ma yin/ mtshon gyis ma yin/ dug sbyar mas ma yin/ byad kyis ma yin / g.yengs ②byed kyis ma yin/ sngags kyi las kyis dum yin/ phye ma'i ⑤sbyor bas ma yin/ yan lag na bar mi 'gyur/ rims kyis btab par mi 'gyur / klad 0pa na ba dang / nyin gcig pa dang / nyin gnyis pa dang /nyin gsum pa dang / nyin bzhi pa dang / nyin bdun pa'i ⑨rims rnams de'i lus la 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /dran bzhin du bde bar gnyid log cing dran bzhin du bde bar sad par 'gyur rodu/ /yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po yang 'thob ⑨par 'gyur ro/ /lan cig 7gis chos dang ldan pa'i dbang phyug chen po thob par 'gyur ro/ /de gang dang gang du skye ba'i skye ba de dang der skye ba dran par ⑩'gyur ro/ /sems can thams cad kyang byams par 'gyur ro⑩/ /phyag bya ba'i gnas su 'gyur ro6)/ /sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas kyi 'gro ba thibs po kun dang / yi dgas ④su skye ba rnams las yongs su thar bar 8'gyur ro/ /ji ltar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor sems can thams cad la snang bar byed pa de bzhin du 'od zer gyis snang ba byed par 'gyur ro/ /ji ltar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bdud rtsi'i mthus sems can thams cad kyi lus sim par byed pa de bzhin du/ chos kyi bdud rtsis ⑩sems can thams cad kyi rgyud sim ⑩par byed par 8'gyur ro/ /rig pa'i rgyal mo chen mo so sor 'brang ba chen mo'i mthus de la gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / 'byung po dang / yi dgas dang yi/ sha za dang / skem byed dang / brjed byed dang / mkha' 90—401

'gro ma dang / gdon ma rungs ①pa thams cad dang / bgegs dang / log ②'dren la sogs pa thams cad kyis gtse ①bar mi nus so/ /de dag 'ongs na yang rig pa'i rgyal mo chen mo 'di dran par bya'o/ /'on kyang 'di lta ste/ rig pa'i rgyal mo chen mo so sor 'brang ba chen mo 'di nyid kyi mthus ma rungs pa de dag thams cad rig dupa 'dzin pa'i dbang du 'gyur te/ bsgo ba bzhin du ngag nyan ①par 'gyur ro/ /de la dgra'i 'jigs pa mi 'byung ngo / /dgra'i tshogs thams cad dang / rgyal po dang / rgyal po'i blon po chen po rjodang / bram ze dang / khyim bdag rnams kyang 'gal bar byed par mi 'gyur ro/ /tha na gsad ⑦par 'os pa zhig la gshed ma ⑧mi rnams kyis mtshon gdab par gzas ⑨na yang mtshon rnams rdul bzhin ⑩dum bu dum bur chag par 'gyur ro/ /de ⑩nyid kyi dus na de la chos thams cad mngon sum du 'gyur ro/ /de'i dran pa'i stobs kyang cher 'gyur ro/ /'di ni srin po 'joms pa'i mchog /gtsang zhing sdig pa 'jig par byed/ /dpal du byed cing blo yang byed/ /yon tan thams cad rnam par 'phel/ /'di ni bkra shis thams cad byed/ /bkra shis ma yin rnam par 'jig /rmi kyilam bzang po rmi 'bar byed/ /rmi 8lam ngan pa rnam par 'jig /rig pa mthu stobs chen mo 'di/ /skyes pa bud med bsrung ⑩ba'i mchog /'brog yidagon dang ni mya ngan las/ /rtag tu de yi mod la 0thar/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bka' bzhin du/ /'dod pa dag ni kun kyang rnyed/ /lam las lam gol zhugs na yang / /rig tu)pa 'di ni rjes dran na/ /myur du lam dang bza' ()ba dang / /btung ba mchog kyang rnyed par 'gyur/ /lus dang ngag dang yid rnams kyis/ /mi dge mang po gang yang rung / /tshe rabs snga mar 90—402

ci byas pa/ /de dag thams cad byang ①bar 'gyur/ /dran pa dang ni 'chang ba dang ske/ /'dzin dang yi ger 'dri ②ba dang / /tshig tu 'don tam aklog pa dang ske/ /bzlas brjod byed dam gzhan ston na/ /de ni ring por mi thogs par//chos kun rtogs par khong du chud/ /de ltar chos kyi ro rnyed ④na/ /sdig pa rnams ⑤ni zad par 'gyur/ /yid kyis ci dang ci 'dod pa/ /dgos pa thams cad grub 6)par byed/ /'chi ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad dang / /rgyal po dang ni me dang chu/ /glog dang de bzhin kun 'joms las/ /'di ni de las skyob par 'gyur/ /rig pa 'bum du bzlas na ni/ /g.yul 'gyed pa dang rtsod ⑦pa dang ske/ /gang yang gcan gzan 6)ma rungs pa/ /de dag thams cad 'bros par 'gyur / /sangs rgyas kun gyis gsungs pa yi/ /dngos grub mchog gi rig pa 'di / /brjod na sgyid 6)lug mi 'gyur bar/ /byang chub tshogs rnams rdzogs par byed/ /bdag dang gzhan gyi don bsgrubs 7phyir/ /gnas kyi rnam pa thams cad du/ /rig pa 'di la sbyor na ni/ /'dod pa'i las rnams gang yin pa / /bsgrim tunyemi dgos par rig 'di las/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom tunyemed / /nad pa rnams ni gso bya ba/ /da ni rab tu bshad par bya/ /sa dang lci ba bsres pa yis/ /dkyil 'khor gru bzhi lham par bya/ /tshon tu gyi phye ma sna lnga yis/ /dkyil 'khor sdug gur 7bri bar bya/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis 8cho ga bzhin / /bum pa gang ba bzhi yang bzhagatso /de la me tog sil mas gtor/ /bdug pa mchog 0gis bdug par bya/ /sems can chen po gdul ba'i phyir/ /gtor ma yi yini las kyang bya/ /snga ma bzhin du me tog spos/ /cho ga bzhin du 'di la mchod/ /dar gyis bcings pa'i mda' bzhi 6)yang / /dkyil 'khor grwa du 90—403

bzhir gzugs par bya/ / de yi ②'og tu nad pa yang / /dri zhim spos kyis ②lus bskus te/ /gtsang ma'i gos rnams bskon nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor dbus su gzhag ①par bya/ /de nas dushar phyogs kha bstan 0te/ /rig pa 'di ni brjod par bya/ /lan bdun bzlas brjod byas nas su/ /mkhas pas de la bsrung bar bya/ /de nas nad pa'i don gyi phyir/ /lan grangs nyi shu rtsa gcig tu / /rig pa 'di ni brjod byas na/ /des ni dund kun zhi bar 'gyur/ /de nas gtor ma'i bum pa lasti/ /lan bdun legs par sngags kyis dugadab/ /de nas bshos kyang sngags ⑨gdab ste/ /gtor ma me tog cho ga bzhin/ /de ltar lho phyogs ngos su ni/ /lan bdun kho nar gtor bar bya/ /nub phyogs su yang bdun nyid de/ /byang phyogs su yang de bzhin no/ /'og dang steng du'ang lan bdun te/ /bsrung ⑩ba byas par 'gyur ba yin/ /bram ze dam pa de lta bur / /byas na 0sdug bsngal kun las grol/ /skyob pa shākya seng ge yis8/ /bsrung tsob 'di ni yang dag bshad/ /'di ma gtogs 8par khams gsum na/ /bsrung tshuba'i rig ⑩pa gzhan med do/ /de ni mi 'chi mi gos te/ /nad kyis mi btab mi sdug min/ /sdug pa dang ni 'bral mi 'gyur/ /rig pa 'di ni bdag gi 0lus/ /shin tu bsgom 8pa byas na ⑩ni/ /de la 'chi bdag tshogs kyis mchod / /chos kyi rgyal po dam pa gshin rje yang / /gus dang bcas pas de la mchod par 'gyur/ /skad cig nga yi dusems dmyal 'di byos la/ / lha yi ⑫grong khyer song zhes smra bar dhi'agyur/ /de nas dugazhal med khang pa rnam tsomang pos / /rdzu 'phrul chen po lha gnas bzang por 'gro/ /de ltar der ni lha mi gnod sbyin dang / /srin po rnams kyis de la rtag mchod 'gyur/ /lag na rdo rje 90—404

gnod sbyin dbang / /bde sogs bdag po dbang po dang / /'phrog ma dang ni lngas rtsen ①dang / /'jig rten skyong ba 'phrul chen dang ②/ /zla ba nyi ma rgyu skar bcas / /mchog tu mi bzad gza' rnams ②dang / /gang yang klu chen thams cad dang / /lha dang de bzhin drang srong dang / /lha min dumakha' lding dri za dang —/ /mi 'am ci dang lto 'phye che/ /bsrung duphyir rtag tu 'brang bar byed/ /gang gis durig pa stobs chen mo/ /rdzu 'phrul chen mo bris nas ni/ /shes rab can gyi ⑦lag la gdags/ /mchod pa chen po 'thob par 'gyur/ /rtag tu phun sum tshogs par 'ong / /'phags pa rig pa'i rgyal mo so sor 'brang ba chen mo rdzogs sol// //rgya gar gyi ⑨mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī tshul dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ⑩ba bande 8ye shes sdes zhus te/ skad gsar chad 8kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa④/ slar yang lo tsā ba gzhon nu dpal gyis chos rje chag lo'i rgya dpe dang bstun nas zhus dag par bgyis so8// //90—405
