༄༅ga /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā shī ②ta ba nī gsu tra/ bod skad du/bsil ④ba'i tshal chen po'i mdo/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten mkhas pa rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /gang gis thog mar rig sngags rnams//'dzam bu'i gling du gsungs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas dpal la phyag 'tshal lo da ltar byung dang 'das pa dang / /ma byon sangs rgyas gang lags pa/ /thams cad la yang bdag phyag 'tshal/ /de dag kun la skyabs su mchiX/ /'khor lo bskor ⑥ba bla ④med pani/ /mar me mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos kyi rgyal po 'od mdzad ⑨pa/ /thams cad gnon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thams cad mkhyen pa grags ldan pa/ /padma'i bla la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spyan dang ldan pa skyob mdzad pa//rab 'thor ⑩gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ded dpon bla na med pa po/ /grags pa'i bla la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyi zla lta bur 'od mdzad pa/ /bde mdzad de la 90—421

phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos kyi me long ston pa po/ /don gzigs la yang phyag 'tshal lo / /dul ba'i tshul khrims 'jigs med pa/ /rgyal zhes bya la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtshan mchog sum cu 6)rtsa gnyis ldan/ /skar rgyal la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpal ldan pa/ /rnam par gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'od can gzi brjid ldan pa po/ /gtsug tor can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /legs par mchod pa grags ldan pa/ /thams cad skyob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdud dpung rab tu 'joms pa po②/ /log dad sel la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bram ze dpal dang ldan pa po/ /gser thub de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can kun la thugs brtse ba/ /'od srung ①de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shākya seng ge 'od mdzad pa/ /gser mdog can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ser sna med pa thugs rje can/ /byams pa la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas kun la'ang ⑤phyag 'tshal te⑤/ /de dag la ni bdag skyabs mchi/ /gang dag gis yini chos bstan pa/ /sangs rgyas kun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang la sangs rgyas gus mdzad pa'i/ /chos la bdag ⑦ni phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang la phul na don che ba'i(kye/ /dge 'dun la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyan thos shes rab mchog gyur pa/ /shā ri'i bu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdzu 'phrul can gyi 6)mchog gyur pa/ / mod gal yibu la phyag 'tshal lo(nye chos kyi gtam la 'jigs med pa/ / kā kyā'i 7bu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyan thos sbyangs pa'i (snyemachog gyur pa/ /'od srung yil yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyob pa yi ni dbang gyur pa/ /kauṇḍi 8rgya la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mang du thos pa rig sngags ⑩'chang / /kun dga' bo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lus ngan dang ni yul 'khor srung tu / /mig mi bzang tunyedang 'phags skyes po/ /phyogs bzhi kho (nyer khor ( kye 90—422

yug gi/ /rgyal chen rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnod sbyin rnams kyi 4)sde dpon mchog /nyi shu brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /pha ma mkhan po slob dpon dang —/ /lha rnams la ni ②phyag 'tshal lo/ /de dag la ni phyag 'tshal nas/ /rig sngags 'di ni grub gyur cig /gang ③gi don du bya ba yili/ /don de bdag la grub gyur cig /sdang bar sems shing gnod byed pa'i/ /mi ma yin rnams gud du deng ⑤/ /gnod par 'dod pa glags lta (6)rnams/ /ston pa'i bstan pa mnyan par gyisaX/ /byams par dusems shing phan 'dod pa'i/ /mi ma yin pa gang yin rnams/ /thams cad 'dus shing mthun po)gyur nas/ /'jig rten skyong ba rnams kyi ⑩tshig /ston pas rjes su yi rang ba/ /dga' ba'i sems kyis tunyebadag la nyon/ /bsil ba'i tshal gyi mdo chen po 'di ni rgyal po chen po bzhi'i bsrung ()ba chen po ste/ 'khor bzhi po rnams la yongs su khyab pa'o / /gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / dri za dang / klu dang / nam mkha' lding dang / gsang ba pa (snyedang / 'byung po dang / grul bum dang /yi dgas yidang / srul tsopo dang / sha za dang / lha ma yin dang / rlung lha dang —/ skem byed dang / 'tshe rgyu dang / smyo byed dang / mi 'am ci dang /gyen du rgyu dang / rgyu ba dang / 'dun pa dang / ngan byed dang / gzi byin 'phrog pa dang / brjed 0byed dang / rims drag po dang / rims zhag gcig pa dang / 0zhag gnyis pa dang / zhag gsum pa dang / zhag bzhi pa dang —/ mi dang mi ma yin pa/ snang bar sems pa dang / glags lta ba dang /mi phan par 'dod pa dang / gnod par byed pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi phyi/bstan pa la mi dga' ba dang / gnod par 'dod pa dang / phan 90—423

par mi 'dod pa dang / bde bar mi 'dod pa dang / grub pa dang / bde bar mi 'dod pa dang / 'khor bzhi po rnams la ①mi dga' ba dang / gnod par 'dod pa dang / phan par mi 'dod pa dang / bde bar mi 'dod pa dang /grub pa dang / bde bar mi 'dod pa dang / ming 'di zhes bya ba la mi dga' ba dang / gnod par 'dod pa dang / phan par mi 'dod pa dang / bde bar mi 'dod pa dang / grub pa dang / bde bar mi 'dod pa gang yin pa de dag ni bsil ba'i tshal gyi mdo chen po 'di thos nas dengs shig /skrag ②par gyur cig / dngangs par gyur cig /①kun tu dngangs par dugyur cig /'di na ma 'khod ①cig / ngan sems dang gnod sems kyi dumago bo tshal pa bdun du 'gas ta thore/ gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / dri za dang / klu dang ske/ nam mkha' lding dang / gsang ba pa ⑧dang / 'byung po dang / grul bum 6)dang / yi dgas tsodang / srul po dang / sha za dang / lha ma yin dang —/ rlung lha dang / skem byed dang / 'tshe rgyu dang / smyo byed dang / mi 'am ci dang / gyen du rgyu ⑩dang / rgyu ba dang / 'dun pa dang / ngan byed dang —/ gzi byin 'phrog pa dang / brjed byed dang / rims drag 8po dang /rims zhag gcig pa dang / zhag gnyis pa dang / zhag gsum pa dang / zhag bzhi pa dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa sdang bar sems pa ma yin pa rnams dang /glags mi lta ba dang / phan par 'dod pa dang / gnod par mi 'dod pa dag ⑫sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la dga' ba dang / don du 'gyur bar 8'dod pa dang / phan par 'dod pa dang / bde bar 'dod pa dang /grub pa dang / bde bar 'dod pa dang / ming 'di zhes bya ba la dga' ba 90—424

dang ske/ don du 'gyur bar 'dod pa dang / phan par 'dod pa dang / bde bar 'dod pa dang / grub pa dang / bde bar 'dod pa gang yin pa de dag ni bsil ba'i tshal gyi mdo chen po 'di thos nas 'dir 'khod cig /ma skrag cig / ma dngangs par ①gyur cig / kun tu dngangs par ma gyur cig② /mi 'jigs pa kho nar gyur cig /ming 'di zhes bya ba'i don dang / phan pa dang /bde chab dang / bde bar gnas par bya ba'i phyir/ bsil ba'i tshal ④gyi mdo chen po 'di bdag ⑤gis bstan cing bshad par bya'o/ /de la bsil ba'i tshal gyi mdo chen po bdag la bsrung 0ba ni 'di yin te/ sgyud ya the dan/ kha ṭi ⑦kha ṭini/ khargyu ⑨se/ pa la ka ba sheyi/ ro ga bha dri ga ṇi/ hi li hi li/ du ma te / kṛtta ⑩ti/ a dza ṭi/ ka tha ri/ ma sā ra kulpe/ sa madhe na/ tsa tub shi/ yo dza na sha ta/ ādma tsorakṣa/ a na ⑩ti kra ma ṇi/ sarba bi ④te ṭha ke bhyaḥtson mo bha ga ba 0te/ bud dha su/ sid rgyas mant+ra pa 4)tā/ da ra du bi btso/ brahma ṇi/ ma na du swā hā/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa tu)dus gcig tshun/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na/ dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal 'jigs su rung ba skyi bung zhes byed pa na 0/ dge slong stong nyis tshubargya lnga bcu'i dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang thabs cig 0tu bzhugs so/ /de nas rgyal po chen po ④bzhi tsolus ngan dang / yul 'khor srung tsodang / mig mi bzang tsodang / 'phags skyes po bu dang bcas/ blon po dang bcas/ 'khor dang bcas/ mngag gzhug pa dang bcas/ pho nya dang bcas/ g.yog 'khor dang bcas pa kha dog 'phags pa dag phyinam phyed na lhags nas gros mthun ( )par dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i ⑥ tshal du dong ste/ rang bzhin gyi 0kha dog dang 90—425

mthus 'od chen pos snang bar byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas lan gsum bskor ba 6)byas nas thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das 'ba' zhig la phyag 'tshal zhing phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /phyogs gcig tu 'khod nas rgyal po chen po bzhis bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pas bstod pa/ 'jig rten mkhas ②pa rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /dpa' ③chen khyod la phyag 'tshal ④mo/ /gi dhitam khyod kyis gang mkhyen pa/ /de ni lha rnams ma 'tshal to/ /lan gnyis lan gsum du yang rgyal po chen po bzhis bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad nas bstod pa/ 'jig rten mkhas pa rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /dpa' 0chen khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gi ⑦tam khyod kyis gang mkhyen pa/ /de ni lha rnams ma 'tshal to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po chen po bzhis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das yul dang 'phrod lags sam/ 'tsho ba dang ldan lags sam/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das sku bde lags sam/ snyun ⑤mi mnga' lags sam/ nyam nga ba ma mchis ṇisam/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sku la gnod pa mi mnga' lags sam/ bcom ldan 'das la gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / dri za dang / klu dang / nam mkha' lding dang / gsang ba pa ⑩dang ske/ 'byung po dang / grul bum dang / yi dgas tunyedang / srul po dang /sha za dang / lha ma yin dang / rlung lha dang / skem byed dang / 'tshe rgyu dang /smyo byed dang / mi 'am ci dang / gyen du rgyu dang / rgyu ba dang / 'dun pa dang / ngan bgyid dang / gzi byin 'phrog pa dang / brjed byed dang /rims drag po dang / rims 8zhag gcig pa dang / zhag gnyis pa dang /90—426

zhag gsum pa dang / zhag bzhi pa dang / mi dang / mi ma yin pa ①snang bar sems pa ②dang / glags lta ba dang / phan par mi 'dod pa dang / gnod par bgyid pa dag las gnod par bgyid par sems pa lta ma mchis lags sam/de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po chen po bzhi la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /kye rgyal po chen po dag nga la ni thams cad yod de/yul dang yang 'phrod/ 'tsho ba dang yang ldan/ lus kyang bde/ nad kyang med / nyam nga ba yang med do/ /kye rgyal po chen po dag nga'i lus la ni gnod pa yang med do/ /kye rgyal po chen po dag ngas ni 'jig rten ⑧lha dang bcas pa/bdud dang bcas pa/ tshangs pa dang bcas pa/ dge sbyong dang / bram zer bcas pa'i skye dgu ④dang / lha dang mir bcas pa'i nang na gang de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la gnod pa ⑤byed par sems pa yang dag par ma mthong ngo / /kye rgyal po chen po dag de lta mod kyi/khyod kyi 'khor rnams nga'i yi'akhor la gnod pa byed par sems so/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po chen po bzhis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gsol ba mchis te/de'i ⑦slad du bcom ldan 'das la blta ba dang phyag bgyi ba dang / bsnyen bkur dubagyi ba dang / bcom ldan 'das nyid la zhu ba'i slad du bdag cag bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar mchis lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/btsun pa bcom ldan 'das dgon pa dang / bas mtha'i gnas mal 'di dag na shin tu sdang ba'i gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / dri za dang / klu dang /nam mkha' lding dang / gsang ba pa khyadang / 'byung po dang / grul bum dang /90—427

yi dgas ①dang / srul po dang / sha za dang / lha ma yin dang / rlung lha dang ske/ skem byed dang / 'tshe rgyu dang / smyo byed dang / mi 'am ci dang /gyen du rgyu dang / rgyu ba dang / 'dun pa dang / ngan byed dang / gzi byin 'phrog pa chadang / brjed byed dang / rims drag po dang / rims zhag gcig pa dang / zhag gnyis pa dang / zhag gsum pa dang / zhag bzhi pa dang —/ mi dang mi ma yin pa ①snang bar sems pa dang / glags lta ba dang /phan par mi sems pa dang / gnod par ④bgyid pa dag mchis so/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyi ⑤nyan thos de dag kyang de na gnas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi yinyan thos de dag ni srod dang tho rangs mi nyal bar sbyor ba la brtson par gnas lags so/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das gnod sbyin nam srin po nas gnod par bgyid pa'i bar dag bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa 'di la dad pa'i sems dang ldan pa ni nyung zad cig mchis par bas ⑦so/ /gang dag bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa 'di la ma dad pa'i sems dang ldan pa ni ches mang lags te / de dag ni btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos srod dang tho rangs dul mi nyal zhing sbyor ba la brtson par gnas pa rnams la gnod par bgyid par sems lags te/ de dag dgag pa'i slad du gnod sbyin ma rungs pa ma dad pa rnams dad par bgyi ba dang / dad pa rnams slar zhing dad par bgyi ba dang /'khor bzhi po rnams bde legs dang / bde bar gnas par bgyi ba dang /ma lus par shin tu mnyam par gzhog par 'gyur ba'i slad du/ bsil ba'i tshal gyi mdo chen po 'di bshad par 'tshal lo/ /mi ma yin pa sdang sems can/ /rgyal ba'i bstan la po)ma dad pa/ /de dag bdag gis bzlog par bya/ /rgyal 90—428

chen rnams ni bdag la nyon/ /mdo chen 'di ni thos nas kyang / /mi rnams la ni gnod ma byed/ /gnod sbyin srin po klu rnams dang / /nam mkha' lding dang gsang ba pa/ /phan par mi 'dod gang yang rung / /de dag thams cad bzlog par bya/ /lha dang lha min rlung lha dang / /lha mo'i tshogs kyis ①gang ba yi/ /gzhal med khang mdzes de dag ni②/ /me dang 'dra bar 'od gsal zhing / /nyi ma zla ba'i tshul 'dra ba / /rin chen las byas shin tu snang / /bsod nams byas pa dag gis gang / /rab snang gdon rnams rnam par spangasabya/ /mi la gnod byed gang yin pa'i/ /'byung po grul bum srin po dang / /yi dgas srul dupo de dag gis/ /rmad byung de dag mi mthong ste/ /gzi byin ldan pa'i lha rnams kyi/ /grong khyer du yang de mi 'gro/ /'byung po chen po 'du ba na/ /de yang de dag 'dur mi dbang / /stan yinam yang na chu yang rung / /zas dang skom yang mi dbang ngo / /lus ngan gyi ni pho brang du/ /nam yang de dag 'gro mi 'gyur / /rgyal po chen po rnams kyi tshig /'byung po gang zhig mi nyan pa/ /de yi kha nas khrag dron dag /myur du rab tu 'bab par 'gyur/ / de yi brla (7yi g.yas rol nasaX/ /phol mig dag kyang 'byung 'gyur te/ /de ni nad kyis 'chi 'gyur zhing / /gnod sbyin gzugs kyang ston par 'gyur/ /'jig rten skyong gis bshad pa yi/ /mdo las gang zhig 'gal byed pa/ /'jigs pa thams cad de la 'ong / /mgo bo tshal pa bdun du 'gas/ /rgyal po chen po rnams kyi tshig /gnod sbyin gang dag mi nyan pa/ /'byung po srin po gang yod pa/ /ngan phreng lhag pa'i ngan phreng rnams/ /lcags las byas pa'i 'khor lo yi/ /mtshon cha spu gri'i 6)so 'dra bas/ /gnod sbyin de dag brlag par bya/ /rgyal po 90—429

chen po dpal dang ldan/ /go cha sra zhing mtshon rno la/ /stan rnams la ni 'khod pa dag /shar phyogs na ni yul 'khor srung 0)/ /lho phyogs na ni 'phags skyes po / /nub phyogs na ni mig mi bzang (mi/ /byang phyogs na ni lus ngan po/ /de dag de na 'khod pa yi/ /nye 'khor gnod sbyin 'di rnams gnas/ / seng ge'i ②gzugs dang stag gi gzugs/ /mi sdug pa dag 'gro zhing rgyu/ /glang chen gzugs dang rta yi rtsigazugs/ /kha cig ma he'i gzugs can la/ /dred mo dang ni wa 5)yi gzugs/ /lug dang spyang ki yiphag rgod rnams/ /rna ba 'phyang dang rna bo che/ /rna ba gcig pa tha dad pa/ /sgra cher 'byin cing 'jigs byed pa / /sa gzhi rab tu g.yo bar byed/ /bong bu dang ni rnga mo khyi/ /cha lugs gzhan yang nye 'khor 'khod/ /rgyal po chen po stobs po che/ /de dag phan tshun 'du ba na/ /lha yi shing rta bcas pa yis/ /nam mkha' las ni 'gro bar byed / /gnod sbyin dag gi bdag po yang / /mi rnams la ni bde legs byed/ /stad (7)ya the dan/ ba ka hu mu le/ ha shi ṇa sha shi ṇa/ ba na mu ha le sa mu hā (gyile / u du hā le(9ri/ sa ma tu )tā le/ pra sha ma nī/ rākṣa 1nyes/ a ma nu 〉kyi/bā spre re mi'i/ yakṣa geni/ bā rā mi 8pre ta ma bhi thesnyi/ du ma nu byā/ ma sa pa ta pho ha dha mur nan/ su ti gyi 3)ti/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos bu/ /mi la zhon pa sder bcas pas/ /'di smras nas ni tshub ma langs/ /de bzhin ri yang g.yos par gyuras 7/ /rgyal po chen po rnam thos bu'i rte/ /rin chen shing rta bcas pa na/ /lha dang mi yi (22sgra skad grag snye /rgyal po chen po 'chi zhusteb na/ /dngos epo rnams kyang 'bar bar 'gyur/ /srin po 'dod dgur ( nyabasgyur ba'i gzugs/ /de yi mdun na rgyug par bgyid/ /mi ma yin pa'i gzugs rnams kyis/ /90wa 430

'jigs shing skrag ①pa bskyed (kyepar bgyid/ /che zhing gtum la mi bzad pa / /drag cing ④mthong na mi sdug la(snye/ /spu yang ring zhing sen mo ring / /lag na ral gri tho ba thogs/ /so ni zangs yican 'jigs par bgyid/ /sna che rnga mo stag gi 'dra/ /drag cing lag pa khrag dmar ba/ /yan lag ma tshang phyed tshal 97)lus / /mig ser lus kyang shin tu ser/ /dri ma can la lus skem pa/ / skra brjes (nyelcags kyi mchu can la/ /mtshon cha tshabs cher 'debs par bgyid/ /rna ba gzhu rna yo)gsus po che/ /sbrul gyi gzugs can be'u the snagazugs/ /phag gi gzugs can lto bo che/ /mgo bo che la lag ring ba/ /rna 'phyang ba la nu ma 'phyang tunye/ /de 'dra'i gnod sbyin mang po yi(nye/ /g.yog 'khor dag gis tsho yongs su bskor/ /gnod sbyin bye ba phrag stong rnams/ /de dag ma ni lim log can / /g.yog 'khor de dag lhan cig tu/ /bdag ni phyag 'tshal slad du mchi/ /gi 8tam dpa' bo khyod la ni/ /chos bzhin mthun 8par blta ⑩zhing mchis/ /drag cing rgod la gtum pa dang / /mgo tu 7bo che la skra zhu ring ba/ /mi rnams dang ni ri dgas yidang / /bya rnams gzi byin 'phrog par bgyid/ /me 'bar za dang mang du za/ /mig gcig zhu )pa dang mig ser dang / /sna dang rna ba bcad 521pa dang / /chad pa mang pos bcad (gyepa dang / /mgo ma mchis dang mgo bcad ( —)dang / /lus kyang sgur la gnyer ma gdong / /mig la me 'bar rkang med pa/ /mi rnams 'jigs par bgyid pa ste/ /'phel du staka che la rgod bag can / /de bzhin 'gro zhing rgyu bar bgyid/ /de 'dra'i gnod sbyin mang po yi/ /g.yog 'khor dag gis yongs su bskor/ /gnod sbyin bye ba phrag stong rnams/ /de dag ma ni rkun ma lags/ /g.yog 'khor 3gede dag lhan cig tu/ /bdag ni 90—431

phyag 'tshal slad du mchis/ /gi ②tam dpa' bo 0khyod la ni/ /chos bzhin mthun ③par blta buzhing mchis/ /bdag cag gi ni gnas rnams na/ /shing rta zhes bgyi srin mo mchisadu/ /de la bu pho stobs ldan pa/ /stong phrag bcu yi rjograngs snyed mchis/ /de dag bdag gi g.yog lags te/ /de dag phyag 'tshal slad du mchis/ /gi ⑦tam dpa' bo dukhyod la ni/ /chos bzhin mthun ⑨par blta ⑩zhing mchis/ /bdag cag gi ni gnas rnams na/ / mgrin rings 0zhes bgyi srin mo mchis/ /srin mo shin tu gnag pa dang / /srin mo nag mo zhes bgyi dang / /srin mo rab gnag ⑩rnams mchis te/ /de dag gi 0tam mthun tsopar blta/ /sa yi gnod sbyin bdag nyid che/ /de dag sa stengs tsoganas pa ste/ /g.yog 'khor de dag rnams kyis ⑩ni/ /yongs su bskor te ⑩'dir mchis lags / /de dag kun dang lhan cig 8tu/ /bdag ni phyag 'tshal slad du mchis / /gi ⑩tam dpa' bo khyod la ni/ /chos bzhin mthun ⑩par blta 0zhing mchis / /bdag gi mdun na rgyug pa yi/ /yi dgas 3gnod sbyin srin po rnams / /lus chen shugs kyang drag po ste/ /so yang che la lto bo che/ /rna 'phyang 'jigs pa chen po ste/ /slo phyim rna la rab tu 'phyang / /yan lag drug pa so brtan pa/ /gur gum mdog can tho ba 'dra/ /so yang rtsub ④cing rno ba dang / /mdung thung phyigasal zhing tso'ajigs par bgyidatshu/ /glang chen mgo dang bum sna phyican / /mgo bo stag dang seng ge 'dra/ /lcags kyi so can lcags kyi skra/ /gdon rnams rnam par skrag bgyid pa / /lag na lcags kyi zhu gtun bu thogs/ /lag na lcags kyi tho ba thogs⑥/ /so rnon lag pa ring ba ste/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can lcags kyi mchu/ /mgo bo che la skra g.yengs pa/ /gnag cing mig ⑫90—432

ser sna zhom pa/ /bum pa'i mgrin ①dang mig dmar dang / /mig gcig (5)pa dang lto bo che/ /mchu 'phyangs gepa dang lag gcig pa/ /rkang gcig/ ri dang rkang gnyis pa/ /kha med kha gnyis drag po ste/ /mi rnams rab tu 'jigs par bgyid / /lag na khar ba dbyug pa thogs/ /mdung rtse gsum pa skrag cing 'jigs / /skrag 0cing 'jigs par byed pa ste/ /gdon rnams rnam par skrag bgyid pa/ /skrag par bgyid cing smra bar bgyid/ /sems kyang 'khrul bar bgyid pa ste/ /smyo ⑤bar bgyid cing rmongs par bgyid/ /de nas gzi byin 'phrog par bgyid/ /de dag 'jig rten 'jigs pa ste/ /stobs po che la bsten par dka'/ /stong phrag drug cu yirtsa bzhi po/ /rgyal po chen po'i mdun 9)na rgyug /de 'dra'i gnod sbyin mang po yi/ /g.yog 'khor dag gis yongs su bskor / /gnod sbyin bye ba phrag stong rnams/ /de dag phyag 'tshal slad du mchisal/ /gi dutam dpa' bo khyod la ni/ /chos bzhin mthun khunyepar blta tsho 7zhing mchisal/ /sa ga lngas rtsen 7zla ba dang / /seng ge sde dang rab gnon dang / /ma la sbyin brtson drag po dang / /gang po dang ni nor 'dzin dang / /tsandan dang ni 'dod mchog dang / /sna tshogs sde dang gtor ma len/ /yid bzhin rab 'byor bzhin bzang 8dang / /'dam bu can dang shin tu rgyal/rte/ /'dod pa thams cad 'byor pa dang / /dbang po rgyal ba khyu mchog dang / /nor bu bzang sras rdzogs bzang dang / /'dam bu sa mchog 'dam bu 8dga'/ /khab kyi spu can ring bzang tsodang / /lag mchog skye dgu'i tsobadag po dang / /'dam bu'i rgyud dang mdung 7ring dang / /rig pa stobs can nor bu dang / /'jog po nag po chen po dang / /la 4)ba can dang dre'u dang gnyis/ / klu yi ⑩rgyal po 90—433

sa srung ①bu/ /yan ②lag chen po rdzu 'phrul che/ /nam mkha' lding ni shugs chen ldan / /'dab ②chags kun gyi mchog gyur pa/ /bya yi gzugs kyis mchi bgyid cing ske/ /rgya mtsho kun tu 'khrug par bgyid/ /lha dang lha min dri za rnams/ /'jigs ④par bgyid ⑤dang dge ba'ang rung / /ma dad pa dang dad pa rnams/ /de dag thams cad 'dir mchis te/ /gi ⑥tam dpa' bo khyod la ni/ /chos bzhin mthun 0par blta ⑤zhing mchis/ /'phrog ma zhes bgyi gnod sbyin mo/ /'jigs ⑨par bgyid pa stobs 0chen mo/ / de yi 0bu ni lnga brgya rnams/ /'jigs bgyid gnod sbyin mthu rtsal 8can/ /bdag nyid kyi ni g.yog lags te//de dag phyag 'tshal slad du mchis/ /gi ⑩tam dpa' bo khyod la ni/ /chos bzhin mthun ④par blta 8zhing mchis/ /ma ga dhā tson thams cad mthong / /ka shi ka ni ⑩padma 'chang / /yangs 8pa can na rgyal mchog gnas/ /gyad yul na ni grags 'dzin gnas/ /rgyal po'i khab na ku be yir/ /ser skya'i gnas na ()drag po ste/ /ta ma la na 'byor pa gnas/ /mi ti la na kun tu rgyal/ /ma mo chen du nyamo 'di brgyad ni/ /gnod sbyin rnams kyi sde dpon mchog /rdzu 'phrul chen po skal ba che/ /stobs chen de dag thams cad ni/ /yid dge dad pa'i sems dang ldan/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas la skyabs mchis pas/ /de dag dang ni 'dus nas kyang / /rgyal po chen po stobs (nyachen gyis( )/ /yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas bstan la(ste/ /mi rnams (nyel ni snying brtse'i zho nyamad/ /gnod sbyin 'byung (7 po yi dgas ( sredang / /sdang ba'i gdon rnams bzlog pa dang / /mi ma yin rnams bzlog pa yiyi/ /bsrung (1ba 'di ni legs par bgyis/ /de nas rgyal po rnam thos bu/ /thal sbyar 'dug ste 0smras pa ni/ /khon (nyedang 'jigs pa 90—434

kun 'das pa/ /rnam grol zag pa mi mnga' ba/ /gi yo)tam dpa' bo (9khyod la ni / /chos bzhin mthun par blta ①zhing mchis/ /khyod la lha dang grub pa dang ske/ /bram ze thams cad phyag 'tshal te/ /gnod sbyin bye ba drug khri dang / /bzhi stong dag kyang lhags nas ni/ / kho ra khor goyug yongs bskor nas/ /thal mo sbyar te 'khod gyur lags/ /bdag ni rgyal po rnam 8thos bu/ /byang phyogs skyong bar bgyid pa ste/ /'jig rten mgon po'i nye 'khor du/ /gnod sbyin rgyu skar smyo byed dang / /brjed (6)byed dang ni mi 'am ci/ /skem byed dang ni rims ⑦drag dang / /de bzhin rims nad zhag bzhi pa/ /de dag bdag gis bzlog par bgyi/ /sngad ya the dan/ u ha haṃ/ u ha haṃ/ ma hā haṃ/ u ha ma hā haṃ/ sa la mu dzi/ i lī mi li(kye/ i lī mi lidzi)/ ki lī mi litshu/ tsi ri ṭi/ 0u bhi u tu bhi/ pi ti li yi8/ ma yo ṭa ma li/ ma nanda ye 8swā hā/rgyal po chen po rnam 8thos kyi bu lus ngan lcang lo can gyi bdag po phyogs skyong bar gyur cig /gnod sbyin dang / rgyu skar dang / smyo byed dang / brjed byed dang ske/ mi 'am ci dang / gyen du rgyu dang / rgyu ba dang / 'dun pa dang /ngan byed dang / gzi byin 'phrog pa rnams bzlog ⑩par gyur cig /lha'i nang na lha'i rgyal po nor lha'i bu zhes bgyi ba mchis te/ de la bdag phyag 'tshal lo/ /de yang bcom ldan 'das nyid la phyag 'tshal te/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpa' bo ste/ /kun mkhyen kun gzigs khyod la 'dud/ /yang dag dpa' bo khyod la 'dud / /chos bzhin mthun ⑩par blta tunyezhing mchis/ /de nas rgyal po yul 'khor srung tunye/ /thal sbyar 'dug ste smras pa ni/ /chos kyi zhu )rgyal po 'od mdzad pa / /sangs rgyas dpal la bdag 0phyag 'tshal( nye/ /gi (snyetam dpa' bo ( kye khyod 90wa 435

la ni/ /chos bzhin mthun ①par blta ②zhing mchis/ /gi gtam khyod kyis gang mkhyen pa/ /de ni lha rnams ma 'tshal torjo/ /srin po mthong na rab 'jigs pa/ /stong phrag drug cu phyirtsa bzhi rnams/ / kho ra khor 0yug yongs bskor nas/ /thal mo sbyar te 'khod gyur ⑦lags/ /bdag ni rgyal po yul 'khor srung ⑧/ /shar phyogs skyong bar bgyid pa ste/ /'jig rten mgon po'i nye 'khor du/ /srin po rnams dang sha za dang / /dri za dang ni rlung lha rnamasal/ /de dag bdag gis bzlog par bgyitshu/ /stad ⑩ya the dan/ i ti mi 48/ khu ra ṭi/ phu ⑫ra she8/ ma ti bi ma ni8/ u ma ṇi ⑩akko0/ maṅge/ na48/ a ṭu mi/ba ṭu mi/ ma te6)/ e 0ri ṭi/ pi 0ri ṭi duswā hā/ rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung duphyogs skyong bar gyur cig /srin po dang / yi dgas tsodang / dri za dudang / rlung lha dang / mi 'am ci dang / gzi byin 'phrog pa rnams bzlog tsopar gyur cig /lha'i nang na lha'i rgyal po nor lha'i bu zhes bgyi ba mchis te/de la bdag phyag 'tshal lo/ /de yang bcom ldan 'das nyid la phyag 'tshal te⑦/rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpa' bo ste/ /kun mkhyen kun gzigs khyod la 'dud/ /yang dag dpa' bo ( nyekhyod la 'dud/ /chos bzhin mthun par blta 0zhing mchis / /de nas rgyal po 'phags skyes po/ /thal sbyar 'dug ste dusmras pa ni/ /'jig rten mgon po skyabs mdzad pa/ /'jig rten kun la phan pa mdzad/ /gi ⑥tam dpa' bo khyod la ni/ /chos bzhin mthun par blta 9zhing mchis/ /grul bum yi dgas dusal po rnams/ /stong phrag drug cu lirtsa bzhi rnams/ / kho ra khor duyug yongs bskor tsonas/ /thal mo sbyar te 'khod gyur lags/ /bdag ni rgyal po 'phags skyes po()/ /lho phyogs skyong bar bgyid pa ste/ /'jig 90—436

rten mgon po'i nye 'khor du/ /'byung po rgyu ba gzi byin 'phrog /grul bum yi dgas srul ①po rnams/ /de dag bdag gis bzlog par bgyi/ /myud ya the dan / a le/ i le lel/ ki le ②kyi le le/ ku pa ku pa sa/ si le si le leX / si li li li/ li li li li li/ hi ti si lecha/ ma ti su ma ti/ su su ma tiX / su su su su/ su su ma ti/ hi li ṣa hi duli ṣa swā hā/ rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po phyogs skyong bar gyur cig /grul bum dang / yi dgas nidang /srul 0po dang / 'byung po dang / rgyu ba dang / gzi byin 'phrog ⑩pa rnams bzlog ⑩par gyur cig /lha'i nang na ⑩lha'i rgyal po nor lha'i bu zhes bgyi ba mchis te/ de la bdag phyag 'tshal lo/ /de yang bcom ldan 'das nyid la phyag 'tshal te/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpa' bo ste/ /kun mkhyen 8kun gzigs 0khyod la 'dud/ /yang dag dpa' bo khyod la 'dud/ /chos bzhin mthun 8par blta ⑩zhing mchis/ /de nas rgyal po mig mi bzang ⑩/ /thal sbyar 'dug ste ⑩smras pa ni/ /mun par gyur pa'i 'jig rten la/ /bcom ldan lam rnams ston mdzad pa/ / gi tam dpa' bo yikhyod la ni/ /chos bzhin mthun zhu par blta 0zhing mchis/ /'jig rten dag na nyi zla 'dra/ /rin chen snying po stobs po che/ /klu dang mkha' lding gsang ba pa/ /stong phrag drug cu tsom bzhi rnamasal/ / kho ra khor 0yug yongs bskor phyinas/ /thal mo sbyar te 'khod gyur lags / /bdag ni rgyal po mig mi bzang tso/ /nub phyogs (nyeskyong bar bgyid pa ste / /'jig rten mgon tsopo'i nye 'khor du/ /klu dang (nyemakha' lding gsang ba pa⑦te/ /lha min dbang po stobs 4)po che/ /de dag bdag gis bzlog par bgyi/ /sngad ya the dan/ da ge da ge/ su ba ti ye/ pa ṭi0/ aṭa/ ka masnetso/ bi 90—437

ma bi 'byed ma/ bi da da ma/ bhi ②da da ma ni/ a bhi na me/ gatstsha nisnu te/da ④la phi (snyen/ ba ra surta yitsi tsi le/ tsi li li li li li li ༷swā hā/ rgyal po chen po mig mi bzang phyogs skyong bar gyur cig /klu dang / nam mkha' lding dang ske/ gsang ba pa dudang / lha ma yin dang / gzi byin 'phrog pa rnams bzlog 6)par gyur cig /lha'i nang na lha'i rgyal po nor lha'i bu zhes bgyi ba mchis te/ de la bdag phyag 'tshal lo/ /de yang bcom ldan 'das nyid la phyag 'tshal te/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpa' bo ste/ /kun mkhyen kun gzigs khyod la 'dud/ /yang dag dpa' bo khyod la 'dud/ /chos bzhin mthun ⑩par blta (1zhing mchis/ /de nas rgyal po chen po bzhi bla gos phrag pa gcig 7tu gzar nas pus tsomo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te ④thal mo sbyar nas / bcom ldan 'das 'ba' zhig la phyag 'tshal zhing gros mthun 8pa dang /tshig mthun yipa dang / skad mthun tu 7par bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bsil ba'i tshal gyi mdo chen po 'di ni rgyal po chen po bzhi'i bsrung (nyab ste 'khor bzhi po rnams la yongs su khyab pa lags so(/)/ /gnod sbyin dang / srin po nas gnod pa bgyid pa'i bar du bzlog par bgyi ba dang / 'khor bzhi po ru )rnams la srung (stob dang / skyob lustepa dang ske/ sbed pa dang / bde legs su 'gyur ba dang / bde bar gnas par bgyid pa lags so/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po chen po bzhi la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /kye rgyal po chen po dag rig (stesngags kyi rgyal po ( thuchen po bzung zin no( rinye/ /bsil ba'i tshal gyi mdo chen po ngas yongs su ( nyabazung zin no(me/ /kye rgyal po chen po dag gzhan yang ngas 90—438

bsil ba'i tshal gyi mdo chen po la rjes su yi tshirang ba'i rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo chabarjod kyisal/ de legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zung goshig dang ngas bshad do/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar 'tshal lo/ /zhes rgyal po chen po bzhis (5)bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa nyan 6)to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis phyag rin po che spyigayas pas na bza' chos gos phye ⑧nas 'byung po'i tshogs de dag la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /ngas 'di bstan par bya'o//rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu la dbye bar bya'o/ /thams cad la go bar bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis rig sngags 'di bka' stsal to/ /sngad ya the dan/ hi 6)phri hi lī/ bhi si ni/ bakki( )/a ha ra ye/ ta ma ti/ ta ma ti/tunye ti la ba48/ ba lī ta keti/ da ri ti na / da adhi na da/ phu byi 8phu phu byi7/ gu byi byagu gu byiyi/ hi tsa kāni/// nā mā(3 / kān tī (nyuswā hā/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo ⑤'di bka' stsal pa na sa 'di kun tu g.yos/ 'byung po thams cad rab tu 'dar nas kye ma kye ( nyetud kye ma sdug bsngal lo zhes sgra chen po byung ngo / /srin ngo/ rnams kyis kyang 'di skad ces smras (nyete/ 'di ltar yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas//sems can kun el thugs brtse nas(nye/ /'byung po kun 'jigs nyen ( tshopa yi/ /rig sngags 'di 'dra srung so)bar mdzad/ /de nas kun mkhyen ston pa po/ /sems can kun la thugs brtse (nyebs/ /gnod sbyin srin po dri za dang / /klu zhu )dang ⑥mkha' so)lding gsang ba pa(nye/ /'byung po rgyu ba gzi byin 'phrog /grul bum yi dgas srul ⑥ po dang / /lha min gshed byed ro langs dang / /brjed byed dang ni mi 'am ci/ /skem byed dang ni rims drag dang / /de bzhin bram 90—439

ze srin po dang / /smyo byed rims nad zhag gsum pa/ /de bzhin zhag ni bzhi pa rnams/ /skrag ①cing rab tu 'dar 'gyur ④te/ /phyogs bcur ①rgyug pa gzigs dunas kyang / /de dag la ni thugs dubartse'i phyir/ /rig sngags 'di ni brjod par mdzad/ /stad ya the dan/ hi ri ma kha/ ti ri kha kha/ ka ṭa ma ṭakyi / sid dha ma hā/ ha ⑦ta ri/ u ṭa ta nini/ da ṭa da ṭa/ da ti li/da mnyekhya/ da maste0/ ⑩ji dhu ri/ da da 8ri/ da ra mi ra0/ ki ri tī 8ye/ka ta ba re ṇiX/ su su mā ⑩le swā hā/ gsang sngags chen po byarig sngags chen po ()'di las 'gal bar ma byed cig /bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung gi chos la yang dag par so sor rtogs shigayi /khyed kun lus zhig ste 0shi ba'i 'og tu ngan song ngan 'gro log par ltung ba sems can dmyal ba rnams su skye zhing 'khor bar 'gro ba re0/ de nas rgyal po chen po bzhis bcom ldan 'das kyi rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 3chen mo 0sngon ma thos pa 'di thos nas skrag cing dngangs ④te mi dga' la skyi bung zhes byed ( nyenas thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal zhing gros mthun ⑩pa dang / tshig mthun 0pa dang / skad mthun par tsobacom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /sdang ba'i 'byung po zad bgyid pa / /rig sngags 'di ni legs par gsungs0/ /mi yi 'jig rten bde bgyid pa'i( ) / /rig sngags bdag cag brjod par 'tshal/ /de la rig sngags 'di lags te/ /'jig rten mgon po bdag la gson/ /stad ya the dan/ u hu ha la/ ku li dzi ba a (nyebyu ya/ ma su ra be dul/ ad tyā bad tyā/du sad byā ba te④/ nad da bad bye(nye/ ma ru dhya/ ma ru dhya/⑩ ba de tsom ru da durya pha (7la swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das 'byung po thams cad bzlog pa 'di gzung bar 90wa 440

gsol / stad ya the dan/ i li i li/ mi li mi li/ ki li ki li/ ba na ra/ni la pa ya/ bhu bhu bhu ra/ thi rū ①phu phu phu ra/ ga sha lī/ ro kha da ya ma la/khu li khu li ba ya swā hā/ rig sngags kyi ⑧rgyal mo ①'di ni lo gcig ④gi bar du mtshams gcod ༷pa dang / 'byung po thams cad bzlog ⑥pa dang / don thams cad grub pa lags so/ /de nas gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / dri za nas gnod par bgyid pa'i bar rnams kyis/ bcom ldan 'das kyi rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo sngon ma thos pa 'di yang thos/ rgyal po chen po bzhi'i bsrung ⑦ba sngon ma thos pa 'di yang ⑧thos nas skrag cing dngangs la 0mi dga' ste / skyi bung zhes byed ⑩nas sa la 'dzul kun tu 'dzul/ kun tu rab tu 'dzul bar byed do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis sa gzhi rdo rjer ⑩sprul nas de dag phyogs bzhir rgyug ⑩go/ /de nas rgyal po chen po bzhis 0phyogs bzhir me'i phung po chen po sprul to/ /de nas nam mkha' la rgyug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis nam mkha' gser du sprul to/ /de nas 'jig rten skyong ba rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu lha dang dri zas bskor cing mdun du bdar te/ steng gi bar snang la 'phags nas gnod sbyin dang srin po nas gnod par byed pa'i bar rnams gzhom pa dang / sems can thams cad la snying brtse 8ba dang / 'byung po thams cad bzlog pa dang / 'khor bzhi po rnams bsrung 8ba dang / bskyab ⑩pa dang / sba ba dang / bde legs su 'gyur ba dang / bde bar gnas par bya ba'i phyir rig sngags 'di brjod do/ /stad ya the dan/ gi mi gi mi gi mi gi mi / gi ni gi ni gi ni gi ni/ na khi mi na khi/ ni ṣa ni ṣa ni ṣa/ u ba a/di shwa di shwa/ bi di ⑩sha /sarba tsodi shwa/ a dhi ba te⑩/ gi ra/ bi sa(3 / dza 90—441

bu'i gdon gang yin pa dang / skya rengs ①'char ma'i gdon gang yin pa dang /grib gnon gyi gdon gang yin pa de dag kyang bsil ba'i tshal gyi mdo chen po ②'di thos nas ⑧ming 'di zhes bya ba'i lus las 0myur du gud du deng ⑧shig /gal te myur du gud du ma dong na de dag la myur du 'jigs pa chen po dang /nad drag pos 'debs par 'gyur la/ de'i rkyen gyis mgo bo dang / snying tshal ⑥pa brgyar 'gas ⑦par 'gyur te/ de'i mod la sdug bsngal du ma 'byung ba dang /brlag pa dang mtha' med par 'gyur ro/ /gzi byin dang ni khrag za ba/ /nyin mtshan rgyu ba gang yin pa/ /de dag gis kyang legs gsungs pa'i/ /mdo bshad thos nas gtang ⑧bar gyis/ /sha za lus 'phags skem byed dang / /'byung po 'jigs byed srul ①po rnams/ /de dag gis kyang legs gsungs pa'i//mdo 'di bshad pa thos nas thong ⑩/ /lha dang lha min rlung lha dang / /dri za dang ni gdon gyi bla/ /'byung po dang ni sha za dang / /de bzhin gnod sbyin srin po rnams/ /kun tu 'khrugs ⑩shing kun tu g.yos/ /skrag cing kun tu rab tu 'gul(gye/ /gdon snang gnod pa byed pa rnams/ /ltung zhing rab tu pham par 'gyur(nye / /sa gzhi tsodag kyang rab tu g.yos/ /sgra bo che dag sgrogs 8par byed//yi dgas ⑩dang ni grul bum rnams/ /sdang ba'i gdon ni zlog 0byed pa'i/ /mdo 'di dag ni thos gyur nas/ /'jigs pa drag pos 'debs par 'gyuratso/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /dad pa'i gnod sbyin gang yin pa/ /de dag mgu zhing yid dga' nas/ /legs par rjes su yi rang ngo / /de nas rgyal po chen po bzhi bar snang las yibabs nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste lhags so )nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te thal mo 90—443

sbyar nas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal zhing / gros mthun ①pa dang / tshig mthun ②par bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bsil ba'i tshal gyi mdo chen po 'di rgyal po chen po bzhis zhabs la phyag bgyis pa dang / 'khor bzhi po rnams srung chab dang / yongs su skyob pa dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po nas gnod par bgyid pa'i bar rnams 'joms pa lags so/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen ④dang / dge bsnyen ma gang la bsrung ba dang du/ de dag gis kyang bsil ba'i tshal gyi mdo chen po 'di gzung bar bgyi/ bcang bar bgyi / brjod par bgyi/ kun chub par bgyi'o/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das dge slong ngamayi/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen ⑦nam/ dge bsnyen ⑧ma gang la la bdag bsrung po)ba dang / bdag sba ba dang / gzhan bsrung ⑩ba dang /gzhan sba ba'i slad du bsil ba'i tshal gyi mdo chen po 'di 'dzin pa dang /'chang ba dang / brjod nyunyapa dang / kun chub par bgyid pa de kyil ni gnod sbyin dang / srin po nas gnod par bgyid pa'i bar rnams nye 'khor du yang gnas par tunyemi 'gyur na/ gnod par bgyid pa lta ga la sems lags/ de gang du mtshan gcig tsam gnas pa der yang gnod sbyin dang / srin po nas gnod pa ⑩bgyid pa'i bar rnams nye 'khor du yang gnas par mi 'gyur na/ de gang du rtag tu gnas pa der lta smos kyang ci 'tshal lags/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das gang la mi ma lags pa'i gnod pas thebs pa de'i mdun du bsil ba'i tshal gyi mdo chen po 'di brjod na/ de myur ba kho nar bde legs dang /nad ma mchis pa dang / bde bar 'gyur 8zhing thar bar 'gyur la/ mi ma 90—444

bdag po tshangs pas 6)bcom ldan 'das kyis cang mi gsung bas gnang bar rig nas gnas ②de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag mdang sum ⑧mi mjed ④kyi bdag po tshangs pa tshangs ris kyi lha rnams dang bcas pa dang / 0lha'i dbang po brgya byin sum cu ⑥ma gsum pa'i lha rnams dang bcas pa dang / rgyal po chen po ⑦bzhi ⑧rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams dang bcas pa dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po khyanyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / 'phrog ma bu dang bcas g.yog 'khor ⑩dang bcas pa rnams nga ga la ba 7der lhags te 'ongs nas mi mjed 8kyi bdag po tshangs pas nga la 'di skad ces smras so/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag ni stong gi 'jig rten gyi khams tsornams su dbang phyug la dbang bgyid pa lags te / btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag ni 'tshal na stong gi 'jig rten gyi khams rnams su bsrung ④bar bgyid/ yongs su skyob 8par bgyid/ yongs su bzung ⑩ba dang / zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur bar bgyid lags so/ /btsun pa bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi mnga' bdag bcom ldan 'das kyang stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams rnams su dbang phyug la mnga' mdzad pa lags te/ bcom ldan 'das kyang bzhed na stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams rnams su bsrung ⑩ba dang / yongs su bskyab pa dang / yongs su gzung tsob dang / zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur bar mdzad ⑩lags na/bcom ldan 'das stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams rnams su bsrung 0ba dang / yongs su bskyab pa dang / yongs su gzung 0ba dang / zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur bar mdzad du gsol zhes tsogasol to/ /dge slong 90—459

dag ngas kyang mi mjed hu)kyi bdag po tshangs pa la cang mi gsung rigebs gnang ②ngo ske/ /de nas mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pas ngas cang mi gsung bar gnang bar rig nas de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /dge slong dag rig sngags kyi rgyal mo gsang sngags chen po ④rjes su 'dzin pa 'di ni 'das pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ⑤kyis kyang gsungs so / /ma 'ongs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang gsung bar 'gyur ro/ /da ltar byung ba na yang 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas kyi byang chub 'di nyid la phan par bya ba'i phyir da ltar nga nyid kyis bshad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo ⑥la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyod kyis rig sngags kyi rgyal mo gsang sngags chen po 6)rjes su 'dzin pa 'di zung 6)shig /chongs shig /lhogs shig /shod cig /kun chub par gyis shig /kun dga' bo rig sngags kyi rgyal mo gsang sngags chen po rjes su 'dzin pa 'di ni 'khor bzhi po rnams kyi don dang phan pa dang bde ba dang bde bar gnas par 'gyur ro6nye/ /tarya thā/ u bud dhe0 / ni bud dhe/ bi bud dhe/nyurnye sa ma bud dhedhi/ bi shwaṣṭa 'bud dhe/ i ha bud dhe/ tant+ra bud ñdzadhe/ ni yaṃ ga me7/ tsha bi la/ a phu la/ ta phu la/tā le mā leyi/ me ga ga me khye snag ma nan/ i ma/ ma biṅgā(ste/ hu du me hu hu 7me/pub gu pra ha re/ kun dga' bo yun ring po nas spyad pa'i gsang sngags stobs dang / mthu rtsal ( medang ldan pa 'di 'das pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams nyekyis kyang gsungs sotso/ /ma 'ongs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs 90wa 460

rgyas rnams kyis kyang gsung bar ①'gyur ro/ /da ltar byung ba na yang 'di lta ste sangs rgyas kyi byang chub 'di nyid la phan par bya ba'i phyir da ltar rgyang nyid kyis bshad do/ /ngas rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chagasang sngags chen po rjes su 'dzin pa du'adis ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung dubar bya'o/ /mtshams bcad do/ /shar phyogs su rgyang grags gcig tshun chad mtshams bcad dudo/ /phyogs dang phyogs mtshams ༷thams cad kyi bar du yang rgyang grags gcig tshun chad mtshams ⑧bcad do/ /tarya thā/ sa mu tsa bi mu tsa/ pha la mu tsa/ dza ⑨ga dha ra/ ma da ⑫sba la/ na la ka ma ga /sa 0mu shwa bā ⑩ti/ bi muñtsahu/ yo ga /hi na sa ga ma / a ra da mu la/ bi ④lha ga mi/ i di tsi ri/ bi ta lā kha yo/ ma kha yo/la ga bhi dha ra ḍibya/ pra ti ṅgā ⑩yo gi⑩/ a tsakra pa ti'/ sa ma sra ba teyi/i lā 0ya/ mi lā 0ya/ ba hu sad rya/ a na ta ma/ arba ba ti ga ra ba ti/ti 'khri ni ti be'/ a ka tson ti/ sa ka na ⑤ti/ sa mi di dum/ ba su ba ṭi tī/a ṭi/ a ṭi/ tabatso/ kha ru smin/ kha 0ru smin/ la ha haṃ/ la hu ⑥ haṃ/sambha ra/ sambha ra/ bi 0ti ra na tai/ ni ru tai/ i la/ ta i la/ sa ra pha la/ ba (nyetu pha la/ sa ta sum ta/ rda'i byam ta/ kun dga' bo yun ring po nas spyad pa'i gsang sngags kyi 8stobs dang / mthu rtsal dang ldan pa 'di dag ni 'das pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang gsungs so/ /ma 'ongs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis kyang gsung bar (nye'agyur ro/ /da ltar byung ba na yang ngas bshad do/ /mi mjed ⑩kyi bdag po tshangs pas kyang bshad do/ /lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis kyang bshad do/ /90—461

rgyal po chen 3)po bzhis kyang bshad do/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyis kyang bshad do/ /'phrog ma bu dang bcas g.yog 'khor dang bcas ②pas kyang bshad do/ /kun dga' bo dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/①dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma gang la la zhig④ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin pa 'di bzung nas ji ltar bstan pa dang / ji ltar kun chub par byas pa de bzhin du shes sam/ mthong ngam/ las su byed pa de la ni ji srid 'tsho'i bar du bsrung ⑤ba dang / yongs su bskyab ①pa dang /yongs su gzung ba dang / zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ba byas par 'gyur ro//kun dga' bo 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bkas rig sngags kyi rgyal mo gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin pa 'dis ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung bar bya'o/ /yongs su bskyab ⑦pa dang / yongs su gzung bar bya'o9)/ /yongs su zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur bar bya'o/ /mtshams bcad ponyedo/ /shar phyogs su rgyang grags gcig ⑩tshun chad mtshams bcad 11do/ /de bzhin du nub phyogs su rgyang grags gcig ⑫tshun chad mtshams bcad 1)do/ /lho phyogs su rgyang grags gcig tshun chad mtshams bcad 8do/ /byang phyogs su rgyang grags gcig tshun chad mtshams bcad 'do/ /phyogs dang phyogs mtshams tsothams cad du rgyang grags gcig ⑩tshun chad mtshams bcad /shedo/ /kun dga' bo tu)rgyal po chen po bzhi'i ⑥ lam dang lam ma yin pa na gnas pa bzhi yod de/ de dag gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste bkra shis ldan dang / kun bshes dang / gang (1po dang dga' ba'i dpal rnams te/ gang de dag gi ming shes pa dang / rus shes pa de la ni rgyal po 90wa 462

chen po'i 'jigs pa mi 'byung ngo / /chom rkun gyi 'jigs pa dang / me'i 'jigs pa dang / chu'i 'jigs pa dang / mi'i 'jigs pa dang / 77mi ma yin pa'i 'jigs pa mi 'byung ngo / /kun dga' bo lag na rdo rje'i phu (27bo lag myur zhes bya ba grong khyer khor yug ces (mibya ba na gnas pa yod debu/ gang de'i ming shes pa dang / rus shes pa de la ni des srung ⑤bar byed/ yongs su skyob (6)par byed/ yongs su 'dzin par byed/ chad pa zlog ⑦par byed zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur bar byed do/ /ming 'di zhes bya ba'i phyir lag na rdo rje'i phu bo lag myur la gsol lo2/ /gsol ba 'debs so/ /'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bkas gang ming 'di zhes bya ba la skabs tshol ba dang / glags lta ba'i gnodang sbyin nam/srin po'am/ yi dgas kyisam/ sha za'am/ grul bum mamatsho )/ srul turnyepo'am/lus srul 8po rnams kyis bdag la glags rnyed par ma rgyur cig /bdag la klan tshogeka rnyed par ma gyur cig /kun dga' bo srin mo chen mo bcu bzhi yod de/ de cidag ni byang chub sems dpa' yum gyi lhums na bzhugs pa na yang bsrung bsrung ⑫/ bltams ⑩pa'i tshe na yang bsrung bsrung tsho / bltams zin pa'i 'og tu yang bsrung bsrung (3/ sku 'khrungs pa turten yang bsrung bsrung ru riste/bcu bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste stobs ldan dang / dri med dang / sgra chen dang / rab mnyen byadang / 'jigs byed ma dang / 'dzam bu'i mgrin sa dang /mchog len dang / bla ma dang / grags ldan rgu nyam dang / rmad grags dang /'thab dga' dang / rtse ji )mo dga' dang / sa 'dzin dang / 'thab 'jug rnams te ⑤/ gang de dag gi ming shes pa dang / rus shes pa de la ni de dag 90—463

gis srung ①bar byed/ yongs su skyob ②pa dang / yongs su 'dzin par byed②/zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur bar byed do/ /kun dga' bo srin mo brgyad yod de / de dag ni skyes pa dang bud med gnyid dulog kyang rung / ma log kyang rung stedu/ gzi byin 'phrog par byed do/ /de dag gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ rwa dudang ske/ thub med dang / ngan slob dang ⑦/ phra ma can dang / bran mo dmar mo dang ⑧/ rab chen dang ⑨/ mig bzang ⑩dang / brgyad pa ste 'jigs byed do / /gang de dag gi ⑩ming shes pa dang rus shes pa de la ni de dag gis srung ⑫bar byed do/ /yongs su skyob ⑩pa dang / yongs su 'dzin pa dang / zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ba dang chad pa zlog ④par byed do/ /kun dga' bo srin mo bdun yod de8/ de dag ni khrag gi 8dri tshor na dpag tshad brgyar ⑩yang rgyug 'go/ /de dag gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ gzi brjid mchog dang / dga' brtsegs dang / sna tshogs sbyin spong yidang / bran mo dkar mo bzang dudang /'jug 'dod dang / grong khyer khor 0yug dang / bdun pa ste ri bsrung ngo phye/ /gang de dag gi ming shes pa dang / rus shes pa de la ni de dag gis srung bar byed do/ /yongs su skyob pa dang / yongs su 'dzin pa dang / zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ba dang / chad pa zlog 0par byed do/ /kun dga' bo srin mo nag mo chen mo zhes bya ba bu stong yod pa rgya mcho1re 'gram na gnas pa mtshan gcig gis dpag tshad brgyad khrir phyin pa zhig byayod de/ gang de'i ming shes pa dang rus shes pa de la ni des srung dubar byed/ yongs su skyob pa dang /yongs su 'dzin pa dang / zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ba dang / chad pa zlog ⑩par byed do/ /kun dga' bo srin mo lnga gnod sbyin 'bum phrag bdun cu ⑦90wa 464

rtsa bdun dang lhan cig ①tu 'dzam bu'i gling gi mi rnams srung dzubazhing skyob par byed do/ /de dag kyang gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ rtag tu myos dang / rjes su myos sridang / stobs kyis rgyags dang / 'od ma'i sbubs dang / lnga pa ste 'byor ldan no/ /gang de dag gi ming shes pa dang / rus shes pa de la ni de dag gis srung ④bar byed/ yongs su skyob pa dang / yongs su 'dzin pa dang /zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ba dang / chad pa zlog ⑤par byed do/ /de bas na bdag gis 0ming 'di zhes bya ba'i phyir srin mo lnga gnod sbyin 'bum phrag bdun cu ⑦ma bdun dang bcas pa de dag la gsol loni/ /gsol ba 'debs sol/ /'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bkas ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung (7ba gyis shig /yongs su bskyab ⑩pa dang / yongs su gzung yib dang / zhi ba dang yibade legs su 'gyur ba dang / chad pa bzlog tu par gyis shig /tarya thā/ bī 8myu de / bī ti de8/ pi tsa ri de⑩/ pi ga ri de/ ka ra ḍi/rte/ ka ra bī ra/ swā tsoriske/ ma dhu ra gho geyi/ sha ta ha ni ta( )/ bha shi ta 0ste akko/ na4zhurte/ bi ka /ḍi tā0/ bi ku ṭi te/ bi ra dze/ bi ghaṣṭa zhuste'i de/ kun dga' bo rig sngags kyi rgyal mo gsang sngags chen po durjes su 'dzin pa 'dis gang la bsrung bar ⑨byas pa dang / sba ba byas pa dang / yongs su bskyab pa byas pa dang /c-i snayongs su gzung tsob byas pa dang / zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ba dang /chad pa bzlog par byas pa de la ni lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten dang / bdud dang bcas pa dang / tshangs pa dang bcas pa dang / dge sbyong dang bram zer bcas pa'i skye dgu ()dang / lha dang / mir bcas pa dang / mi 'am ci dang /90wa 465

lto 'phye chen po dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na mi'am/ mi ma yin pa'am/gnod sbyin nam/ srin po'am/ lha ma yin nam/ dri za'am/ klu'am/ nam mkha' ①lding ngam/ gsang ba pa'am/ yi dgas ②sam/ sha za'am/ ro langs sam/ byad ②stems sam/ gshed byed dam/ srul po'am/ lus srul dupo'ams/ smyo dubyed dang ⑦/ brjid byed glags lta ba dang / klan nika tshol ba rnams kyis 7glags rnyed ⑩pa'i sems can gang yang ngas yang dag par ma mthong ste de ni gnas med do/ /las kyi rnam par smin pa ni ma gtogs so/ /de bas na ngas 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bkas rkyo/7rig sngags kyi rgyal mo gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin pa 'dis 8mi'am/ mi ma yin pa'am/ gnod sbyin nam/ srin po'am/sha za'am/ lha ma 8yin nam/ dri za'am/ klu'am/ nam mkha' lding ngam/gsang ba pa'am/ yi dgas tsosam/ sha za'am/ ro langs sam/ byad stems sam / gshed byed dam/ srul tsopo'am/ lus srul tsopo'am/ smyo 0byed dam/brjid byed rnams las ming 'di 8zhes bya ba la bsrung bar ⑩bya'o/ /yongs su bskyab ⑥ pa dang / yongs su gzung 0ba dang / sba ba dang / zhi ba dang bde legs ⑥su 'gyur ba dang / chad pa bzlog dupar bya'o/ /dug med par bya'o/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo gsang sngags chen po charjes su 'dzin pa 'dis sdang bar sems pa (nyethams cad dang / gnod par sems pa tsothams cad dang / mi phan par sems pa thams cad dang / rab tu sdang bar sems pa ⑥thams cad dang —/ bdud thams cad dang / gseb lam bsrung ba ( 3thams cad dang /la gcan bsrung ⑥ba thams cad dang / sho gam gyi gnas bsrung 0ba de dag 90—466

'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das padma'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das nor bu'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo /bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das las kyi gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das rin po che'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo / /bcom ldan 'das gzhon nu'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das glang po'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das gti mug gi gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das chags pa'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpa' brtan pa'i sde mtshon lho)cha'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das ②de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mi bskyod pa la phyag 'tshal lo//bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin pa rgya mtsho 'joms (7pa la phyag (4)'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sman gyi bla bee ḍūrya'i (9'od kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de (nyabazhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas don yod grub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sā (7)la'i dbang po'i rgyal po me tog shin tu rgyas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra 90—678

bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas padma mchog gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs hu)la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gtsug tor can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad skyob tshul phyag 'tshal lo / /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra ⑧bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas log par dad sel la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom ④pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gser thub la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra ⑤bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung ⑥la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin 4)chen zla ba la phyag 'tshal lo//bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin po che tog gi (8)rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun du bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas padma rgyas pa dang utpa la'i dri'i tog 6)gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /90—679

de rnams la phyag 'tshal nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor nas byung ba gdugs dkar po can zhes bya ba gzhan gyis mi thub ma phyir zlog ①pa'i rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di rab tu brjod par bya'o/ /'thab pa dang / 'thab mo dang / rtsod pa dang / 'gyed pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed ②pa/ 'byung po dang gdon thams cad zlog ③par byed pa/ pha rol gyi rig sngags ④thams cad gcod par byed pa/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba las yongs su skyob pa/ sems can bcings pa thams cad thar bar byed pa/sdang ba dang rmi lam ngan pa thams cad 'joms par byed pa/ gnod sbyin dang srin po'i gdon thams cad rnam par rlag ①par byed pa/ gdon stong phrag brgyad cu ⑥ma bzhi po rnams rnam par 'joms par byed pa/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad rab tu sgrub par byed pa/ dgra thams cad zlog ⑦par byed pa/ gza' ⑧chen po brgyad rnam par rlag ⑨par byed pa/ drag shul dang /0 snang ba dang ⑫mi lam ngan pa rnams rnam par 'joms par byed pa/ dug dang mtshon dang me dang chu las skyob par byed pa/ ngan 'gro'i 'jigs pa thams cad las sgrol ba/dus ma yin par 'chi ba brgyad kyi bar du yongs su skyob par byed pa ste/ gzhan gyis mi thub drag shul che/ /stobs chen gzi brjid chen mo ste/ /gtum pa chen mo dkar mo che/ /gsal ba chen mo stobs chen mo/ /'bar ba chen mo phreng ba che / /gos dkar mo ni chen mo ste/ /'phags ma sgrol ma khro gnyer can/ / rgyal ba'i 8rdo rje phreng zhes grags8/ /padma'i snang ba rdo rje'i mtshan/ /gzhan gyis mi thub phreng ba can/ /rdo rje mchu can rnam sgeg ma8/ /zhi ba'i 8lha rnams kyis mchod patshu/ / zhi gzugs yidakar mo chen mo ste/ /'bar ba dang ni gos 90—680

dkar mo/ /'phags ma sgrol ma stobs chen mo/ /'chi med rdo rje lu gu rgyud/ /rdo rje gzhon nu ①rig 'dzin ma/ /lag na rdo rje'i rdo rje dang / / de bzhin ②rig sngags gser ⑤phreng ④can/ /le brgan rtsi dang rin chen ma/ /rnam ⑤par snang mdzad rigs kyi 'odadu/ /de bzhin gshegs rigs gtsug tor ma/ /rnam par bsgyings ⑦ma'i phreng ba dang / /rdo rje ⑧gser 'od lta bu'i spyan/ /rdo rje sgros dang dkar mo dang / /padma'i spyan dpal sangs rgyas spyan⑨/ /de bzhin rdo rje zla ba'i 'od/ /de bzhin rdo rje 'dzin ma dang / /rdo rje phreng ⑩ba sgyu 'phrul che'i / /lha mo dang ni gser 'od can/ /spyan mdzes ma dang dkar mo dang / /padma 0yi ni spyan can dang / /rnam dul zhi ba'i tsosems dang ni/ /zla 'od bdag gi 8yon tan shes/ /phyag rgya'i tshogs 8de dag dang / ma mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad kyis bdag 'khor dang bcas pa dang sems can thams cad la bsrung 8ba mdzad du gsol/ oṃ ṛ tso'i ga ṇa pra shāsta byasarba ta thā ga tosmi ṣa si tā ta pa tre hūm̐ rghaṃ hrīḥtsos/ dzambha ni rgyu hūm̐ hrīḥsayi/ stambha ni hūṃ hūm̐ hrīḥsayi/mo ha na ka rī hūm̐ hūm̐ hrīḥ0sbyo/ pa ri bityā tsos ma bhakṣa byaṇa ka rī dus hūm̐ hrīḥrdzis/tsosarba biṅgā1 chad na ka rī hūm̐ rghaṃ hrīḥ 3sna/ sarba duṣṭa ṭwāṃ 0stambha na ka rī hūm̐ hūm̐ hrīḥ0sbyo/sarba yakṣa rākṣa sa gra hā tsā bi tt+waṃ yis na ka rī durgyu rtsu hrīḥdus/ tsa tu rā shī 9khri ṭwāṃ tsogra ha sa ha sru ṇḍaṃ 0bi dhwan na ka rī rgyu hūm̐ hrīḥs/ aṣṭa bi sha tī 0rna na dukṣa tā 〉spra 0sā dhan 0ka rī hūṃ rlu hrīḥṣṭi/ aṣṭa ṭwāṃ ma hā gra 0hā ṇakhri tt+waṃ sa na ka rī hūm̐ hūm̐ hrīḥbyas / rakṣa rakṣa māṃ dusarba sa rwabyu/ bcom ldan 'das ma 8de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 8gtsug tor nas byung ba'i zhugadugs dkar mo 0can rdo rje gtsug tor phyir zlog (nyepa chen mo phyag stong mnga' ba chen mo/ dbu 9stong 90—681

mnga' ba chen mo/ spyan bye ba brgya phrag stong mnga' ba chen mo/ mi phyed 'bar ba'i mtshan rtags can/ rdo rje ①yangs pa chen pos / sa gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du ⑧mnga' mdzad mdu/ oṃ bdag dang sems can thams cad bde legs su mdzad du gsol⑤/ rgyal po'i du'ajigs pa dang / chom rkun gyi dhi'ajigs pa dang / me'i ⑧'jigs pa dang / chu'i ⑨'jigs pa dang / dug gi ⑩'jigs pa dang / mtshon gyi ⑩'jigs pa dang / dgra'i tso'ajigs pa dang /pha rol gyi dmag tshogs kyi 'jigs 8pa dang / mu ge'i 'jigs 8pa dang /dgra'i 8'jigs pa dang / thog gi tso'ajigs pa dang / dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs ⑩pa dang / sa g.yo ba'i tso'ajigs pa dang / skar mda' lhung ba'i ⑩'jigs pa dang / rgyal po'i chad pa'i ( )'jigs pa dang / gcan gzan shyigatum po'i du'ajigs pa dang / klu'i 6)'jigs pa dang / glog gi rdzi'ajigs pa dang / bye ma (nyetsha mo'i ⑩'jigs pa dang / nam mkha' lding gi ⑦'jigs pa dang / yams kyi nad dang / gnod pa dang / 'go ba'i nad dang / 'khrug pa thams cad kyi 'jigs tsos dang / gdon gyi 'jigs ⑥pa dang / lha'i gdon dang / klu'i gdon dang / gnod sbyin gyi gdon dang / srin po'i gdon dang / dri za'i gdon dang / lha ma yin gyi gdon dang / nam mkha' lding gi gdon dang / rlung lha'i gdon dang / mi 'am ci'i gdon dang / lto 'phye ⑥ chen po'i gdon dang / mi'i gdon dang / mi ma yin pa'i gdon dang /'byung po'i gdon dang / yi dgas (1kyi gdon dang / sha za'i gdon dang /grul bum gyi gdon dang / srul po'i gdon dang / lus srul po'i gdon dang /skem byed kyi gdon dang / smyo byed kyi gdon dang / grib gnon dugyi gdon 90—682

dang —/ brjed 6)byed kyi gdon dang / gnon po'i gdon dang / mkha' 'gro ma'i gdon dang / lus chags ma'i gdon dang / nam gru'i gdon dang /tsher ma 'don pa'i gdon dang / re lde 'don pa'i gdon dang / bya'i gdon dang ske/ ma mo dga' bar byed pa'i gdon dang / kun du phreng bar ②byed pa'i gdon dang / 'phyang ba'i gdon dang / mkha' 'gro ma'i gdon dang / lus mkha' 'gro ma'i gdon dang / ka ṭang ka ṭa'i tshogs ①can gyi gdon dang /gdon thams cad dang / mdangs 'phrog pa dang / mngal za ba dang / khrag 'thung ba dang / zhag za ba dang / sha za ba dang / tshil za ba dang / rkang za ba dang / btsas pa za ba dang / srog 'phrog pa dang / gtor ma za ba dang /phreng ba za ba dang / dri za ba dang / me tog za ba dang / bdug pa za ba dang ske/ 'bras bu za ba dang / lo tog za ba dang / bsreg bya za ba dang /rnag 'thung ba dang / bshang ba za ba dang / gcin 'thung ④ba dang /mchil ⑤ma za ba dang / snabs za ba dang / ngar snabs za ba dang / skyugs ⑥pa za ba dang / rnam ⑦bu za ba dang / mi gtsang ba za ba dang / stor khung nas 'bab pa 'thung ba dang / nor 'phrog pa dang / sems 'phrog pa rnams dang /de dag thams cad dang gdon thams cad (nyekyis po)byas pa'i rig sngags thams tu nyecad ral gris gcad yido/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab bo/ /kun du rgyus byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab bo/ /mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro mas byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad (nyeral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab bo/ /tshangs pas byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab bo/ /brgya byin gyis byas ()pa'i rig sngags ral gris 90—683

gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab bo/ /sred med kyi bus byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab bo/ /phyugs bdag chen po dang ①drag pos byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab bo/ /nag po chen pos byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab bo/ /ma mo'i tshogs kyis byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab bo/ /mi'i thod pa can gyis byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus ②gdab bo/ /ri khrod pas byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab bo/ /g.yung pos byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab bo/ /skar ①mda' gdong gis byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus ④gdab bo/ /rdo rje gzhon nu mas byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab bo/ /gshin rje ⑤gshed kyis byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab bo/ /gshin rje'i pho nyas byas pa'i ⑥rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab bo/ /klu ma rungs pas byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab bo/ /me'i ⑦las kyis byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab bo/ /log 'dren gyis byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus nigadab bo/ /gzhon nus byas pa'i rig ①sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab bo/ /rgyal po chen po bzhis byas pa'i tsorig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab bo/ /sring mo bzhis ⑩byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab bo/ / nam mkha' ⑩sding yang dag pas byas pa'i tirig 90—684

sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab bo/ /rgyal bar byed pa dang sbrang rtsir byed pa dang grub par byed pa dang don kun sgrub ①pas byas pa'i ②rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab bo/ /blang ①gi ri ti rjodang /dga' byed dbang phyug dang smin drug gi bu dang zla ba dang nyi ma dang tshogs kyi bdag po dang lhan cig pas byas pa'i rig sngags ⑤ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab bo/ /dge sbyong gcer bus byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do / /rdo rje phur bus dugadab bo/ /dgra bcom pas byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab bo/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab bo/ /'dod chags dang bral bas byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab bo/ /gsang ba ⑦pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rjes byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab bo/ /gang dang gang du ⑧byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab bo/ /gang gis byed du bcug pa des byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur ⑨bus gdab bo/ /dge sbyong mgo reg gis byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do / /rdo rje phur bus gdab bo/ /pho nya dang pho nya mo dang bran pho dang bran mos byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab bo/ /drang srong gi ⑩mchog thams cad kyis byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab bo/ /lha'i tshogs thams cad kyis byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris yigacad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab bo/ /mi phan par 'dod pa thams cad kyis byas pa'i rig sngags ral gris gcad do/ /rdo rje phur bus gdab bo/90—685

bā ru tsā ①ye phaṭa/ mā ru gtī ye phaṭa/ ma hā mā ru tī ye phaṭa/ sau kyai ②phaṭa/ i sā nī duye phaṭa/ pokka dusri ye phaṭa/ a tharba tsā ye phaṭa/ sha ba bu'i ye phaṭa/ kroṇḍa sha ba rtsi'i ye phaṭa/ ya ma dru tī ⑧yi phaṭa/ nis di 0bā tsa re bhyaḥphaṭa/tri san dhyālcekhyuḥ0phaṭa/ dha ⑩ra tsā ye phaṭa/ a dhi timusti tsokaḥ tsor ma hā sma shā ⑫nī bā si nī ye phaṭa/ i ti bhyaḥyi/ sarba bha ye bhyaḥyi/ sarba do ṣe bhyaḥ8phaṭa/oṃ ju ṣṭṛ ⑩bharnya bharnya dusarba duṣṭan 0rakṣa rakṣa māṃ dusarba sa/byu swā hā/ gang su dag bdag 'khor dang bcas pa dang / sems can thams cad la sdang ba phyosnang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / drag shul drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / sdig pa sdig pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / 'khrug pa 'khrug pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / mi mdza' ba mi mdza' ba'i sems dang ldan pa de rnams las bdag 'khor dang bcas pa dang / sems can thams cad la bsrung ④ba mdzad du gsol/ lo brgya 'tsho ( nyebar gyur cig /ston brgya mthong bar shog shigatso / bdag 'khor dang bcas pa dang / sems can thams cad la gdon dang gnod sbyin tshugang su dag gnod sbyin gyi gdon rnams dang ske/ mdangs 'phrog pa rnams dang / mngal za ba rnams dang / khrag 'thung ba rnams dang / zhag za ba rnams dang / sha za ba rnams dang / tshil za ba rnams dang / rkang za ba rnams dang / btsas pa za ba rnams dang /srog 'phrog pa rnams dang / gtor ma za ba rnams dang / phreng ba za ba rnams dang / dri za ba rnams deng / me tog za ba rnams dang / bdug pa za ba rnams dang / 'bras bu za ba rnams dang / lo tog za ba rnams dang /bsreg bya za ba rnams dang / nor 'phrog pa rnams dang / sems 'phrog pa 90—688

rnams dang / rnag za ba rnams dang / bshang ba za ba rnams dang / gcin ①'thung ba rnams dang / mchil ②ma 'thung ba rnams dang / snabs za ba rnams dang ske/ ngar snabs za ba rnams dang / skyugs ⑧pa za ba rnams dang / rnam dubu za ba rnams dang / mi gtsang ba za ba rnams dang / stor khung nas 'bab pa 'thung ba rnams dang / sdig pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / snang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang /lha'i gdon rnams dang / klu'i gdon rnams dang / gnod sbyin gyi gdon rnams dang / srin po'i gdon rnams dang / dri za'i gdon rnams dang / lha ma yin gyi gdon rnams dang / nam mkha' lding gi gdon rnams dang / mi 'am ci'i gdon rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po'i gdon rnams dang / mi'i gdon rnams dang / mi ma yin pa'i gdon rnams dang / rlung lha'i gdon rnams dang / yi dgas ⑤kyi gdon rnams dang / sha za'i gdon rnams dang /'byung po'i gdon rnams dang / grul bum gyi gdon rnams dang / srul po'i gdon rnams dang / lus srul po'i gdon rnams dang / skem byed kyi gdon rnams dang / smyo byed kyi gdon rnams dang / grib gnon gyi gdon rnams dang / brjed ①byed kyi gdon rnams dang / gnon po'i gdon rnams dang / mkha' 'gro ma'i ⑦gdon rnams dang / nam gru'i gdon rnams dang / kun du 'breng ⑧ba'i gdon rnams dang / tsher ma 'don ⑨pa'i gdon rnams dang /bya'i gdon rnams dang / ma mo dga' bar byed pa'i gdon rnams dang / bum pa lta bu'i gdon rnams dang / 'phyang ba'i gdon rnams dang / lus mkha' 'gro ma'i gdon rnams dang / ka ṭang ka tshuṭa'i tshogs can gyi gdon rnams 90—689

dang / gdon thams cad bsal ①du gsol/ bdag 'khor dang bcas pa dang glu/ sems can thams cad la ②rims nyin gcig pa rnams dang / nyin gnyis pa rnams dang / nyin gsum pa rnams dang / nyin bzhi pa rnams dang /nyin bdun pa rnams dang / zla ba phyed pa rnams dang / zla ba gcig pa rnams dang / nyin mo pa rnams dang / nyi ma phyed pa rnams dang / yud ①tsam pa rnams dang / rtag pa'i rims rnams dang / rims mi bzad 0pa rnams dang /'byung po'i rims 0rnams dang / yi dgas 0kyi rims rnams dang / sha za'i rims rnams dang / mi'i rims rnams dang / mi ma yin pa'i rims rnams dang / rgyun mi 'chad ⑦pa'i rims rnams dang / rlung las gyur pa rnams dang /mkhris pa las gyur pa rnams dang / bad kun las gyur pa rnams dang /'dus pa las gyur pa rnams dang / rims thams cad dang / klad pa na ba bdag dang sems can thams cad la (kyebasal ①du gsol/ bdag 'khor dang bcas pa ⑩dang sems can thams cad kyi yigazhogs phyed na ba dang / yi ga 'chus pa dang / mig nad dang / sna nad dang / kha nad dang / mgul nad dang ske/ snying nad dang / lkog tunyema'i lha gor na ba dang / rna ba 8na ba dang /so na ba dang / brang na ba dang / snying na ba dang / gnad na ba dang / rtsib ④logs na ba dang / rgyab na ba dang / lto na ba dang / rked pa na ba dang /mdoms tson ba dang / gzhang na ba dang / skye gnas na ba dang / rab tu skye gnas na ba dang / brla na ba dang / byin pa na ba dang / lag pa na ba dang /rkang pa na ba dang / yan lag na ba dang / nying lag na ba bsal tsodu gsol/bdag 'khor dang bcas pa ()dang / sems can thams cad la 'byung po dang /90—690

yi dgas ①dang / ro langs dang / mkha' 'gro ma dang / rims dang / shu ba dang / mig ser dang / g.ya' ba dang / 'brum bu ②phya mo dang / mdze dang ske/ phol ②mig dang / bas bldags dang / mchin nad dang / mtshan bar rdol ba dang / g.yan pa dang / gzhang 'brum dang / me dbal dang /lhog pa dang / skems ④pa dang / dbugs mi bde ba dang / skrag pa dang /lud ⑤pa dang / brgyal ba dang / dbyig dug dang / dug sbyar ma dang /dug dang / byad dang / me dang / 9chu dang / mi ngas dang / bdud dang ro/pe 'thab mo dang / 'khon (nyadang / gnod pa dang / dus ma yin par 'chi ba dang / sbrang bu tree ma po)bu ka tshudang / tree lā ta (7ka dang / sdig pa dang / sprul dang / sre mo dang / seng ge dang / stag dang / dom dang /dred dang / g.yag rgod 8dang / chu srin dang / spyang ki dang / chom po dang ske/ de dag la sogs pa srog 'phrog par byed pa gzhan thams cad kyang bsal 'du gsol/ gdugs dkar po yican rdo rje gtsug tor phyir zlog pa ⑫chen mo'i rig sngags kyi mthus dpag tshad bcu gnyis kyi nang tshun chad dam/dpag tshad lnga brgya'i nang tshun chad du rig sngags bcing bar bgyi'o/ /gzi brjid bcing bar bgyi'o/ /rig sngags thams cad bcing bar bgyi'oyi/ /gzhan gyi rig 4)sngags thams cad yo)bcing bar bgyi'o/ /mtshams gcad par bgyi'o / /sa bcing bar bgyi'o/ /phyogs bcu bcing bar bgyi'o/ /nam mkha' bcing bar bgyi'o/ /gzhan gyi sde rab tu rengs 47par bgyi'o/ /tarya thā/oṃ a na le a na le/ a tsa le a tsa le/ kha kha me kha kha me/ bi ṣa de bi ṣa de/bī re bī re/ bee ra bai du ra/ sau mye sau skye(nya/ shādhe shārnye/ rādhe rādhe/ badzra 90—691
