nor bu'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das glang po'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das gzhon nu'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das klu'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpa' brtan pa'i sde mtshon cha'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /①bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mi bskyod pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /②bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sman gyi bla bee ḍūrya'i rgya'od kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par ④rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sā dula'i dbang po'i rgyal yipo me tog kun du rgyas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin po che'i tog ⑦gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo / /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun du bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas spyan rgyas pa utpa la'i dri'i tog ⑧gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de rnams la phyag 'tshal nas/ bcom ldan 90—704

'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba ①gdugs dkar po ②can gzhan gyis mi thub pa phyir zlog ③pa chen mo 'dis du'abyung po'i gdon thams cad tshar gcod par byed pa/ gzhan gyi rig sngags thams cad dugacod par byed pa/dus ma yin par 'chi ba thams cad zlog ⑥pa/ sems can gsod 0pa dang /bcings pa thams cad las grol bar byed pa/ sdang ba dang /⑧ mi lam ngan pa ⑨ ltas ngan pa 0thams cad zlog 7pa/ gnod sbyin dang srin po'i gdon thams cad 'jig par byed pa/ gdon stong phrag brgyad cu 8rtsa bzhi 'jig ⑫par byed pa/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad dga' bar byed pa/ gza' 8chen po brgyad 'jig par byed pa8/ dgra thams cad zlog ⑩par byed pa/ ma rungs pa dang ske/ sdang ba dang / rmi lam ngan pa thams cad 'jig par byed pa/ dug dang / mtshon thams cad dang / me dang chu las zlog par byed ⑩pa/ ngan 'gro'i 'jigs 8pa thams cad las sgrol ba ste/ gzhan gyis mi thub drag shul che / /gtum pa chen mo stobs chen mo/ /'bar ba chen mo gzi brjid che/ /dkar chen 'bar phreng gos dkar mo/ /'phags ma sgrol ma khro gnyer can/ /rgyal ba'i rdo rje phreng zhes grags/ /padma'i mngon mtshan rdo rjes mtshan/ /gzhan gyis mi thub phreng ba can/ /rdo rje'i mchu can rnam sgeg mo/ /zhi ba'i lha rnams kyis mchod mayi/ /zhi ba gser gyi phreng ba can/ /dkar chen 'bar ba gos dkar mo/ /'phags ma sgrol ma stobs chen mo/ /rdo rje lu gu rgyud gzhan dang / /rdo rje gzhon nu rigs 0'dzin ma/ /lag na rdo rje'i 0rigs gser phreng / /le brgan rtsi dang rin chen ma/ /⑤snang mdzad rdo rje dugatsug tor grags/ /phyag rgya ⑥dang ( nyesngags kyi tshogs de dag thams cad kyis bdag 'khor dang bcas pa dang /90—705

rī hūṃ hūm̐/ sarba yakṣa rākṣa 0)sa gra hā (gyishā bi tt+waṃ sa na ka zhu'i hūṃ hūm̐/ tsa tu rā shi tī ṭwāṃ dug ha sa ha sru oṃ dhibi dhī sa na ka rī rtsu hūm̐/ aṣṭa stidzi ⑦sha tī ⑧〈 na kṣa tā dhishā pra sā dha yin ka rī rtsu bhrūṃ/ aṣṭa tsā (nyam hā gra ha 7shā bi 0dhe tsos na ka rī ༷rtsu hūm̐/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa tsorakṣa rakṣa māṃ swā hā/⑩ bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can rdo rje'i gtsug tor (nyephyir zlog pa tsochen mo/ phyag stong mnga' ba chen mo/ dbu stong mnga' ba chen mo / spyan bye ba brgya stong mnga' ba chen mo/(3 mi phyed 0'bar ba'i mtshan rtags can/ rdo rje yangs pa chen mos sa gsum gyi dkyil 'khor la mnga' mdzad ma kun bdag la bsrung 'du gsol( ste/ bdag dang sems can thams cad rgyal po'i 'jigs pa dang / rkun po'i 'jigs pa dang / me'i 'jigs pa dang —/ chu'i 'jigs pa dang / dug gi (9'jigs pa dang / mtshon gyi ( nye'ajigs pa pa 69dang / pha rol gyi dmag tshogs kyi 6)'jigs pa dang / mu ge'i phyo'ajigs pa dang / dgra'i 0'jigs pa dang / lce 'bab pa'i gu 'jigs pa dang / dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i zhunya'ajigs pa dang / sa g.yo ba'i ()'jigs pa dang / skar mda' ltung ba'i sonye'ajigs pa dang / rgyal po'i chad pa'i 'jigs pa dang /(ste las kyi 'jigs pa dang /( —) klu'i (nya'ajigs pa dang / glog gi 0'jigs pa dang / nam mkha' lding gi 4)'jigs pa dang / gcan gzan 0khro bo'i 'jigs pa dang / lha'i gdon dang / klu'i gdon dang / lha me yin gyi gdon dang / rlung lha'i gdon dang / nam mkha' lding gi gdon dang ske/ dri za'i gdon dang / mi 'am ci'i gdon dang / lto 'phye chen po'i gdon dang /bya gnod sbyin gyi gdon dang / srin po'i gdon dang / yi 90—707

dgas ①kyi gdon dang / sha za'i gdon dang / 'byung po'i gdon dang /grul bum gyi gdon dang / srul po'i gdon dang / lus srul po'i gdon dang /skem byed kyi gdon dang / brjed ②byed kyi gdon dang / smyo byed kyi gdon dang / grib gnon gyi (migadon dang / gnon po'i gdon dang / mkha' 'gro ma'i gdon dang / nam gru'i gdon dang / gshin rje'i gdon dang / bya'i gdon dang / ma mo dga' bar byed pa'i gdon dang / kun du phreng ④ba'i gdon dang / tsher ma 'don pa'i gdon las bdag bde legs su gyur cig /zas su mdangs za ba dang / zas su mngal za ba dang / zas su khrag 'thung (mib dang / zas su zhag za ba dang / zas su sha za ba dang / zas su tshil za ba dang / zas su rkang za ba dang / zas su btsas pa za ba dang / srog 'phrog pa dang / zas su skyugs (7pa za ba dang / zas su phyi sa za ba dang / zas su gcin 'thung ba dang / zas su stor spyikhung nas 'bab pa 'thung ⑧ba dang /zas su lhag ma za ba dang / zas su mchil ma 'thung ba dang /dzi) zas su snabs za ba dang / zas su ngar snabs za ba dang / zas su mi gtsang ba za ba dang / zas su gtor ma za ba dang / zas su phreng ba za ba dang / zas su dri za ba dang / zas su bdug pa za ba dang / sems 'phrog pa dang /7 zas su me tog za ba dang / zas su 'bras bu za ba dang / zas su lo tog za ba dang /zas su sbyin sreg za ba'i gdon las bdag la bsrung ba gyis shig7 /gdon de dag thams cad kyi 6)rig sngags gcad 3gedo/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /kun du rgyus byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ / mkha' 'gro dang ⑩mkha' 'gro mas byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur phus gdab bo/ /tshangs 90—708

pas byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /dbang phyug chen pos byas pa'i rig sngags gcad 6)do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /sred med kyi bus byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /nam mkha' lding yang dag pa dang lhan cig pas byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo//nag po chen pos byas pa'i rig sngags ②gcad do/ /phur bus chagadab bo/ /ma mo'i tshogs rnams ④kyis byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /mi'i thod pa can gyis byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus phyigadab bo/ /rgyal bar byed pa yidang / sbrang rtsir byed pa dang / don kun grub ⑦pas byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /sring mo bzhis byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /blang (8)gi ri ti dang / dga' byed dbang phyug dang / tshogs kyi bdag po dang lhan cig pas byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus 5)gdab bo/ /dge sbyong gcer bus byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /dge sbyong mgo reg 7gis byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /dgra bcom pas byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /'dod chags dang bral bas byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /'jig rten dbang phyug 'khor dang bcas pas tunyebyas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /lag na rdo rje 'khor dang bcas pas byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /pho nya dang / pho nya mo dang / bran pho dang / bran mos byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus gdab boturte/ /drang srong gi tshogs thams cad yo kyis byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /lha'i tshogs thams 90—709

gzi byin 'phrog pa rnams dang / zas su mngal za ba rnams dang / zas su khrag 'thung ba rnams dang / zas su zhag za ba rnams dang / zas su sha za ba rnams dang / zas su tshil za ba rnams dang / zas su rkang za ba rnams dang /zas su btsas pa za ba rnams dang / srog 'phrog pa rnams dang / zas su lhag ma za ba rnams dang /⑨ zas su gtor (mim za ba rnams dang / zas su phreng ba za ba rnams dang / zas su dri za ba rnams dang / zas su bdug pa za ba rnams dang / zas su me tog za ba rnams dang / zas su 'bras bu za ba rnams dang / zas su lo tog za ba rnams dang / zas su sbyin sreg za ba rnams dang /zas su rnag za ba rnams dang / zas su phyi sa za ba rnams dang / zas su gcin 'thung ba rnams dang / zas su mchil ①ma 'thung ba rnams dang / zas su skyugs ④pa za ba rnams dang / zas su snabs za ba rnams dang / zas su ngar snabs za ba rnams dang / zas su mi gtsang ba za ba rnams dang / zas su stor tshikhung nas 'bab pa 'thung ba rnams dang / sdig pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / gdug pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / 'khrug pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / snang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / lha'i gdon rnams dang / klu'i gdon rnams dang / lha ma yin gyi gdon rnams dang / gnod sbyin gyi gdon rnams dang / srin po'i gdon rnams dang / 'byung po'i gdon rnams dang / yi dgas (6)kyi gdon rnams dang / sha za'i gdon rnams dang / kum bhaṇḍa'i gdon rnams dang / srul po'i gdon rnams dang / lus srul po'i gdon rnams dang / skem byed kyi gdon rnams dang / smyo byed kyi gdon rnams dang /90—712

grib gnon ①gyi gdon rnams dang / brjed ②byed kyi gdon rnams dang /gnon po'i gdon rnams dang / mkha' 'gro ma'i gdon rnams dang / nam gru'i gdon rnams dang / gshin rje'i gdon rnams dang / bya'i gdon rnams dang / ma mo dga' bar byed pa'i gdon rnams dang / kun du 'breng ②ba'i gdon rnams dang / re lde 'don pa'i gdon rnams dang /li tsher ma 'don pa'i gdon rnams las bdag bsrung (gebar mdzad du gsol/ lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig /ston brgya mthong bar gyur cig /rims nyin gcig pa yirnams ⑦dang / nyin gnyis pa rnams dang / nyin gsum pa rnams dang / nyin bzhi pa rnams dang / nyin bdun pa rnams dang / rtag pa'i rims rnams 'byedang /rims mi bzad 6)pa rnams dang / 'byung po'i rims rnams dang / rlung las gyur pa rnams dang / mkhris ⑩pa las gyur pa rnams dang / bad tunyekan las gyur pa rnams dang / 'dus pa las gyur pa rnams dang / rims nad thams cad dang / klad pa na ba bsal du gsol/ gzhogs phyed na ba dang / yi ga 'chus pa dang / mig nad dang / sna nad dang / kha nad dang (nya/ mgul nad dang / snying nad dang / lkog ma'i lha gor (rten ba dang / rna ba na ba dang /so na ba dang / snying na ba dang / gnad lin ba dang / rtsib 8logs na ba dang / rgyab na ba dang / lto ba yin ba dang / rked pa na ba dang / chu so na ba dang / brla na ba dang / rje ngar na ba dang / lag pa na ba dang / rkang pa na ba dang / yan lag na ba dang / nying lag na ba bsal tu)du gsol/gdugs dkar po yonyecan rdo rje gtsug tor phyir zlog pa 5)chen mo 'dis dpag tshad bcu gnyis kyi nang tshun chad rdu )du 'byung po dang / ro langs dang / mkha' 'gro 90—713

ma dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / rims nad dang / shu ba dang /g.yan pa dang / 'brum bu phra mo dang / mtshan bar rdol ba dang / mdze dang /phol mig dang / bas bldags dang / me dbal dang / g.yan pa dang /①lhog ②pa dang / skems pa dang / skrag pa dang /① lud pa lu ba dang /dbugs mi bde ba dang / mi dran pa dang / dbyig dug dang / dug sbyar ma dang ske/ byad dang / me dang / chu dang / mi ngas dang /du bdud dang /'ching ba dang / dgra dang / dgon (9pa dang / dus ma yin par 'chi ba dang / sbrang bu bye 0bu ka dang / tree la tā (7ka dang / sdig pa dang / sbrul dang ske/ sre mo ⑧dang / seng ge dang /6) stag dang / dom dang / dred dang / g.yag 0rgod dang / chu srin la sogs pa'i srog chags rnams bsal ⑪du gsol/ de dag thams cad kyi rig (nyesngags bcing bar bya'o⑩/ /gzi brjid bcing bar bya'o⑩/ /gzhan thams cad kyi rig sngags bcing bar bgyi'o⑩ / / mtshams bcing bar bgyi'o/ /⑩tarya thā/ oṃ a na ⑩le a na le/kha sa me kha sa me/ bī ra bī tunyer/ sau mye sau skye༅/ shārnye shārnye/ rādhe rādhe/bi ṣa de ( )bi ṣa de/ bai re bee 0re/ de bi 'badzra dhā ri baddha baddha 'di badzra pā ṇi phaṭa / oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hrīḥṣṭi 'phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ badzra pā (༄ṇi brnya brnya badzra pā she tson ma ma sarba duṣṭa bi: 6)bi nā ya ṭwāṃ hūm̐ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ nye ba'i snying po'o/ /sus de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor nas byung ba'i tsogadugs dkar po ⑥can gzhan gyis du )mi thub pa 87phyir zlog sgo)pa'i rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di gro ga'am/ras sam shing shun la bris te/ lus sam mgul du thogs sam klog par byed na de la ji srid 'tsho'i sgo bar du dug gis cimi tshugs/ mtshon gyis mi tshugs/⑥90—714

me yis mi tshugs①/ chus mi tshugs/ dbyig dug gis mi tshugs/ dug sbyar mas mi tshugs/ byad kyis mi tshugs/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i dus byed par mi 'gyur ro/ /gdon thams cad dang / bgegs thams cad ②dang / log 'dren thams cad kyang dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje'i rigs bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag brgyad cu ②rtsa bzhi rnams dang grub pa'i lha mo rnams kyis kyang de la rtag tu mthun 0par srung ⑤ba dang / skyob ⑥pa dang / sbed par byed do/ /de rnams kyi yid du 'ong ba dang dga' bar yang ⑦'gyur ro/ /bskal ⑧pa chen po stong phrag brgyad cu stim bzhir skye ba dran par 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje'i 7pho nya mo drug cu yirtsa bzhi yang 8rtag par phyi bzhin tunyeyongs su skyong bar 'gyur ro/ /nam du yang gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang /④ yi dgas tsodang / sha za dang /srul po dang / lus srul po nyid du mi 'gyur ro/ /mi dbul por mi 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das grangs med dpag tu med pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi bsod nams kyi phung po dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das tsodang / byang chub sems dpa' gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyis bsrung ⑩ba dang / bskyab tunyepa dang / sbed par mdzad cing / de dag gi thugs su byon pa dang dgyes par yang 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs yidakar po ⑥ can gzhan gyis mi thub pa 0zhes bya ba'i ( )phyir zlog (nyapa'i rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di 'chang na tshangs par mi spyod pa yang tshangs par spyod par 'gyur ro/ /thub par ma byas pa yang thub par byas par ④'gyur ro/ /mi gtsang ba yang gtsang bar 'gyur ro/ /smyung (nyeb ma byas pa yang smyung ( nyeb byas par 'gyur ro/ /mtshams med pa lnga byas pa yang 90—715

'byang tunyebar 'gyur ro/ /sngon gyi las kyi sgrib pa yang ②ma lus par zad par ⑧'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi 0bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo bu 'dod pa gang la las ⑤de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba yigadugs dkar mo gcan phyir zlog ⑧pa chen mo rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di 'chang ngam klog na bu 'dod pa des bu rnyed ⑨de / tshe dang bsod nams dang / stobs kyang rab tu rnyed do/ /'di nas shi 'phos tsonas kyang 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /mi nad dang / phyugs yind dang / yams kyi nad dang / 'tshe ba dang /gnod pa dang / nad 'go ba dang / 'khrug pa thams cad dang /kyi pha rol gyi dmag tshogs 'ong ba tsothams cad la④/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i bragadugs dkar mo 8can zhes bya ba gzhan gyis mi thub ma 0phyir zlog tunyepa'i rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la btags te/ rim gro yicher byas te mchod pa chen po byas (3 la grong khyer thams cad kyi sgo'am/ grong ngam / grong khyer ram/ grong rdal lam/ ljongs sam/ dgon pa'i gnas su gzugs so/ /'phags pa gzhan gyis mi thub pa phyir zlog ma 0chen mo rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di rim gro cher byas te btsugs na ( nyebatsugs ma thag tu g.yul zhi bar byas par 'gyur ro/ /yams kyi nad dang / 'tshe ba dang / gnod pa dang ske/ nad 'go ba dang / 'khrug pa dang /'a pha rol gyi dmag tshogs thams cad rab tu ( stezhi bar 'gyur ro/ / gtarya thā/ oṃ ṣṭi brnya baddha ma ma rakṣa rakṣa swā hā/ o sbyo bandha baddha badzra ma ma rakṣa rakṣa badzra pā ṇi tsū phaṭa swā hā/tso ma sarba ta thā ga tosmi ri phyog a ( nyen le a ba sgo)lo ki te tsurṇa ( 7te dzwa rā shi( )/ oṃ 4nyang la dzwa la/ dha ka dha ka / dha ra dha sgoger/ bi da ra bi da ra/ sbyin hrīnda/ bhinda 90—716

bhindahu / hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga to: ②ga tt+waṃ phaṭa swā hā/ tabya thā / oṃ ②a na le a na le/ kha sa me kha sa me/ bee re bai re so me sau me/sarba buddha a dhiṣṭha ④na a dhiṣṭha ⑤te⑨/ sarba ta thā ga to: ṣa si tā ta pa tre hūm̐ phaṭa/rtsu ma ma hūm̐ ni hūm̐ swā hā/za༅ klu'i rgyal po mtha' yas dang / klu'i rgyal po dung skyong dang / klu'i rgyal po nag po chen po rnams kyis ⑧dus dus su char 'bebs so / /dus dus su sprin sdud dol/ /dus dus su 'brug gi ⑩sgra sgrogs 7par 'gyur ro/ /nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad la sangs rgyas kyi ⑩rnal 'byor du 8byas la ④lan gsum bzlas par yonyebya'o/ /sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangs 7te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba gdugs ⑩dkar po nyunyecan gzhan gyis 67mi thub pa chen mo 62 phyir zlog 0pa tsomachog tu grub pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so ⑫// //paṇḍi ta pa ra hi ta bha dra dang / lotstsha (steb gzu nunyedaga' rdor gyis kha che'i bdud rtsi 'byung gnas kyi gtsug lag khang gi tsodape rnying la gtugs nas gtan la phab pa⑥// //90—717

'tshal lo/ /lha'i drang srong dmod pa 'dor ba dang phan 'dogs 6)nus pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rig sngags 'chang grub pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshangs ②pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /legs ldan drag po dka' thub zlog ③pa'i bdag po dang lhan cig pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /legs ldan sred ④med kyi bu phyag rgya chen po lngas phyag byas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /legs ldan nag po chen po grong khyer sum brtsegs 'jig ⑤par byed pa dur khrod na gnas par mos pa/ ma mo'i tshogs kyis phyag byas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdung la phyag 'tshal 9lo/ /padmo'i dugadung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nor bu'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /glang po'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhon nu'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /klu'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpa' brtan pa'i sde mtshon cha'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i lasangs rgyas mi 'khrugs 6)pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sman gyi bla bai ḍūrya'i kyi'od kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sā kyila'i dbang po'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub 90—725

pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin po che tog gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ①rnam par snang mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas spyan rgyas pa utpa la'i bsung (migi tog gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de rnams la phyag 'tshal nas/ bcom ldan 'das ma (gude bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs ④dkar po (9can gzhan gyis mi thub pa zhes bya ba'i (6)phyir zlog 4༄pa chen po zhu)'dis 'byung po'i gdon thams cad tshar gcod pa/ gzhan gyi rig sngags thams cad gcod pa/dus ma yin par 'chi ba las zlog pa/ sems can bcings pa thams cad 'grol ba / sdang ba dang / rmi lam ngan pa dang / ltas ngan pa thams cad zlog pa/gdon brgyad khri bzhi stong 'jig par byed pa/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad dga' bar byed pa/ gza' chen po brgyad 'jig par byed pa/ dgra thams cad zlog 6)pa / ma rungs pa dang / sdang ba dang / rmi lam ngan pa thams cad 'jig par byed pa/ dug dang mtshon dang me dang chu las 7sgrol ba ste/ gzhan gyis mi thub drag tu)shul che/ /gtum po tu chen mo stobs chen mo/ /'bar ba chen mo gzi brjid che/ /dkar mo chen mo stobs chen mo/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba gos dkar mo / /'phags ma sgrol ma khro gnyer can/ /rgyal ba'i rdo rje phreng zhes grags/ /padma'i mngon mtshan rdo rjes mtshan/ /gzhan gyis mi thub phreng ba can/ /rdo rje 90—726

mkhar bsnams ①'joms pa mo/ /zhi ba'i lha rnams kyis mchod pa/ /gzugs zhi gzi brjid chen mo can/ /'phags ma sgrol ma stobs chen mo/ /rdo rje lu gu rgyud gzhan dang / /rdo rje gzhon nu rigs 'dzin ma/ /lag na rdo rje rigs gser phreng / /le brgan rtsi ②dang rin chen ma/ /snang mdzad rdo rje gtsug tor grags / /rnam par bsgyings ma'i rdo rje dang / /gser 'od lta bu'i spyan mnga' bal/ /rdo rje sgros dang dkar mo dang / /padma'i spyan dang zla 'od dang / /phyag rgya'i ①tshogs de dag thams cad kyis bdag la bsrung ༷du gsol/ bsrung ba (snyemadzad du gsol/ oṃ ṛ 6)'i ga ṇa (7)pra sha sta ⑧ya sarba ta thā ga to: ṣa si tā ta pa tre hūm̐ phroṃ/ dzambha na ka rī hūm̐ hūm̐/ stambha na ka rī hūm̐ rdu/ ma hā bityā sam bhakṣaṇa ka rī tsū hūm̐/ pa ra bityā sambha dzitakṣa ṇa ka tshu'i hūm̐ hūm̐/ sarba duṣṭa nī 0stambha na ka rī hūm̐ hūm̐ / sarba yakṣa rākṣa tsos gra hā tsā tustebi tt+waṃ tsos na ka rī hūm̐ hūm̐/ tsa tu rā shi tī 8rna gra ha sa ha sru ⑩〈 bi tt+waṃ tu)sa na ka rī hūm̐ hūm̐/ aṣṭa dzi sha 8khri nī nakṣa tā ṭwāṃ 8pra sā da na 4 )ka rī hūṃ hūm̐/ aṣṭa nī ma hā gra hā 0shā bi tt+waṃ sa na ka rī hūm̐ phroṃ/ rakṣa rakṣa 〉zhu ge/ bcom ldan 'das ma 3de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tsotor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can rdo rje gtsug tor phyir zlog pa chen mo/ phyag stong mnga' ba chen mo/ dbu stong mnga' ba chen mo/ spyan bye ba brgya 'phrag stong mnga' ba chen mo/ mi phyed 'bar ba'i mtshan rtags can/ rdo rje yangs pa chen mos (nyas gsum gyi dkyil 'khor la mnga' mdzad pas kun nas bdag la bsrung ( 7du gsol/ bsrung dudu gsol/ oṃ rgyal po'i 'jigs pa dang / chom rkun gyi (kye'ajigs pa dang / me'i zho )'jigs pa dang / chu'i (nya'ajigs pa dang / dug gi sgo snye'ajigs pa dang / mtshon gyi nunye'ajigs pa dang / pha rol gyi dustedamag tshogs kyi (snye90—727

'jigs pa dang / mu ge'i ①'jigs pa dang / dgra'i ②'jigs pa dang / lce 'bab pa'i ⑧'jigs pa dang / dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i ④'jigs pa dang /sa g.yo ba'i ⑤'jigs pa dang / skar mda' ltung ba'i yi'ajigs pa dang /rgyal po'i chad pa'i ⑦'jigs pa dang / lha'i (nya'ajigs pa dang / klu'i ⑨'jigs pa dang / glog gi kyi'ajigs pa dang / name mkha' lding gi ⑩'jigs pa dang / gcan gzan khro bo'i 8'jigs pa dang / lha'i gdon dang / klu'i gdon dang / lha ma yin gyi gdon dang / rlung lha'i gdon dang / nam mkha' lding gi gdon dang / dri za'i gdon dang / mi 'am ci'i gdon dang / lto 'phye chen po'i gdon dang / gnod sbyin gyi gdon dang / srin po'i gdon dang / yi dgas tho)kyi gdon dang / sha za'i gdon dang / 'byung po'i gdon dang ske/ grul bum gyi gdon dang / srul po'i gdon dang / lus srul po'i gdon dang /8 skem byed kyi gdon dang / brjed 'byed kyi gdon dang / smyo byed kyi gdon dang / grib gnon gyi gdon dang /⑩ gnon po'i gdon dang / mkha' 'gro ma'i gdon dang /4 sta nam gru'i gdon dang / gdon de dag thams cad las bdag bde legs su gyur cig /tsomadangs 'phrog pa dang /zas su mngal za ba dang / zas su khrag 'thung ba dang / zas su zhag za ba dang ske/ zas su sha za ba dang / zas su tshil za ba dang / zas su rkang za ba dang / zas su btsas pa za ba dang / srog 'phrog ⑩pa dang / zas su skyugs ⑥pa za ba dang / zas su mi gtsang ba za ba dang / zas su gcin 'thung ba dang /zas su stor (nyukhung nas 'bab pa 'thung ba dang / zas su lhag ma za ba dang /zas su mchil ma 'thung ba dang / zas su snabs za ba dang / zas su ngar 90—728

snabs za ba dang / zas su rnag za ba dang / zas su gtor ma za ba dang /zas su phreng ba za ba dang / zas su dri za ba dang / zas su bdug ①pa za ba dang ske/ sems 'phrog pa dang / zas su me tog za ba dang / zas su 'bras bu za ba dang / zas su lo tog za ba dang / zas su sbyin sreg ②za ba de dag thams cad ①las bdag bde legs su gyur cig /de dag thams cad dang gdon thams cad kyis byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /kun du rgyus byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ / mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro mas byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /④phyugs dubadag chen pos byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /—sred med kyi bus byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /nam mkha' lding yang dag pa dang lhan cig pas byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /nag po chen po dang ma mo'i tshogs kyis byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /mi'i thod pa can gyis byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /rgyal bar byed pa dang / sbrang rtsir byed pa dang / don kun sgrub pas byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /sring mo bzhis byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus gdab bol/ /blang dugi ri ti dang / dga' byed dbang phyug dang / tshogs kyi bdag po dang lhan cig pas byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /dge sbyong gcer bus byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /dgra bcom pas byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /'dod chags dang bral ⑦bas byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /90—729

phaṭa / biṇḍa khyabī ye phaṭa/ bāhma tī ②ye phaṭa/ asnri ①ye phaṭa/ ma hā kā lī ye phaṭam/ kā lā rda ḍi ye phaṭa/ irnyi ④ye phaṭa/ ro trī ①ye phaṭa/ kau ma ⑥dri ye ( )phaṭa/ bā rā tī ye phaṭa/ tsa mu ṇḍi ②ye phaṭa/ rā 6)spyi ye phaṭa/ kā la tso'o tī ye phaṭa/ ya ma daṇḍi ye phaṭa/ ka tunya'i lī ye phaṭa/ a dhi musti ()sma sā na bā si nī 0ye phaṭa/ sems can gang su dag bdag la sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / mdangs 'phrog pa rnams dang / zas su mngal za ba rnams dang / zas su khrag 'thung ba rnams dang / zas su zhag za ba rnams dang / zas su sha za ba rnams dang / zas su tshil za ba rnams dang / zas su rkang za ba rnams dang / zas su btsas pa za ba rnams dang / srog 'phrog ④pa rnams dang / zas su skyugs 8pa za ba rnams dang / zas su mi gtsang ba za ba rnams dang / zas su gcin 'thung ba rnams dang ske/ zas su stor ⑩khung nas 'bab pa 'thung ba rnams dang / zas su lhag ma za ba rnams dang / zas su mchil ma 'thung ba rnams dang / zas su snabs za ba rnams dang / zas su ngar snabs za ba rnams dang / zas su rnag za ba rnams dang / zas su gtor ma za ba rnams dang / zas su phreng ba za ba rnams dang ske/ zas su dri za ba rnams dang / zas su bdug pa za ba rnams dang /sems 'phrog pa rnams dang / zas su me tog za ba rnams dang / zas su 'bras bu za ba rnams dang / zas su lo tog za ba rnams dang / zas su sbyin sreg za ba rnams dang / sdig pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / snang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang /gnod sbyin gyi gdon rnams dang / srin po'i gdon rnams dang / yi dgas tu tsho90—731

kyi gdon rnams dang / sha za'i ①gdon rnams dang / 'byung po'i gdon rnams dang / grul bum gyi gdon rnams dang / srul po'i gdon rnams dang /lus srul po'i gdon rnams dang / skem byed kyi gdon rnams dang / smyo byed kyi gdon rnams dang / grib gnon gyi gdon rnams dang / brjed ②byed kyi gdon rnams dang / gnon po'i gdon rnams dang / mkha' 'gro ①ma'i gdon rnams dang / nam gru'i gdon rnams dang / gshin rje'i gdon rnams dang /bya'i gdon rnams dang / ma mo dga' bar byed pa'i gdon rnams dang / kun du 'breng ④ba'i gdon rnams dang / tsher ma 'don pa'i gdon rnams dang /rims nyin gcig ⑤pa rnams dang / nyin gnyis pa rnams dang / nyin gsum pa rnams dang / nyin bzhi pa rnams dang / nyin bdun pa rnams dang / rtag pa'i rims rnams dang / rims mi bzad ⑥pa rnams dang / rims ldang dub pa rnams dang / 'byung po'i rims rnams dang / rlung las gyur pa rnams dang / mkhris pa las gyur pa rnams dang / bad kun las gyur pa rnams dang /'dus pa las gyur pa rnams dang / rims nad thams cad dang klad ⑦pa na ba bsal 6)du gsol/ gzhogs 6)phyed na ba dang / yi ga 'chus pa dang / mig nad dang / sna nad dang / kha nad dang / mgul nad dang / snying nad dang / lkog ma'i lha gor na ba dang / rna ba na ba dang / so na ba dang /snying na ba dang / klad yipa na ba dang / ske yin ba dang / rtsib 8logs na ba dang / rgyab na ba dang / lto na ba dang / rked pa na ba dang / chu so na ba dang / brla na ba dang / rje ngar na ba dang / lag pa na ba dang / rkang pa na ba dang / yan lag na ba dang / nying lag na ba bsal ()du gsol/90—732

khug /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs rtog pa dang bcas pa ①༄༄gi /rgya gar skad du/ sarba ta thā ga ta usnri ṣa bi dza ya nā ma dhā ra tī gal paṃ sa ②nyi ta/ bod skad du/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor (kyernam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs rtog pa dang bcas pa/ sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i ④dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag tu med pa de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bde ba can gyi chos yang dag par sdud pa'i phug khang bzangs zhu)mchog na nye bar bzhugs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu sdug bsngal ba nad kyis gzir ba'i sems can (6)tshe thung ba yod de(7)/ de rnams kyi phyir 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor la nye bar gzigs te/ kun du gzigs pa'i dpal gyi mtshan de bzhin gshegs pa thams 90—759

cad kyi gtsug tor hu)rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs 'di bcang ba dang /bklag ②pa dang / gzhan la rgya cher yang dag par ston pa ni tshe ring ba dusgrub par byed pa'i ched du'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug stan las langs te thal mo sbyar bar gyur pas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bstan du gsol/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs bde bar gshegs pas bstan du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor la gzigs te/kun du gzigs pa'i dpal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs 'di bka' stsal pa/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te ④sarba 0ltu lo kya pra ti bi kṣiṣṭha duya bud dhā ya te na maḥ/ tarya thā/sti ma : : : sho dha ya sho dha ya/ bi sho dha ya bi sho dha ya/ a sa ma sa manta a ba bhā (nyes spha ra ṇa ga ti/ ga ga na swa bhā ba bi shud dhe/⑨ ma bhi ṣiñtsantu rmā0/ sarba ⑩ta thā ga tāḥ8su ga ta ba ra ba tsa na/ a mṛ ⑩ta a bhi ṣe ④karatso/ ma hā mu drwa ⑩mant+ra pa deḥ6)/ ā ha ra ā ha ra/ ma ma ā yuḥsan dhā ra 〉tso/ sho dha ya sho dha ya/ bi sho dha ya bi sho dha ya/ ga ga na swa bhā ba bi shud yite/ usnri ṣa bi dza ya pa ri shud dhe/ sa ha sra rasmi 0〈 tso di te/sarba ⑥ta thā ga ta ( nyes wa lo ki ni/ ṣaṭa pā ra mi tā pa ri pū ra ṇi/ sarba 0ta thā ga ta ④mā te/ da sha bhū mi pra tiṣṭha te/ sarba (nyeta thā ga ta skṛ yid ya a dhiṣṭha dun a dhiṣṭha te/ mu dre mu dre ma hā mu dre/ badzra kā ya saṃ ha ta naphye/ pa ri shud dhe/sarba ( )karma ā gu wa ra ṇa 0bi shud dhe/ pra ti ni bar ta ya/ ma ma ā ()yur bi 90wa 760

shud dhe/ sarba dhita thā ga ta ②sa ma ya a dhiṣṭha dun/ i dhidhiṣṭha te/ oṃ mu ni mu ni⑤la/ ma hā mu ni/ bi mu ni bi mu ni/ ma hā bi mu ni/ ma ti ma ti/ ma hā ma ti/ ma ma ti/ su ma ti/ ta thā tā/ khyu ta ko ṭisti/ pa ri shud dhe/bi sgu ṭa/ bud dhi shud dhe/ he he/ dza ya dza ya/ bi dza ya bi dza ya/ sma ra sma ra / spha ra spha ra/ sī ra ya sī tshur ya/ sarba nibud dha las dhiṣṭha na a dhiṣṭha te/shud dhe shud dhe/ bud dhe bud dhe/ badzre badzre/ ma hā badzre/ su badzre/ badzra garje dza ya garje/ bi dza ya garbhe/ badzra dzā lā tsogarbhe/ badzra ud bha skyebe/ badzra saṃ bha tsobe/ badzre brdzu ṇi0/ badzrambha bas④/ ma ma sha rī 8ro sarba yis tā nāñtsa kā ⑩ya pa ri shud dhi ra bha bas8/ sa dā me sarba blug ti pa ri shud dhizudzi/dusarba 0ta thā ga tā: māṃ sa mā shā sa 0yantu/ bud dhya bud dha/ sid rgya sid dhaX/bo dha ya bo dha ya/ bi bo dha ya bi bo dha ya/ mo tsa ya mo tsa ya bi mo tsa ya bi mo tsa ya/ sho dha ya sho dha ya/ bi sho dha ya bi sho dha ya/ sa mas 'amo tsa ya mo tsa ya/sa manta rasmi pa ri shud dhe/ sarba ⑩ta thā ga tā skṛ 6)da ya a dhiṣṭha phyin a dhiṣṭha te/mu dre mu dre/ ma hā mu dre ma hā mu dru ⑦mant+ra pa deḥ0swā hā/ 0lha'i dbang po gtsug tor durnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs 'di ni ngan 'gro thams cad yongs su sbyong ba/ sdig pa'i las kyi sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sbyong ba/ bde 'gro'i lam du 'gro ba/ ngan 'gro thams cad rnam par 'jig 9par byed pa 'di ni sangs rgyas gang gā'i klung 'bum phrag bye ba brgyad cu 0rtsa brgyad kyi bye ma snyed kyis gsungs pa/ byin gyis brlabs pa/ rjes su yi rang bar mdzad pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi phyag rgyas btab pa ste/ sems can thams cad bde 'gror 'gro bar bya ba dang / ngan 'gror lhung byab rnams bzlog 90—761

pa dang / sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten la sogs pa'i 0)sdug bsngal gyi gnas thams cad du sdug bsngal zhing nyam nga bar (migyur pa rnams dang / sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtshor ltung ①ba'i sems can rnams rnam par grol bar bya ba'i phyir gsungs pa'o/ /de bzhin du sems can tshe thung zhing skal ba chung ba smad pa dang / rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i skye bar ltung ④ba rnams dang / bsam pa nyams pa dang / sems can lam las nyams pa rnams kyi don du gzungs 'di 'dzam bu'i gling du sems can rnams la gzungs 'di dang / phyag rgya 'byedang / sngags yongs su gtad pa yin no/ /de'i phyir lha'i dbang po khyod kyis yang dag par gzung bar bya'o/ /lha'i dbang po gzungs 'di lan cig 6)thos ma thag tu bskal pa brgya stong du bsags pa'i las kyi sgrib pa yongs su byang bar 'gyur ro/ /skye bar skye ba sna tshogs pa sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten dang / yi dgas (7)kyi yul dang / lha ma yin gyi ris (8)dang / 'di lta ste/gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / 'byung po dang / sha za dang / srul po dang / lus srul po dang / brjed (spu)byed dang / khyi dang / rus ⑩sngal dang /sbrul dang / gcan gzan 1)khro bo dang / bya dang / sbrang bu dang / sbrang ma dang / sdig sbrul dang / grog sbur la sogs pa srog chags kyi rigs rnams su phyis mi skye bar rig par bya'o/ /gzhan du de bzhin gshegs pa dang phrad pa dang /byang chub sems dpa'i rigs su skye ba dang / rigs chen por skye ba ste/ de la rigs chen po ni 'di lta ste/ bram ze'i rigs shing sā (gyel chen po lta bu'am/rgyal rigs shing sā (1nyil chen po lta bu'am/ khyim bdag gi rigs shing sā ④la chen 90—762

po lta bu'am/ tshong dpon gyi rigs shing sā 6)la chen po lta bur skye'o zhes nga smra'o//lha'i dbang po de ltar na gzungs 'di'i mthus byang chub kyi snying po'i mthar thug gi bar du skye ba yongs su dag pa chen po 'thob ste/ lha'i dbang po gzungs 'di ni de ltar mthu che ba/ phan yon che ba/ mthu stobs che ba/ dge ba shis pa yin te/ lha'i dbang po sems can rnams kyi don gyi phyir gtsug tor ②rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs ngan 'gro thams cad yongs su sbyong ba 'di bzhag go//'di lta ste/ dper na nor bu rin po che nyi ma'i snying po shin tu dri ma med pa nam mkha' ltar yongs su dag pa 'od gsal ba ni 'od zer gyi snang bas 'bar zhing 'dug go/ /lha'i dbang po de bzhin du sems can de yang gos pa med par shes par bya'o/ /'di lta ste/ dper na 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser shin tu dri ma med pal/ yongs su dag pa/ shin tu mnyen ①pa/ shin tu sdug pa'o/ /lha'i dbang po de bzhin du sems can chen po de yang shin tu yongs su dag par rig par bya ste / tshe rabs gzhan du yang de bzhin du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /lha'i dbang po gang na gzungs ④'di rab tu ston pa dang / bye brag tu na yi ger 'drir ⑤'jug pa dang / 'dzin pa dang /0 klog pa dang / 'don pa dang / kha ton du byed pa dang / mchod pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / nyan pa dang / 'dzin par 'gyur ba de 'gro ba thams cad yongs su dag par 'gyur ro//sems can dmyal ba thams cad rgyun chad par 'gyur ro/ /lha'i dbang po gzungs 'di yi ger bris te rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mor gzhag ⑦par bya/ ri mthon po'am / khang pa mthon po'am/ mchod rten gyi nang du gzhag par bya'o/ /lha'i dbang po dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge 90—763

bsnyen ma'am/ de las gzhan pa rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang gis rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mor gzhag ①pa mthong ngam/ de dang nye bar gnas par gyur ②na / tha na de'i grib mas phog gam/ de'i rdul rlung gis ①btab pa phog na yang lha'i dbang po sems can de la sdig pa thams cad dang / ngan 'gror 'gro ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad mi 'byung ngo / /sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten dang / yi dgas rjodang / lha ma yin gyi ris ༷thams cad du mi skye bar rig par bya'o/ /lha'i dbang po sems can de ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis lung bstan cing bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par rig par bya na/ lha'i dbang po shing dubazo byed pa la yang phan yon chen por 'gyur na/ mchod pa dang —/ rim gror ⑦byed cing / me tog dang / bdug pa dang / spos dang /me tog 0phreng ⑨ba dang / byug pa dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang /ba dan dang / spos dang / rgyan rnams kyis brgyan par byed pa dang / lam gyi bzhi mdor mchod rten byas la gzungs 'di gzhag tshul/ thal mo sbyar ⑩ba'am / phyag 'tshal ba'am/ skor8ba byed pa lta ci smos te/ lha'i dbang po sems can 'di ni 8sems can chen po yin par rig par bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sras su rig par bya'o/ /chos kyi gnas su rig par bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten du rig par bya'o/ /de nas chos kyi rgyal po gshin rje de'i nub mo de nam langs yinas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste/bcom ldan 'das la lha'i me tog dang / gos dang / rgyan byal sogs pas mchod pa dang / bsti yisang du byas nas des bcom ldan 'das la lan bdun 90—764

bskor ba byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la gtugs nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gzungs 'di ni mthu che zhing sman ①yon che ba lags te/ bcom ldan 'das bdag kyang rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par sems can de'i slad bzhin 'brang zhing / dus kun du bsrung ②ba dang / yongs su bskyang ⑧pa'i slad du gnas par bgyi'o/ /sems can dmyal ba thams cad las de bzlog par bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag ni byas pa gzo bar ④bgyid kyi byas pa mi gzo bar mi bgyid do/ /de nas rgyal po chen po bzhis bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gzungs 'di'i ⑤cho ga zhib mo dang / bgyi ba'i cho ga'i tshul rgyas par bshad du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po chen po bzhi po dag la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /nyon cig dang gzungs 'di'i bya ba'i cho ga'i tshul bshad par bya'o/ /sems can tshe thung ba'i don gyi phyir rigs 0kyi bu 'am/ rigs kyi bu mos tshes bcwa ⑨lnga'i zla ba la khrus byas te/ gos gtsang ma gyon nas smyung nib byas te/ lan stong bzlas brjod byas na de sems can tshe zad pa de yang phyir nur ro/ /nad dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /sgrib pa thams cad rnam par dag pa yo)thob par 'gyur ro/ /sems can dmyal ba la sogs pa ngan 'gro thams cad las yongs su thar bar 'gyur ro/ /tha na dud 'gro'i skye gnas su song ba'i srog chags bya'i rna lam du yang gzungs 'di'i sgra bsgrags ( )par bya ste/ des ni de'i ngan 'gro 'di nyid tha ma yin par rig par bya'o/ /gang zhig nad chen pos btab ste sman pa rnams kyis bye brag phye ste 0bor ba yang de ltar na nad de las yongs su thar bar 'gyur ro/ /de ni ngan 'gror skye ba thams 90—765

cad rgyun chad par 'gyur ro/ /shi 'phos nas kyang bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de nyid de'i mngal gyi gnas tha ma yin par shes par bya'o/ /de gang dang gang du skye ba de dang der padma'i snying po kho na las brdzus 0)te skye bar 'gyur ro/ /tshe rabs thams cad du yang tshe rabs dran par 'gyur ro/ /sems can sdig pa byed pa gang dag 'chi ba'i dus byas pa de dag gi ②don du gzungs 'di yungs kur chal lan nyi shu rtsa gcig yongs su brjod de/ de dag gi 0rus gong rnams kyi steng du gtor na de dag sems can dmyal ba 'am/ dud 'gro'i skye gnas sam/ gshin rje'i 'jig rten nam/ yi dgas phyesam/ de las gzhan pa'i ngan 'gro rnams su skyes par gyur yikyang rung ste / de dag ⑦gzungs 'di'i mthus ngan 'gro de dag las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /ri de dag las thar nas kyang lhar skye bar 'gyur ro/ /su zhig 'di nyin 6)gcig bzhin du lan nyi shu rtsa gcig rtsa gcig yongs su brjod pa de 'jig rten pa chen po rnams kyis mchod pa'i 'os su 'gyur ro/ /tshe ring bar 'gyur ro/ /nad med par 'gyur ro/ /bde ba myong bar 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu spro ba dang ldan pa dang / mya ngan las 'das pa chen po thob par 'gyur ro/ /shi 'phos kyinas kyang 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing sna tshogs pa tha dad du 'gro bar (spe'agyur ro/ /der yang de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang phrad 12par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis kyang dbugs 'byin par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis kyang lung ston par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du yang 'jig rten la snang ba tugebyed par 'gyur ro/ /phyag rgya bcing ba ni sor mo bcu'i thal mo 90—766

la sdigs mdzub 6)gnyis bkug ste mthe bong gnyis dang sbyar la/ de nas gzungs 'di dran par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa byas te me tog sna tshogs bkram la sna tshogs pa'i bdug pas bdug cing / pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ting nge ②'dzin gyis dmigs nil phyag bya zhing / de nas gzungs brgyad brgya bklag 4)par bya'o/ /de ltar lan cig bklags (7pa tsam gyis bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag brgyad cu 0rtsa brgyad kyi gang gā'i ⑨klung gi bye ma dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod cing bsnyen bkur zhu)dang ri mor byas pa ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod pa chen po'i dzi)sprin gyis mchod par 'gyur ro/ /de kun gyis kyang legs so zhes bya ba'i sgra brjod par 'gyur ro/ /sems can de ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ⑩bdag nyid las skyes pa'i sras su rig par bya'o/ /sgrib pa med pa'i ye shes dang ldan zhing byang chub chen po'i sems kyi (7rgyan dang mnyam pa thob ()par 'gyur ro/ /de la gzungs bsgrub tu)pa'i cho ga'i thabs 'dis ni lha'i dbang po 'gro ba thams cad kyang tsosems can dmyal ba la sogs pa'i ngan 'gro las yongs su thar bar 'gyur ro/ /de dag gi 'gro ba thams cad kyang 8yongs su dag par 'gyur ro/ /tshe ring bar 'gyur ro/ /lha'i dbang po song la lha'i bu blo gros shin tu brtan pa la gzungs 'di rjes su ston la sgrogs shig /lha'i dbang po des na zhag bdun na lha'i bu shin tu brtan pa'i 'gro ba thams cad yongs su dag cing tshe ring bar 'gyur ro/ /stobs che bar 'gyur ro//de nas lha'i dbang po brgya 0byin gyis de bzhin gshegs pa las rjes su bstan pa 'di blangs te/ de'i gnas su phyin nas lha'i bu shin tu brtan pa la gzungs 90—767

'di byin no/ /de nas lha'i bu des nyi ma bdun pa'i bar du nyin drug mtshan drug tu gzungs 'di la brtson par byas nas①/ de'i bsam pa thams cad phun sum tshogs te/ 'di lta ste/ ngan 'gro las ni yongs su thar/ bde ba'i lam la yang ②gnas/ tshe ring bar yang ①gyur nas/ a la la sangs rgyas/ a la la chos / a la la gzungs 'di lta bu 'jig rten du byung ste/ des bdag 'jigs pa chen po las yongs su thar to/ /zhes ched du brjod pa ched du ④brjod do/ /de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya 0byin dang / lha'i bu shin tu brtan pa 'khor che ba rnams kyis me tog dang / dri dang / bdug pa dang / phreng ba dang /gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / gos kyi ⑥rgyan bzang po'i bla re dang / lha'i tshogs kyi mthus bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du phyin te thad dhi du phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa chen po lha rdzas kyi gos kyi rgyan la sogs pa nye bar mkho niba'i mchod pa brgya stong phul te bskor ba byas nas bcom ldan 'das kyi mdun du 'dug ste/ de bzhin du ched du brjod pa byas nas bcom ldan 'das kyi mdun du 'dug ste chos nyan to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis phyag gser gyi mdog can brkyang ste 8lha'i bu shin tu brtan pa dbugs phyung nas chos ston par byed cing sangs rgyas kyi ⑩bar du lung ston 7to/ /rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ba'i gzungs 'di ni 'chi ba chen po'i dbyug pa 'dzin pa ste/ dag byed sdig pa 'joms 8par byed pa 'di gro ga'am/ gzhan zhig la bris te/ mchod rten gyi nang du bzhag la rab tu rgya che ba'i mchod pa ji ltar 'byor pas mchod de bskor ba stong phrag brgya byas na mchog gi tshe dang blo rno ba sbyin par byed par 'gyur ro/ /90—768

de ltar byas pas zhag bdun pa'i tshe ni lo bdun thub ①bo/ /lo bdun pa'i tshe ni lo bdun cu thub ②bo/ /de ltar mchog gi tshe thob cing dran pa dang ldan pa dang /nad med pa dang / skye ba dran par 'gyur ro/ /mchod rten la bzhugs su gsol te③/ mgo la bcings na nad chen po las grol bar 'gyur ro/ /gos sam shing shun la gi wang ④gis rang gi ming dang bcas par gzungs bris te/tsandan gyi rang bzhin gyi mchod rten la bzhugs su gsol nas⑤/ rang gi khyim du bzhag la rgya che ba'i stong gis yimachod pas mchod de/ zla ba re re zhing brgya phrag brgyad kyis ⑦bzlas pa'i mchod pa'i cho ga byas na nad las grol zhing lo brgya thub par 'gyur ro/ /med na 'dam pa'i ⑧rang bzhin la yang bya'o/ /yang gos gtsang ma la sna tshogs rdo rje la gnas pa'i mchod rten bris la/ rdo rje phreng bas bskor bas brgyan ⑨pa de'i nang du rang gi ming dang gzungs kyi tshig 'di gi wang ⑩gis bris la/ kham por (nyekha sbyar gyi nang du bzhugs su gsol te rang gi khyim du bzhag la mchod pa rgya chen pos mchod pa byas na rtag tu bsrung tibar 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang cho ga ni sa la ma lhung tunyeba'i lci bas maṇḍal gru bzhir byas la me tog dkar po bkram ④ste/ mtshams bzhir zhun mar gyi mar me bzhi bzhag la/ a ga 8ru dang du ru ska'i ⑩bdug pa byas la/ de bzhin du dri'i 0chus gang ba'i snod me tog dkar pos brgyan 8te/ gzungs kyi snying po can gyi mchod rten nam sku gzugs dbus su bzhugs su gsol la/ de la g.yon pa'i lag pas reg ste g.yas pa'i lag pa phreng ba 'dzin pas nyi ma re re zhing lan yinyi shu rtsa gcig rtsa gcig dus gsum du bzlas pa byas la/ de'i chu khyor ba gsum 'thungs zhu na nad med pa dang / tshe ring ba dang / dgra yongs su (1nyams pa dang / 'dzin blo 90—769

rno ba dang / ngag btsun par 'gyur ro/ /skye ba nas skye bar skye ba dran par 'gyur ro/ /de'i chus khang pa dang / phyugs kyi ra ba 'am/ rta'i ra ba 'am/rgyal po'i khab tu gtor na/ rkun ma dang / sbrul dang / gnod sbyin dang /srin po la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa mi 'byung zhing nad kyis yongs su gdungs par mi 'gyur ro/ /mgo la gtor na de nad de las grol bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar tshe dpag tu med pa'i phan yon che ba'i gzungs 'di gang dang gang du rab tu sbyar na0) / de dang de ru zhi ba chen por 'gyur ro/ /so shing la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig yongs su bzlas te/ 'chos na nad med pa dang / blo rno ba dang / tshe ring bar 'gyur ro/ /chu khyor ba gsum la dus gsum du lan nyi shu rtsa gcig rtsa gcig (gyiyongs su bzlas te 'thungs na nad thams cad las yongs su grol zhing yun ring du 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag tu med pa la bskor ba byas nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mos mchod rten gyi las ji ltar bya/ sku gzugs la sogs pa bsgrub pa 557ji ltar bya/ 'dir sbyin sreg kyang ji ltar bgyi/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dri ba legs par smras pa ni/ /dpa' bo chen po legs so legs/ /sems can kun la phan brtse'i ④phyir/ /'dir (5)ni rtse gcig yid kyis nyon/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das (6)kun du 'od dpag tu med pa'i dpal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi tshe dpag tu med pa zhes (77bya ba'i gzungs 'di gsungs pa ni 'di lta ste/ oṃ a mi 8)te/ a mi toddha (9)be a mi ta saṃ bha we/kyi sa mi (sto90—770

ta bi kān te/ a mi ta gā dretsho)/ a mi ta gā mi ni/ a mi ta ā yurda de②/ga ga na rmārnyi ka rel/ sarba kle sha kṣa yaṃ ka ri ye ④su hā/ zhes bya ba'i gzungs 'dis mchod rten ⑤byed pa'i ⑥'jim pa blang ba dang / byug pa la sogs pa dang ske/ gdugs gdags pa'i ⑦bar ji snyed durdzogs par bya'o/ /'di'i cho ga ni / mchod rten 0cho ga mchog gyur pa/ /de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /gser dang / ind+ra nī ⑩la dang / dngul dang / padma rā (nyag la sogs pa'i rang 8bzhin mang po'i tu)rin po ches spras pa'i sor bcu gnyis kyi tshad padma'i steng na bzhugs pa/ de'i logs bzhir 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi lag na rgyal mtshan bsnams pa'o/ /me tog dang / bdug pa dang / dri lag na bzung ba'i gnas gtsang ma'i lha'i bu rnams dang / lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin lag na gdugs bsnams ④pa dang / g.yas dang g.yon gyi logs 8gnyis na 8spyan ras gzigs dang / rdo rje 'chang gnyis rnga yab dkar po phyag na bsnams pa gnyis bya'o / /de lta bu'i cho gas mchod rten the la g.yas bskor gyi tsosbyor bas padma'i 'dab tsho/rtem la bri bar bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya 9 )ba'i gzungs bris la de'i ring bsrel zhu)gyi snying po can du byas te/ dri zhim po dang bsres pa'i chus gtor zhing dri zhim po'i me tog gis mchod la/ stong phrag gcig gis mchod pa byas te/ dkar po'i phyogs kyi tshes brgyad kyi nyin zhag la smyung tshubar gnas shing / sems can thams cad la phan pa'i blos tshe dang blo ster ba'i yon byin te stong phrag gcig bzlas par ( stebya'o/ /zla ba re re zhing byas na zla ba drug gis tshe lo stong thub par 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu lo gcig tu byas na tshe lo 'bum thub par 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu byas na tshe lo mi zad 90—771

pa thub cing stobs dang ldan pa dang / gang gis kyang mi thub cing lha dang lha ma yin dang mi mnyam pa'i mkha' spyod kyi gtsug tor mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /de nas gzhan yang cho ga ni rab tu dge ba'i gnas su sa blangs la dri zhim pos bsres la mchod rten bya'o/ /stong phrag gcig nas brtsams te ji srid lnga'am gcig gi bar du'o / /nyi ma re re zhing mchod rten du gtogs pa gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ba yang dag par bzhugs su gsol la/ ji skad gsungs pa'i mchod pa rgya chen po byas la stong phrag gcig nas brtsams te lan bdun gyi bar du bklag ①par bya'o/ /nyi ma re re zhing tshe dang blo ster bar byed pa'i gzungs kyi ched du byas te/ sems can thams cad la thun mong du dge ba'i rtsa ba sbyin par bya'o/ /sems can ②rnams la bcing ②ba dang brdung ba ④la sogs pa spang bar bya'o/ /zla ba gzhan re re la mchod pa nyis 'gyur du byas la brgyad brgya'i bzlas pa bya ba ni rang ngam rang dang 'dra bas bya'o/ /cho ga 'di yis ⑤ni dus ma yin par 'chi ba brgyad med par 'gyur ro/ /blo rno ba dang / nad med pa dang / tshe lo brgya thub cing 'gro ba thams cad kyi ⑥yid du 'ong ba dang / skye ba dran par 'gyur ro/ /gang gi tshe 'chi ba'i dus byed pa de'i tshe sbrul shun pa brjes ⑦pa dang 'dra bar rang gi lus bor te mdzes pa'i lus bde ba can dugyi 'jig rten gyi khams su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /yang de nyid dmyal ba dang / byol song gi skye gnas dang /gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi 6)ngan 'gror skye bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rna ba'i bu gar ⑩dmyal ba'i sgra yang thos par mi 'gyur na 'bras bu smin par lta ga la 'gyur/'di rnams kyi gnas su 'gro ba med do/ /7de nas bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag tu med pas gzhan yang sgrub pa'i thabs bka' stsal pa8/ gang gis sems can 90—772

tshe dpag tu med par 'gyur ba dang nyam nga ba'i 'khor ba las grol bar byed pa ni gzhon nu mas bkal ba'i hu)skud pa tshad dang ldan pa mdzes pa'i ras mkhas pas bya'o/ /de nas gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs tshon ⑤sna ma lus pas gzungs kyi yi ge las sprul pa'i mchod rten gyi nang du bri bar bya'o/ /tshe dpag tu med pa 'od zer stong gi phreng ba can padma dang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ ston ku'i zla ba lta bu'i 'od can/ rgyan ②thams cad kyis brgyan pa / zhal gsum pa/ spyan gsum gsum ④pa/ phyag brgyad pa/ g.yas pa'i ⑤zhal zhi ba gser gyi 'od zer dang ldan pa'o/ /g.yon pa ni mche bas ma mchu mnan pa mi bzad pa utpal sngon po'i rtsi'od zer gyi 'od dang ldan pa'o/ /dbus ma ni sgeg pa dang bcas shing dkar ba'o⑦/ /g.yas pa'i phyag gis snying gar ⑤sna tshogs rdo rje'o/ /de bzhin du padma la gnas pa'i 'od dpag tu med pa dang / mda' dang mchog sbyin pa'o/ /g.yon du sdigs mdzub khyadang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang / de bzhin du gzhu dang / mi 'jigs pa dang / bum pa'ol/ /yang mgo ⑩bor mchod rten la gnas pa'i oṃ dang / mgrin par āḥdang glu/ snying gar yis ngo ⑫/ /dpral bar traṃ ngo / /lte ba'i phyogs su hrīḥ'o⑩/ /rkang pa gnyis la e 8aḥ/ yi ge 'di rnams bkod la rakṣa swā hā dang bcas pa ⑫'di'i nang du rang gi ming dang spel ba'o/ /de'i logs gnyis su padma dang /rdo rje 'chang gnyis tshurnga yab dkar po phyag na bsnams pa'o/ /steng du bdud rtsi'i char gyi rgyun 'bebs bzhin pa'i gnas gtsang ma'i lha'i tsobu gnyis so/ /logs bzhir khro bo mi g.yo ba dang / 'dod pa'i rgyal po dang / dbyug pa sngon po can dang / stobs po che zhes bya ba 8ste/ ral gri dang / lcags kyu dang /90—773

dbyug pa dang / rdo rje bsnams pa'o/ /g.yon pa na 6)gdug pa can 'jigs pa'i sdigs mdzub phyed (khudu byed pa'o/ /de ltar 'bad pas rdzogs par byasani/ring bsrel ④dang bcas pa'i mchod rten (5)la smyung yibar gnas pas mchod pa chen po stong phrag gcig gis mchod pa byas la 'bum phrag gcig bzlas pa bya'o/ /de nas dkar po'i 7phyogs kyi tshes gcig nas bzung ste ji srid bcwa ⑧lnga'i bar du stong stong bzlas pa bya'o/ /de nas snga bar nam nangs pa dang bcom ldan 'das ma zhal mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas ji ltar dngos grub 'dod pa ster ro / /yang na ni thang ka 6)de ( )dri zhim po dang bsres pa'i chus byugs (nyepa'i phyogs gcig tu yang dag par bzhugs su gsol la tu mchod pa rgya chen po bya zhing nyi ma re re zhing brgyad brgya bzlas pa bya'o/ /yang zla ba re re la stong stong gi mchod pa bya zhing stong stong gi bzlas pa byas na tshe dpag tu med pa dang / stobs dpag tu med pa gnon pa dang / nam mkha' la hu)'gro ba dang / nad chen po med par 'gyur ro/ /sems can thams cad kyis yinyi ma re re tshigs bcad stong 'dzin pa'i phyin ci ma log pa'i ngag tu 'gyur ro/ /yang na kha cig 8gis de lta bu byed par mi nus na de yis skyarang gi khyim du dri zhim po dang bsres pas (spresa'i char bzhugs su gsol la/ ji ltar 'byor pa'i mchod pa byed yoshel zla ba 'ong ngo cog gi tshes brgyad la brgyad brgya'i bzlas pa bya zhing nyi ma re rer 37dus gsum du nyi shu rtsa gcig rtsa gcig brjod ༷ )na blo rno ba dang / tshe ring ba dang / shes rab dang ldan pa dang / nad med pa dang / skyid pa dang / lo brgya 'tsho ba dang / skye ba dran par 'gyur ro/ /yang na rang gis ma nus na de'i tshe rang dang 'dra bas byas na tshe ring ba dang / blo rno bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas gzhan yang sbyin 6)sreg 90—774

gi cho ga sems can thams cad la phan pa'i phyir nye bar bshad par bya ste/ khru gang gi tshad kyi thab khung zlum po rdo rje'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ tsandan dkar po 'am ①sa dkar gyis byugs tshul me tog dkar po bkram ste / logs bzhir zhun mar gyi mar me bzhi bzhag la/ bdug spos la sogs pas yang dag par mchod la / phyogs bzhir mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bum pa rab tu mdzes pa gos dkar pos g.yogs ④pa yal gas kha brgyan po pa dgod par bya'o/ /'o ma can gyi yam shing la me spar la der me lha bkug ste dgang blugs gsum byin la bsang yigator byas te gshegs su gsol lo/ /de nas tshe dpag tu med pa gsal por thab khung gi dbus su bsams ⑦la gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ba bzlas shing dgang blugs gsum dbul lo/ /yang na oṃ a mṛ ta ā yurda te ②swā hā/ zhes bya bas 7tshe dang ske/ blo rno ba dang bcas pas brgyad brgya dus gsum du sbyin sreg ⑩bya'o/ /gtsug tor rnam (7par rgyal ba lan bdun du bzlas pa byas na tshe ring ba dang /blo rno ba dang / skyid pa dang / nad med par 'gyur ro/ /yang na zla ba re re'i tsodakar po'i yo phyogs kyi tshes brgyad la mchod pa rgya chen po byas la dus gsum du tshe lo stong thub par 'dod pas sbyin sreg tsobyas na mchog gi tsotshe ring ba dang / blo rno ba sbyin par byed do/ /sems can rnams la smad par mi bya'o/ /cho ga 'dis rang gi lus nad kyis gos par mi 'gyur ro/ /lo brgya lnga bcur 'tsho ba dang / dgra las rgyal ba dang / blo rno bar 'gyur ro/ /dbyangs snyan par 'gyur ro/ /gal te rang gis ma nus na de'i tshe rang dang 'dra bas byas na zhi ba chen por 'gyur ro/ /de nas gzhan yang 9sgrub par 'dod na gtsug tor gyi rgyal po chen po tshe dang blo rno ba dang bcas par 'bum phrag gcig hu)sbyin sreg byas te/she/90—775

de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i (1nyesangs rgyas ma gtogs par de'i skyabs dang / rten ②dang / dpung gnyen du 'gyur ba su yod snyam du bsams so/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin nub mo de'i srod la spos dang / me tog dang / bdug pa sna tshogs dang / gos dang / rgyan ⑤sna tshogs la sogs pa khyer nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te lan bdun bskor ba byas nas mchod pa chen po ④byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi ( spyan sngar 'dug nas lha'i bu shin tu brtan pa'i 'gro ba bdun po dag bcom ldan 'das la zhib tu gsol to/ /lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis 'gro ba bdun po (7de dag gsol ma thag tu/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi tsogatsug tor nas 'od zer sna tshogs byung ste / des phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi gnas thams cad kun nas snang (shebar byas te slar log nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal gyi sgor zhugs so6)/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dzum pa mdzad nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /lha'i dbang po gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs de bzhin gshegs pas spyi bo yonas dbang bskur ba/ ngan 'gro thams cad yongs su sbyong ba/ sgrib pa dang / sdug bsngal bar skye ba thams cad 'jig kyirtapar byed pa/ sems can dmyal ba dang / byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten thams cad yongs su sbyong ba(rte/ bde 'gro'i lam du 12'jog pa yod de/ lha'i dbang po de lta bas na gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs ngan 'gro thams cad yongs su sbyong ba thos ma thag tu sgrib par 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin sna tshogs shin tu mang po 'jig par 90—806

byed do/ /skye ba yongs su dag pa'i rgyud thob 6)par 'gyur ro/ /tshe rabs thams cad du yang tshe rabs dran par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi ②zhing du 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /lha'i 'jig rten nas lha'i 'jig rten du 'gro bar 'gyur te/ lha'i gnas sum cu ②rtsa gnyis kyi bar du 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /lha'i dbang po de brjod ma thag tu tshe zad pa yang tshe phyir nur bar 'gyur ba'i las thob par 'gyur ro/ /lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las yongs su dag pa bsags pa bde bar reg pa la gnas pas gnas par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyang de la gzigs so/ /de dag de la rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par bsrung (geb dang / bskyab pa dang / sba bar mdzad par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyang de la sems par 'gyur/ brjod pa tsam gyis (gyesems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten dang / yi dgas (6)kyi yul thams cad skems ⑦par 'gyur/ rnam par 'jig par 'gyur/ rnam par 'thor bar 'gyur/ rnam par sel bar 'gyur / stongs (kyepar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar de la sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad dang / lha'i gnas thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa'i gnas thams cad kyi sgo rnams phye bar 'gyur ro/ /de gang 'dod pa der 'jug par 'gyur ro//de nas bcom ldan 'das 5)la lha'i dbang po brgya ⑩byin gyis 'di skad ces gsol to / /bcom ldan 'das gzungs de bka' stsal du gsol/ sems can thams cad kyi srog la sman gdags pa bshad du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lha'i dbang po brgya tunyabyin gyis gsol ba btab pa mkhyen nas gzungs 'di dag bka' stsal to/ / na mo ratna tra yā ya/zhi o na mo bha ga wa yinate sarba yint+ra lo kya pra 90—807

bo dha ya/ mo tsa ya mo tsa ya/ bi mo tsa ya bi mo tsa ya/ sho dha ya sho dha ya/ bi sho dha ya bi sho dha ya/hunye sa manta rasmi pa ri shud dhe/ sarba (mita thā ga ta skṛ srid ya a dhiṣṭha stin a rnyikhri ⑤te/ mu dre mu dre/ ma hā mu dre ma hā mu dā stimant+ra pa deḥ0swā hā / lha'i dbang po gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs ngan 'gro thams cad yongs su sbyong bzhi)/ sdig pa dang / las dang / sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sbyong ba/ bde 'gro'i lam thams cad du 'gro ba dang / ngan 'gro thams cad rnam par 'jig par byed pa 'di 6)ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang gā'i 7klung 'bum phrag bye ba phrag brgyad cu (nyartsa brgyad kyi bye ma snyed dag gis gsungs 8pa/ byin gyis brlabs pa/ rjes su yi rang bar mdzad pa/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi phyag rgyas btab pa ste/ sems can thams cad bde 'gror 'gro bar bya ba dang / ngan 'gror tunyelhung ba rnams bzlog pa dang / sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang /gshin rje'i 'jig rten la sogs pa sdug bsngal gyi gnas thams cad du sdug bsngal zhing nyam nga bar gyur pa rnams dang / sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtshor lhung ba'i sems can rnams rnam par 'grol yibar bya ba'i phyir gsungs pa'o/ /de bzhin du sems can tshe thung zhing skal pa chung ba/ smad 8pa dang / bsam pa nyams tsopa dang / sems can lam las nyams pa rnams kyi don du gzungs 'di 'dzam bu'i gling du bzhag go/ /lha'i dbang po khyod kyis gzungs 'di zung sbyil lha'i bu shin tu brtan pa la sgrogs shig /bsgrags nas kyang gdon pa dang / kha ton du bya ba dang / bsam pa dang / bsgom hunyepa dang / dran par bya ba dang /mchod pa dang / gzung ba yidang / kun chub par bya ba la de sbyor pya bar gyis 90—809

shig dang / de ltar lha'i gnas thams cad na 'khod pa'i lha'i bu rnams dang /'dzam bu'i gling pa'i sems can rnams kyi don dang / phan pa dang / bde ba'i phyir gzungs kyi phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags 'di dag khyod la gtad do/ /de'i phyir lha'i dbang po khyod kyis gzung bar bya'o/ /lha'i dbang po gzungs 'di thos ma thag tu bskal pa brgya 6)stong du bsags ②pa'i las kyi sgrib pa yongs su byang bar 'gyur ro/ /skye bar skye ba rnam pa sna tshogs sems can dmyal ba dang /dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten dang / yi dgas kyi yul dang ske/ lha ma yin gyi ris dang / 'di lta ste/ gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang ske/ 'byung po dang / sha za dang / srul po dang / lus srul po dang / brjed byed dang /zhu khyi dang / rus ④sngal dang / sprul dang / gcan gzan (7khro bo dang / bya dang / sbrang bu dang / sbrang ma dang / sdig sbrul dang —/ grog sbur 97la sogs pa'i srog chags kyi rigs su phyis ⑦mi skye bar shes par ⑧bya'o/ /gzhan du na de bzhin gshegs pa dang phrad pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i 6)rigs su skye ba ni ma gtogs so/ /de rigs tsochen po 'di lta ste/bram ze'i rigs shing sā (nyal chen po lta bu'am/ rgyal rigs shing sā snyil chen po lta bu'am/ tshong dpon gyi rigs shing sā tunyel chen po lta bur skye'o yizhes nga smra'o/ /lha'i dbang po de ltar na gzungs 'di'i mthus byang chub kyi snying po la mthar thug gi bar du skye ba yongs su dag pa chen po 'thob ste/ lha'i dbang po gzungs 'di ni de ltar mthu che ste/ lha'i dbang po gzungs 'di ni 'di 7ltar mthu che ba/phan yon che ba/ mthu stobs che ba/ dge zhing shis pa yin te/ lha'i dbang po sems can rnams kyi don gyi phyir/ gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ba yizhes bya ba'i ⑩90—810

gzungs ngan 'gro thams cad yongs su sbyong ba 'di bzhag go/ /'di lta ste dper na/ nor bu rin po che nyi ma'i snying po shin tu dri ma med pa nam mkha' ltar yongs su dag pa 'od gsal ba ni 'od zer gyi snang bas 'bar zhing 'dug goske/ /lha'i dbang po de bzhin du sems can de yang gos pa med par shes par bya'o / /'di lta ste dper na 'dzam bu'i chu bo'i gser ni dri ma med pa/ shin tu yongs su dag pa/ shin tu mnyen pa/ shin tu sdug pa'o/ /lha'i dbang po de bzhin du sems can de yang shin tu yongs su dag par rig par bya ste/ tshe rabs gzhan du yang de bzhin du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /lha'i dbang po gang na gzungs 'di rab tu ston pa dang / bye brag tu na yi ger 'drir 'jug pa dang /'dzin pa dang / klog pa dang / 'don hu)pa dang / kha ton du byed pa dang /mchod pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / nyan pa dang / 'dzin par 'gyur ba der 'gro ba thams cad yongs su dag par 'gyur/ sems can dmyal ba thams cad rgyun chad par 'gyur ro/ /lha'i dbang po gzungs 'di yi ger bris te rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mor gzhag ②par bya/ ri mthon po'am/ khang pa mthon po'am/ mchod rten gyi srog shing gi steng du gzhag ③par bya'o/ /lha'i dbang po dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen linam/ dge bsnyen ma'am(ge / de las gzhan pa'i rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang gis rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mor bzhag pa mthong ngam/ de dang der yinye bar gnas par gyur na / tha na de'i grib mas 9)phog gam/ de'i rdul rlung gis btab pas phog na yang lha'i dbang po sems can de la sdig pa thams cad dang / ngan 'gror 'gro ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad mi 'byung ngo / /sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 90—811

'gro'i skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten dang / yi dgas dang / lha ma yin gyi ris thams cad du mi skye bar 'gyur ro/ /lha'i dbang po sems can de ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis lung bstan cing / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par rig par bya'o/ /lha'i dbang po mchod pa dang / rim gro hu)byed cing me tog dang / bdug pa dang / spos dang / me tog phreng ba dang / byug (kyepa dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / rgyan rnams kyis brgyan par byed pa dang / lam gyi ②bzhi mdor mchod rten byas te/ gzungs 'di bzhag pa la thal mo sbyar ④ba'am phyag 'tshal ba'am skor (5)ba byed pa lta ci smos te/ lha'i dbang po sems can de ni sems can chen por rig par bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sras su rig par bya'o/ /chos kyi (6)gnas su rig par bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten du rig par bya'o/ /de nas chos kyi (7rgyal po gshin rje nub mo nam langs nas / bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song steni/ bcom ldan 'das la lha'i me tog dang / gos dang / rgyan la sogs pas mchod pa dang / bsti po)stang byas nas / des bcom ldan 'das la lan bdun bskor ba byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la gtugs nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gzungs 'di ni mthu che zhing phan yon che ba lags te/ bcom ldan 'das bdag kyang rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad tu )par sems can de'i slad bzhin du yoskre'abrang zhing kun du bsrung kyi ba dang / yongs su bskyab pa'i slad du gnas par bgyi'o/ /sems can dmyal ba thams cad las de bzlog par bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag ni byas pa gzo (/stebar bgyid cing / byas pa mi gzo 8bar mi bgyid do/ /de 90—812

nas rgyal po chen po bzhis bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas te/bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gzungs 'di'i cho ga zhib mo dang / bgyi ba'i cho ga'i 6)tshul rgyas par bshad du gsol/de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po chen po ②bzhi po dag la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /nyon cig dang gzungs 'di'i bya ba'i tshul bshad par bya'o/ /sems can tshe thung ba'i don gyi phyir rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mos tshes bcwa lnga'i ③zla ba nya ba la khrus byas te lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod byas na des sems can tshe zad pa de'i tshe phyir nur nas nad thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur ro / /sgrib pa thams cad rnam par dag pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /sems can dmyal ba la sogs pa ngan 'gro thams cad las yongs su thar bar 'gyur ro/ /tha na dud 'gro'i skye gnas su song ba'i srog chags bya'i rna lam du gzungs 'di'i sgra bsgrags ④par bya ste/ des ni de'i ngan 'gro'i tha ma yin par rig par bya'o/ /gang zhig nad chen pos btab ste ⑤sman pa rnams kyis 6)bye brag 6)phye ba de yang nad de las yongs su thar bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i ngan 'gror skye ba thams cad kyang rgyun chad par 'gyur ro/ /shi 'phos nas kyang 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de nyid de'i mngal gyi gnas tha ma yin par rig par bya'o / /gang dang gang du skyes pa de dang der padma'i snying po kho na las brdzus te skye bar 'gyur ro/ /tshe rabs (kyithams cad du yang tshe rabs dran par 'gyur ro/ /sems can sdig pa byed pa gang dag shi ba'i dus byas pa de dag gi don du gzungs yungs kur 6)dag la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig yongs su brjod de/ de dag gi rus gong rnams kyi steng du gtor na de dag dmyal ba'am/ dud 'gro'i skye 90—813

gnas sam/ gshin rje'i 'jig rten nam0)/ yi dgas sam/ de las gzhan ngan 'gro rnams su skyes par (2)gyur kyang rung ste/ de dag gzungs 'di'i mthus ngan 'gro de dag las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /de dag las thar nas kyang lhar skye bar 'gyur ro/ /su zhig 'di nyin gcig bzhin du lan nyi shu rtsa re re ①yongs su brjod pa de 'jig rten mang po'i mchod pa'i 'os su 'gyur ro/ /tshe ring bar 'gyur ro/ /bde ba myong bar 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu spro ba dang ldan pa dang / mya ngan las 'das pa chen po thob par 'gyur ro/ /shi 'phos nas kyang 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas kyang sangs rgyas kyi zhing tha dad pa sna tshogs su yongs su ༅'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /der yang de bzhin gshegs pa ris)thams cad dang phrad par 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis kyang dbugs 'byin par 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis lung ston par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du yang 'jig rten la (6)snang bar byed par 'gyur ro/ /lha'i dbang po thabs 'dis ni 'gro ba thams cad kyang sems can dmyal ba la sogs pa'i 'gro ba thams cad las yongs su thar bar 'gyur ro/ /de dag gis (7)'gro ba thams (87cad kyang yongs su dag cing tshe ring bar yang 'gyur ro/ /lha'i dbang po song la lha'i bu blo gros shin tu brtan pa la gzungs 'di rjes su ston la sgrogs shig /lha'i dbang po des na zhag bdun na lha'i bu shin tu brtan pa'i 'gro ba thams cad yongs su dag cing tshe ring bar 'gyur ro/ /stobs che bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis de bzhin gshegs pa las 6)rjes su bstan pa 'di blangs te/ de'i gnas su phyin nas lha'i bu shin tu brtan pa la gzungs 'di byin no/ /de nas 90wa 814
